original: {FLAVOR}Ail-mint is quick to state that poison should not be taken internally. Or externally, for that matter. Really, just leave it alone. It's poison!
translation: {FLAVOR}衰薄已经说得很清楚了，它的“药”不应该内服，连外用也不行。因为它是毒药！

translation: 衰薄可以使所有僵尸中毒，并暂时加强草坪上所有的衰薄家族植物。

translation: 阿开木-木可以投掷在僵尸间来回弹跳的导弹。

original: {FLAVOR}Aloe likes to soothe. He likes to alleviate, he likes to restore, he likes to mend. But don't ask him to revive. He's touchy about revival.
translation: {FLAVOR}芦荟喜欢抚慰受伤的人，无论是帮你包扎体伤，还是治愈心伤。但记住，别和他提关于复活的事，他一听到这两个字就变脸。

original: Aloe heals injured plants to their immediate right when that plant is below a certain amount of health.
translation: 芦荟可以在右边植物的生命值低于一定水平时治疗它。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Instantly heal every plant in the surrounding radius.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}立即治愈周围的所有植物。

original: {FLAVOR}Appease-mint takes great umbrage at the notion that he might back down from a fight. "Yes, my name is 'Appease-mint,' but that has more to do with my affinity towards peas than any disinclination to stand up for my beliefs. Rescind your vile calumny this instant, lest I compose a blistering letter of outrage!"
translation: {FLAVOR}一想到有人说他会在战场上喷人，喷薄就会很生气。“没错，我的名字是叫‘喷薄’，但不是因为我是喷子啊，那是因为我的攻击方式像是一把喷子！所以，现在请收回你的诽谤，免得我对你写一封更加愤怒的控诉信！”

original: Appease-mints fire a volley of huge peas that break into smaller peas and provide a temporary boost to all Appease-mint Family plants on the lawn.
translation: 喷薄可以喷出许多能破裂成小豌豆的大豌豆，并暂时加强草坪上所有喷薄家族的植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: {FLAVOR}Apple Mortar stuns three zombies dead in their tracks. SPAF! That'll show 'em! That'll show ALL of them!
translation: {FLAVOR}苹果迫击炮让三只僵尸在路上晕死了。太强了，有被他装到！真的有被他装到！

original: Apple Mortars lob apple cores that damage and briefly stun zombies over three lanes.
translation: 苹果迫击炮可以投掷苹果核，眩晕三条路上的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs large apples at every zombie on the lawn, dealing damage and temporarily stunning them.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向草坪上的所有僵尸投出大号的苹果，对它们造成伤害、减慢速度。

original: Lobs stunning cores down three lanes
translation: 向三行投掷带眩晕效果的果核

translation: 需要访问商店下载最新版本才能继续游玩

original: {FLAVOR} Once during its regular morning jog, Aqua Vine tied a taco to the end of a string in the hopes of getting Dave to exercise. Who knew Dave could be so fast?
translation: {FLAVOR} 某天早上，绿水藤蔓照常去晨跑。它用一根绳子绑住一块玉米卷，想着能不能让戴夫也跟着一起做运动。结果谁知道戴夫居然可以跑这么快！

original: An amphibious plant that can support both ground and water type plants. Its abilities will change based on the type plant it is host to.
translation: 两栖植物，无论植物是陆生还是水生，它都能为其提供辅助。寄生在不同类型的植物身上，其能力也会有所不同。

original: Aqua Vine can support ground type plants in water and water type plants on ground. Use this versatility to optimize your plant placement.
translation: 无论是水面上的陆生植物，还是陆地上的水生植物，绿水藤蔓都能为其提供辅助。灵活利用这样的多功能性，优化你的植物布阵。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Attracts zombies and then blasts them away with a jet of water.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}吸引僵尸，随后喷出水柱将其吹飞。

original: Amphibious support plant, with a powerful water jet.
translation: 两栖辅助类植物，拥有强力喷水管。

original: Unlock Power Ups to use in Endless!
translation: 在无尽模式解锁金手指！

original: Play Arena matches to earn mints! Mints can be used to acquire mint-family plants and give you the edge in Adventure and Arena!/r
translation: 参加竞技场比赛，获取薄荷糖！你可以通过薄荷糖来得到薄荷家族植物，使你在冒险模式和竞技场中占据优势！/r

original: {FLAVOR}"Lobbing projectiles, for me, has always been a very personal endeavor," says Arma-mint. "It's a great way for me to express myself, my identity, and my preference that zombies be defeated in large groups."
translation: {FLAVOR}“我觉得吧，投掷子弹这件事是一种对个体自身很有用的努力。”重荷说：“它可以很好地表达自己、彰显个性，以及表明我喜欢一次击败一大群僵尸。”

original: Arma-mints launch a volley of heavy stunning projectiles and provide a temporary boost to all Arma-mint Family plants on the lawn.
translation: 重荷可以发射大量重弹丸，并暂时加强草坪上所有重荷家族的植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

translation: 成功注册账户后，每个档案都能获得奖励！

你的{PLANT}得到了一件新装扮！
成为提基文明传承者的通行证！

original: Access to the Big Bad Butte!
Access to the Pyramid of Doom!
translation: 进入厄运金字塔的通行证！

original: Survive level after level of escalating zombie attacks. Test your skills in this Endless Zone.
translation: 随着关卡的推进，僵尸的进攻会越来越激烈。试着在无尽模式中生存下来，考验你的技术吧。
进入冰封战场的通行证！

original: Access to Highway to the Danger Room!

translation: 窥探逝者宝藏的通行证！

original: It's an ancient key.  Now all you need is an ancient lock.
translation: 这是一个上古时代的钥匙。现在你需要一个上古时代的锁。

original: ONE OR MORE LAWN MOWERS WERE TRIGGERED!
A parchment of ancient lands, with cosmic implications.
translation: 一张来自远古土地的羊皮纸，上面预示着宇宙的奥秘。

original: Like your head is full of brains, this bag is full of coins!
translation: 这个袋子里装满了硬币，就像你的脑袋里装满了脑子一样！

original: Coins, coins, coins! For all your Power Up and Plant Food needs!
translation: 硬币，硬币，硬币！让你植物养料、金手指使用随心！

original: It's better than a bag of imps, there are coins!
translation: 袋子里装满了硬币，至少比装一袋子小鬼要好！

original: Sorry, your epic bag of infinite coins was on another zombie.
translation: 真遗憾，那个有无限硬币的袋子在另一只僵尸身上。

original: A coin in the bag is way better than looking a gift zombie in the mouth.
translation: 看到袋子里的是硬币，可比从袋口看到礼物僵尸好多了。
你得到了一个新的升级道具！

original: Use only in a jam. Do not use if quality seal is broken.
translation: 只能在罐子中使用。如果密封不严实，请勿使用。

translation: 你现在可以享受巨浪海滩的海滨假日了。

translation: 你现在可以感受狂野西部的漫天黄沙了。

translation: 你现在可以感受黑暗时代的封建社会了。

translation: 用来解锁新的世界，穿越到其他时空！

translation: 你现在可以遭遇侏罗纪沼泽的蜥蜴危机了。

original: You have secured access to the urgent rhythms of the Neon Mixtape Tour.
translation: 你现在可以感受炫光魔音游的跃动节拍了。

original: You have secured access to the technological conundrum of the Far Future.
translation: 你现在可以预见遥远未来的技术瓶颈了。

original: You have secured access to chilling enclosure of the Frostbite Caves.
translation: 你现在可以面对极寒冰窟的凛冽寒风了。

translation: 你现在可以探寻失落之城的神秘遗迹了。

translation: 你现在可以回到现代年华的平凡生活了。

translation: 你现在可以体验海盗港湾的海盗生活了。

original: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss' creation, the Zombot Sphinx-inator.
translation: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，狮身终结者僵尸机器人。

original: You have defeated Dr. Zomboss’ creation, the Zombot Multi-stage Masher.
translation: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，狂舞碎灭者僵尸机器人。

translation: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，明日破译者僵尸机器人。

translation: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，獠牙驯服者 10000 BC 僵尸机器人。

translation: 你击败了僵王博士的造物，飞艇浮船僵尸机器人。

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Bamboo Spartan enters a Battle Trance once his shield shatters, increasing his damage.

{FLAVOR}“For Tacos and Liberty! Scratch that... for TACOOS!!”
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}斯笆达可以在护盾破碎后进入“战斗恍惚”状态，提升它的攻击力。

{FLAVOR}“为了玉米卷和自由！算了……为了玉米卷!!”

original: A Fierce Bamboo Warrior that can withstand massive damage. When his shield breaks, his attacks will deal even more damage.
translation: 一位骁勇善战的竹战士，可以承受大量伤害。护盾破碎后，他的每次攻击都能造成更多伤害。

original: Bamboo Spartan can give and take a lot of punishment, making him a very effective frontliner.
translation: 斯笆达既可以惩戒敌人，也能承受住敌人的猛击，真是一位出色的前线。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Slams its Spear to knockback zombies multiple times.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}砸下长矛，多次击退僵尸。

original: Tanky Melee Plant that can hit Zombies upto 2 tiles away.
translation: 高生命值近战植物，最多可以把僵尸击退 2 格地砖。

original: {FLAVOR}It's important to avoid stereotyping as much as possible. Stereotypes are often flat-out wrong. And also hurtful. But honestly ... Banana Launcher is TOTALLY bananas.
translation: {FLAVOR}尽自己所能地去避免刻板印象十分重要。因为它们很多时候根本不正确，而且还很伤人。但是……香蕉火箭炮确实是香蕉。

original: Banana Launchers can fire explosive bananas at any tile on the lawn.
translation: 香蕉火箭炮可以向草坪上的任何一块地砖上发射爆炸香蕉。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches four explosive bananas that target random zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向随机僵尸发射四枚爆炸香蕉。

original: Tap on banana, then a tile, to launch explosive banana
translation: 轻点香蕉，再轻点一块地砖，即可发射爆炸香蕉弹

original: {FLAVOR}With multiple advanced degrees in Botany and Space-Time Relativity, no one will argue that Bean Sprout is a plant genius. Which makes it incredibly difficult for him to watch Dave work in his kitchen. “No... No... Why are you doing that?!? Don’t cut the Red wires!”
translation: {FLAVOR}持有多个植物学、时空相对论的高级学位，豆芽是一位植物天才，毋庸置疑。所以，在看到戴夫在厨房里折腾的时候，他非常难以忍受。“不……不……你为什么要这样?!? 不要剪红色的线啊！”

original: Mild mannered Wall plant with a dark monstrous side. When Bean Sprout takes too much damage, it transforms into a fist swinging monster.
translation: 豆芽是一株表面温文尔雅，内心却黑暗恐怖的屏障类植物。当受到太多伤害时，它会摇身一变成为一个挥舞拳头的怪物。

original: Planting another Bean Sprout on an existing one, will force him into its monster form.
translation: 在一株豆芽上方再叠种一株，即可强制激活它的怪物形态。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT} Transforms into its monster form, if it wasn’t already, and sends massive shockwaves both in front and behind him.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT} 如果还有没变身的话，则转变为怪物形态，随后同时向前、后方发射一阵强力冲击波。

original: Wall plant that transforms into a monster when taking damage.
translation: 屏障类植物，受到伤害变身怪物。

original: {FLAVOR}Blastberry Vine snickers to himself. He imagines lobbing bomblets. He’s been reading up on it and he knows it’s gonna make a big splash when it happens. “Soon,” he whispers.
translation: {FLAVOR} 爆莓藤蔓时常在那里自娱自乐。最近，他就在想象自己可以投射炸弹。他看了很多关于这个的书，知道自己一旦练成，一定会惹所有人的注目。“很快，我就能……”他小声喃喃道。

original: Blastberry Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide increased defense and an additional attack in the form of lobbed projectiles that break into explosive bomblets.
translation: 爆莓藤蔓可以种在其他植物上面，增强他们的攻击和防御，还可以发射子弹，这些子弹会分裂成小子弹然后爆炸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches a barrage of explosive berries at zombies in its column.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向所在排的僵尸发射一连串的爆炸莓果。
保护其他植物，同时投射炸弹

original: {FLAVOR}Blast Spinner suddenly showed up on the lawn one day, eager to join the fight against Dr. Zomboss. Even after multiple attempts, neither Penny nor Dave are any closer in determining where she is from. The one thing Penny can conclude is that she must be from a world in an uncharted part of Space-Time.
translation: {FLAVOR}不知哪天，爆网织株突然空降到草坪上，渴求加入反抗僵王博士的队伍。潘妮和戴夫屡次试图寻找她的来历，但最终都以失败告终。不过潘妮可以断定一点：她肯定来自时空中不为人知的那部分世界。

original: Lobs immobilizing, sticky webs at zombies on adjacent lanes. Affected zombies may be turned into cocoons that will explode and deal damage to all surrounding zombies.
translation: 向周围行的僵尸投掷黏性蛛网，将其定住。被命中的僵尸有概率化为可以爆炸的茧，爆炸后对周围的所有僵尸造成伤害。

original: It takes a few seconds for Blast Spinner’s cocoons to explode, clump zombies up to maximize the damage potential.
translation: 爆网织株的茧得过几秒才会爆炸，把僵尸聚在一起，最大利用爆炸造成的伤害。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple web cocoons at nearby zombies, turning them into explosive cocoons.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向周围的僵尸发射数枚茧囊，将其变为可以爆炸的茧。

original: Immobilizes zombies using webs and explosive cocoons.
translation: 使用蛛网、爆炸茧囊定住僵尸。

original: {FLAVOR}"Hey, guys! Blockoli here! What's goin' on? Here comes a zombie! I'm gonna SLAM 'IM! With FISTS!" says Blockoli. And he really means it!
translation: {FLAVOR}“嘿，老铁们！西拦花在此！咋地了？有僵尸啊！看我把他揍得满地找牙！”然后，他还真就这么干了！

original: Blockoli dual-wields two sturdy floret shields, slamming them down to stun and block approaching zombies.
translation: 西拦花双持坚固的花盾，猛击下来，眩晕、阻挡接近的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Swings his florets around dealing damage and stunning Zombies in the surrounding area. Gain two iron shields that can absorb a large amount of damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}挥动他的小花茎，对周围的僵尸造成伤害、产生眩晕效果。随后获得两面可以阻挡大量伤害的铁盾。

original: {FLAVOR}As the first new member to your home defense team, Bloomerang enjoys long walkabouts with his friend, Koala Bear, and listening to his Bob Barley albums out back.
translation: {FLAVOR}作为脑子守卫团的第一位新成员，回旋花喜欢和他的朋友考拉熊一起回到丛林中去感受自然。在往返的途中，当然还是鲍勃·贝利的专辑与他作伴。

original: Bloomerangs can hit multiple targets in their lane, twice each coming and going!
translation: 回旋花可以攻击一行上的数个目标，并且一来一回攻击两次。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throws boomerangs in four directions damaging all zombies in the area.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向上、下、左、右投掷大量回旋镖，对区域内的所有僵尸造成伤害。

original: Throws many boomerangs that hit all the zombies to the left, right, above, and below.
translation: 向上、下、左、右四个方向发射回旋镖攻击僵尸。

original: Hits up to three targets in its lane, twice
translation: 最多击中行内的三个目标，伤害两次

original: {FLAVOR}Blooming Heart loves zombies. She gets guff from her fellow plants over it, but she stands firm. She's into zombies and makes no apologies about it.
translation: {FLAVOR}铃儿草深爱着僵尸。尽管她总是因此被她的植物伙伴恶语相向，但这依然改变不了她的观点。她就是这么爱僵尸，而爱不需要道歉。

original: Blooming Hearts lob projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing increasing damage the more they hit.
translation: 铃儿草可以投掷令僵尸迷恋的心之蕊，僵尸被攻击的次数越多，受到的伤害越大。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throw large projectiles at every zombie, dealing massive damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向每只僵尸投掷大号子弹，造成大量伤害。

original: Lobs projectiles that do more damage the more they hit
translation: 向僵尸投掷心之蕊，僵尸受击次数越多，受到的伤害越大

original: {FLAVOR}The luckiest stunt clover around, Blover is the most recent recipient of the Stunty Award. You can see his work in "Bulb Fiction," "Rooty," and "Finding Flower." He also teaches a stunt class on Tuesdays at the community center.
translation: {FLAVOR}他是最幸运的三叶草，就在不久前，他还刚被授予了“最佳特技奖”的荣誉。他的特技表演家喻户晓，像是《球茎小说》、《寻根究底》、《找花》等大作中都有他的身影。不仅如此，每周二他还在社区中心讲授一门有关特技技巧的课程。

original: Blovers blow away all zombies in the air.
translation: 三叶草可以吹走在空中的僵尸。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Blows away all flying and floating zombies
translation: 吹走所有飞行或飘浮着的僵尸

original: {FLAVOR}Boingsetta's a springy plant whose positive outlook is infectiously delightful! The chilling effect is merely a secondary consequence.
translation: {FLAVOR}一品轰其实是一株富有春意的植物，她积极的态度很令人愉快！不过她同时也能给予僵尸如寒冬般的感受。

original: Boingsettas slam the ground in a "boing" that heavily damages grid items, bounces zombies back and chills them.
translation: 一品轰可以“轰”地一声猛击地面上的障碍物，击退僵尸，并让它们冷缓。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Deal heavy damage to all obstacles and slight damage to all zombies, knocking them back and chilling them for a short duration.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}对所有障碍物造成大量伤害，对所有僵尸造成轻微伤害，随后将它们击退一段距离，并使其获得一段时间的冷缓效果。

original: {FLAVOR}"Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."
translation: {FLAVOR}“爆炸真的很有意思，”爆薄眼里闪着调皮的光说到：“在消灭僵尸的过程中，一串接着一串的爆炸不仅让僵尸都灰飞烟灭，还能带来一股迷人的芬芳——那是胜利的味道。”

original: Bombard-mints set off a number of explosions on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
translation: 爆薄可以在草坪上制造数次爆炸，并暂时加强草坪上所有的爆薄家族植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: {FLAVOR}Bombegranate is explosive, but she likes to think there's more to her than that. She's also deciduous and exarillate!
translation: {FLAVOR}炸弹石榴极具爆炸性，但是她觉得还应该有更多的词来描述她。好吧，她也是一种落叶植物，并且没有假种皮！

original: Bombegranates explode and leave 3x3 grids of exploding seeds that damage zombies.
translation: 爆炸石榴可以在 3x3 的范围内爆炸，并留下会爆炸的种子对僵尸造成伤害。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。
爆炸后留下会爆炸的种子

original: {FLAVOR}A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out for the price of one!
translation: {FLAVOR}作为一个兼职牙医，他在这个月开出了一个优惠 - 拔牙拔一送一！

original: Bonk Choys rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.
translation: 拳击白菜可以快速攻击前后的敌人。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Rapidly punches in a 3x3 area around it, dealing heavy damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}在它周围的 3x3 区域快速出拳，造成大量伤害。

original: Attacks with a flurry of fists, doing massive damage to anything on nearby tiles.
translation: 打出一连串重拳，对附近地砖上的任何东西造成极高伤害。

original: Rapidly punches enemies ahead or behind
translation: 快速拳击前后方的敌人

original: {FLAVOR}“How to make the best explosions! First fuel. Mix in a spark and an oxidizing agent. Finally, you’ll need Me!”
translation: {FLAVOR}“怎样制造一场最绝妙的爆炸？首先，加入燃料，把它和火花、氧化物充分混合。然后，你需要我！”

original: Launches explosive berries at the last zombie in its lane, stunning them for a short time.
translation: 向所在行的最后一只僵尸发射可以爆炸的莓果，令其短暂眩晕。

original: Especially effective against Zcorpion, Octo and Wizard zombies.
translation: 对投石机、章鱼、巫师僵尸格外有效。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple projectiles, blanketing the target column with explosive berries.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射数枚子弹，用可以爆炸的莓果盖满目标排。

original: Launches explosive berries at the last zombie in its lane.
translation: 向所在行的最后一只僵尸发射可以爆炸的莓果。

original: {FLAVOR}Boom Balloon Flower's balloons are inflated with hydrogen and aerosolized kerosene. It's an anti-safety measure.
translation: {FLAVOR}爆炸气球花的气球里充满了氢气和雾化煤油气，十分危险！

original: Boom Balloon Flowers spawn exploding balloons that can be placed anywhere on the lawn as traps for zombies.
translation: 爆炸气球花可以在草坪上的任何地方生成一个爆炸气球，气球会在僵尸接近时爆炸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spawns a giant Doom-shroom balloon named the "Doom Balloon", that will explode once it reaches the fifth column.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}生成一枚巨大的毁灭菇气球——“毁灭气球”，达到第五排后即可爆炸。

original: This plant is already boosted! Use it in a level!
translation: 这株植物已经强化过了！先用一次吧！
击败的僵尸会掉落硬币
免费获得植物养料效果

original: Zombies defeated by this plant drop coins. This boost lasts for 1 level.
translation: 强化后，被该植物击败的僵尸将会掉落硬币。该强化只在 1 关内有效。

original: Extra protection from zombies. This boost lasts for 1 level.
translation: 强化后，该植物将拥有更高的生命值。该强化只在 1 关内有效。

original: Recharges more quickly. This boost lasts for 1 level.
translation: 强化后，该植物的冷却时间将会变短。该强化只在 1 关内有效。

original: Gets free Plant Food effect when planted. This boost lasts for 1 level.
translation: 强化后，该植物将在种植时免费获得一次植物养料效果。该强化只在 1 关内有效。

original: Attacks at a faster rate. This boost lasts for 1 level.
translation: 强化后，该植物的攻击速度将会得到提升。该强化只在 1 关内有效。

original: Explodes when shoveled. This boost lasts for 1 level.
translation: 强化后，该植物被铲除时将会发生爆炸。该强化只在 1 关内有效。

original: Costs less sun to plant. This boost lasts for 1 level.
translation: 强化后，种植该植物将花费更少的阳光。该强化只在 1 关内有效

original: Inflicts up to {DAMAGE} damage to bosses every {TIME} seconds!
translation: 每 {TIME} 秒对 BOSS 造成高达 {DAMAGE} 的伤害！

original: {FLAVOR}Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah, sure. Keep dreamin, bub.
translation: {FLAVOR}猜猜是哪一支球队又一次夺冠，并且已经守擂五年了？保鳞茎队，毫无悬念。他们现在的名气可以说是滔滔“滚滚”了。你觉得自己能击败他们？继续做梦吧，小子。

original: Bowling Bulbs roll shots that can bounce into multiple zombies.The Larger bulbs deal more damage.
translation: 保鳞茎可以发射在数只僵尸间弹射的滚动子弹。鳞茎越大，破坏力越大。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots three charged explosive bulbs at zombies, dealing heavy damage. Waits until zombies appear on the lawn before shooting.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向僵尸发射三枚可以爆炸的充能鳞茎，造成巨大伤害。可以等到僵尸出现在草坪上后再发射。

original: Rolls bouncing shots that can hit multiple zombies
translation: 滚出可反弹的子弹，击中数只僵尸

original: {FLAVOR}Bramble Bush is a prickly sort. In fact, let's not beat around the Bramble Bush here; he's covered in extraordinarily dangerous spikes.
translation: {FLAVOR}莓棘灌木丛浑身上下都是刺，非常危险——险象“丛”生。

original: Bramble Bush traps and damages a zombie. The berry clusters show the number of traps remaining.
translation: 莓棘灌木丛可以困住僵尸，并对它们造成伤害。莓果簇的数量表示还剩多少个陷阱。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Regenerate all of his berry traps and trap the leftmost zombie in his column, dealing 2x damage for a short duration.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}重生所有的莓果陷阱，并将所在排最左边的僵尸困住，在短时间内造成 2 倍伤害。
困住僵尸，并对它们造成伤害

original: {FLAVOR}Bud'uh Boom's buttery obsession always had him on a hair trigger, but when Zomboss served up "You-can't-believe-it's-not-butter!" – it was poppin' pandemonium on the lawn! Now, he's ready to butter up zombies and explode with boiling, buttery, BOOM!
translation: {FLAVOR}爆浆玉露对黄油无比痴迷，光是轻轻提一嘴黄油的不好，就能让他顺间警觉。但在僵王推出了“鬼都不信这不是黄油!”牌人造黄油后——他终于忍不下去了，整个草坪都淹没在他含怒喷涌出的黄油之下。如今，他已整装待发，要把真正的黄油糊在僵尸脸上，用爆汁、爆浆的爆炸，向它们发起警示！

original: An over-pressurized bulb of boiling butter, this instant plant will go BOOM! Burning away zombies around it and flinging blobs of butter across the lawn, stunning any zombie unfortunate to be caught in its shower of buttery goop.
translation: 一颗加压过度的鳞茎，里面装满了沸腾的黄油。一种下去，就会瞬间爆浆！焚灭周围的僵尸，并向草坪各处扔出黄油，眩晕任何待在黄油雨中的倒霉僵尸。

original: Bud’uh Boom makes short work of clumped up zombies. Level it up to increase the amount of butter traps he will fling around the board.
translation: 爆浆玉露可以轻松处理聚在一起的尸群。升级可以提高它向场上扔出的黄油陷阱的数量。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT} 没有植物养料效果。

original: Deals massive damage in an area and leaves behind butter trap tiles.
translation: 在一定范围内造成大量伤害，随后留下黄油陷阱地砖。
200 包悬浮洋芋种子 + 50 颗宝石 + 5000 枚硬币
200 包超级机枪种子 + 50 颗宝石 + 5000 枚硬币
原始土豆地雷协作捆绑包
僵王斗兽场种子捆绑包

original: {FLAVOR}Buttercup's sweet as can be, but she packs a wallop! "I'm not cheap," she says, referring to her flat 25 sun cost. "I'm reasonable."
translation: {FLAVOR}黄油毛茛虽然很便宜——只需要花费 25 阳光，但她其实非常厉害！“啥叫便宜啊？”她反驳说，“这明明是‘物美价廉’好吗！”

original: Buttercup butters butter onto attacking zombies, stunning them with butter. Butter!
translation: 黄油毛茛可以往攻击她的僵尸脸上砸黄油，让它们被黄油眩晕。黄油，永远的神！

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Throws butter immediately in front of her, dealing damage and stunning zombies for a long duration.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}立即向她前方投掷黄油，对僵尸造成伤害，产生长时间的眩晕效果。
往攻击她的僵尸脸上砸黄油

original:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}on being eaten/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}eating zombie has the Electrified Condition applied to it/r
{KEYWORD}Electrified Condition: {STAT}Electrified Zombies are slowed down and take damage over time. They periodically shoot Arc Lighting at nearby Zombies./r
{KEYWORD}Charged Condition: {STAT}Zombies hit with Arc Lightning from Electrified Zombies will get the Charged Status applied to them, slowing them down for a brief period/r
{FLAVOR}He’s about to pop!
translation:
{KEYWORD}使用：{STAT}被吃掉时生效/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}吃掉他的僵尸会获得通电状态/r
{KEYWORD}通电状态：{STAT}获得通电状态的僵尸会受到减速效果，并随着时间的推移受到伤害。每隔一段时间它们还会向周围的僵尸发射弧光。/r
{KEYWORD}带电状态：{STAT}通电的僵尸发射弧光击中另一只僵尸后，被击中的僵尸会获得带电状态，在短时间内减速。/r
{FLAVOR}他快爆炸了！

original: When eaten, Bzzz Buttons Electrifies the Zombie, damaging it over time and slowing it down. Electrified zombies shoot Lighting at other nearby zombies.
translation: 被吃掉时，电鸣金纽扣会让吃掉他的僵尸获得通电状态，随着时间的推移对其造成伤害，同时降低其速度。通电的僵尸会向周围的其他僵尸发射弧光。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Detonate and ELECTRIFIES all zombies in a 3x3 area.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}在前方 3x3 的范围内产生爆炸，使其中所有僵尸获得通电效果。

original: When eaten, Bzzz Button damages and slows bunched up Zombies
translation: 电鸣金纽扣可以在被吃掉时伤害、减速尸群

original: {FLAVOR}Cabbage-pult received his doctorate in pulting from Harvest University. He knows a thing or two about launching his way to the top. He also makes a mean soup.
translation: {FLAVOR}卷心菜投手曾在草稻田大学荣获投手学博士学位。关于怎样过上一掷千金的生活，他也是略知一二。不仅如此，卷心菜做的汤也很好喝。

original: Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.
translation: 卷心菜投手可以向敌人投掷卷心菜。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple cabbages at every zombie, dealing heavy damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向每只僵尸投掷数颗卷心菜，造成大量伤害。

original: Hits every zombie on the lawn with a large cabbage.
translation: 用大卷心菜攻击草坪上的每只僵尸。

original: Hurls cabbages over obstacles at the enemy
translation: 越过障碍物向敌人投掷卷心菜

original: {FLAVOR}Things have really changed for Cactus lately. Book deals, movies, truck show appearances... she’s just trying to focus on staying humble and launching thorns like always.
translation: {FLAVOR}最近仙人掌的生活真的变了很多。售书会，电影，卡车秀……她只是想像往常一样去扎人。

original: Cactus fires a penetrating thorn that can damage multiple enemies! Hides underground when zombies are close. Can stretch up and pop balloon zombies.
translation: 仙人掌可以用尖刺穿透数名敌人！当僵尸接近时，可以藏在地下发动攻击。可以伸长身体扎破气球僵尸的气球。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Permanently increases piercing power and damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}永久提升穿刺能力和伤害。

original: Fires a penetrating thorn, hides for ground damage
translation: 发射可以穿透的刺，有僵尸靠近时会藏起来从地面造成伤害

original: Daily rewards is currently unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
translation: 日常奖励目前不可用。请过几分钟再来试试吧。

original: You have already claimed this reward. The next reward is at {DATETIME}.
translation: 你已经领取过这份奖励了。下一次奖励将在 {DATETIME}发放。

original: Please collect the reward from the previous tab first.
translation: 请先收集上一个标签页的奖励。

original: Yowsers, your calendar streak's at risk! Spend gems to keep it?
translation: 兄弟，你的连续签到快要中断了！要花点宝石来保留它吗？

original:
- Earn rewards each day by opening Plants vs Zombies 2!/r
- Earn extra rewards during Seasonal Events./r

translation:
- 每天登陆《植物大战僵尸 2》，赢取丰厚奖励！/r
- 在赛季活动期间获得额外奖励！/r
- 此功能需要互联网连接。/r

original: Tap on a zombie to flip its panel
translation: 轻点任意一只僵尸，翻转它手里的卡牌

original: Great! Now tap on another one
translation: 干得漂亮！现在试试轻点另一个

original: Awesome! Keep matching symbols to win the game
translation: 好样的！继续配对这些符号，赢得游戏

original: Tap on the coconut cannon to make it fire
translation: 轻点椰子加农炮让它开火

original: Great! Now blow up as many zombies as you can
translation: 棒极了！现在尽你所能击败僵尸吧！
iOS《植物大战僵尸 2》硬币商店
iOS《植物大战僵尸 2》地图商店

original: {FLAVOR}Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.
translation: {FLAVOR}超能花菜的眼睛因为焦虑而旋转。他刚刚为自己的小说想到了一个很棒的结局，不过他害怕自己的表哥不能理解。

original: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
translation: 超能花菜可以使用他们的精神攻击来催眠僵尸，使其变成我们的友军。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Tosses 5 random zombies off the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机将 5 只僵尸甩出草坪。

original: We need to update game data. This may take a short while. The game will return to the Main Menu when the update is complete.
translation: 我们需要更新游戏数据，这可能会花一点时间。更新完成后，游戏将返回到主菜单。

original: Downloading update data. The game will return to the Main Menu when the download is complete.
translation: 正在下载更新数据。下载完成后，游戏将返回主菜单。

original: The download has been disabled. Try again later.
translation: 下载功能已禁用。请稍后再试。

original: There is an error with the download. Try again later.
There is already a download in progress.
translation: 已经有一个下载进程了。

original: You can retry the download, or cancel and not proceed to the feature.
translation: 你可以重新尝试，也可以取消下载，放弃这项功能。

/r
{FLAVOR}Celery Stalker resents the implication that there’s anything unsavory about his attack style. He simply believes that discretion is the better part of vegetation.
translation:
/r
{FLAVOR}潜伏芹菜对那些暗示他攻击方式不光彩的人感到不满。他只是觉得小心驶得万年船罢了。

original: Celery Stalkers wait until zombies pass, then pop up and bash them from behind.
translation: 潜伏芹菜等僵尸经过他之后，突然跳起在僵尸背后偷袭。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself to full and spawns three Celery Stalker.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}治愈自己，并生成三株潜伏芹菜。

original: Pops up and bashes zombies from behind
translation: 钻出地面并从后方猛击僵尸

original: Do you want to use cellular data to download additional content? You can change this setting in the options menu later.
translation: 你想要使用蜂窝数据来下载额外内容吗？你可以随时在设置中改变这一设定。
摧毁 {GRID_ITEMS} 根治疗师蛇杖

original: {FLAVOR}You might remember Chard Guard from his days in the WWF (that's World Wrestling Foliage). When he was in the ring – boy-oh-boy – he was something to behold! His moves! His style! His attitude! The crowd loved him. He was quite the star for a while there. Sure, those days are behind him. But if you watch carefully, when Chard Guard is fighting zombies, you'll see him use the wrestling move he made famous. The ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver – it gets 'em every time.
translation: {FLAVOR}你还记得甜菜护卫在 WWF 的日子吧（指世界摔跤树叶联盟）。他还在拳击场上的时候，我的天，没有人不被他威猛的身姿所吸引！他的动作！他的身姿！他的态度！观众爱他都爱疯了。他曾一度是那里的明星。当然，现在已经物是人非了。但如果你仔细观察甜菜护卫与僵尸战斗的话，你都能看到他使用自己的招牌动作——“夺命撂倒”，无比传统，却又无比有用。

original: Chard Guards are defensive blockers that can hurl zombies backwards.
translation: 甜菜护卫擅长防御僵尸，可以把僵尸扔回去。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Regenerates leaves and hurls zombies in front, dealing a small amount of damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}重生所有叶子，抛开前方的僵尸，造成少量伤害。

original: Returns to full health, then damages and pushes back zombies in 6 adjacent tiles.
translation: 恢复所有生命值，并对附近 6 块地砖上的僵尸造成伤害并击退他们。
阻碍僵尸，并将僵尸向后扔

original: {FLAVOR}The Cherry Bomb Brothers attempted to start their own band. "We tried to figure out what the sound would be, but we kept explodonating speakers, stages, fans, and of course, zombies. Look for our LP next year."
translation: {FLAVOR}樱桃炸弹兄弟曾试着组建他们的乐队。“我们明明已经在想节目内容了的，但是我们现在必须去找扩音器、舞台、粉丝以及僵尸。明年就去找人签合约吧。”

original: Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.
translation: 樱桃炸弹可以炸死一个区域内的所有僵尸。他们的保险丝很短，所以放在靠近僵尸的地方吧。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Blows up all zombies in a medium area
translation: 炸掉中等区域内的所有僵尸

original: {FLAVOR}He's not blushing, he's trying to hold it in.
translation: {FLAVOR}他并不是因为害羞才脸红，而是因为他在憋——你自己想象吧…

original: Chili Beans deliver a crippling bout of gastrointestinal distress when eaten by a zombie.
translation: 辣豆能让僵尸的肠道翻云覆雨。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches out 3 Chili Bean clones to random locations on the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向草坪的随机位置发射 3 株复制体辣豆。

original: Launches out 3 Chili Bean clones to random locations on the lawn.
translation: 向草坪上的随机位置投出 3 颗辣豆的复制体。

original: Zombies that eat it are defeated and release gas
translation: 吃掉它的僵尸会死去并释放气体

original: {FLAVOR}”Get up and freeze the day!! Chilly Pepper might look innocent and unassuming but deep down he’s cold as ice. Compare him to Jalapeño and watch him EXPLODE!”
translation: {FLAVOR}“早晨起床第一件事，冻住一切!! 寒冰辣椒看似人畜无害，内心深处却冷若冰霜。你要是把他和火爆辣椒比，那他就当场炸给你看！”

original: Chilly Pepper’s explosion deals heavy damage to zombies and radius damage to tiles in his lane freezing 3 lanes in the aftermath.
translation: 寒冰辣椒的爆炸可以对僵尸造成大量伤害，并对所在行地砖上的僵尸造成范围性伤害，随后冻结 3 条路上的僵尸。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Chilly Pepper’s explosion is as destructive as he is frigid.
translation: 寒冰辣椒的爆炸破坏性极强，冷酷无比。

original: {FLAVOR}Everyone appreciates what Chomper does. His appetite has saved them on numerous occasions. But truth be told, Chomper's friends think that eating zombies is gross. And his breath! No one has the heart to tell him, and he never gets the hint when you offer him a mint.
translation: {FLAVOR}每颗植物都很感激大嘴花所做的事。他的大胃口曾拯救无数植物。但说实话，他的朋友其实觉得他吃僵尸的行为超级恶心，他嘴里呼出来的气就更别提了！大家都不好意思给他说这件事，就想着给他薄荷糖来暗示一下。但他显然从来都没有 get 到他们的意思。

original: Chompers can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.
translation: 大嘴花可以吞掉整只僵尸，但在咀嚼的时候会很脆弱。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Consumes several nearby zombies in the column, then releases a burp that knocks back any surviors.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}就近吃掉所在排的若干只僵尸，随后通过打嗝来把剩余的僵尸击退。

original: Devours a zombie, then chews on it for a while
translation: 吞下一只僵尸，然后咀嚼一段时间

original: {FLAVOR}As the owner and primary user of "Vitamin C-U-Later" 20-hour energy shots, Citron is always on and always ready for action. "Let's make this happen!!"
translation: {FLAVOR}作为“维 C 永别”号能量射击大炮的主人以及主要用户，等离子香橼时刻准备着行动。“准备好开炮吧!!”

original: Citrons shoot powerful balls of plasma.
translation: 等离子香橼可以发射威力强大的等离子球。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a giant plasma ball that can destroy most mech type zombies and flings zombies to adjacent columns.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射一枚巨大的等离子球，摧毁绝大多数的机甲类僵尸，并把僵尸扔到相邻的两排上去。
发射威力强大的等离子球

original: Collect your Daily Gift from the Store!
translation: 在商店里收集你的每日礼物！

original: Use your Arena Free Plays and get gems!
translation: 使用你的竞技场免费游玩券，赢得宝石吧！
还剩 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 张竞技场免费游玩券！
获取竞技场免费游玩券！

original: {FLAVOR}Sure, he's a hairy old man, but Coconut Cannon can still fire on all cylinders. The reason he's so hairy: he's in-between waxings.
translation: {FLAVOR}椰子加农炮虽不再年轻，却有着一头锃亮的秀发，而且他仍能在前线威震四方。至于秀发闪亮的原因，我们猜测大概是上了蜡。

original: Coconut Cannons fire down a single lane, causing a medium explosion on impact.
translation: 椰子加农炮可以向所在行开火，炮弹撞向僵尸后对僵尸造成中等的伤害。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a huge cannonball that pushes the zombies it hits to the right side of the lawn and then explodes.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射一枚大炮弹，先把僵尸推向草坪右边，随后爆炸。

original: Fires a huge cannonball that pushes the zombies it hits to the right side of the lawn and then explodes.
translation: 发射一枚巨大的炮弹，把僵尸推到草坪右边，随后爆炸。

original: Tap on the cannon to fire an explosive coconut
translation: 轻点大炮，发射会爆炸的椰子

10 包超级机枪种子 + 10 包负荷家族种子

original: You need more coins.  Choose a package below.
translation: 你需要更多硬币。在下方选择一个硬币包吧！

original: {FLAVOR}Cold Snapdragon gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin Snapdragon. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.
translation: {FLAVOR}当有人提起冰龙草的堂兄弟火龙草时，他会很生气。“我们对温度的看法非常不同，我可不想讨论这个，”他是这么说的。

original: Cold Snapdragons breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles that both slows and damage zombies.
translation: 冰龙草可以向周围的 6 块地砖吐出冰雾龙息，不仅可以对僵尸造成伤害，还能减慢它们的速度。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires an ice blast in front, dealing heavy damage and either freezing or chilling zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向前发射一股冰爆冲击，对僵尸造成大量伤害，并造成冻结或冷缓效果。

original: Breathes icy mist in an area in front of it
translation: 向前方一片区域内喷出冰雾

original: How do zombies survive on the sea? They're back on land and trying to eat your brains. You need to help save the lawn! Think of Dave!
translation: 僵尸在海上都能活下来？现在，它们重返陆地，又在对你的脑子虎视眈眈。来吧，拯救你的草坪！为了戴夫！

original: Surf's up...and so are the zombie! The Big Beach Brawl is about to roll in with the tide!
translation: 海浪正好，适合冲浪……不过僵尸也这么觉得！一同随着巨浪汹汹闹海滩！

original: Happy birthday, Plants vs Zombies! Celebrate our birthday with a new Thymed Event (so many levelz), exclusive store offers and of course, caketank!
translation: 《植物大战僵尸》生日快乐！快来参与本次的限时活动，与我们一起欢庆生日吧（超多关卡）！不仅如此，商店里还有许多限定商品。当然，也少不了蛋糕坦克！

original: Celebrate PvZ 2's birthday with an exciting all new Limited Thyme Event!
translation: 在这惊心动魄的全新的限时活动中，一起庆祝《植物大战僵尸2》的生日！

original: New zombies are coming your way - literally - defend and protect your lawn! The carnival is only available for a limited amount of time - so fight them before they move to a new backyard!
translation: 全新僵尸即将来袭，赶紧建立防线，保卫草坪吧！游乐园活动时间有限，在它们进攻别的院子前击败它们吧！

original: Deck the lawns with bites of holly – Feastivus is shambling in soon!
translation: 咬碎冬青装扮草坪——盛宴节蹒跚来临！

original: It's a harvest like no other - Join the Harvest Festival and reap the laughs!
translation: 独一无二、与众不同——一起加入丰收节，收获无穷的乐趣与欢笑！

original: Plants and zombies come together, once a year, to fight for the Golden Taco Trophy! Can you win it!?
translation: 植物、僵尸，为了闪闪发光的“金玉米卷杯”，共同角逐一年一度的草坪碗！你能把它收入囊中吗!?

original: Prepare for pumpkin-smashing, zombie-bashing fun on the Lawn of Doom!
translation: 做好准备！砸砸南瓜、打打僵尸，一同畅游末日草坪！

original: Why do zombies get all the luck?! Take them down and defend your lawn in the new Luck o' the Zombie Thymed Event! Dave's waiting for you - you're his lucky charm!
translation: 僵尸也配当幸运星？在全新的僵尸幸运星限时活动中击败它们，保卫你的草坪！来吧，向戴夫证明你才是他的幸运星！

original: Start the New Zoo Year with a Bang! Defend your lawn and check out the Zodiac plants.
translation: 玉露喷爆，新年来到！守护草坪，结识植物生肖。

original: Even Plants need training. Prepare for the next Dr. Zomboss scheme by checking out the Plant of the Week!
translation: 植物也需要训练。看看周度植物星，为僵王博士的下一个计划做好准备！

original: Let the “Experiments” begin!!! Battle through waves of zombies to earn the right to face Dr. Zomboss’s latest creations.
translation: “实验”，开始吧!!! 与一波接着一波的尸潮战斗，获取直面僵王博士最新造物的机会。

original: Only you can defeat these bunny-eared zombies! A new Thymed Event is coming your way - just in time for spring!
translation: 只有你才能打败那些戴着兔耳的僵尸！一个全新的限时活动即将随着春天的步伐到来。

original: A sunny Thymed Event is coming your way! Prepare your swimsuit, flip-flops and zombie fighting plant team!
translation: 一场阳光明媚的限时活动即将来袭！准备好你的泳衣、人字拖，组建起植物队伍与僵尸作战！

original: Descend into the tomb to explore hidden rooms, secret room and find treasures that time forgot. What exciting adventures await our Heroes? Find out in the Tombastic Adventures Event!
translation: 潜入陵墓，探寻隐密暗室、阴暗密室，发掘其中被时光忘却的宝藏。英雄们会面临怎样惊心动魄的冒险？来探陵奇遇活动中一探究竟！

original: A new plant is coming to your lawn - let's meet Tomb Tangler and see what he's all about! Can you beat this Limited Thyme Event with his help?
translation: 一株新植物即将踏上你的草坪 - 来认识认识坟墓缠绕者吧，看看他的身手如何！在他的帮助下，你有能力完成这个限时活动吗？

original: ZCorp Takeover - because even zombies need to diversify their portfolios.
translation: Z 公司大收购 - 因为就连僵尸都知道要让自己的投资多元化。

original: Is that a ship on the horizon? Arrghh it's pirates!
translation: 地平线那边是艘船吗？恶，是海盗！

original: Looks like trouble is afloat, Zombies are rolling in with the tide!
translation: 麻烦渐渐浮现，尸潮汹涌而来！

original: Happy Birthday to us! Join the revelry!
translation: 祝我们生日快乐！一同加入狂欢吧！

original: Come one, come all, to the Big Top Extravaganza Event!
translation: 大帐篷盛会活动现已开启！来者不拒！

original: Bringing Zombie tidings and Zomboss cheers – Feastivus coming soon!
translation: 僵尸成群，僵王报喜——盛宴节即将来临！

original: Its a Gourd-geous Harvest! Coming Soon.
translation: 五谷丰登大丰收！敬请期待。
球植若渴！欢迎来到草坪碗！

original: The Luck o' the Zombie is almost here!
Lunar Zoo Year will be here soon! Check back later!
translation: 笼笠新年活动即将到来！过段时间再来看看吧！

original: No time to waste, get ready for this Plant of the Week!
translation: 为这次的周度植物星做好准备，刻不容缓！

original: Battle Dr. Zomboss’s latest creations in The Zombosseum!
translation: 与僵王博士的最新造物相战僵王斗兽场！

original: Are those zombies dressed as bunnies? Precisely!
translation: 僵尸穿着兔子装？你没看错！

original: Summer break activated! Let's relax and fight some zombies!
translation: 暑假到了！放松下来，与僵尸酣战到底吧！

original: Get Ready to dive into the Tomb!!!

translation: 现在是坟墓缠绕者的主场！

original: Resumes ready? - ZCorp Takeover is looking for fresh Brainz!
translation: 简历准备好了吗？- Z 公司大收购正在招贤纳尸！

original: Treasure Yetis are overrunning Feastivus! Defeat them to win 100 Cold plant seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
translation: 盛宴节庆典怎么来了这么多宝藏雪人？击败他们，赢取 100 包冰系植物种子，并为社区挑战献力！

original: Play with Grapeshot to win 60 Grapeshot seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
translation: 试玩葡萄爆弹，赢取 60 包葡萄爆弹种子，并为社区挑战献力！
社区挑战史诗任务：葡萄爆弹！

original: Play a fresh crop of inzane, organically-grown levels and contribute to the Community Challenge!
translation: 游玩一组全新的、疯狂的、有机培植的关卡，并为社区挑战献力！
社区挑战史诗任务 - 精神错乱！

original: Play with Toadstool to win 60 Toadstool seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
translation: 试玩蟾蜍毒菌，赢取 60 包蟾蜍毒菌种子，并为社区挑战献力！
社区挑战史诗任务：蟾蜍毒菌！

original: {FLAVOR}Conceal-mint ducks ninja-like out of the party without telling a soul. "Where's Conceal-mint?" ask the other plants. They don't know. Nobody does. Conceal-mint is just that sneaky.
translation: {FLAVOR}蔽薄会像个忍者一样，悄无声息地离开聚会。“蔽薄去哪儿了？”其他植物问。是的，没有谁知道它的去处。蔽薄就是这么神神秘秘。

original: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.
translation: 蔽薄能给草坪上所有的暗影植物提供暗影力量，并且能将数只僵尸拖向毁灭的深渊。随后，再加强草坪上所有蔽薄家族的植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: {FLAVOR}"Go easy, there," says Contain-mint. "No need to be in such a rush all the time. Movement is totally overrated."
translation: {FLAVOR}“放轻松，”负荷说。“没必要那么急。有的时候，慢功才能出细活。”

original: Contain-mints stun all zombies on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Contain-mint Family plants on the lawn.
translation: 负荷可以眩晕场上的所有僵尸，并暂时加强草坪上所有的负荷家族植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Do you want to continue your current game or restart the level?
translation: 你是想继续当前的游戏还是重新开始关卡？

translation:
你的游戏进度和得到的奖励均已顺利保留！而你多出来的星星都已经转换成了植物装扮！/r

你得到了 {COSTUME_AMT} 款新装扮！

original: You've been awarded a World Key for your progress in the game. Use it to unlock the world of your choice!
translation: 已将你在游戏里的进度转换成了世界钥匙。你可以用它们来随心解锁各个世界！

original: Your photo will only be saved to this device.
translation: 你的照片只会储存在这部设备上。
种植豌豆射手，开始游戏
种植玉米投手，开始游戏

original: {FLAVOR}Cran Jelly is more than capable of changing into any other shapes. Cubes. Pyramids Cones. Icosahedron. It can do it all. But few shapes are as structurally strong or offer as much zombie crushing power as the cylinder. Not to mention, it lets him go really fast.
translation: {FLAVOR}蔓越莓果冻完全可以变换成任何其他的形状。无论是长方体、圆锥体、二十面体，它都没问题。但是很少有形状能像圆柱体那般坚固，也很少能把僵尸撞得满地找牙。更别说，只有圆柱体才能让他的速度这么快，离谱的快。

original: Instant plant that crushes zombies in the lane under its girthy jellified mass. Leaves behind a pool of acidic goo that both slows and damages zombies when a zombie is crushed.
translation: 一株可以撞向所在行僵尸，往它们身上铺满粘稠果冻状物质的植物，种植后立即生效。当僵尸被撞死时，会留下一滩酸性黏液，不仅可以减缓僵尸的速度，也能造成伤害。

original: Cran Jelly works best when zombies are clumped together. Level it up to increase the number of lanes it will roll down.
translation: 当僵尸聚在一起时，蔓越莓果冻的效果最佳。给它升级，就能让它滚过更多行。

translation: 撞扁种植行的所有僵尸。

original: {FLAVOR}"Look," says Dandelion, shaking his head. "I’m not a leprechaun and I’m not a genie. You can blow my seeds off all you want, but I can't make your wish come true. I don’t even know how that rumor got started.”
translation: {FLAVOR}“你听好了，”蒲公英摇了摇头说道：“我不是什么精灵之类的东西。你确实可以吹飞我的种子，但它们又不是孔明灯，怎么可能帮你实现愿望？你们到底是从哪儿听到的这种谣言的？”

original: Dandelions send explosive seeds down three different lanes, one lane at a time.
translation: 蒲公英一次可以向周围三行中的其中一排散布它的爆炸种子。

original: {FLAVOR}“Why waste shots on foot soldiers when you can win the battle with one well-chosen dart to the dome?” wonders Dartichoke. “Why would you do it? Why would ANYONE do it?”
translation: {FLAVOR}“如果能绕过前面的炮灰，直接一镖先擒王，那又何必浪费子弹去打那些炮灰呢？”飞镖洋蓟心想。“为什么？为什么就是有人想不通这个道理？为！什！么！”

original: Dartichokes fire high-damage darts down the lane, prioritizing especially dangerous zombies such as Wizards, Octo Zombies, and Healers.Has a limited supply of darts that can deal critical damage.
translation: 飞镖洋蓟可以向所在行发射高伤害的飞镖，并且会优先攻击诸如巫师、章鱼僵尸、治疗师等高危险度的僵尸。飞镖伤害不俗，但数量有限。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots darts that deal with damage to a multiple of zombies on the lawn.

original: Dazey Chains grow through stages, becoming more powerful and releasing a stunning puff of gas at each stage.
translation: 迷乱雏菊束可以通过生长来变得更加强大，每次生长，有毒气体就会提升一个等级。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Releases a large plume of stunning gas toward zombies in its column and adjacent columns.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射大量晕眩气体，眩晕所在排和相邻排的僵尸。
生长后可以释放气体眩晕僵尸
它们根本不符合计算机图形标准！

original: Their team spirit is too overwhelming!
translation: 它们的团队精神太过头了！

original: Gamers in a game? Too meta!
translation: 在游戏里玩游戏？什么元游戏！
它们的气球也太耐用了吧！

original: Barrels are for storing things, not for smushing plants!
translation: 桶是用来放东西的，不是用来碾扁植物的！

original: Time to get back to basics, and thin out the zombie horde!
translation: 返朴归真，是时候让僵尸大军减减员了！

original: Defeat the stylish basic zombies of Big Wave Beach!
translation: 击败巨浪海滩时髦的普通僵尸！

original: Defeat Basic Big Wave Beach Zombies!
translation: 击败巨浪海滩普通僵尸！

original: Teach these zombies that buckets are for making sand castles.
translation: 教教那些僵尸，桶是用来堆沙堡的。

original: Better beat these beach blanket bozos!
translation: 最好击败这些沙滩毯傻瓜！

original: They're zombies, but they look like weird crabs! Ick!
translation: 它们是僵尸，但是看着像诡异的螃蟹！呕！

original: Half fish, half imp. Entirely gross.
translation: 半鱼半小鬼，真够恶心的。

original: Their headgear is simply too geometric!
translation: 它们的头饰简直不要太几何了！

original: Their emotions are too raw, too honest!
translation: 它们的情感太原始、太诚实了！

original: Their fly moves are simply intolerable!
translation: 它们的飞行动作真让人难受！

original: Time to make these zombies kick the bucket!
translation: 是时候让这些僵尸桶飞头掉了！

original: Bug/zombie symbiosis is just too creepy!
translation: 飞虫和僵尸居然能互利共生……真是令人不寒而栗！

original: They look like bulls, but they're actually robots! GET 'EM!
translation: 看上去像牛，但它们其实是机器人！干掉它们！

original: Bones in beards are questionably fashionable!
translation: 胡子里藏骨头可能算不上时尚吧！

original: That camel-flauge isn't fooling anyone. Defeat camel zombies!
translation: 小样，别以为躲牌后面我就认不出你来了。击败骆驼僵尸！
击败 {NUMBER} 只有氧运动僵尸

original: They wrangled just one too many chickens!
translation: 它们养的鸡也太多了吧！

original: Practice a little garden safety by culling out Conehead Zombies!
translation: 把路障头僵尸清理出你的草坪，保障你花园的安全！

original: Defeat the boot-wearing basic zombies of the Wild West!
translation: 击败狂野西部中穿靴子的普通僵尸！
击败狂野西部普通僵尸！

original: In my day, buckets were for mucking the stables!
translation: 我们那个年代啊，铁桶是用来清扫马厩的！

original: Send these cone rangers to the pokey!
translation: 把这些路障骑警送到监狱去！

original: Those weird skulls shouldn't be able to do what they do!
translation: 这些奇怪的头骨不应该有这种能力！

original: They're not pleasant, they're peasant! And that's terrible!
translation: 他们不是农民，他们是农冥！大大的坏事！

original: They'll never be knights with low-tier equipment like that!
translation: 它们永远不会成为那种只有低级装备的骑士！

original: Their big stone hammers are clumsy and all too effective!
translation: 它们的大石锤笨拙但有效！
击败黑暗时代巨人僵尸！

original: These monks ain't funky! Except for their smell.
translation: 这些僧侣一点都不时髦！除了它们的气味。
它们的服装完全不符合历史！
击败侏罗纪沼泽普通僵尸！
呃……铁桶，坏耶。把它们砸碎！
击败侏罗纪铁桶头僵尸！

original: Zombie like cone. You not a zombie. Crush cone!
translation: 僵尸喜欢路障，但你又不是僵尸。所以把那些路障打得稀巴烂吧！
击败侏罗纪路障头僵尸！
它们的骨头棒也太钝了吧！

original: Their mean little giggles are super unsettling!
translation: 它们卑鄙的傻笑真是让人不安！

original: Their 70s disco rhythms don't belong in their far-future era!
translation: 它们那 70 年代的迪斯科旋律与这个遥远的未来时代格格不入！

original: Who knew dodos could be such jerks?
translation: 谁知道渡渡鸟也这么混蛋呢？

original: Defeat the bandaged basic zombies of Ancient Egypt!
translation: 击败上古埃及中绑着绷带的普通僵尸！
击败上古埃及普通僵尸！

original: These pail-packers need to go pound sand!
translation: 它们头上的桶应该拿来装沙子的啊！

original: Don't they have a pyramid to build, or something?
translation: 它们不应该去建金字塔吗？

original: Wrap things up by taking care of some Mummified Gargantuars!
translation: 击败木乃伊巨人，终结这一切！

original: They're always growling about obscure bands!
translation: 它们总是为小众乐队尖叫！

original: Defeat Basic Neon Mixtape Tour Zombies!
translation: 击败炫光魔音游普通僵尸！

original: They don't know what it means to be a metalhead!
translation: 它们才不知道金属头代表着什么！

original: Their traffic cone and denim look is SO out of style.
translation: 它们头上的路障和身上的牛仔裤实在是太过时了。

original: They need to learn at least two chords!
translation: 它们至少得学习两种和弦！

original: Shovels just shouldn't be that effective! Punish them!
translation: 有铲子了不起啊？让它们长长教训！

original: Use your leveled-up plants to tackle extra-tough veteran zombies in expert levels! Warning: May Be Tense!
translation: 请使用高等级植物来应对专家关卡中超强的高级僵尸！警告：局势可能会很紧张！

original: Teach the explorer zombies that playing with fire is dangerous!
translation: 不知道玩火会自焚吗？让那些探险家僵尸长长教训！

original: Because seriously. These guys. They need to go away.
translation: 因为说真的，这些家伙，应该离开。

original: How dare they shove your plants like they do?
translation: 它们凭什么铲走你的植物？

original: A skull on a head is one skull too many!
translation: 脑袋上再套一个脑袋？套娃是吧！

original: They have shiny jumpsuits and awful, carnivorous intentions!
translation: 那些闪亮的连身衣，掩盖着它们那可怕的食肉之欲！
击败遥远未来普通僵尸！

original: They need to upgrade to the zCone 7 anyway.
translation: 不管怎样，它们必须得升级到 zCone 7。

original: They have telephone poles for arms! TELEPHONE POLES!
translation: 它们把电线杆当作武器！电线杆诶！

original: They scamper around in creepy little spider-bots! Brrrrrr!
translation: 它们坐在那令人毛骨悚然的机器蛛虫里蹦蹦跳跳！脑——！

original: Take on the big boys by taking out some random Gargantuars!
translation: 随便击败几只巨人僵尸，让这些大个子臣服！

original: Roller skates are more of a 70s thing anyway!
translation: 旱冰鞋？70 年代的老东西了吧！

original: Because snowballs are preposterous hunting gear!
translation: 雪球是什么奇奇怪怪的狩猎工具啊！

original: They lack technological sophistication! Punish them for it!
translation: 原始人还敢和我们斗？让它们长长教训！
击败极寒冰窟普通僵尸！

original: I've heard of ice buckets, but this is ridiculous!
translation: 我听说过“冰桶”挑战，但你这也太离谱了吧！

original: They're all just evolutionary dead ends!
translation: 它们已经掉进进化的死胡同里了！

original: These lunkheads don't even have the decency to be slothful!
translation: 这些原始僵尸也配用“地懒”来称呼自己吗！

original: Unfortunately these yetis are anything but scarce.
translation: 很遗憾，这些雪人不算什么稀有物种。

original: How do they pack all those zombies in there? It strains credulity!
translation: 它们是怎么把那些僵尸包起来的？太不可思议了！

original: These things are just weird. Please get rid of them!
translation: 这些东西太奇怪了，把它们统统赶走！
莫霍克发型的小僵尸？嘶呼——！

original: Why do they get jetpacks? It's so unfair!
translation: 为什么它们有喷气背包？太不公平了！

original: They're constantly ripping off other funnier zombies' material!
translation: 它们一直在偷其他僵尸的笑话！

original: They refuse to govern with the consent of the governed!
translation: 它们才不用管人民的意见。它们说自己是王，它们就是王。

original: They work too hard upholding a regressive feudal system!
translation: 它们还在不遗余力地维护那封建制度，别费功夫了。

original: Their exploratory efforts are highly questionable!
translation: 它们无畏的探索精神值得被世人质疑！
击败失落之城普通僵尸！

original: Buckets. Why did it have to be buckets?

translation: 击败铁桶头冒险家僵尸！

original: Impressive mustache or no, these guys have got to go!
translation: 不管有没有留着令人印象深刻的胡子，这些家伙都得出发了！
击败路障头冒险家僵尸！

original: They just lug too much stuff around!
translation: 它们不过是卖力地搬运过多乘客罢！

original: Their helmets are just the piths!
translation: 它们头顶的安全帽才是要点所在！

original: Nobody should have ever issued them a license to fly!
translation: 任何人都不该给它们飞行执照！

original: How dare they spin their mics that way!
translation: 它们怎么敢那样转麦克风！

original: Robo-cone zombies are too cylindrical to be allowed!
translation: 机器路障僵尸不应该出现。为什么？因为它们太圆柱了！

original: Their contemporary crimes may not be countenanced!
translation: 它们在当代犯下的罪行可不会得到包容！
击败现代年华普通僵尸！

original: Make them kick the… well, you know.
translation: 让这些僵尸桶飞……呃，你懂的。
击败现代年华铁桶头僵尸！

original: Defeat the conehead zombies of Modern Day!
translation: 击败现代年华的路障头僵尸！
击败现代年华路障头僵尸！

original: They're really just big softies. Make sure they know that.
translation: 它们真的就只是一群大软蛋。让它们瞧瞧自己有几斤几两。
击败现代年华巨人僵尸！

original: They already threw out the comics section!
translation: 别盯着报纸了，它们已经把里面的漫画撕掉了！

original: Enslaving octopuses for zombie purposes is just not cool!
translation: 为了僵尸的想法而奴役章鱼一点也不酷！

original: Those parasols are just too fancy and expensive!
translation: 那些阳伞太花哨，太昂贵了！

original: These Pharaohs think they rule, but they'll never win this duel!
translation: 这些法老觉得自己才是主宰。但这场战斗中，主宰战场的是你！

original: They can't even read sheet music!

translation: 给这些臭海盗一点颜色瞧瞧！
击败海盗港湾普通僵尸！

original: Swab the decks with their leaky headgear!
translation: 用他们的破帽子擦甲板吧！

original: Do it before they mutate into Pirate Admiral Zombies!
translation: 搞快点，等它们变成海军上将僵尸就晚了！

original: Cross their crossbones off the list!
translation: 把他们的交叉骨从名单上叉掉！

original: Turn these cannoneers into cannon fodder!
What are they hiding under their ponchos? You can never tell!
translation: 它们的斗篷下面藏着什么？你永远不会知道！

original: And defeat their scruffy prospector beards, too!
translation: 还要打破他们那脏兮兮的勘探者胡子！

original: E.M.Peaches make short work of these technological terrors!
translation: 电磁脉冲桃能让这些恐怖的机械短暂失灵！

original: Their jackets and boots have too many spikes!
translation: 它们的夹克和靴子里的钉刺实在是太多了！

original: Ra Zombies are out to soak up your sun - make them ancient history!
translation: 太阳神僵尸可以迅速偷走你的阳光，太恶心了！让它们被遗忘在历史的长河里吧！

original: Teach them it's better to leave relics where they are!
translation: 告诉它们最好把宝物留在原地！

original: How can a seagull that small carry a zombie? It's ridiculous!
translation: 这么小的海鸥怎么能吊起一只僵尸？离谱！

original: They wear snorkels when they don't even need to breathe!
translation: 它们都不需要呼吸，干嘛含着根呼吸管？

original: They're throwing away a perfectly good post-secondary education!
translation: 它们放弃了接受良好的大专教育！

original: Who do they think they are, buckling those swashes?
translation: 他们以为他们是谁！我渴望有价值的对手！

original: Teach these Tomb Raisers that messing with you was a grave mistake!
translation: 让影立古墓僵尸明白，惹到你，只有粉身碎骨！

original: What secrets are contained within its lunchbox? Only one way to find out!

original: {FLAVOR}Electric Blueberry prides herself on being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep 'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when it's disintegrated."

When asked, Electric Peel said, "Don't touch my Peel, you won’t like what happens next!", in a cautious tone, while emitting a buzzing electric sound.

translation: {FLAVOR}上周，其他植物给逃脱树根举办了一场盛大的惊喜派对，但是他却在忙自己的事。这下被惊喜的反而是他们自己了。

original: Escape Roots explode on contact, and can be swapped with other plants that are in danger.
translation: 逃脱树根会在接触时爆炸，还可以与处于危险中的植物交换位置。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates 2 copies of itself, one at a time, next to a zombie and transform into a random Bombard-mint plant.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}依次在僵尸身边创建 2 份自己的复制体，一次只会创建一个，随后变形成一株随机的爆薄家族植物。

original: Explodes and can be swapped with other plants

original: Not all plants work well against all zombies. Try our different combinations!
translation: 僵尸形形色色，不是所有植物都能悉数通吃。多试几种阵容搭配！

original: Don’t forget to use plant food!!! They can help you turn the tide of battle.
translation: 不要忘了使用植物养料!!! 它们可以助你扭转战局。

original: Some plants prefer certain areas in the lawn. Try different placements to see which one works best for you.

original: {FLAVOR} Explode-O-Vine is sooooooooooooooo ready to explode. Just ridiculously ready. He's got the color picked out and everything.
translation: {FLAVOR} 爆炸藤蔓已经全副武装——完完全全——彻头彻尾准备好去爆炸了。准备的程度好到离谱。他已经选好了颜色，准备好了一切。

original: Explode-O-Vines detonate an explosion with knockback when planted, and then a larger explosion when eaten.
translation: 爆炸藤蔓可以在种下时发生爆炸并产生击退效果，被吃掉后还会产生更大的爆炸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Explode dealing damage to nearby zombies and gain armor. If the armor is destroyed, the armor explode.
