original: {FLAVOR}Fila-mint hovers enigmatically and electrically over the lawn, surveying his surroundings. He nods, once. It is good./r
translation: {FLAVOR}电荷用他那放电似的目光，悄悄地在草坪上观察。他淡淡点了一下头。很好，一切正常。/r

original: Fila-mints do electric damage and provide a temporary boost to all Fila-mint Family plants on the lawn.
translation: 电荷可以瞬间造成一次电击伤害，随后加强草坪内的所有电荷家族植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Bowling Bulb rolls bulbs down rows to bop, bounce and bash multiple zombies!
translation: 扔出保龄球，一次性击打、反弹、痛击数只僵尸！

original: Abolish the atrocious Gargantuar of Big Wave Beach!
translation: 在巨浪海滩击败残暴的巨人僵尸！

original: Guacodile shoots, swims, and charges forward on defeat! REVENGE!
translation: 鳄梨可以发射，可以游泳，就算被击败了，也可以冲向僵尸复仇！

original: It's no day at the beach without Lily Pads! They let you plant on water!
translation: 在海滩，怎么能没有睡莲叶呢？毕竟有了它们，你才能种植物在水面上！

original: TIKI-TORCHER! Paste perennial partying zombies and earn rewards in this beachside bash!
translation: 提基文明传承者！在这场海滨狂欢上黏住僵尸，获取奖励！

original: Banana Launcher dispenses justice by launching missiles anywhere on the board!
translation: 在你指定的地方发射香蕉导弹，伸张正义！

original: Quash the querulous Dr. Zomboss in this surfing struggle of Big Wave Beach
translation: 击败狡猾的僵王博士，完成巨浪海滩中的这场热情似火的战斗

original: Run silent, run deep. Tangle Kelp drags marine zombies to a watery grave!
translation: 越走，越深。缠绕海带可以把僵尸拖进沉溺海底的墓碑里！

original: Sun Shovel! Get an additional 25% of sun cost back when shoveling up plants!
translation: 阳光铲！铲除植物后，可以额外回收那株植物所消耗阳光的 25%！

original: Melon-Pult flings heavy damage melons down a lane, hitting groups of zombies!
translation: 西瓜投手可以扔出伤害极高的西瓜，重击一群僵尸！

original: Wall Nut Aid: Fully repair damaged defensive plants by planting on top of them!
translation: 坚果墙急救术：在被损坏的防御类植物身上再种一次，就能治愈它！

original: Tall-Nut totally frustrates flying and hopping zombies! Serves 'em right!
translation: 高坚果能轻松阻挡飞行和跳跃僵尸！好好招待他们吧！

original: Sneaky zombies creeping up from behind? Split Pea shoots forward AND back!
translation: 狡猾的僵尸想偷偷从后面突袭？裂夹豌豆可以向前后同时射击！

original: Instant Recharge: refresh a seed packet by dragging and dropping Plant Food on it!
translation: 即刻冷却：把植物养料拖动到种子包上就能立即完成冷却！

original: Winter-Melon hits groups of zombies, deals heavy damage AND chills them out!
translation: 攻击一群僵尸，造成巨大伤害，还能让它们受到冷缓效果！

original: Attack the awful Dr. Zomboss in this desert duel of Wild West
translation: 击败可怕的僵王博士，完成狂野西部中的这场尘土飞扬的战斗

original: BIG BAD BUTTE: Engage endless zombies in this frontier fracas!
translation: 大恶战：与无尽的僵尸战斗，在这场边境之争中获得奖励！

original: Chili bean destroys a foe and stuns the group behind it!
translation: 辣豆可以消灭一名敌人，然后眩晕其后的尸群！

original: Pile up Pea Pods for massive firepower!
translation: 堆种豌豆荚，获得强大火力！

original: Crush the monstrous Gargantuar of Wild West
translation: 击败可怕的狂野西部巨人僵尸

original: Lightning Reed shocks multiple foes at high speeds and adjacent lanes!
translation: 闪电芦苇可以快速攻击数行道路上的多名敌人。用来炸鸡也不错哦！

original: Maul the medieval Gargantuar of Dark Ages
translation: 在黑暗时代击败中世纪巨人僵尸！

original: ARTHUR'S CHALLENGE: Punish primitive zombies in a forever feudal feud!
translation: 亚瑟王的挑战：在这无尽的封建社会中获得奖励！完成黑暗时代第 12 夜！

original: Ug, metal! So annoying! Attract buckets and helmets away with Magnet Shroom!
translation: 恶，金属！太烦人了！快快用磁铁菇把那些铁桶和头盔吸走吧！

original: Cheap lil' Sun-Shrooms emit ever-growing piles of sun! Radiant!
translation: 物超所值的阳光菇能生产越来越多的阳光！光芒四射！

original: Hamper the heinous Dr. Zomboss in this tenth-century titlecard of Dark Ages
translation: 击败凶恶的僵王博士，完成黑暗时代中的这场中世纪的战斗

original: How about a quick little shooter that costs ZERO sun? Puff-shroom it is!
translation: 想要一个喷得快还免费的小射手？小喷菇，就是你了！

original: Fume-shroom sprays all zombies in an area. Take that, clumps of zombies!
translation: 烟雾菇可以向一个区域内的所有僵尸喷出烟雾。来吧，就算一大群僵尸咱也不怕！

original: What if zombies spat out sun as they took damage? Sun Bean makes it happen!
translation: 如果僵尸受到伤害就能生产阳光，岂不美哉？阳光豆让你梦想成真！

original: Annihilate the antediluvian Gargantuars of Jurassic Marsh
translation: 在侏罗纪沼泽击败原始的巨人僵尸！

original: Primal Sunflowers emit big, big suns!
translation: 原始向日葵可以生产超——大的阳光！

original: Primal Peashooters sling serious smack with heavy, stunning peas!
translation: 原始豌豆射手可以发射沉重，还能打晕僵尸的豌豆！

original: LA BRAINSA TARPITS: Face dinosaurs and prehistoric zombies in this bygone battle!
translation: 脑子焦油坑：在这场年代久远的战斗中面对恐龙和史前僵尸！

original: Blast zombies with starchy goodness, courtesy of the Primal Potato Mine!
translation: 轰炸僵尸，并爆出大量淀粉，这得感谢原始土豆地雷！

original: Frustrate the feverish Dr. Zomboss in the swampy strife of Jurassic Marsh
translation: 击败邪恶的僵王博士，完成侏罗纪沼泽中的这场沼泽池中的纷争！

original: Build up defenses quickly with the fast-planting Primal Wall-nut!
translation: 用冷却极快的原始坚果墙快速建立防御！

original: Charm dinosaurs and sic 'em on the zombies with Perfume-shroom!
translation: 用香水菇魅惑恐龙，让他们与僵尸反目成仇！

original: PYRAMID OF DOOM: Bash zombies for rewards in this endless Egyptian survival mode!
translation: 厄运金字塔：在无尽的埃及生存模式中，痛击僵尸，获得奖励！

original: Bonk Choy: this pugilisitic plant beats zombies up AND backwards!
translation: 拳击白菜：无论僵尸在前面还是后面，这个植物拳击手都能打到！

original: Plant Food Slot: Hold onto one more Plant Food during a level! Always handy!
translation: 植物养料拓展槽：可以在关卡中多存储一份植物养料！很实用的！

original: Why shoot one pea when you can shoot two for twice the firepower with Repeater!
translation: 能用双发豌豆喷射两颗豌豆使火力加倍的时候，为什么要只射一颗呢？

original: Starting sun boost: Start every level right with 25 extra sun in the bank!
translation: 起步阳光增益：与额外 25 点阳光一起，开启每一关的旅程！

original: Sun-starved? Twin Sunflowers burp up twice the sun per square!
translation: 你缺阳光吗？双子向日葵每次能生产出双倍阳光！

original: Defeat the diabolical Dr. Zomboss in this bygone battle of Ancient Egypt
translation: 击败恶魔般的僵王博士，完成上古埃及中的这场荒凉的战斗

original: Lob cabbages over gravestones for a long-distance surprise! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 2!
translation: 投掷卷心菜，越过墓碑，让僵尸措手不及！完成上古埃及第 2 天！

original: Whip boomerangs through several foes at once for double-dealing damage!
translation: 回旋花可以一次性穿刺多只僵尸，并回弹造成双倍伤害！

original: Iceberg Lettuce freezes zombies in their tracks! So cool!
translation: 冰山生菜能在僵尸走的路上冻结他们！真是冷酷无情！

original: Play more Ancient Egypt levels to unlock more plants!
translation: 游玩更多上古埃及关卡，解锁更多植物！

original: Defeat the hideous Gargantuar of Ancient Egypt Day 6 to earn a time-leaping Pirate Seas Key!
translation: 在上古埃及第 6 天击败可怕的上古埃及巨人僵尸，获取海盗港湾钥匙！

original: Crumble gravestones instantly with Grave Buster!
translation: 用墓碑吞噬者迅速破坏墓碑吧！

original: Mangle the musical Gargantuar of Neon Mixtape Tour
translation: 在炫光魔音游击败音乐巨人僵尸

original: Use Garlic for all your lane-diversion needs!
translation: 使用大蒜来满足你让僵尸走上另一条道路的愿望吧！

original: Phat Beet brings the rhythm and doles out damage all around!
translation: 节拍甜菜能踩着节拍，进行范围伤害！

original: 80s DANGER ROOM:Rap rhythmic zombies in this melodic mashup!
translation: 80 年代无尽模式：在这个音乐天堂击败那些走路都带音乐的僵尸！
解锁 80 年代无尽模式！
孢子菇是其他蘑菇之母！

original: Revive eaten plants with the indomitable Intensive Carrot!
translation: 用医护胡萝卜复活被吃掉的植物吧！

original: Irritate the irascible Dr. Zomboss in this operatic onslaught of Neon Mixtape Tour
translation: 击败狂躁的僵王博士，完成炫光魔音游中的这场摇滚巨献

original: Sneaky Celery Stalker hides underground to pop up and smack zombies from behind!
translation: 狡猾的潜伏芹菜藏匿于地底，随后从僵尸背后突袭重击！

original: Want to rewind zombies back to their starting position? Let's do the Thyme Warp again!
translation: 想要让僵尸回到原点吗？那就来逆时一次吧！

original: Infi-Nut regenerates over time and blocks all rows with Plant Food! Astounding!
translation: 无穷坚果可以随着时间的推移重新生成。而使用植物养料后，更可以挡下所有道路上的僵尸！太强了吧！

original: Fun with Sun! Spend sun on powerful blasts with Magnifying Grass.
translation: 阳光，汇聚光芒！花费阳光，用透镜草汇聚出强力射线吧！

original: Laser Bean's gaze pierces all zombies on a lane with each shot! ZAP!
translation: 激光豆的锐利眼“光”能穿透一整行的僵尸！咻咻咻！

original: Mower Launcher: manually launch one mower by tapping and holding! Clear 'em out!
translation: 割草机启动器：按住割草机，手动启动它！横扫僵尸！

original: Power Tiles boost your Plant Food effects. Create 'em with Tile Turnip!
translation: 能量地砖可以强化你的植物养料效果。试试用地砖芜菁来创造它们吧！

original: Deny the devious Dr. Zomboss in this someday struggle of Far Future
translation: 击败狡猾的僵王博士，完成遥远未来中的这场来自未来某一天的战斗

original: Use Blover to blow away all airborne enemies on the board in one big WHOOOSH!
translation: 三叶草可以“呼”的一声吹走所有飞在空中的敌人！

original: TERROR FROM TOMORROW: Tackle technological zombies in an infinite imbroglio!
translation: 明日的恐惧：击退全身是高科技武装的僵尸，在这场无尽的未来战争中赢得奖励！

original: Citron deals overwhelming damage to one target at a time. Gargantuars beware!
translation: 等离子香橼可以一次对一个目标造成恐怖的伤害。小心了，巨人僵尸！

original: Face the furious Gargantuar of Far Future
translation: 面对遥远未来的狂暴巨人僵尸！

original: Use E.M.Peach to stun all robotic and mechanical zombies in an area!
translation: 使用电磁脉冲桃，眩晕范围内的所有机械与机甲类僵尸！

original: Hold the line, or better yet, push 'em back! Chard Guard is on the case.
translation: 谁可以守住防线……甚至还能把僵尸推开？甜菜护卫精通这行。

original: Attack the abominable Gargantuar of Frostbite Caves
translation: 在极寒冰窟击败可憎的巨人僵尸

original: Need to stun some zombies in place for a while? Stunion is ON IT!
translation: 想把僵尸眩晕在一个地方吗？眩晕洋葱可以办到！

original: Freezing wind got you down? Hot Potato breaks the ice!
translation: 冰窟的寒风让你浑身打颤？用热土豆来融化寒冰吧！

original: ICEBOUND BATTLEGROUND: Fracture frigid zombies in this ongoing glacial gambit!
translation: 冰封战场：在这场无尽的冰野之战中击碎冰冻的僵尸，获得奖励！

original: Rotobaga flies, floats and fires in four fabulous directions!
translation: 旋转洋芜菁可以飞起来浮在空中，向四个方向发射子弹！

original: Confound the corrupt Dr. Zomboss in this cryogenic conflict of Frostbite Caves
translation: 击败腐败的僵王博士，完成极寒冰窟中的这场严寒中的战斗

original: Fight ice with fire. Pepper-pult melts ice and lobs hot blobs over obstacles!
translation: 以火克冰。甜椒投手可以融化附近的冰，还可以越过障碍投射甜椒！

original: The best offense is a good defense? Why not both! Endurian blocks AND damages!
translation: 最好的防御是进攻？那既可以防御又可以进攻岂不美哉？榴镰可以在阻挡僵尸的同时造成伤害！

original: Dash the dastardly Gargantuar of Lost City
translation: 在失落之城击败卑鄙的巨人僵尸！

original: Stallia slows down zombies with a burst of fragrant perfume!
translation: 大丽花可以喷发香气，令僵尸减速！

original: Red Stingers shoot powerfully close to home and become more defensive further away!
translation: 红针花在后排火力全开，而到了前排，却能扛起防御的重任！

original: TEMPLE OF BLOOM: Eradicate zombies in this perpetual party of botanical battle!
translation: 鲜花神殿：在这场无尽的植物战争中消灭僵尸！

original: Gold Leaf turns regular boring tiles into exciting sun-generating Gold Tiles!
translation: 黄金叶可以把平平无奇的地砖变成可以产生阳光的黄金地砖！

original: Pester the pernicious Dr. Zomboss in the adventurous arena of Lost City
translation: 击败可恶的僵王博士，完成失落之城中的这场冒险

original: A.K.E.E. lobs shots that bounce off of several foes down a lane. Heads up!
translation: 阿开木-木可以投射在多行间穿梭的投掷物。注意头顶！

original: Poison zombies with the shadowy toxicity of Shadow-shroom!
translation: 用暗影菇的暗影剧毒令僵尸中毒！

original: Upbraid the up-to-date Gargantuars of Modern Day
translation: 在现代年华击败最新的巨人僵尸！

original: Fling explosive nuggets at hungry zombies with Dusk-Lobber!
translation: 让薄暮掷手向饥饿的僵尸扔爆炸花饼！

original: Boost shadow plants with the lunar lunacy of Moonflower!
translation: 用月光花的月之能量强化暗影植物！

original: HIGHWAY TO THE DANGER ZONE: Tangle with temporal titans in this neverending nexus!
translation: 通往无尽的高速：在这无尽的时间交汇点中与僵尸决一死战！

original: Unlock Highway to the Danger Zone!
translation: 解锁通往无尽的高速路！

original: Drag zombies to their deserved doom with the Grimrose!
translation: 用报丧花把僵尸拖入虚空之中！

original: Defy the devilish Dr. Zomboss in this climactic clash of Modern Day
translation: 击败邪恶的僵王博士，完成现代年华中的这场高潮迭起的战斗

original: Deal major slaps with the shadow Nightshade!
translation: 用夜影茄给僵尸当头棒喝！

original: BOOM! Clear entire groups of zombies with each explosive shot from Coconut Cannon!
translation: 轰！椰子加农炮的每一发炮弹都能消灭一大群僵尸！

original: Threepeater shoots down three lanes at once to triple your offensive firepower!
translation: 三线豌豆可以一次攻击三条线路，让你的火力乘三！

original: Spikeweed: Strong enough to stand up to a Gargantuar, sharp enough to de-feet zombies!
translation: 地刺草：强大到能举起巨人僵尸，尖锐到击败僵尸游刃有余！

original: Can Kernelpult deal damage AND stun zombies? You'd butter believe it!
translation: 玉米投手不仅能定住僵尸，还能造成伤害？“油”点东西！

original: Extra Seed Slot: Carry more plants into the fray! More seed slots mean more options!
translation: 额外种子槽：让你可以在关卡中使用更多的植物！种子槽越多，选择越多！

original: Cherry Bomb's overwhelming blast fries whole groups of foes across lanes!
translation: 樱桃炸弹恐怖的爆炸伤害可以轻松消灭数行内的大量敌人！

original: Hammer the hateful Dr. Zomboss in this saltwater scrap of Pirate Seas
translation: 击败可恶的僵王博士，完成海盗港湾中的这场海上之战

original: Heat things up with Snapdragon's fiery attacks that hit multiple lanes at a time!
translation: 用火龙草那可以攻击数条道路的烈焰，让战斗升温吧！

original: DEAD MAN'S BOOTY: Endless adventures on the high seas await your command!
translation: 逝者的宝藏：一声令下，海上的无尽探险即将启航！

original: Damage zombies and bust barrels with the indomitable Spikeweed!
translation: 坚强的地刺草可以攻击踩在上面的僵尸，甚至是扎破轧在上面的木桶！

original: Smash the appalling Gargantuar of Pirate Seas
translation: 在海盗港湾击败可怕的巨人僵尸！

original: Swashbuckler got you on the ropes? Use Spring Bean to knock 'em back to Davy Jones' locker!
translation: 源源不断的海盗让你陷入困境了吗？用弹簧豆把他们弹回戴维·琼斯的储物柜里去吧！

original: {FLAVOR}Fire Peashooter knows that what she does looks exciting. But working with an open flame is serious and, more importantly, dangerous business. That's why, in her spare time, she talks to children about the importance of fire safety. "I'm a trained professional," she explains. "Don't try this at home, kids."
translation: {FLAVOR}火焰豌豆射手知道她做的事看上去很刺激。但是与明火共同工作很严肃，更重要的是，这是个非常危险的工作。这就是为什么在她的闲暇时间，她会与孩子谈论消防安全有多么重要。“我是受过专业训练的，”她解释道。“别在家里这么做，孩子。”

original: Fire Peashooters are immune to frost and shoot flaming peas down the lane.
translation: 火焰豌豆射手免疫冻结效果，可以向所在行发射火焰豌豆。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates a fire trail, unfreezing plants and damaging zombies in the row.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}引燃所在行的道路，解冻植物，对僵尸造成伤害。

original: Throws a line of flame down the lane, damaging all zombies in it.
translation: 沿所在行吐出一行火焰，伤害所有在行内的僵尸。

original: Shoots flaming peas and warms nearby plants
translation: 发射火焰豌豆，并且可以温暖附近的植物
每 {TIME} 秒让 {NUMBER} 只僵尸飘走！

original: This item has been purchased before. Restore Purchases will allow you to claim all of your past purchases in any profile.
translation: 这项商品你之前已经购买过了。你可以通过“恢复购买”功能来为你的所有档案重新获取之前购买的物品。

original: A new version of the game is available

{FLAVOR}"I think of myself as a pretty confident shroom and an all-around fungi," says Fume-shroom. "But sometimes, when I'm eating Plant Food, I hear them chuckling. I hear them calling me 'Balloon-shroom'. I don't think they know how much that hurts."
translation: {FLAVOR}“我觉得自己是个很自信的蘑菇，很全能的那种。”烟雾菇说。“但只要我一吃植物养料，就经常会听到他们在旁边偷笑，说我是‘气球菇’。他们才不知道这话到底有多么伤人。”

original: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that damage all zombies in an area.
translation: 烟雾菇可以向一个区域内的所有僵尸喷出烟雾，对它们造成伤害。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Sprays a stream of fumes that deal damage and pushes all zombies back.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}喷出一大串烟雾，造成伤害，击退所有僵尸。

original: Shoots fumes that can damage all zombies in an area
translation: 喷射可以伤害一定范围内所有僵尸的烟雾
遥远未来 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

original: You must connect to Game Center outside the PvZ2 app to access achievements and leaderboards.
translation: 若想访问成就和排行榜，你必须在游戏外连接到 Game Center。
把关卡中的巨人僵尸替换掉！

original: {FLAVOR}Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.
translation: {FLAVOR}能够很好地对付僵尸，也能用来对付任何可能路过的吸血鬼。

original: Garlic diverts zombies into other lanes.
translation: 大蒜可以使僵尸转移到其他行。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and releases gas that will temporarily stun zombies in front and divert them to another column.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}治疗自己，随后发射气体，暂时眩晕前方的僵尸，并将它们移到另一列。

original: Crazy Dave's Stickybomb Strategy seed Bundle
translation: 疯狂戴夫的黏弹糯米战略种子捆绑包

original: Crazy Dave's A.K.E.E Strategy Seed Bundle
translation: 疯狂戴夫的阿开木-木战略种子捆绑包

original: Crazy Dave's Tiger Grass Strategy Seed Bundle
translation: 疯狂戴夫的虎草战略种子捆绑包

original: Crazy Dave's Citron Strategy Seed Bundle
translation: 疯狂戴夫的等离子香橼战略种子捆绑包
末日草坪 - 种子捆绑包
极寒冰窟里程碑捆绑包
失落之城里程碑捆绑包
现代年华里程碑捆绑包
炫光魔音里程碑捆绑包
狂野西部里程碑捆绑包

original: Need more gems? Choose a package below.
translation: 需要更多宝石吗？在下方选择一个包吧！

original: {FLAVOR}You might not know it looking at her, but Ghost Pepper didn't always wear that white sheet everywhere she went. She first put it on as a lark for a Halloween party one year. Everyone else had these elaborate costumes, and she thought it would be funny to dress like a plain ol' ghost. But she fell in love with that costume. It spoke to her. She'd found her calling.
translation: {FLAVOR}别看她现在这样，你大概不知道，断魂椒以前并没有成天裹着这条白色床单。她在某年的万圣节派对第一次穿上它的时候，只是觉得好玩罢了——大伙都有精心制作的装扮，而她却只拌成一个普通幽灵的模样，这种反差肯定很有意思。结果她却爱上了这件装扮——仿佛它俩注定在一起。于是，她就这么找到了自己人生的使命。

original: Ghost Peppers haunt zombies that pass by and explode after a limited time.
translation: 断魂椒可以缠扰所有经过的僵尸，一段时间后爆炸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Deals heavy damage to all nearby zombies, and resets its lifetime timer.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}对周围所有僵尸造成大量伤害，重置自己的生命计时器。

original: Haunts all zombies that pass by and explodes after a limited time
translation: 缠扰所有经过的僵尸，一段时间后爆炸

original: {FLAVOR}Gloom Vine's gloomy exterior shouldn't be seen as implying a gloomy interior. His interior is gloomy, but for complicated personal reasons that go way back.
translation: {FLAVOR}忧郁藤蔓的忧郁不表露在外表，而隐匿在内心，由于他复杂的个人原因，他从很久以前就开始这样了。

original: Gloom Vines power individual shadow plants and shoot zombie-damaging gloom in eight directions.
translation: 忧郁藤蔓可以使所在格的暗影植物得到暗影强化，并可以向八个方向喷射阴雾来攻击僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spray a stream of noxious fumes that deals increased damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}喷出一大串毒雾，造成更多伤害。
向 8 个方向发射子弹

original: {FLAVOR}"Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."
translation: {FLAVOR}“那些植物学家花费了无数心血研究‘能否做到’，”黄金蓓蕾说，“但是他们并没有停下来思考‘是否应该这样做’。”

original: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.
translation: 黄金蓓蕾可以立刻提供大量阳光。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Gives an instant burst of sun
{FLAVOR}”For a small initial investment, you too can generate huge sun,” says Gold Leaf. She’s a firm believer in solar markets.
translation: {FLAVOR}“起步只需投资一点点阳光，你也能赢得巨大的阳光收益。”黄金叶说。她十分相信太阳能市场能给予她不菲的收益。

original: Gold Leaves create a Gold Tile on planting.
translation: 黄金叶可以在种植的位置创造金地砖。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。
在种植处制造黄金地砖

original: You must connect to Google Play to access achievements and leaderboards.
translation: 若想访问成就和排行榜，你必须连接到 Google Play。

original: You got a new POWER UP!
translation: 你的到了一个新的金手指！
这些钥匙能解锁新世界！

original: You already have all your keys!
translation: 你已经拥有所有钥匙了！

original: You just got keys for all the worlds! Check them out!
translation: 你刚刚获得了可以解锁所有世界的钥匙！去看看吧！

original: You shouldn't be seeing this message, it is only for older players.
translation: 奇怪……你不应该看到这条消息的呀，应该只有老玩家才能看到。

original: Hey, time traveler! Here’s all the world keys.
translation: 嘿，时间旅行者！给你所有的世界钥匙。

original: {FLAVOR}"Spa-BOOM!" enthuses Grapeshot. "You like that? I got a million of 'em! Wa-POW! Buh-BLAM! Za-... um... Ker-... hmmm... Okay, I guess I've only got the three."
translation: {FLAVOR}“啪，轰！”葡萄爆弹热情似火。“你喜欢这声儿吗？我有上百种爆炸声音！哇，砰！蚌，砰！炸……额……吭……呃呃呃……好吧，我只有这三种声音。”

original: Grapeshots explode and scatter bouncing projectiles in eight directions.
translation: 葡萄爆弹可以爆炸并散出可反弹的子弹。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。
爆炸并散出可反弹的子弹

original: {FLAVOR}He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.
translation: {FLAVOR}墓碑吞噬者可能看起来很凶，但他只是想给你一个大大的拥抱。小狗除外，因为他害怕狗。

original: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.
translation: 墓碑吞噬者能吞噬掉所在位置的墓碑。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Plant it on a grave to remove the grave
translation: 种植在墓碑上除掉墓碑

original: Disperse {COUNT} three-use Boost Tile every {TIME} seconds!
translation: 每 {TIME} 秒产生 {COUNT} 个可以用三次的强化地砖！

original: Disperse {COUNT} single-use Boost Tiles every {TIME} seconds!
translation: 每 {TIME} 秒产生 {COUNT} 个一次性的强化地砖！

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT} powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring/r
/r
{FLAVOR}"When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被暗影强化的报丧花可以将 3 只僵尸拖入无尽深渊/r
/r
{FLAVOR}报丧花说：“仔细想一想，僵尸应该本来就在地下吧，所以，我只是在送它们回家。”

original: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging up to 3 zombies into the dirt.
translation: 报丧花是一株类似于缠绕海带的暗影植物，最多可以把 3 只僵尸拖入地底。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Drags the strongest small zombie into the ground. If the zombie is large or mechanical- deal damage instead.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}将最强的小体型僵尸拖入地下。如果是大体型或者机械类僵尸，则改为造成伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}Ask Guacodile to tell you a little bit about himself and he'll give you a wry smile. "I'm a Guacodile. I've got a bite like a bear trap. I spit rock-hard pits with a force, speed and accuracy envied by every plant on the battlefield. Heck, I've been known to walk on water. I'm pretty much the whole enchilada." Yeah, the guy is a bit of a braggart but he’s good at what he does.
translation: {FLAVOR}如果你让鳄梨告诉你些许关于他的事，他会苦笑一下。“我是鳄梨。我有着捕熊器般的咬合力。我吐出的子弹有着战场上所有植物都嫉妒的力量、速度以及爆发力。对了，所有人都知道我能行走于水面之上。我简直就是个传奇人物。”嗯，这家伙是有点儿爱吹牛，不过他确实有这个能力。

original: Guacodiles is an amphibious plant that fire seeds from a distance. When attacked they will rush off the lawn biting any zombies they encounter.
translation: 鳄梨是一株两栖植物，可以远程发射种子。在受到攻击时则会冲向前方，撕咬遇到的所有僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Knock back zombies near it and releases two rushing Guacodiles that deal damage down its row.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}击退周围的僵尸，向所在行释放两枚可以造成伤害的鳄梨。

original: Shoots seeds, will rush all zombies ahead of him when attacked
translation: 发射种子，在受到攻击时冲向前方

original: {FLAVOR}What does 3.154e+13 and Guard-shroom have in common? When Dave asked, it took Penny more than 4 hours to complete the Guard-shroom census and emerge from the basement. Penny vehemently states this number is accurate and has banned anyone else from going down there.
translation: {FLAVOR}守卫菇与 3.154e+13 有什么共同点？某天，戴夫问了一嘴守卫菇的数量，潘妮立马驶入地下室对其进行菌落计数，结果花了四个多小时才从里面出来。潘妮严正声明这个数字是准确的，不准任何人去验算。

original: An amphibious mushroom that will spawn mini versions of itself to guard adjacent plants.  These Mini-shrooms can gobble up zombies, as well as significantly boost mushrooms and other plants they share a tile with.
translation: 两栖蘑菇，可以生成迷你版的自己守卫周围植物。迷你菇可以吞噬僵尸，还能大幅强化与其处于同一块地砖的蘑菇和其他植物。

original: Guard-shroom’s Minis will grant a significant boost to all shroom type plants and give an extra boost to Sea-shroom, Puff-shroom, Scaredy-shroom and Nightcap.
translation: 守卫菇的迷你分身可以大幅强化所有的蘑菇类植物，更能为海洋菇、小喷菇、胆小菇与暗夜菇提供额外增益。

original:
{KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Main Body - Drags several zombies and pummels them.
Mini - Retriggers the Plant Food ability of the host plant.
translation:
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}主体 - 拖近僵尸，痛击它们。
迷你分身 - 再次触发宿主植物的植物养料效果。

original: Replicates itself to guard adjacent plants.
translation: 自我复制，保护周围植物。

original: {FLAVOR}"I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
translation: {FLAVOR}“我只嚼火腿味的口香糖，”树胶桉果嘟囔着。“火腿加盐。”

original: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
translation: 树胶桉果会把黏稠的口香糖黏在僵尸身上，让它们定在原地，挡住身后的其他僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a large gum bubble that immobilizes a large number of zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射巨大的树胶泡泡，让大量僵尸无法动弹。
制造树胶黏住僵尸，被黏住的僵尸会阻碍其他僵尸

original: {FLAVOR}Headbutter Lettuce yawns. "Oh, is it that time? Time to headbutt zombies? Let me put on my butting face and I'll be right out!" He's a champ.
translation: {FLAVOR}黄油生菜打了个哈欠。“哦，可以了吗？我可以用头去捶一顿僵尸了吗？我只需要把脸糊上去，马上就能完事！”真是个勇士呢！

original: Headbutter Lettuces bash zombies in front and behind while occasionally buttering zombies.
translation: 黄油生菜可以攻击前后僵尸，偶尔还可以扔出黄油糊住僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Bashes and throws stunning butter at surrounding area zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}猛击周围区域的僵尸，并向其投掷黄油，造成眩晕效果。
猛击前方或后方的僵尸，向僵尸投掷黄油

original: {FLAVOR}Heath Seekers have always believed that the shortest distance between two points is an elaborately curved path that passes through several zombies and also looks pretty. Needless to say, they're struggling in geometry class.
translation: {FLAVOR}石南导引头一直相信两点之间的最短距离是一条复杂的曲线，这样不仅可以穿过几只僵尸，而且看上去也漂亮。好吧……不用说也知道，他们的几何课肯定上得很艰难。

original: Heath Seekers are Spear-mint family instant-use plants that burst into a storm of homing, piercing darts.
translation: 石南导引头是挑薄家族的立即使用型植物，可以爆裂出一场能够穿透僵尸的制导飞镖风暴。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。
爆裂出一场制导飞镖风暴

original: He’s got your back – and front!
{FLAVOR}"Observe," says Hocus Crocus. "Have I anything up my sleeve? Do I even have sleeves? No? Prepare, then, to have your quaint and old-fashioned notions of spatial location SHATTERED FOREVER!!!"
translation: {FLAVOR}“仔细看。”魔术番红花说。“我袖子里藏有任何东西吗？我有袖子吗？没有吧？那么，准备好，我会永远摧毁你那对于空间位置——古朴而又过时的观念!!!”

original: Hocus Crocuses use slick sleight-of-petal chicanery to magic zombies close to your home all the way back to the rightmost part of the lawn.
translation: 魔术番红花可以使用魔法，将离你房子最近的僵尸送回草坪的最右侧。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Teleports up to three left most zombies to the right most column.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}将最多三只最左边的僵尸传送到最右边的一排。
用魔法将接近的僵尸传送回草坪右边

original: {FLAVOR}Holly Barrier would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."
translation: {FLAVOR}冬青屏障建议大伙不要吃他的果子。他说：“首先，不经我同意就开始吃我的果子很没有礼貌。其次……它毒性很强。”

original: Holly Barrier deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
translation: 冬青屏障可以对攻击他的僵尸造成伤害，还可以发射 3 片带刺的屏障叶来击退、伤害僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fully heals itself and regains all berries. Launches Armored leaves on to random tiles.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}治愈自己，重新获得全部的莓果。随后向随机地砖发射发射带有盔甲的叶子。

original: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
translation: 伤害攻击他的僵尸，轻点操作发射屏障

original: {FLAVOR}As a young nut he spent way too much time standing between two mirrors and trying to look into infinity.
translation: {FLAVOR}好好的一个坚果，就这么把自己的大好青春年华，都花到站在两面镜子之间，试图洞察无穷的意义上了？

original: Infi-nuts are weaker than Wall-nuts, but they can regain health over time.
translation: 无穷坚果比坚果墙稍微脆弱一些，但是它们可以随着时间的推移恢复生命值。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fully heals itself and creates a shield to protect the column from incoming attacks.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}治愈自己，创建一面可以保护所在排的护盾，抵御攻击。

original: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time
translation: 稍微脆弱一些的坚果墙，可随着时间的推移恢复生命值

original: {FLAVOR}Don't even think about trying to pull one over on Homing Thistle. He's got a bead on you. He sees right through your facade. It's like he has a laser beam ... aimed at your soul.
translation: {FLAVOR}不要试图套路导向蓟，他可以轻轻松松拿捏你的一切。他的目光触及你的表皮，更穿透你的表皮。目光？更像是激光。一道直击你灵魂的光。

original: Homing Thistles fire seeking shots at targets that are the closest to home.
translation: 导向蓟可以发射追踪刺，攻击离房子最近的目标。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots homing projectiles at all zombies on the lawn, dealing moderate damage to each.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向草坪上的所有僵尸发射导向弹，对每只僵尸造成中等伤害。

original: Attacks farthest left target in any lane
translation: 攻击全场最靠左的目标

original: {FLAVOR}Hot Date's a charmer. He's polite, well-read, has lots of interesting opinions, and practices active listening. Zombies line up around the block to be incinerated by him.
translation: {FLAVOR}热辣海枣可以说是很有魅力了。他不仅彬彬有礼、博闻强识、见多识广、幽默风趣，而且最近都还在学习听人说话的技巧。看，僵尸都已经排好长队想要看看他有多么热辣了。

original: Hot Dates attract zombies from lanes above and below them, and then unleash a lane of flame when they're eaten.
translation: 热辣海枣可以吸引上下两列的僵尸到那它的那一列，在被吃掉后燃起一行火焰。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and attracts zombies in the surrounding area.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}治疗自己，吸引附近的僵尸。
吸引其他行的僵尸，被吃掉时烧伤整行僵尸

original: {FLAVOR}How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that’s how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.
translation: {FLAVOR}热土豆是怎么做到无论遇到什么状况都能积极面对的呢？答案就是瑜伽。她一节瑜伽课都没有缺席过。此外，定期的冥想也是她如此坚韧的原因。虽然她的身体并不算很坚韧啦。

original: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks they’re planted on.
translation: 热土豆可以融化所在格子上的冰块。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Plant it on an ice block to melt the block
translation: 种植在冰块上融化冰块
把关卡中的猎人僵尸替换掉！

original: {FLAVOR}You could say Hurrikale is a "blow hard" in the truest sense of the phrase. He is the first chair trombonist in the Biennial Philharmonic Orchestra. He is also proficient in the trumpet, saxophone and the tuba. But man o' man, you should really see him on the flugelhorn. Dude absolutely kills it.
translation: {FLAVOR}没错，飓风甘蓝真的很会吹……我是说乐器啦。他可是“双年爱乐管弦乐团”的首席长号手。不仅如此，小号、萨克斯和大号对他来说也都不是问题，但这些最多只能算是他的业余爱好。你绝对不能错过他的柔音号。只需要听一个音符，你都会觉得这辈子值了。

original: Hurrikales push back all zombies in their lane with a chilling wind.
translation: 飓风甘蓝可以吹出寒风，将所在行上的僵尸往后吹。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Blows a chilling wind that pushes back zombies in lane
translation: 吹动一阵寒风，击退同一行中的僵尸

original: {FLAVOR}Hypno-shroom has no trouble persuading zombies to fight on behalf of the plants. But he has yet to convince one to cluck like a chicken. "One day," he says. "One day."
translation: {FLAVOR}催眠菇可以轻轻松松让僵尸为植物作战，却至今也没能成功催眠它们去学鸡叫。“哼，早晚会的……”他嘀咕道，“早晚会的。”

original: When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.
translation: 僵尸吃掉催眠菇后，会成为你的盟友，为你战斗。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Turns a hypnotized zombie into a Gargantuar.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}将一只被催眠的僵尸变为巨人僵尸。

original: Makes a zombie fight for you

translation: 极寒冰窟 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}weak zombies in 3x3 area are iceblocked when defeated/r
/r
{FLAVOR}The last time Ice Bloom had pancakes for breakfast, she wasn’t satisfied. She can’t say why, exactly, but there was something subtly wrong with them. The shocking reason? Substandard maple syrup.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}脆弱的僵尸在 3x3 范围内被击败后会被冰封/r
/r
{FLAVOR}上次寒冰蓓蕾早餐吃煎饼时，她不是很满意。她说不出确切的原因，只觉得哪里怪怪的。到底为啥？说出来吓你一跳，里面的枫糖浆不合格。

original: Ice Blooms freeze, chill, and damage all zombies on the board, and more so in a 3x3 area around where they’re planted
translation: 寒冰蓓蕾可以冻结、冷缓，并对草坪上的所有的僵尸造成伤害，而在 3x3 范围内则会有更强力的效果。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: {FLAVOR}Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step… but only if you're a zombie.
translation: {FLAVOR}别傻傻地盯着冰山生菜的眼睛。如果你这样做了，这将是你生命中做的最后一件事……当然啦，这只对僵尸管用。

original: Iceberg Lettuces freeze a zombie when stepped on.
translation: 冰山生菜可以冻结踩到他的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Freezes or chills every zombie on lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}冻结或冷缓草坪上的每只僵尸。

original: Flash freezes all zombies on the lawn.
translation: 发光，接着冻结草坪上的所有僵尸。

original: Freezes zombies that step on it, and extinguishes flames
translation: 冻结踏上它的僵尸，熄灭火焰

original: {FLAVOR} “It’s not easy re-inventing yourself” says Ice-shroom after returning from an intensive stint of training in the coldest parts of the Antarctic. “It’s not often you get a second chance, but I’m back now, and this time I won’t be letting my fans or any of my friends down “. Cheering erupts as Ice-shroom steps onto the lawn.
translation: {FLAVOR}“想要重塑自己并不容易”，从南极最寒冷的地带进行强化训练归来后，寒冰菇说。“不是每件事都有第二次机会。如今，我受训归来，我不会再让我的粉丝、我的挚友失望。”寒冰菇踏上草坪，掌声雷动。

original: Smashes zombies in melee range. Emits a chilling aura that both buffs nearby Winter-mint plants and chills zombies.
translation: 击打近距离内的僵尸。释放寒气光环，既可以增强附近的寒薄家族植物，也可以冷缓僵尸。

original: Cluster other Winter-mints plants around Ice-shroom to gain a massive damage bonus .
translation: 把其他寒薄家族植物集中种植在寒冰菇附近，获取巨额伤害加成。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT} Lobs several icicles at random zombies across the field.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机向场地上的僵尸扔出数根冰柱。

original: {FLAVOR}Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."
translation: {FLAVOR}受到大联盟征召，冰刺草非常兴奋，等不及想要冷藏僵尸並让他们吃吃苦头了。他执意要我们使用“並”字，以及——“冷藏”。

original: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.
translation: 冰刺草可以冷缓并伤害踏在上面的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a sawblade that knockbacks and freezes all zombies in the column. Permanently increases damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}召唤一把锯片，将所在行的所有僵尸击退、冻结。还能永久提升它的伤害。
伤害并冷缓踏在上面的僵尸

original: We have detected multiple different identities associated with you. On the following screen please review the data with each identity and select which one you would like to proceed with.
translation: 我们探测到有多个不同的身份与你相关连。请在之后的界面上检查每个身份的数据，并选择你想继续使用的身份。

original: Identity save has failed. Please check your internet connection and try again.
translation: 身份保存失败。请检查你的互联网连接，然后再试一次。

original: Are you sure you would like to proceed with this identity? This will be the permanent identity associated with you. All Arena Winstreak, Arena League, and Adventure progress will be lost on other identities.
translation: 你确定想要用这个身份来进行游戏吗？一旦确认，这个身份将会永远和您绑定。其他身份的竞技场连胜数、竞技场联赛阶级，甚至冒险进度都将会永远丢失。

original: {FLAVOR}Having studied French Theater at Julienne, the Imitater went to the streets with his art, and has perfected his technique he calls "Potato stuck in a box."
translation: {FLAVOR}在切呈丝学会了法式喜剧后，变身洋芋完善了那项他称为“困在箱子里的土豆”的独门绝技，并带着他的杰作来到了街上。

original: Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!
translation: 变身洋芋可以让你在一道关卡内使用两株相同的植物！

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Performs Plant Food effect of the plant it's imitating.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}执行所模仿植物的植物养料效果。

original: Performs Plant Food effect of the plant it's imitating.
translation: 执行所模仿植物的植物养料效果。

original: Lets you have two of the same plant

/r
{FLAVOR}Imp Pear impairs zombies. Of course, Imps don’t appreciate this characterization, but who cares?
translation:
/r
{FLAVOR}小鬼梨可以让僵尸变弱。当然，小鬼才不喜欢这种设定。不过……谁管它们啊。

original: When zombies eat Imp Pears, they become Imps. When Imps eat Imp Pears, they are destroyed, releasing stunning gas.
translation: 吃了小鬼梨的僵尸会变成小鬼。如果小鬼吃了小鬼梨，它们则会死亡并释放晕眩气体。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Randomly transforms five zombies on the lawn into Imps.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机将草坪上的五只僵尸转换成小鬼。

original: {FLAVOR}Inferno doesn't feel like he gets enough credit. "Of course, I burn zombies," he fumes. "That's a given. But what about how I sweep them down the lane through the sheer force of hot air? Where's my prize for that?"
translation: {FLAVOR}地狱火蕨觉得自己没有得到充分的认可。“我当然能烧伤僵尸，” 他恼火地说，“不用说你也知道。但是我用热气的强大力量击退僵尸的事情呢？不该因此给我一份额外的奖励吗？”

original: Infernos swirl up devastating fire tornados that sweep zombies back, burning and damaging them.
translation: 地狱火蕨可以制造毁灭性的火龙卷，并且击退并烧伤僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Create a huge fire tornado that pulls zombies in the adjacent columns, dealing heavy damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}创造一团巨大的火龙卷，吸入相邻两排的僵尸，造成大量伤害。
让僵尸灰飞烟灭 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 次！

original: Use Cherry Bombs, Jalapenos and more to incinerate zombies!
translation: 使用樱桃炸弹、火爆辣椒等植物焚烧那些罪恶的灵魂！

original: Butter, Sap or Stall Zombies {ACTIONS_LEFT} Times!
translation: 让僵尸毒缓、被砸黄油或树脂减速 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 次！

original: Use Electric Blueberries and more to zap zombies!
translation: 使用电击蓝莓等植物电死来势汹汹的僵尸大军！

original: Use Chard Guard, Hurrikale and more to bounce back pesky zombies!
translation: 使用甜菜护卫、飓风甘蓝等植物击退可恶的僵尸！

original: Use Winter Melons, Snow Peas and more to chill the undead!
translation: 使用冰瓜投手、雪花豌豆等植物冷缓汹汹而来的不死军团！
让 {ACTIONS_LEFT} 只僵尸获得阳光豆效果！

original: {FLAVOR}“How do I revive defeated plants?” asks Intensive Carrot. “In a word: vitamins. Vitamins and sorcery.”
translation: {FLAVOR}“你问我是怎么复活阵亡的植物的？”医护胡萝卜说：“很简单：维生素。维生素再加一点魔法。”

original: Intensive Carrots bring eaten plants back to life.
translation: 医护胡萝卜可以救回堕入死亡深渊的植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Brings eaten plants back to life
Jack o' Lantern is back for a limited time!
{FLAVOR}"Boo! Mwah-ha-ha-haaaaah," opines Jack O' Lantern. Oh, yes. Things and stuff are scheduled to be seriously spooky when he's around. Count on it.
translation: {FLAVOR}“哇嗷！木哈哈哈哈哈哈！”南瓜灯狰狞地笑道。别紧张，只要南瓜灯在你身边，周围的事情就会开始变得诡异起来。习惯就好。

original: Jack O’ Lanterns spray fire down a lane, doing extensive burning damage over a short distance.
translation: 南瓜灯可以向前方一段距离喷射火焰，对多个目标造成短暂的火焰伤害。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons 5 green ghosts on random tiles on the lawn, that continuously deal fire damage to zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}在草坪上的随机地砖上召唤 5 个绿色幽灵，持续对僵尸造成火焰伤害。

original: Fires jets of flame over a short distance
{FLAVOR}This jalapeno is one spicy character by day and The Macramé Vigilante by night. You might be wondering what his secret weapon is… it's knots.
translation: {FLAVOR}火爆辣椒在白天只是个普普通通的辣椒，但到了晚上，他就会摇身一变成为花结守护侠！你问他的超能力是什么？那还用说吗，打结啊。

translation: {FLAVOR}当他还在当地的一家电影院当服务员的时候，他看到了《油炸绿番茄》的海报。从此，他便找到了更高的植生目标。他收拾好谷壳、谷粒和黄油，应征入伍。

original: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and immobilizing butter at zombies.
translation: 玉米投手可以向僵尸投掷玉米粒和让它们定住的黄油。

original: Triggers a butter storm that stuns every zombie on the lawn for a few seconds.

original: {FLAVOR}"I like to keep an even keel," says Kiwibeast. "But zombies... oooh... zombies make me so mad! And when I get mad... RARRRRRGGG!"
translation: {FLAVOR}“我是想冷静的啊！但那些僵尸……”猕猴桃野兽愤怒地说道：“啊啊……那些僵尸弄得我好生气!! 我只要一生气……就……哼哼……啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！”

original: Kiwibeasts emit damaging thumps, and become bigger and more powerful the more they are hurt by zombies.
translation: 猕猴桃野兽可以发出具有极大破坏力的撞击声，僵尸对他的伤害得越多，他就会变得越强。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately grows to its last stage and deal massive damage in the surrounding area.

original: Becomes more powerful as it takes damage

original: {FLAVOR}After a laser eye surgery had gone horribly right, Laser Bean gained a sense of purpose and a new-found affinity for competitive staring contests.
translation: {FLAVOR}在一场成功得令人发指的眼部激光手术之后，激光豆终于找到了植生的意义——他现在已经在瞪眼比赛中战无不胜了。

original: Laser Beans fire down a lane, hitting all zombies ahead of it.
translation: 激光豆可以攻击前方一行的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a huge laser beam at all zombies in the row, dealing huge damage to each zombie.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向一行的所有僵尸发射巨大的激光束，对每只僵尸造成巨大伤害。

original: Shoots a laser that pierces through zombies
translation: 发射可以穿透僵尸的激光

original: {FLAVOR}Lava Guava frowns with barely-repressed rage. He’s trying to keep it in check. He’s trying so hard. But one day some zombie’s going to push him too far, and he can’t be held responsible for the consequences.
translation: {FLAVOR}岩浆番石榴皱着眉头，怒气冲冲。他想努力克制自己的这种情绪，但总会有几只僵尸会不知死活地跑去惹他。没办法，这是它们自找的，他也不用负责任了。

original: Lava Guavas erupt, creating a lava pool that burns zombies.
translation: 岩浆番石榴可以喷发，随后创造一个岩浆池，燃烧踏上的僵尸。

translation: 闪电芦苇可以向周围发射闪电链，闪电链会波及到附近的其他僵尸。

translation: 睡莲叶能让你在水上种植非水生植物。

translation: 把更强大的射手放在后排。

translation: 扔出来的小鬼往往落在相同的位置。

original: Zombies of a world can be defeated by plants of that world.
translation: 来自某个世界的僵尸可以被来自相同世界的植物击败。

original: Stop or slow early zombies to give more time to generate sun.
translation: 前期让僵尸减速或者停下来，可以给你充分的时间积累阳光。

original: Build sun production as fast and early as you can.
translation: 尽快、尽早建立起你的阳光生产体系。

original: Replace sun producers with offensive plants later in the level.
translation: 在关卡后期将阳光生产植物替换成攻击植物。

original: Plant Bonk Choy right behind Wall-nut.
translation: 试试把拳击白菜种在坚果墙后面。

original: Plant sun producers early and often.
translation: 尽早、尽多地种植阳光生产植物。

original: Try for 2 columns of sun producers.
translation: 试着种植 2 排阳光生产植物。

original: Try to save sun for costlier but more powerful plants.
translation: 试着为更贵但更强的植物积攒阳光。

original: Use Plant Food on Sunflowers for a burst of extra sun.
translation: 对向日葵施用植物养料，获得超多阳光。

original: A plant becomes briefly invulnerable during its Plant Food effect.
translation: 正在进行植物养料效果的植物暂时不会受到伤害。

original: Don't be afraid to plant on the right half of the lawn.
translation: 不要害怕把植物种在草坪的右半边。

original: Try insta-kills like Chili Bean or Chomper against heavily armored zombies.
translation: 尝试使用辣豆、大嘴花之类的秒杀植物对抗有强大盔甲的僵尸。
你马上就能解锁{PLANT}了！快来加把劲吧！

original: {ZOMBIE} thinks you're scared! Show 'em you've got what it takes!
translation: {ZOMBIE}觉得你肯定害怕了！用实际行动来打它的脸吧！

original: {ZOMBIE} wants a chance to eat yer brainz, come show 'em who's the boss!
translation: {ZOMBIE}在找机会吃掉你的脑子！给他点颜色瞧瞧！

original: Your Penny Pursuit Fuel has refreshed!
translation: 你的潘妮的追击燃料刷新了！

original: Day 3 of Birthdayz Party is on! Play now and take a bite out of Birthday Cake Pharoah.
translation: 生日派对第 3 天开始啦！快来尝尝生日蛋糕（法老僵尸）吧！

original: Play day 4 of the Birthdayz Party event right now for zombies jet-packed with presents!
translation: 现在游玩生日派对第 4 天，打败背着礼包外壳喷射器的僵尸！

original: Gargantuar has crashed today’s Birthdayz Party. Play now to wrap him up!
translation: 巨人僵尸闯入了今日的生日派对。立即开玩，把他重新打包回礼物盒中！

original: Feastivus Day 2 is on! Do I hear reindeer on the lawn? Play now!
translation: 盛宴节第 2 天到了！我是听见草坪上有驯鹿的声音吗？现在来玩吧！

original: It’s beginning to look a lot like the end of Feastivus. Only a few days left. Play now!
translation: 我开始感觉盛宴节要结束了。佳节不足数日。快快开玩吧！

original: It’s the final day of Feastivus! Fa-la-la-la-last chance!
translation: 盛宴节最后一天了！抓紧最后时机颂唱圣歌！

original: Get double Snowballs when you win a power up in Feastivus. Snowball fight is on!
translation: 盛宴节可赢取双倍的雪球指。雪仗开打！

original: Win Snow Pea’s winter hat collection. Keep your brains warm. Feastivus is on!
translation: 赢取雪花豌豆的冬日帽子装束。注意脑子保暖。盛宴佳节已至！

original: Try out Sap-fling in Feastivus today. Stickier than fruitcake! Play now.
translation: 今天来盛宴节活动试用树脂抛手吧。比莓果蛋糕还要黏！快来玩吧。

original: Win 5 in a row and get special Feastivus rewards from Señor Piñata. He loves a good holiday bash!
translation: 连续胜利 5 场，赢取来自大彩陶的奖励。他可喜欢盛宴节了！

original: Day 11 of Feastivus is on. The Imps have been hung by the Gargantuars with care. Don't miss out!
translation: 盛宴节第 11 天开始了。小鬼已被巨人僵尸精心“挂”好。别错过了！

original: Sap-fling is back for Day 12 of Feastivus. Pinecones, away!
translation: 树脂抛手在盛宴节第 12 天回归。松果走起！

original: Play Feastivus and start off the New Year with a fresh brain!
translation: 畅玩盛宴节，用清爽的脑子开启新的一年！

translation: 盛宴节来临！佳节尚未结束，巨人僵尸也尚未脱下那件丑毛衣。快来玩吧。

translation: 今天的彩陶派对开启了！快去击败僵尸吧！

original: Win {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} Piñata Parties in a row for big prizes!
translation: 连续赢得 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 场彩陶派对，就能赢得大奖！

original: Win PRIZES in a 24-hour battle with zombies from all worlds!
translation: 与来自各个时空的僵尸酣战到天明，赢取你的战利品！

original: Win today's Piñata Party for {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} in a row!
translation: 赢得今天的彩陶派对，即可完成 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 连胜！

original: A new Penny Pursuit level has unlocked!
translation: 潘妮的追击新关卡解锁了！

original: You have a personal best of Level {LEVEL_NUMBER} in {DANGER_ROOM_NAME}. Think you can do it again?
translation: 你在{DANGER_ROOM_NAME}的个人最佳纪录是第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 级。想再试一次吗？

original: You reached Level {LEVEL_NUMBER} in the {DANGER_ROOM_NAME}. The Zombies say you can't go higher. Prove ‘em wrong.
translation: 你在{DANGER_ROOM_NAME}已经达到第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 级了。僵尸说这就是你的极限，快去向他们证明自己吧。

original: You’re so close to your personal best of Level {LEVEL_NUMBER} in {DANGER_ROOM_NAME}. Can you make it?
translation: 你离自己在{DANGER_ROOM_NAME}创造的个人最佳纪录——第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 级已经很接近了。去超越自己吧！

original: The Zombies say you can’t pass Level {LEVEL_NUMBER} in {DANGER_ROOM_NAME}. Silly Zombies. Go for it.
translation: 僵尸都在说你过不了{DANGER_ROOM_NAME}的第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 级。证明自己吧！

original: The current tournament has ended, and a new one begins!
translation: 当前赛程已经结束，下一赛程即将开始！

original: The current tournament ends tomorrow! Last chance to compete!
translation: 当季的赛程将于明天结束，抓住最后机会完成任务吧！

original: You have another Free Play in Arena mode!
translation: 你又可以免费游玩竞技场了！

original: Your piñatas have refreshed! Replay levels to win World piñatas!
translation: 彩陶追踪计时器重置了！重新游玩关卡，赢取世界彩陶！

original: The current Penny Pursuit event has ended, and a new one begins!
translation: 当前的潘妮的追击任务已经结束，新的任务又开始了！

original: The current Penny Pursuit event ends tomorrow! Last chance to earn awards!
translation: 当前的潘妮的追击任务将在明天结束，抓住最后机会获取奖励吧！

original: The current season ends soon! Last chance for awards!
translation: 当前赛季即将结束！抓紧最后机会赢取丰厚奖励吧！

original: A new season has begun! Compete for awards!
translation: 新赛季现已开启！投入对战，赢取丰厚奖励！

original: Travel Log Update: Onward to {WORLD}! {QUEST_TITLE} to earn {XP_GRANTED} points.
translation: 旅行木标更新：向{WORLD}前进！{QUEST_TITLE}，获取 {XP_GRANTED} 点数。

original: Travel Log Update: You’ve defeated {DEFEATED_COUNT} brain-hungry zombies! Only {DEFEATS_NEEDED} left to complete the Quest.
translation: 旅行木标更新：你已经击败 {DEFEATED_COUNT} 只饥渴的僵尸了！再击败 {DEFEATS_NEEDED} 只即可完成任务。

original: Travel Log Update: You’re almost there! Earn {XP_NEEDED} points and level up to Rank {NEXT_RANK}.
translation: 旅行木标更新：马上就好了！再获取 {XP_NEEDED} 点数，就能升级到 {NEXT_RANK} 阶了！

original: Your Daily Gift is available in the store! Collect it now!
translation: 你的每日礼物已经在商店里了！快去收集吧！

original: Don’t forget to collect your Daily Gift from the store!
translation: 别忘了去商店收集你的每日礼物！

original: New Adventure Seeds are now available in the store!
translation: 新的冒险种子包现已上架商店！

original: Come back for a new FREE pinata in the store!
translation: 回到商店领取免费彩陶吧！

original: Play Vasebreaker today! Those vases won’t smash themselves.
translation: 来玩玩今天的的破瓶者！这些花瓶可不会自己敲自己。

original: You're smashing it up in Vasebreaker! Play now to break your all-time zombie-wave record.
translation: 你在破瓶者中势如破竹！继续游玩，打破你曾经的僵尸波数记录。

original: Take another go at Vasebreaker! Stand up. Dust off your plants. The zombies are waiting.
translation: 再来试试破瓶者吧！唤醒你的植物，击倒虎视眈眈的僵尸！

original: Unlock the Butterizer! Defeat three Vasebreaker levels and all the butter is yours.
translation: 解锁黄油指！完成三道破瓶者关卡后，黄油之力将由你掌控。

original: Take on the Vasebreaker again to unlock the mighty Butterizer!
translation: 再玩一关破瓶者，即可获得闪耀非凡的黄油指！

original: Don’t stop Vasebreaking now! One more level and Butterizer and its mighty butter are yours!
translation: 别在现在停止破瓶！仅需一关便可解锁闪耀非凡的黄油指，它那巨多的黄油将就此归你所有！

original: The zombies are coming in Vasebreaker! Defeat {ENDLESS_WAVE} waves to take control with the Vase Displacer!
translation: 僵尸又来到破瓶者了！砸破 {ENDLESS_WAVE} 波花瓶便可掌握移瓶指！

original: See hidden zombies. Finish the Vasebreaker tutorial now and get X-Ray power!
translation: 窥见藏匿于瓶中的僵尸。立即完成破瓶者引导关，获得 X 光的能力！

original: You have sprouts waiting in your Zen Garden. Plant them quick and add power to your game.
translation: 你的幼芽在禅境花园中等着。快去种下他们，在游戏中获得更强的力量吧。

original: You have unplanted sprouts in your Zen Garden. Grow 'em up right to give your plants a boost.
translation: 你的禅境花园里尚有未种植的幼苗，快快让他们长大来为你的植物提供强化吧！

original: Your plants have grown. Collect your boosted plants in Zen Garden!
translation: 你的植物成熟了！在禅境花园获得它的强化卡片吧！

original: Your plants have grown! Visit your Zen Garden to collect heaps of coins.
translation: 你的植物成熟了，去禅境花园里收集产出的硬币吧！

original: Your plants have grown! Collect your boosted plants in Zen Garden!
translation: 你的植物成熟了！在禅境花园获得它的强化卡片吧！

original: It's getting dry in your Zen Garden. Water your plants now to get more BOOM in your blooms.
translation: 禅境花园的植物感到口渴了。立刻为你的植物浇水，让他们在花蕾中孕育更多奇迹！

original: Water your Zen Garden now and get cool gifts. Don't let your happy plants go dry.
translation: 现在去禅境花园浇水，获取丰厚奖励吧！别让原本快乐的植物干枯掉哦。

original: Your plants have grown! Collect your boosted plants in Zen Garden!
translation: 你的植物成熟了！在禅境花园获得它的强化卡片吧！

original: Your plants are sporting super powers! Visit Zen Garden to unleash them.
translation: 你的植物获得超能力了！快去禅境花园看看。

original: The plants in your Zen Garden have boosted!
translation: 你在禅境花园的植物获得强化了！

original: Your plants are all grown up.  Visit your Zen Garden to pick up your boosts.
translation: 你的植物已经全部成熟了，去禅境花园收集属于你的强化卡片吧！

original: You have boosts waiting to be used!   Visit Zen Garden for buffed up buds.
translation: 强化卡片随时等着你去使用！来禅境花园收集强化过的幼苗吧。

original: Your {PLANT} has grown! Water it again to give it super powers.
translation: 你的{PLANT}成熟啦！再去浇一次水来让它获得超能力。

original: Your {PLANT} has grown! Collect your boosted plants in Zen Garden!
translation: 你的{PLANT}成熟啦！来禅境花园获得它的强化卡片吧！

original: Your {PLANT} has grown! Water it again to boost its power.
translation: 你的{PLANT}成熟啦！再去浇一次水来加强它的能力。

original: Your {PLANT} has grown to full size! Visit Zen Garden to pick up your super plant powers.
translation: 你的{PLANT}长大了！快去禅境花园捡起你的强化卡片吧！

original: Your Marigold is fully grown! Visit your Zen Garden for an extra-big payout.
translation: 你的金盏花长大了！回到禅境花园去得到奖励吧！

original: Your Marigold just kicked out some serious coin!
translation: 你的金盏花吐出了一些硬币！

original: Your Marigold has grown! Water it again for an extra-big payout.
translation: 你的金盏花已长成！给它再浇一次水将有额外的报酬。

original: Dr. Zomboss will escape soon. Defeat him for rewards!
translation: 僵王博士将于不久后择机而逃。击败他，赢取奖励！

original: What's in Treasure Yeti's lunchbox? Defeat him to find out!
translation: 宝藏雪人的午餐盒里藏着什么秘密？只有击败他才能知道！

original: What's in Treasure Yeti's lunchbox? Defeat him to find out!
translation: 宝藏雪人的午餐盒里藏着什么秘密？只有击败他才能知道！

original: Treasure Yeti won't give up without a fight. So fight him!
translation: 宝藏雪人不打一架是不会善罢甘休的，去打他一顿吧！

original: Sometimes Treasure Yeti sneaks up on you. Like right now!
translation: 宝藏雪人有时会悄悄地接近你，就像这样！

original: Treasure Yeti is loose! Defeat him now to win his riches.
translation: 宝藏雪人要跑路了！击败他，赢得他的财富！

original: Fight for the awesome things in Treasure Yeti's lunchbox.
translation: 击败宝藏雪人，夺取他午餐盒里的宝藏

original: Defeat the Treasure Yeti now to get what's in his lunchbox.
translation: 快击败宝藏雪人，赢取他午餐盒中宝物

original: Eat the Treasure Yeti's delicious lunch... of treasure!
translation: 享用宝藏雪人的美味午餐……盒里面的宝藏！

original: The Treasure Yeti thinks you're weak. Prove him wrong!
translation: 宝藏雪人觉得你太弱了。向他证明自己！

original: Defeat the Treasure Yeti and take his lunchbox. Do it now!
translation: 快！击败宝藏雪人，夺取他的午餐盒！

original: There's only one way to get Treasure Yeti's riches. Fight!
translation: 只有一种方法能得到宝藏雪人的财宝——击败他！

original: Take some whacks at SEÑOR PIÑATA by playing {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} consecutive parties.
translation: 连续游玩 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 场彩陶派对，就能赢取大号彩陶！

original: Play {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} days in a row to earn a Grand Prize!!
translation: 连续游玩 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 天，获取大奖！

original: Take some whacks at the Hero-Tron 5000 by playing 5 consecutive parties.
translation: 连续游玩 5 次彩陶派对，就能赢取英雄机 5000！

original: Get a giant present by playing {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} consecutive parties.
translation: 连续游玩 {LARGE_PINATA_INTERVAL} 次彩陶派对，赢取一份超级大礼！

original: Whack SEÑOR PIÑATA x3 times to open the Mystery Treasure!
translation: 敲 3 次高级彩陶，赢取神秘额外奖励！

original: Whack the Hero-Tron 5000 to open the Mystery Treasure!
translation: 敲开英雄机 5000，赢取神秘奖励！

original: Tap the giant present 3 times to open the Mystery Treasure!
translation: 轻点 3 次超级大礼，赢取神秘额外奖励！

original: Tap the fireworks box 3 times to open the Mystery Treasure!
translation: 轻点 3 次烟花，赢取神秘额外奖励！

original: Double coin rewards with every win!
translation: 每次胜利都能得到双倍硬币！
畅享双倍硬币奖励！本次彩陶的赞助商是

original: Summer Nights - Loads of coins with every win!
translation: 畅游仲夏夜 - 每次胜利都会奖励大量硬币哦！
轻点以打开 3 份礼物
轻点以发射 3 枚烟花

original: TAP to open and find out what treasure lies inside.
translation: 轻点即可打开，找出里面的宝藏。
失落之城 - 第 {LEVEL_NUMBER} 天

original: Luck of the Zombie Ad Pinata
Luck of the Zombie Mini Pinata
Luck of the Zombie Premium Pinata

translation: 幸运星高级彩陶捆绑包
幸运星彩陶新人薄荷包

original: Your device is low on disk space. Your progress may not be saved.
translation: 你设备上的储存空间已经捉襟见肘了。游戏进度可能无法保存。

original: Watch an ad for an energy!
translation: 观看广告，获取 1 份能量！

original: Watch an ad or purchase more energy! Earn more energy in {DURATION}.
translation: 观看广告赚取能量，或者去购买更多能量！{DURATION}后你就能领取更多能量。

original: Your Limited Thyme Event energy is refilled - come play!
translation: 你的限时活动能量已经补充完毕了——来接着玩吧！

original: These swashbuckling zombies ain't landlubbers but they're making an exception for your lawn! Play through the Pirates o' the Seas event and send these pirates sailing! The Limited Thyme Event is active for a limited thyme!
translation: 这些侠盗剑客僵尸可不是旱鸭子，但望到你的草坪，它们决定强势登陆！快来参加港湾海盗活动，让这些海盗回到海上去！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

original: Sun, Sand and Zombie-slaying fun! Grab your sunscreen, hit the waves and take down those beach-bumming zombies.
translation: 阳光、沙滩，一起来痛痛快快地爆杀僵尸！戴上你的太阳镜，消灭阵阵尸潮，激起波波巨浪！

original: Happy Birthdayz! Embark on a new Thymed Adventure with Dave, Penny and the gang to celebrate the start of PvZ2.
translation: 生日快乐！快来与戴夫、潘妮，以及其他伙伴一起踏上新的限时冒险之旅，一同庆祝《植物大战僵尸 2》诞辰。

original: The Zombies are coming to town in the greatest show on the lawn!  BigTop Extravaganza will be here for a limited thyme!
translation: “僵”临此地，上演拿手好戏。大帐篷盛会即将限时开启！

original: Even zombies love Feastivus! Protect your lawn from Dr. Zomboss and his ever growing horde of festive zombies.
translation: 就连僵尸也喜欢盛宴节！别让僵王带着圣诞僵尸大军践踏你的草坪。

original: Let the Food Fight begin! Food Fight your way through zombie filled levels to become the king of the food lawn.
translation: 开始吧，食物大战！用美食，在僵尸横行的关卡中战出一条血路，称霸食物草坪。

original: Harvest season is here and it's time to harvest your crops and protect your lawn from the onslaught of zombies.
translation: 丰收的季节到了，快来收获庄稼，别让僵尸的猛攻摧毁你的草坪。

original: Go head to head with the zombie in this season's Lawnbowl! No doubt Dr. Zomboss will stop at nothing to reach the goal.
translation: 在本季草坪碗中与僵尸正面交锋！为夺胜券，僵王博士肯定会不择手段。

original: It’s back, time for the next season of Lawnbowl! Zomboss has a new trick and he’s ready to unleash it onto the field. We are headed for Overtime during this Thymed event!
translation: 盛大回归——新一季草坪碗正式开幕！僵王又想了个坏点子，想在赛场上耍花招。一起在本次的限时活动中激情角逐，直至加时赛！

original: Play through our spooky Lawn of Doom! Zombies at every step! Maybe even bats! Use your plants to get you through. And remember that Thymed Events are limited thyme!
translation: 来玩玩令人毛骨悚然的末日草坪活动吧！这里，“尸横遍野”，说不定还有蝙蝠相伴！快带上你的植物朋友，挺过这恐怖的万圣之夜。别忘了，限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧！

original: Zombies have crashed into your lawn. Prove that you hold the four leaf clover in Luck o' the Zombie event.
translation: 僵尸闯入了你的草坪。在僵尸幸运星活动中证明手握四叶草的人是你。

original: Celebrate the new Lunar Zoo Year and defend your lawn with your favorite zodiac plant in this Limited Thymed Event.
translation: 一同庆祝笼笠新年，在这场限时活动中用你最爱的生肖植物守卫草坪。

original: Mega Gatling Pea is ready for some snowy fun! He's bringing his squad and needs your help beating levels, earning coins and seeds to complete his Winter Adventure.
translation: 超级机枪豌豆已整装待发，试在这皑皑白雪中找点乐子！植物小队集结完毕，但要想通过这些关卡，获取硬币、种子，最终通过冬日大冒险，他还需要你的帮助。

original: Claim your rewards, if you can beat these grueling levels that stress both your plant and zombie knowledge. This event won’t be around forever! Dr. Zomboss is already hard at work on next week’s levels.
translation: 知己知彼，通过这些严酷的关卡，奖励非你莫属。这次活动时间有限！僵王博士已经在努力研究下周的关卡了。

original: Let's get ready to Zombosseum! Battle the ever increasing horde of zombies to earn your place as the Champion!
translation: 备战僵王斗兽场！打败日益壮大的僵尸大军，夺得冠军王座！

original: Bunny zombies and eggs?! It must be Springening! Play and defeat the zombies and save the eggs to earn unique rewards!
translation: 兔子僵尸？复活节彩蛋?! 看来暖春节又到了！游玩关卡，击败僵尸，收集彩蛋，获取奖励！

original: The heat is high and the chance of zombies is even higher! Beat back the summer heat in this limited Thymed Event.
translation: 温度再高，也不如僵尸出现的概率高！来这场限时活动中击退盛夏热浪。

original: Descend into the Tomb to find the hidden tacos. Find secrets and untold treasure, if you survive the inhabitants!!!
translation: 潜入陵墓，探寻神秘玉米卷。在陵中居民的袭击中生存下来，探索那耐人寻味的秘密、不为人知的宝藏!!!

original: Tomb Tangler is the new tombstone eatin' plant in town. Help defeat the zombies and remember - Tomb Tangler has some surprises up his sleeve! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time.
translation: 欢迎全新食墓植物——坟墓缠绕者来到镇上。快来帮他击败僵尸，同时也别忘了——他其实还藏了一手！限时活动时间有限，赶紧来玩吧。

original: Lock up your Gems and get prepared for the ultimate financial apocalypse. ZCorp is here, and they're hungry for profits!
translation: 锁好宝石，准备迎接即将来袭的金融风暴。Z 公司随浪而至，虎视眈眈，想要榨取每寸利益。

original: Play Events to get special rewards - including plant seeds! Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants. Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
translation: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括各种植物种子包！有的关卡可能会有一点难度，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！活动时间有限，过了时间可就不能再玩了哦！

original: Play Events to get special rewards. Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants! Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
translation: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励。有的关卡可能会有一点难度，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！活动时间有限，过了时间可就不能再玩了哦！

original: Play Events to get special rewards - including Food Fight pinatas and plant seeds. Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants to win! Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
translation: 游玩活动，即可赢取特殊奖励：包括食物大战彩陶，还有其他植物种子包！有的关卡可能会有一点难度，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！活动时间有限，过了时间可就不能再玩了哦！

original: Play Thymed Events to earn special rewards - including plant seeds! If you reach a difficult level, make sure to level up your plants. Thymed Events are, well, timed and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
translation: 游玩限时活动，即可获取特殊奖励：包括各种植物种子包！如果你遇到了比较难的关卡，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！限时活动……很明显，时间有限。过了时间可就不能再玩了哦！

original: Play Thymed Events to earn special rewards - including plant seeds! If you reach a difficult level, make sure to level up your plants. Thymed Events are, well, timed and cannot be played after the clock runs out!
translation: 游玩限时活动，即可获取特殊奖励：包括各种植物种子包！如果你遇到了比较难的关卡，把植物升到更高等级即可提高你的获胜几率！限时活动……很明显，时间有限。过了时间可就不能再玩了哦！

original: Play Events to get special rewards - including plant seeds! Some Event levels are difficult - make sure to level up your plants. Events are limited time and cannot be played after the clock runs out!

original: {FLAVOR}Despite his unusual appearance, Magnet-shroom doesn't have a problem attracting girlfriends. But he does have a problem keeping them. It's the same thing every time. In the end, they always find him too clingy.
translation: {FLAVOR}尽管他的外表与众不同，磁铁菇依然可以很轻松地吸引异性来当他的女朋友。不过他很难留住她们，每次都一样。因为到最后，她们总是发现他真的太黏人了。

original: Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.
translation: 磁铁菇可以把僵尸身上的金属物品吸走。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Remove and toss all metal objects on zombies within range, dealing damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}移除范围内僵尸身上的所有金属物品，然后把它们扔出去，造成伤害。

original: Removes helmets and other metal objects from zombies
translation: 从僵尸身上移除头盔等金属物品

original: {FLAVOR}Magnifying Grass understands the inherent power of a rainbow. Beneath her stoic features she takes great joy in delivering radiant multicolored destruction to the zombie horde.
translation: {FLAVOR}透镜草熟知彩虹的内在力量。在她坚韧的外表下，藏着的是为僵尸带来七彩光芒的心愿——七彩的毁灭之光。

original: Magnifying Grass turns sun into a bolt of colorful damage.
translation: 透镜草可以将阳光转化为七彩的高能光束。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots an energy beam that deals damage to zombies in its row. The beam duration increases based on the number of sun-producing plants on the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射一串能量光束，对所在行中的僵尸造成伤害。草坪上的阳光生产类植物越多，光束的持续时间就越长。

original: Tap to spend sun for a powerful attack
translation: 轻点即可花费阳光发动强大攻击

original: If you DELETE this profile you will lose all game play data associated with this profile including any purchased coins.
translation: 删除此档案将失去所有游戏进度数据，包括任何通过内购获得的硬币。

original: {FLAVOR} Mangofier’s straightforward nature leaves little for the imagination. But one thing still remains a mystery and has stumped even the brightest minds. What is the Mangofier’s beam made out of?  Numerous hypotheses have been made… Solar Radiation? A form of Thermal Condensation? Reverse Photosynthesis? Dave claims to know the answer, and has published an 8 page thesis on this subject. Titled ‘Wabby Wab-boobo’.
translation: {FLAVOR}聚光芒生而直来直往，没有留给大家半点可以想象的空间：但有件事至今还是个谜，难倒一众智者——聚光芒的光束是从哪儿来的？种种假设接踵而至…来自太阳辐射？某种热缩合？或者是逆光合作用？戴夫声称自己知道答案，并就此发表了一篇长达 8 页的论文。标题为“歪比巴卜”。

original: Utility launcher plant that can be toggled between focus and cluster firing modes. Its long range attacks can reach all parts of the lawn.
translation: 一株可以在聚集与发散两种发射模式间进行切换的功能性发射器类植物。攻击范围很大，可以覆盖草坪上的每个角落。

original: Mangofier’s long range attack can switch between focus damage, taking out high value targets or spread damage to take out multiple smaller threats.
translation: 聚光芒攻击范围很大，既可以造成聚集伤害，消灭高价值目标；也可以造成发散伤害，消灭数名威胁更小的敌人。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Focuses ambient energy to continuously blast zombies on the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}聚集周围的能量，连续轰炸草坪上的僵尸。

original: Toggles between focus or spread launcher fire modes.
translation: 可以在聚集与发散两种发射模式间进行切换。

original: {FLAVOR}Marigold has dedicated herself to the Zen lifestyle. She's a team player, and gives it her best there in the garden. But if she never has to confront another zombie on the lawn again it will be too soon.
translation: {FLAVOR}金盏花喜欢禅境生活。她在花园里是群花中最美丽的那一支。但若是到草坪战场上，她还是太嫩了。

original: Marigolds give you coin rewards in Zen Garden.
translation: 金盏花可以在禅境花园给予你硬币作为奖励。

original: Gives you rewards in Zen Garden
translation: 在禅境花园中为你提供奖励

original: Try out the amazing leveled-up Peashooters!
translation: 试试令人震惊的高等级豌豆射手！

original: {FLAVOR} “I'm more than just a set of pretty bells ya know? I can also throw a wicked curveball.”
translation: {FLAVOR}“你知道吗，我可不仅仅是一株美丽的铃兰，我扔出的弧线也是一条邪恶而致命的美丽。”

original: A defensive enchanted projectile plant that captures and shoots pesky bee-like projectiles that target nearby zombies when threatened.
translation: 一株可以发射子弹的防御性魔法植物，可以捕捉讨厌的蜜蜂状物体作为子弹，把它们发射出去，“蜜蜂”被惊扰后会对附近的僵尸发起进攻。

original: When fired over Lightning Reed projectile damage is boosted. Try this with Plant Food for maximum damage!
translation: 发射后如果穿过闪电芦苇，可以加强子弹的伤害。巧妙利用这个技巧，配合植物养料效果，达到最大伤害！

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a barrage of stronger bee-like projectiles to seek out targets all across the board and for a short time leaves zombies that survived the attack stunned!
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射一连串更为强大的“蜜蜂”子弹，在全场寻找攻击目标。如果僵尸被攻击后仍然存活，则会让其眩晕一小段时间！

original: Fires multiple bee-like projectiles that target nearby zombies.
translation: 发射数枚瞄准附近僵尸的“蜜蜂”子弹。

original: {FLAVOR}"I used to be an upgrade," says Mega Gatling Pea with uncharacteristic shyness. "Now I'm my own plant, with my own ambitions, dreams and gym club memberships!"
translation: {FLAVOR}“以前，我只是一株升级植物”超级机枪豌豆带着平日里不曾有过的羞涩说。“不过现在，我独立了。我有了自己的志向、自己的梦想，甚至还有了自己的健身房会员！”

original: Mega Gatling Peas fire four peas at a time, and will occasionally Plant Food itself.
translation: 超级机枪豌豆可以同时发射四颗豌豆，偶尔还会自己产生植物养料效果。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a huge number of peas out, dealing massive damage. Normal attack will fire five peas instead of four, permanently.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射大量豌豆，造成巨大伤害。此后的普通攻击将永久从发射四颗豌豆升级为发射五颗。

original: {FLAVOR}"Everyone says my head looks like a melon," said the middle child of the Pult family, "and they would be right." Don't ask him if he's seedless or not though, it offends him and frankly it's none of your business.
translation: {FLAVOR}“别人都说我的头像个西瓜，”投手家族的老二说，“也许他们是对的。”但千万别问他是不是无籽西瓜，他一听到这话就冒火，而且……关你什么事啊喂！

original: Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.
translation: 西瓜投手可以对僵尸造成巨额伤害。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches melons at every zombie, dealing both damage and splash damage on impact.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向每只僵尸发射西瓜，既可以造成直接伤害，也能造成溅射伤害。

original: Heavy melons are launched up that target every zombie on the lawn.
translation: 发射大量沉重的西瓜，砸向草坪上的每只僵尸。

original: Does heavy damage to groups of zombies
translation: 对成群僵尸造成大量伤害

original: {FLAVOR}”Out of this world molten mayhem! But first… coffee!!”
translation: {FLAVOR}“坠落吧——熔火狂欢！但在这之前……来杯咖啡!!”

original: Meteor Flower conjures meteor strikes from the sky that leave molten tiles.
translation: 流星花可以从空中召唤流星坠，被砸中的格子会被融化。

translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}召唤 3 颗流星坠，造成伤害，并在撞击的地方形成熔池。

original: Meteor Flower conjures meteor strikes from the sky.
translation: 流星花可以从空中召唤流星坠。

original: {FLAVOR}While she is called Missile Toe, Missile Toe has no toes and, properly speaking, lacks missiles. How'd she get her name? Nepotism! Pure favoritism!

original: {FLAVOR} "Some say that encasing yourself in gelatin is no way to conduct an offense," says Murkadamia Nut with an infectious twinkle. "I say they just haven't planted ME yet!"
translation: {FLAVOR}“有人说，‘你真以为把自己放在果冻里就可以刀枪不入了？’”黑暗夏威夷果的眼中闪了一道不屑而又自信的光，说道：“那他们可能还没见过我。”

original: Murkadamia Nuts are defensive shadow plants who, when powered, grow jelly murk to damage attacking zombies.
translation: 黑暗夏威夷果是一株防御性植物，在被暗影强化时，可以生长出黑暗果冻对僵尸造成伤害。

暗影强化后，可以对僵尸造成伤害

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Fools! Seek your taco. Soon you shall feast... on a taco of DOOM!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}蠢货！去找你的玉米卷吧！很快……你就会享用这顿玉米卷盛宴……带来的毁灭！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{LONG}Those peashooters are confused and are just going to be in the way.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{LONG}这些豌豆射手好像有点懵住了，还挡了我们的路。

original: {EXCITED}{LONG}Use the shovel to dig them up and make room for useful plants!
translation: {EXCITED}{LONG}使用铲子移走它们，为更有用的植物腾出空间！
{PLAYFUL}我可以借一下那瓶辣椒酱吗？

original: {BRINGOUT_TACO}{SAY}{LONG}I've been holding onto this taco for forever!
translation: {BRINGOUT_TACO}{SAY}{LONG}这块玉米卷我已经拿在手上……一辈子了！

original: {EXCITED}I want to eat THAT taco again! I need my TIME MACHINE!
translation: {EXCITED}我还想再吃一次刚刚那块玉米卷！我需要我的时光机！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Her name is Penny and I'm Crazy Dave. But you can call me Crazy Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}她叫潘妮，我叫疯狂戴夫。你也可以简称我为疯狂戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}Finally, another User who can process my queries.
translation: {SAY:winnie}终于出现了，一位能正确向我下达指令的用户。

original: {TIRED:winnie}Let me postulate, Dave wants to go back in time to eat his taco... again...
translation: {TIRED:winnie}让我猜一猜，戴夫想要回到过去……再一次……吃到他的玉米卷…

original: {SAY:crazydave}She's so smart! Now let's go after my taco!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}她真聪明！现在一同去追寻我的玉米卷吧！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Fools! Seek your taco. Soon you shall feast... on a taco of DOOM!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}蠢货！去找你的玉米卷吧！很快……你就会享用这顿玉米卷盛宴……带来的毁灭！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}I wonder if Plant Food works on other types of plants?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}不知道植物养料对其他植物会有什么效果？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}{LONG}Aww...you let your plant get eaten! Try again!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED}{LONG}啊……你的植物被吃掉了！再试一次！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}{LONG}I love the smell of coconut cannons in the morning!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}{LONG}我喜欢一大早就闻到椰子加农炮的味道！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{LONG}It appears the zombies have been gathered in that corral.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{LONG}看来僵尸已经聚集在围栏里了。

original: {SAY}{MEDIUM}Better plant something before they get loose.
translation: {SAY}{MEDIUM}最好在他们“失缰”前种些什么。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Oh good. There are no zombies here.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Ail-mint family includes fungi and poison plants.
translation: {SAY:winnie}衰薄家族包括菌类和有毒的植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Tap 'Find More' to see where you can find more seed packets for each plant.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}轻点“寻找更多”即可查看获取每种植物种子包的地点。

original: {SAY:crazydaveicon}I need a place to collect and upgrade my plants!
translation: {SAY:crazydaveicon}我需要个地方来收纳、升级我的植物！
{NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}你是指类似“交互式图鉴”的东西？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Some of your plants are ready to Rank Up!  Choose a worthy one.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}你的某些植物已经可以升阶了！选一株合适的吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Ranking Up will increase your plant's and its whole family's power.  Tap RANK UP to try it out.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}升阶可以提高那株植物，及其整个家族的力量。轻点“升阶”试试吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Take those seed packets you won and upgrade your Peashooter!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}用你赢得的种子包来升级豌豆射手！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Looks like you can upgrade your Wallnut too!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}看来你的坚果墙也可以升级了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} 超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得他们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Appease-mint family includes peas and other straight shooters.
translation: {SAY:winnie}喷薄家族包括豌豆以及其他直线射手植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Arma-mint Family comprises various lobbing and cannon plants.
translation: {SAY:winnie}重荷家族包括投掷和炮弹植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Tap on Banana Launcher, then a tile, to launch explosive banana.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} 轻点香蕉火箭炮，再轻点一块地砖，即可发射爆炸香蕉弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave. Please note the line of Banana Launchers.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，请注意那一排香蕉发射器。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Let's get to it! After all, bananas are a very a-PEELING fruit!
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, if I had a head, I would be shaking it right now.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，如果我有皮肤的话，我已经起鸡皮疙瘩了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My research indicates that the sport of bowling experienced a heyday during this era.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的研究表明，保龄球运动在这时正处于鼎盛时期。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Are you thinking what I'm thinking, Penny?
{TIRED:winnie}I find your thought process indecipherable, User Dave.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}我觉得你的思考过程很难解读，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}I was thinking that Bowling Bulbs would make excellent allies here.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我觉得此情此景，保鳞茎会成为我们最棒的盟友。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Huh. I was thinking how much I love wearing bowling shoes.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}嗯。其实我刚刚在想自己有多爱穿保龄球鞋。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}So many colors ... right there on my feet!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}穿上保龄球鞋……我的双脚五彩斑斓！

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}...we need a plant with the appetite of a shark.
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}…我们需要一种有着鲨鱼般欲望的植物。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I catch your drift, Penny. You're talking about Chomper!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}我懂你意思了，潘妮。你是在说大嘴花吧！

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. His sharp teeth could turn the tide of battle.
translation: {SAY:winnie}的确如此。他的尖牙可以扭转战局。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Hey, I have an idea too! We could call this Chomper Week!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}嘿，我也有个主意！我们可以把这周称作“大嘴花之周”！

original: {TIRED:winnie}If we must, User Dave. If we must.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}到时候再说吧，用户戴夫。到时候再说。

original: {SAY:crazydave}It's got everything a growing plant needs!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}它有着植物生长所需要的一切！
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}阳光、沙滩，还有源源不断的浪花儿！

original: {SAY:winnie}Caution, User Dave. My sensors indicate there are zombies on your beach...
translation: {SAY:winnie}当心，用户戴夫。我的传感器表明你的海滩上有许多僵尸…

original: {SAY:winnie}... and far too much water. It will overwhelm the plants.
translation: {SAY:winnie}…还有过多的海水。它会淹没你的植物。

original: {SAY:crazydave}No problem-o! We'll just lay down some Lily Pads.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}这可没问题！我们只需要先放些睡莲叶。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Then the other plants can ride the waves!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}然后其他植物就可以凌驾于海浪之上了！

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Or as the vernacular of this era goes: They can "hang ten."
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}或者用这里的土话来说：它们可以“踏浪前行”。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Listen up, dudes! I'm here to totally bum you out.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}你们几个，听好了！我要把你们狠狠拍在沙滩上。

original: {SAY}Way down deep, there's a certain creep...
{SAY}When he swims up, your brains he'll keep!
translation: {SAY}当他的身影从海洋中浮起，你的脑子将落到他的手上！
{SAY}回见，你们这群废柴！僵王博士

original: {TIRED:winnie}He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}看得出来他对我们很不爽，用户戴夫。非常不爽。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Dudes, like, you're totally in for it now!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}你们几个，我说啊，已经死到临头了！

original: {SAY}The Deep Sea Gargantuars have their slimy sights on you.
translation: {SAY}深海巨人僵尸那黏糊糊的视线盯上你们了。

original: {SAY}But you can't escape their scaly grip!
translation: {SAY}但是你绝对逃不过他们粗糙的掌心！

original: {TIRED:winnie}He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}看得出来他对我们很不爽，用户戴夫。非常不爽。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I tell ya, Penny, these surf-loving zombies are the pits!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}我说过的，潘妮，这些爱冲浪的僵尸太废渣了！

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Hmmm. Pits. Very interesting. User Dave! You are a genius!
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}额。废渣。相当有趣。用户戴夫！你真是个天才！

original: {TIRED:winnie}No. No you are not. However, you have given me an idea.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}不，你并不是。不过，你给了我一个好主意。

original: {EXCITED:winnie}Guacodile! This plant fights zombies with pit-like projectiles.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}鳄梨！这种植物用类似废渣的子弹同僵尸战斗。

original: {SAY:winnie}And he employs a powerful bite as well.
{EXCITED:winnie}Plant him on the front lines. You'll see.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}试试把他种植在潮位线之前。你就知道它的厉害了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Whew! Fighting zombies that arrive in waves AND tides isn't easy.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}呼！僵尸一波波、一潮潮地发起进攻，真是棘手啊。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}You know what we need, Penny? An ally with a lot of 'tude!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}潘妮，你知道我们需要什么吗？一位很牛的盟友！

original: {SAY:crazydave}And by 'tude, I mean attitude. In case you need translation.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}牛就是厉害的意思。如果你没听懂的话我解释一下。

original: {SAY:winnie}Then I suggest we call upon Homing Thistle.
{SAY:winnie}I believe he has this 'tude you speak of.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我相信他就是你说的那种很牛的植物盟友。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}His eyes! Intense! He can shoot the zombies a real mean look.
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}看他那眼神！咄咄逼人！感觉他光凭目光就能把那些僵尸射爆！

original: {EXCITED:winnie}More importantly, he can shoot deadly darts that home in on their target.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}更厉害的是，他还可以发射精确锁定目标的死亡毒镖。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Two painful blows for the price of one! Radical!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}一次就能造成双份的伤害，实在是无与伦比！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, data suggests that we should beware the tides.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，数据表明我们应该提防潮汐。

original: {SAY:crazydave}When the tide comes in, it'll be a WIPE OUT for our plant friends?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}你是说，涨潮时，我们的植物伙伴就会被淹没吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. But the tide line indicates how high the water will rise. Plan accordingly.
translation: {SAY:winnie}正确。但是海岸线可以表明潮水最多能上涨到多高。所以依照着它来合理安排吧。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}The tide comes in, the tide goes out. Who can explain it?
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}潮起潮落，谁又能解释这些现象呢？
{TIRED:winnie}科学能为你解答一切，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Yo beach bums! Don't flip your lid.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}嘿！海滩懒汉！听过我的话之后可别大动肝火。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}But have you noticed that Chomper and Bikini Zombie have been ultra cozy lately?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}你们有注意到大嘴花和比基尼僵尸最近有些过于亲密吗？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Could a beachside plant-zombie romance be in bloom?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}有没有一种可能，植物与僵尸的海滨爱情正在缓缓萌芽？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Speaking of which, how sure are you of Chomper's loyalties?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}说到这儿，你们对大嘴花的忠诚还有几分把握呢？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}I can't help but notice ... that plant has the appetite of a zombie.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我也不禁注意到……那株植物的食欲，和僵尸如出一辙！

original:
{SAY:zombossicon}Chew on that land lovers! Later dudes!/r
Dr. Zomboss
translation:
{SAY:zombossicon}先是咬碎土地上的爱人！接着就是你们几个！/r
僵王博士

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}A plant-zombie romance? Penny ... my mind is BLOWN!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}植物与僵尸的爱情？潘妮……我的脑子简直要爆—炸—了—！

original: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, do not jump to conclusions. I suggest something more productive.
translation: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，不要妄下定论。我建议去做些更有用的事情。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Alert! I've detected a strange statue of surfing-era significance.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}警告！我探测到了一具象征着冲浪时代的奇怪雕像。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Well lookie there! It's a tiki statue. With crazy eyes.
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}看哪！这是一具提基雕像。双瞳真是魔性啊。

original: {SAY:winnie}Analysis indicates this tiki could inflict a terrifying challenge upon any who follow it.
translation: {SAY:winnie}分析表明，这个“提基”会让任何信奉它的人面临一个可怕的挑战。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}So you're saying that a tiki torture awaits? Get it? A tiki TORCH-er?
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}提基“船沉”者是吧。哈哈，听懂这个笑话了吗？提基“传承”者！

original:
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I must say, your pun is.../r
TORCH-er-ous.
translation:
{TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，我不得不说…/r
你的谐音梗说明了船沉的危险性。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}植物与僵尸的爱情？这简直太疯——狂了！

original: {SHOUT:crazydave}And I know a thing or two about craaaazy!
translation: {SHOUT:crazydave}我还知道了一两件疯——狂的事！

original: {SAY:winnie}I concur. I suspect Dr. Zomboss was attempting to sow seeds of discontent.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我赞同。我怀疑僵王博士企图播下令人不满的种子。

original: {SAY:crazydave}From now on, we are the only ones sowing seeds around here!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}从现在开始，我们才是这儿唯一能种下种子的人！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Totally bogus! Little do you know what I have in store for you!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}完全错误！你们对于我还留了一手这事知之甚少！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}The seeds of destruction have been planted! Brace yourselves for a wipe out!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}毁灭之种已然撒下！为这毁灭的万物，振奋起来吧！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}But for now, I gotta split. Catch you dweebs later!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}不过现在呢，我先开溜啦。待会儿再来找你们这些傻瓜！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Look! It must be time to play Beach Zombie Bungo!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}看那！是时候去玩海滩僵尸饼干小游戏了！

original: {SAY:crazydaveicon}You already won, Penny? Wow. You're good at this!
translation: {SAY:crazydaveicon}你已经 BINGO 取胜了吗，潘妮？哇。你很擅长这个呢！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I am picking up a grid of plants, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我正在收集整理一箩筐子的植物，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}My scans suggest that they can be swapped to create matches of three.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的雷达显示，通过两两交换，我们可以把三株相同的植物配对，然后消去他们。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I saw a game like that once on my telephoney!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}我曾在我的小手机上见过这款游戏！

original: {SAY:winnie}You can use sun to upgrade the plants.
translation: {SAY:winnie}使用阳光可以提升场上植物的品质。
{SAY:winnie}通过制造 100 组匹配来战胜此关的僵尸吧！
