original: {SAY:crazydave}We're learning how to reduce Chew Times!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我们在学习如何减少咀嚼的次数！
{SAY:crazydave}没时间想那么多了！先学为敬！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}To the contrary, foolish Dave. Soon you shall discover...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}恰恰相反，呆瓜戴夫，你很快就会发现…

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny! I saw Dr. Zomboss in my poetry class!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮！我在诗歌课上看到了僵王博士！

original: {SAY:winnie}Beware, User Dave. He is up to something.
translation: {SAY:winnie}当心，用户戴夫。他肯定在计划些什么。

original: {SAY:crazydave}But his rhymes were so dope and refreshing!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}但他的诗歌真的太酷了，使人充满了活力！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}How are you faring in your summer classes, User Dave?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你的暑期课程进展如何？用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Did you know numbers keep going after 10?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}你知道数字在 10 以后还会增长吗？

original: {SAY:crazydave}I had to take my shoes off!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我现在得脱下鞋来用脚数了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Snow Pea is a big hit at Summer School, Penny!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}潘妮，雪花豌豆在暑期班很受欢迎！

original: {SAY:crazydave}His increased Chance to Freeze ability is making him BPOC!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}他提升的冻结能力让他如鱼得水！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}This so-called "Big Brainz event" is not just a tribute to knowledge and education.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}这个所谓的“大头僵尸”活动不仅仅对知识和教育的致敬，

original: {SAY:zombossicon}It is also a TRAP MOST DIRE!!!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}You must find a way to foil Dr. Zomboss' evil Big Brainz plot, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你必须想方设法来阻止僵王博士在“大头僵尸”活动上的邪恶阴谋，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:crazydave}But how? Summer School doesn't offer a course in "defeating mad scientists."
translation: {SAY:crazydave}但是要怎么阻止？暑期班没有开设“如何打败疯狂科学家”的课程啊！

original: {SAY:crazydave}We gather together all the plants who've been going to Summer School...
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我们把所有去过暑期班的植物聚集在一起…

original: {SAY:crazydave}We're in bigger trouble than I thought!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}看来我们遇到的麻烦比想像中还要棘手！

original: {SAY:crazydave}You may try to ruin our fun Big Brainz event with some mad scheme!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}你可能是在试图用一些疯狂的计划，破坏我们有趣的“大头僵尸”活动！

original: {SAY:crazydave}I got an A+ on my synonym quiz!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我在同义词测验中拿了 A+！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Foolish Dave! Your time is... uh... wait a moment...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呆瓜戴夫！你的时候到……呃……等一下…

original: {SAY:zombossicon}I spent so much time gloating I forgot to invent a scheme!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}幸灾乐祸太久，我都忘记要想个计划了！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}What's that, Zomboss? Didn't do your HOMEWORK?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}咋了？僵王，你该不会是作业还没写完吧？

original: {SAY:crazydave}In English class we call that IRONY!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}在英语课上，我们称之为“IRONY”——讽刺！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}This isn't over! I'll take online classes! You haven't seen the last of meeee...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这还没完！我会去上网课的！你还会再见到我的…

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I bet we've seen the last of him!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我打赌这是我们最后一次见到他了！

original: {SAY:winnie}Don't count on it. But at least the Big Brainz event was a huge success!
translation: {SAY:winnie}不至于。但起码“大头僵尸”活动取得了巨大的成功！
{SAY:sunflower}就喜欢你这样的选择性热情，兄弟！

original: {SAY:sunflower}I know, silly! We've been friends for years!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}我知道，小傻瓜。我们已经当了好多年的朋友了！

original: {SAY:sunflower}Thirteen of them, to be exact! Time to PARTY!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}准确地说，已经 13 年了！一起来开个派对吧！
{SAY:sunflower_r}哪家孩子 13 岁还不会说话呀！

original: {SAY:winnie}Greetings, Wall-nut. And a fine happy Birthdayz to you as well.
translation: {SAY:winnie}你好，坚果墙。也祝你度过一个愉快的生日。

original: {SAY:winnie}I am Penny, User Dave's time-traveling recreational vehicle.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我叫潘妮，用户戴夫用来进行时间旅行的休闲车。

original: {SAY:wallnut}Neaters! I guess that means you can have Birthdayz whenever you want!
translation: {SAY:wallnut}太厉害了！那你岂不是可以随时过生日！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}Who should we invite to the Birthdayz party, Sunflower?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}我们应该邀请谁来参加生日庆典呢，向日葵？

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Gnash my teeth! A birthdayz party? Without I?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}气抖冷！生日派对……居然不邀请我？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Dr. Edgar Zomboss? Premiere alt-life thinker and moral philosopher?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我可是首席另类生命思考家、道德哲学家——埃德加·僵王博士！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}You shall rue and pay for this insult!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}如此侮辱我，你们会为之后悔、付出代价的！
{SAY:sunflower}大家都知道这也是你的生日！

original: {SAY:sunflower}If the presents keep coming, I'm not complaining!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}如果礼物不断，我的快乐也不会断！

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}I just hope we don't see Jetpack Zombies in this level.
translation: {SAY:wallnut_r}我只希望这关不要出现喷射器僵尸。

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}I will FREAK OUT if we do!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What an incredible Birthdayz this has been, Penny!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}这次的生日庆典太棒了，潘妮！
{SAY:crazydave}而且现在植物可以说话了，潘妮！

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}We plants gossip all the time in there!
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}我们植物经常在里面聊八卦！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I believe celebratory congratulations are in order.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，庆典祝贺应该已经准备就绪了。

original: {SAY:winnie}No User Dave, it is your Birthday!
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}There will be no celebrating today! You!! Get them!!!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我才不会让你们庆祝呢！来人!! 抓住他们!!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Emergency!!! Unusual energy signatures detected. Brace for time… .. . *BZZZTTT… WOOOOSHhhh*
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}紧急状况!!! 探测到异常能量签名。赶快……*嗞……唔——*

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Muhahah!!! You fools! You walked right into my trap.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈!!! 你们这群傻瓜！步入我的陷阱了吧。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Finally, my subscription to Evil Genius Monthly is paying off.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}终于啊，看来我订阅《邪恶天才月刊》的钱没百花。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Is that a Yeti? I thought they'd gone extinct?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}那是只雪人吗？我还以为它们都灭绝了呢？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It would appear that Zomboss’s tampering has caused the Yeti's reappearance.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}看来是僵王篡改了时空，让雪人再次出现了。

original: {SAY:winnie}I can use this to plot a way back home. However, this will require all my processing powers.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我可以用它来规划我们回家的路线。然而，这将消耗我所有的算力。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Be careful, don’t fall for their trap.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}It would appear we are back to our original coordinates.
{NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Whhaaat! How can this be... How did you…
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curses... I miscalculated this time, but mark my words you haven’t seen the last of me.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}坏了……这次我有些失算，但你们要知道，我一定会回来的。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}There was never any cake, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}No User Dave. For once, you are right on schedule.
translation: {SAY:winnie}并没有，用户戴夫。你终于准时一次了。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Those are some ominous looking clouds heading towards us.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}有一团“无彩不祥云”在朝我们袭来。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}But my next invention will soak you completely!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}下次，我的发明会把你生吞活剥！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We’ll be ready for you Zomboss. All of us plants and with...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}我们会从容应对的，僵王。除了我们全体植物大军，还有…

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Vines are special plants that can be planted on top of other plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}藤蔓是一类可以种在其他植物上面的特殊植物。

original: {SAY:winnie}It can lob fragmentation projectiles giving other plants for an offensive boost!
translation: {SAY:winnie}它可以发射碎片子弹，还能强化其他植物的攻击力！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Blockoli to smash and stun with blocking shields.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植西拦花，用坚固的花盾击晕僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Bombard-mint Family is made up of explosive plants.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Bramble Bush to trap and damage zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植莓棘灌木丛，困住僵尸，并对它们造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Some levels may have Buffz & Bruisez active.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}有些关卡会激活“增强与弱化”机制。

original: {SAY:winnie}This means zombies can be weak, resistant, or immune to damage from certain plant families.
translation: {SAY:winnie}也就是说，这关的僵尸可能对某些家族植物的攻击产生抗性、完全免疫，或是更加脆弱。

original: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies are WEAK to plants in the Fila-mint family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}这次，僵尸面对电荷家族植物的攻击时会更加脆弱。

original: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do a lot of damage.
translation: {SAY:winnie}即便是闪电芦苇，也能造成大量伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Buffz & Bruisez can work the other way as well.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}增强与弱化机制也可以反过来。

original: {SAY:winnie}Zombies can resist damage from certain plant families.
translation: {SAY:winnie}僵尸可以抵抗某些植物家族的伤害。

original: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies RESIST damage from plants in the Fila-mint family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}这一次，僵尸对电荷家族植物的攻击具有抗性。

original: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do less damage than normal.
translation: {SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇只能造成比原先更低的伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}At the greatest extreme, Buffz & Bruisez can nullify a plant family completely.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在极端情况下，弱化机制甚至可以让部分植物家族的攻击完全无效。

original: {SAY:winnie}This time, zombies are IMMUNE to damage from plants in the Fila-mint family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}这一次，僵尸对电荷家族植物的攻击完全免疫。

original: {SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds will do no damage. Use them as blockers!
translation: {SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇无法造成任何伤害，只能用把他当做沿路的炮灰了！
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植黄油毛茛，往攻击她的僵尸脸上砸黄油。

original: {SPECIAL4}Here neighbor, have some moola! Why? Because I'm CRAAAZY!
translation: {SPECIAL4}来来来，我的邻居！拿好这些元宝！为啥，因为我疯——了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{LONG}If you want to use a Power Up, you can buy one with coins!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{LONG}如果你想用金手指，可以用硬币买一个！

original: {LONG}Just tap on that doohickey down there and you're in business!
translation: {LONG}只需要轻点这个小按钮，交易就完成啦！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Surf's up, dudes! Let's shred some zombies!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}准备冲浪，兄弟们！把僵尸撞得粉身碎骨！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Totally! We'll wipe 'em out like a gnarly wave!
{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You punks don't even know what you're up against. You're all just fish out of water.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们这些小混混根本不知道自己正在面对什么。你们，不过如离水之鱼般弱小。

original: {SAY:peashooter}And you're about as scary as a goldfish in a bowl.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}而你，不过如缸中金鱼般可怕。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Or maybe a seagull with a insomnia.
{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Or a hermit crab with stage fright.
{NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Enough with the inane jokes! Attack, my aquatic fiends!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}这都哪儿跟哪儿啊，讲够了吗！进攻，我的水中之友！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Wallnut, you might wanna get on a Lily Pad. The tide is coming in.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}坚果，你还是到睡莲叶上来吧。潮水马上就来了。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Nothing's wrong with the ground.  You will get swept away if the water gets too high.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}地上没问题。但是如果潮水涨得太高，你就会被冲走的。

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}Hey, I'm not afraid of a little water. I'm a tough nut to crack, you know.
translation: {SAY:wallnut_r}切，我才不怕这点儿水呢。我可是坚强的坚果。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Wall-nut, just get on a Lily Pad. It'll be like your own private island.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}坚果墙，快到睡莲叶上来。上面就像私人岛屿一样。

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}You know, Peashooter, this isn't half bad. I could get used to this Lily Pad life.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}你知道吗，豌豆射手，其实感觉没那么糟。我开始习惯在睡莲叶上的生活了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}That's the spirit, dude. Now just sit back, relax, and enjoy the tide.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}就是这样，兄弟。你只需要坐下、放松，享受潮涨潮落就好。

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}And if any zombies try to mess with us, we'll just toss 'em back to the deep end.
translation: {SAY:wallnut_r}然后如果有僵尸来惹我们，我们就把它扔回深渊中去。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Dude! It's Banana Launcher! This beach party is about to get a whole lot crazier!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}帅啊！是香蕉火箭炮！看来我们的海滩派对要更疯狂了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Awesome! Make sure he's well-protected so he can shoot those sweet banana missiles.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}好耶！一定要保护好他，这样他才能安心发射那些强力的香蕉导弹。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Let's surround him with Lily Pads and I'll keep those Zombies off him.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}用睡莲叶围住他吧，我会让僵尸离他远远地。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Good idea, Wall-nut! And I can cover him from behind.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}好办法，坚果墙！我能在他身后掩护他。

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}This is great! We should have a beach party like this every day!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}真棒！以后我们真该每天都举办一场这样的海滩派对！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Only if Banana Launcher carries his banana missiles, those things are heavy!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}只是如果香蕉火箭炮要带他的导弹的话，行李就会很重。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Yo, dude! We totally washed the beach with those zombies!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}牛的，兄弟们！我们把海滩上的僵尸扫荡一空了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Yeah! We weren't about to let those undead losers.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}好耶！他们这些废渣不死族，本来就是不速之客。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}My beach resort plans are ruined. I will crush you plants, you just wait.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我的海滩度假计划泡汤了。我早晚会压扁你们这些植物的，你们等着瞧。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Oh, please. You and your zombie crew are nothing but beach bums.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}那就来啊。你和你的僵尸军队不过是在海滩上游走的废柴罢了。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Just you wait, I have a whole ocean of tricks up my sleeve.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}等着吧，我还有海量你前所未见的绝招。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Ooh, we're shaking in our roots. Maybe you should just shell out and go home.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}哇，真是吓得我们根都在发抖呢。要不您早点打包回家洗洗睡吧。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Yeah, before you get sand in your circuits.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}没错，不然小心你的电路里进沙子。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Mark my words, I'll be back to make you plant punks pay.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}记住我说的话，我会卷土重来，让你们这群植物小混混付出代价的。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:peashooter}Whatever, dude. Don't let the sand hit you on the way out.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:peashooter}随你呗，兄弟。走的时候小心鞋里进沙子。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I am ready for the beach. The sun, the sand and the...zombies?
translation: {SAY:peashooter}我准备好在沙滩激情四射了。阳光明媚，满地金沙，还有…尸潮如雨？

original: {SAY:winnie}Affirmative, User Dave. Beach day initiating. Preparing for travel.
translation: {SAY:winnie}确实如此，用户戴夫。海滩之旅，就此启航。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Don't forget to frown and prepare for a sandy showdown!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}别忘了要愁眉苦脸，准备一场沙地对决啊！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Oh, come on, Zomboss! Can't we have just one day off?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}哎，别吧，僵王！我们就不能放一天假吗？

original: {SAY:zomboss}Absolutely NOT! My zombies will give you a seaweed-infested welcome.
translation: {SAY:zomboss}绝对不行！我的僵尸军团会让你们无处可逃、海藻缠身，以此表达我们的热情欢迎。

original: {SAY:peashooter_r}Bring it on, we aren't afraid of a little sand in our leaves.
translation: {SAY:peashooter_r}那就放马过来吧，“沙场”的尘土，是吓不倒我们的。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}Well that was an unexpected twist in our beach day plans, huh?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}还真没想到我们的沙滩假日会闹这一出啊。

original: {SAY:winnie}Affirmative Sunflower! The beach is secured, resuming relaxation mode.
translation: {SAY:winnie}确实如此向日葵！海滩已安全，恢复放松模式。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}This isn't over, plants! I'll have my revenge...on some other sunny day.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}还没结束呢，你们这群植物！我会卷土重来的……等我再找一个阳光明媚的日子。

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Maybe next time, Zomboss. Today, the beach is ours!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}下次再说吧，僵王。今天，海滩是我们的！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Uh-oh, the road is forked. What do we do?!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}啊噢，前方的道路产生了分叉。我们该怎么办?!

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Those are where you flex your brains with new plants and upgrades.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}那里可以充分发挥你脑子的聪明才智，以此活用新植物与升级道具。

original: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}Brain busting? Very dangerous. You go first.
{SAY:peashooter_r}Yep. Sorry I missed the last couple of limited-time events.
translation: {SAY:peashooter_r}嗯嗯。对不起啦，之前的几个限时活动我都没来。

original: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}I was getting a haircut and it took FOREVER.
translation: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}我去剪了个头发，结果半天都弄不好。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Nobody told me about these circus zombies!
translation: {SAY:peashooter}怎么有这么多马戏团僵尸啊！

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}GASP! Mr. Zomboss! I never thought I'd face you face-to-face!
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}*倒吸一口凉气* 僵王先生！我没想过居然会和你面对面谈话！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Bah! I care not for your thoughts! Only evil plans!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}呸！我才不在乎你怎么想！我只关心我的邪恶计划！
{SAY:sunflower_r}兄弟，是你先来找我说话的啊！

original: {SAY:sunflower}Mr. Zomboss told me he's got evil plans!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}僵王先生告诉我他有“邪恶计划”！

original: {SHOUT:wallnut}Is your evil plan to hit us with circus zombies again?
translation: {SHOUT:wallnut}你的“邪恶计划”是想再用马戏团僵尸袭击我们一次吗？

original: {SAY:crazydave}Carnival zombies left and right! Mostly right!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}简直可以说是“左右为尸”了！当然，大部分都在右边！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}You may have won this round, Machine!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}破机器，也许你这次的确获胜了！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Bah! Those data can be interpreted many ways!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}呸！这些数据的理解方式多着呢！

original: {SAY:peashooter_r}What new craziness will Dr. Zomboss cook up?
translation: {SAY:peashooter_r}僵王博士接下来又会耍什么新把戏呢？
{SAY:peashooter_r}欲知后事如何，请听下回分解！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha ha ha! I'm here to take over this circus, and there's nothing you plants can do to stop me!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈哈哈！这个马戏团就由我来接管了，你们这些植物休想阻止我！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Oh no! We can't let you do that! Where will we get up to our shenanigans then?!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}不行！我们才不会让你得逞！不然我们要到哪儿去狂欢呢?!

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}We'll never let you take over, Zomboss!
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Alert! The Big Top will block sun falling from the Sky.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}警告！游乐园的大帐篷会挡住从天上降落的阳光。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}You're no match for my zombie army! The Big Top tent will be mine!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}你们根本不是我僵尸大军的对手！大帐篷游乐园我赢定了！

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}You'll have to get past us first! We won't let you take over without a fight!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}那得先过了我们这关！不打赢我们，休想得逞！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Very well, plants. Let's see who is the better mastermind!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}好啊，你们这群植物。来看看谁更会出谋划策吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Looks like Coconut Cannon crew have joined our Defense of the Big Top!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}看来椰子加农炮小队加入到我们的帐篷守卫战了！

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}I'm not sure if Coconuts are going to be effective against the zombies.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}我不是很确定椰子对那些僵尸有没有用。

original: {SAY:wallnut}they can take down the zombies from any angle using those carts!
translation: {SAY:wallnut}他们还能利用那些矿车，从各个角度击溃僵尸！

original: {SAY:peashooter}Lets blast these zombies back into their clown car!
translation: {SAY:peashooter}把这些僵尸轰回它们自己的小丑车里去吧！
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}看仔细了，这是我的高跷僵尸！

original: {SAY:iceburg_r}Don't worry, Wallnut! We'll help you out!
{SAY:wallnut}I feel so inadequate compared to those tall zombies.
translation: {SAY:wallnut}和那些高大的僵尸比起来，我太弱小了。

original: {SAY:iceburg_r}Don't be silly, Wallnut! You may be shorter than them, but you're just as tough!
translation: {SAY:iceburg_r}别傻了，坚果墙！你可能确实比他它们矮，但你和它们一样坚强！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Step right up and witness, back by popular demand, the Catastro-liope!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}都上前来看清楚了，我的悲乐风琴机器人，在众望所归之下强势回归！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Tremble you fool! Its only purpose in life is to ROOT out plants and take over this circus!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}颤抖吧，傻瓜！它唯一的目的，就是把那些植物连根拔起，然后统治这个马戏团！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Oh no! That sounds like it could be trouble!
{SAY:zomboss}Ha ha ha! You'll never be able to defeat the Catastro-liope! It's indestructible!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}哈哈哈！你们根本不可能打败我这坚不可摧的悲乐风琴机器人！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Grrr... How could you defeat my Catastro-liope? It was supposed to be unbeatable!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}恶……你们是怎么打败我的悲乐风琴机器人的？它明明是无敌的啊！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Ha! We took it down with ease, thanks to our trusty Friends, the Coconut Cannons.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}哈！多亏了我们那群值得信赖的朋友，椰子加农炮小队。轻松拿下！

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}And don't forget, we had a little help from Wallnut and his tough shell.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}别忘了，坚果墙坚硬的壳也给了我们一些帮助。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}That's right. We may be plants, but we're no pushovers.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}没错。我们或许不过是植物，但我们绝不软弱。

original: {SAY:zomboss}You may have won this battle, but the war is far from over. The Big Top will be mine!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}这场战斗你也许能够侥幸获胜，但这场战争还远未结束。大帐篷游乐园早晚会落入我的掌心！

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Bring it on, Zomboss. We're always ready for you.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}放马过来吧，僵王。我们随时奉陪。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Wait a minute! I have a better idea! Let's put on a show for the zombies!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}等等！我有个好主意！我们来给僵尸表演个节目吧！

original: {SAY:wallnut}Really? Thanks, team! I feel better now.
translation: {SAY:wallnut}真的吗？谢谢大家！我感觉好受些了。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Indestructible, you say? I have just the thing! *rolls out a Coconut Cannon
translation: {SAY:crazydave}坚不可摧是吧？我有东西来对付它！*推出来一架椰子加农炮

original: {SAY:crazydave}These are my friends, the Coconut Cannons! And they are going to destroy your Cart of Doom once and for all!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}他们是我的朋友，椰子加农炮小队！他们会把你的毁灭之车摧毁得片甲不留！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Its not a Cart of Doom! Show some respect to your eventual demise, the Catastro-liope!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}这才不是什么毁灭之车！给你死神——悲乐风琴机器人一点尊重好吧！

original: {SAY:crazydave}A performance that will be so entertaining, your zombies won't even want to take over the Big Top tent anymore!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}很有意思的节目，看完之后，你的僵尸都不会再想去抢占大帐篷游乐园了！
{SAY:peashooter_r}是吗？来看看吧！*开始表演杂技

original: {SAY:crazydave}*starts riding a unicycle and juggling at the same time
{NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Yeah, we couldn't do it without you! You're a valuable member of the team!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}对呀，没有你，我们根本做不到！你是我们队伍中很重要的一员！

original: {SAY:zomboss}That's the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard!
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Roll up, roll up, puny mortals, to my undead extravaganza!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}凡人们，瞧一瞧，看一看，欣赏我的不死军团大展览！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Behold, my monstrous performers shall steal the show, literally. Muhuhahaha!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}看清楚吧，我的怪奇艺人定会抢尽风头——真正地“抢”。木呼哈哈哈！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Oh no! Our show is being hijacked. My performance was next.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}不好！我们的风头要被“抢”了。下个是我来表演呢。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Who knew Zomboss had such a flair for dramatics?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}谁知道僵王原来这么有戏剧天赋。

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}But I guess we have to show Zomboss how its actually done.
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}但我想，我们必须让僵王见识见识什么才是真正的表演。

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Without sun there is no stopping me today! Minions!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}没了阳光，今天没有什么能阻止我了！小的们！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Looks like we managed to outshine the zombie act.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}看来我们的表演比起僵尸还是技高一筹啊。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Blast it all! You may have stopped my act.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}真该死！你们也许能够阻止我的表演。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}But this isn't the end and my evil plans will go on!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}但却阻止不了我的邪恶计划！这次，可不是结束！
{SHOUT:wallnut}…啊哦…转得停不下来了…不不不…救命啊！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}It's a coverup! We're intense in tents, Penny!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}后院被罩起来了！潘妮！我们被游乐园的帐篷罩住了！

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. It appears the Backyard Big Top has come to town.
translation: {SAY:winnie}是的。看起来后院游乐园到我们镇上来了。

original: {SAY:winnie}The big top will block sun falling from the sky.
translation: {SAY:winnie}游乐园的大帐篷会阻挡天空中掉下来的阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plants on mine carts can be moved.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你可以移动在矿车上的植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Conceal-mint family includes all the shadow plants.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Contain-mint Family includes stalling and slowing plants.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I say, Penny, old thing, tally ho! Pip-pip and such!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我说，潘妮老伙计，快看哪，我终于找到了好些呆板稀奇的英国佬！

original: {SAY:winnie} We are in the Wild West, User Dave. Not Victorian England.
translation: {SAY:winnie} 我们现在身处狂野西部，用户戴夫。这里并不是维多利亚时代的英格兰。

original: {SAY:winnie}We are likely to encounter far more ferocious former frontiersmen, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们预计将与更多更凶悍的美国西部拓荒者交战，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}We will need upgraded plants to stake any claim.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们将需要升级植物来捍卫我们对这片土地上的主权。

original: {SAY:winnie}The rough terrain forbids the mowing of lawns.
translation: {SAY:winnie}崎岖不平的地势阻碍了对于草坪的修剪。

original: {SAY:winnie}Our battles shall be more fraught from here on.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们后续的战役将更加令人忧心。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Even as the West was wild, so is my fury even wilder!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}就像狂野西部的荒蛮一样，连我此刻的愤怒也更为狂野了！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Face me! Face me and the rebuilt and improved Zombot War Wagon!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}面对我吧！面对我和那重制升级版的兵戈牛车僵尸机器人！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}It was a stagecoach, it was a robot... it was Complete Cowboy CRAAAAY-ziness!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}那是架马车，又是个机器……这……简直完完全全是牛仔发疯！

original: {SAY:winnie}Our upgraded plants proved up to the task, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们的升级版植物已经圆满完成任务，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}All my efforts... useless! I begin to seriously question my capacity to succeed!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我所有的心血，所有的努力……都白费了！我开始严重怀疑我夺得胜利的才能了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}It's high noon, and waves of zombies about.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Time to show them who's got the fastest plants in time!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}看看是它们的嘴快，还是植物的子弹快！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}I could really go for a tub of fried chicken right now.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:winnie}Well, they've let loose the birds of war, so you're in luck.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:winnie}可以呀。僵尸正好放跑了几只战鸟，把它们现炸了就好。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}干得漂亮，用户时间旅行者长官。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Put on your bloomers and charge your reeds.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}给你的芦苇充好电！对了，也别忘了穿上你的牛仔裤！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}That is a lot of mine carts.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I didn't know mine carts could do math!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}我居然不知道矿车会做算数题！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}My great grandpappy was a lawman around these parts.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}我的曾祖父以前就在这附近当治安官。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL17}They're coming 'round the mountain for your brains!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL17}他们要绕过大山来找你的脑子！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}I can't believe there were so many chickens.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}我不敢相信这儿居然有那么多鸡！

original: {SAY:winnie}This will be remembered as the Great Chickening of 1850.
translation: {SAY:winnie}这会被后世人称为“1850 大鸡群事件”。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}These levels can be tough nuts to crack.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}你需要在这些关卡里保护好坚果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And I want to see the delicious creamy center.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}我想瞧瞧美味的坚果奶油夹心。

original: {TIRED:winnie}The point is not to crack them.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}这关的重点不在于如何敲碎它们。

original: {SAY:crazydave}It sounds like a stampede of pianos!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}听起来像是一批蜂拥而至的牛仔钢琴家！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}You've got the fastest fingers in the West.

translation:
{SAY}怀旧钢琴小曲：/r
下载完毕

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Agents are arriving to mark your brains as my property.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我的特工马上就会来把你的脑子划为我的财产了。
{SAY:zombossicon}此致 敬礼 埃德加·僵王博士。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I don't want my brains all marked up.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我才不想我的脑子上写着别人的名字！
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}不然我得花很久很久才把它们洗得干干净净了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}Like cow tipping, zombie tipping is best done from the side.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}就像“推牛倒”游戏一样，对付僵尸最好是从两面夹击！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Trust me, do not try and tip a cow from behind!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}相信我，千万不要从牛后面推倒它们！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Have you considered that you are sharing in Crazy David's madness?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}你有没有想过其实你自己已经变得和疯狂戴夫一样疯了？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}There is no zombie outbreak threatening you.
{SAY:zombossicon}You are not using plants to defend your home.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}你使用植物也并不是为了守卫自己的家园。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}The zombies and I are normal people, simply trying to help you.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}而我与那些所谓的僵尸实际上都是一些普通人，仅仅是想帮助你。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}I bet you'll tell us there are no spoons, too!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}你是不是还要像《黑客帝国》里一样告诉我“其实根本没有勺子”？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}用户戴夫，是时候给马备鞍并准备离开了。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL14}夕阳近在咫尺，让我们策马前行吧！

original: {EXCITED:winnie}Where do you think the future will take us?
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}你觉得未来会将我们带向何方？

original: {SAY:crazydave}We should take another look at my Time-Space Taco Map.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我们应该再看看我的时空玉米卷地图。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}My Uncle Milo used to have one these, he called it a boom box.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我的叔叔米洛曾经有一个这样的玩意，他管这叫砰砰盒。

original: {SAY:winnie}Actually, that's close enough. I'll allow it.
translation: {SAY:winnie}事实上，这么称呼它已经够贴切了。至少我认可这样。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Maybe we can use that to unlock our minds.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}也许我们能用它来解放我们的思想。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I still have some cleaning to do.
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}不过我还有一些清洁工作要做。

original: {SAY:winnie}It would be better used gaining access to a World.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我觉得用它去进入另一个世界会更好。

original: {TIRED:winnie}You know, for the greater good of...
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}用户戴夫，是时候给马备鞍并准备离开了。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL14}夕阳近在咫尺，让我们策马前行吧！

original: {EXCITED:winnie}Where do you think the future will take us?
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}你觉得未来会将我们带向何方？

original: {SAY:crazydave}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
translation: {SAY:crazydave}{SPECIAL15}请记住。明日，永远都是一个玉米卷…

original: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
translation: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}而玉米卷，正是我们每个人内心深处所苦苦寻求之物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}That's right! These plants versus you and your zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}这就对了！植物永远与你们僵尸势不两立！

original: {SAY:crazydave}And we didn't even use any spoons...
translation: {SAY:crazydave}而我甚至没有动用引线炸弹…
{SAY:crazydave}哪怕我们手上真的有这些玩意！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I admit you are correct in this regard.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我不得不承认……在这点上你们是正确的。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}We have no existential conflict over the nature of spoons.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}然而在武力对抗方面，我们之间不存在辩驳的余地。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}That looks like it could be all futurey.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}看样子我们要向未来看齐了！

original: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}That Mr. Boss guy seems like a really nice fellow!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}那位博士先生看起来真是位大善人啊！

original: {TIRED:winnieicon}We should be wary of that one User Dave.
translation: {TIRED:winnieicon}我们必须担心未来，用户戴夫。

original: {EXCITED:winnieicon}Earning Stars will prepare you for Star Gates we find later!
translation: {EXCITED:winnieicon}收集星星，为开启找到的下一扇星星门做准备！

original: {SAY:winnieicon}Also, Endless Zones will keep you sharp for future trials.
translation: {SAY:winnieicon}同时，无尽地带能让你为将来的试炼养精蓄锐。

original: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
translation: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}请记住。明日，永远都是一个玉米卷…

original: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
translation: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}而玉米卷，正是我们每个人内心深处所苦苦寻求之物。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}I bet Future Dave has solved our taco paradox.
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}我敢说将来的我肯定解决了“玉米卷悖论”。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}I'm detecting a rush of tachyon particles.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}我探测到了一股超光速粒子。

original: {EXCITED:winnieicon}Maybe Future Penny is trying to make contact.
translation: {EXCITED:winnieicon}也许是未来的潘妮正尝试与我们取得联系。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}The Future will be requesting your presence.
{SAY:zombossicon}Upon entry, legal possession of your brains...
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}一旦踏足未来，你们脑子的合法所有权…

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Will be transferred to one Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}将归于名为埃德加的僵王博士名下。

original: {PLAYFUL}Let's get these plants to the watering hole.
translation: {PLAYFUL}让我们把这些植物带去酒吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}It appears brains are outlawed around here.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}看起来持有脑子在此地是非法的。
{PLAYFUL:winnieicon}我们会跟随您的安排，用户戴夫。
{SAY}好消息是：你又得到了额外的两个！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}Nice pick, let's see how far you can get!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}明智之选！让我们看看你能在这个模式中走多远！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to The Tiki Torch-er!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到提基文明传承者！

original: {SAY:crazydave}But beware! Zombies are selling seashells by this seashore!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}但是你可要小心！僵尸正在海岸卖贝壳呢！

original: {SHOUT:crazydave}And they insist you pay in brains!
translation: {SHOUT:crazydave}他们还坚持要用你的脑子来付账！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Big Bad Butte!
{SAY}And by big I mean crawling with zombies...
translation: {SAY}我说的“大”是指这里僵尸横行…
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到亚瑟王的挑战！

original: {PLAYFUL}Here you'll find that day is night and knights are zombies!
translation: {PLAYFUL}这里你将会见到日夜颠倒，骑士为尸的奇观异景！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to La Brainsa Tarpits!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}你好啊，邻居！欢迎来到脑子焦油坑！

original: {PLAYFUL}I hope you're ready for a reptilian rumble!
translation: {PLAYFUL}我希望你准备好迎接一场恐龙大战了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Pyramid of Doom!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到厄运金字塔 ！

original: {SAY}It's just like a regular pyramid, but... you know... doomier.
translation: {SAY}它看上去真像个再普通不过的金字塔，但……你懂的……它充斥着更多厄运。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to the GREATEST HITS!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}你好啊，邻居！欢迎来到最潮专辑！

original: {PLAYFUL}I hope you're ready for a righteously up-tempo experience!
translation: {PLAYFUL}我希望你已经准备好迎接真正快节奏的战斗体验了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Terror from Tomorrow!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到明日的恐惧！

original: {PLAYFUL}Making tomorrow's terror something terrible for today!
translation: {PLAYFUL}让明日的恐惧在今日就降临吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Icebound Battleground!
{SAY:crazydave}This place is cold as, uh, ICE ... not to mention chock full o' zombies.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}这个鬼地方……像“寒极”一样冰冷，更别提还有源源不断的僵尸让你不寒而栗了。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Best bring some hot zombie-fightin' moves. And maybe a nice warm coat too.
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}最好带些对僵尸“热”情的植物。也别忘了穿一件保暖的外套。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Temple of Bloom!
{PLAYFUL}Here you'll find that gold is good but brings out more zombies!
translation: {PLAYFUL}你可以在这儿找到值钱的黄金……同时也会引来更多的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to Highway to the Danger Room!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}你好啊，邻居！欢迎来到通往无尽的高速！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to Dead Man's Booty!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}嗨，邻居！欢迎来到逝者的宝藏！

original: {SAY}Your Plant Food carries over to the next level!
translation: {SAY}你的植物养料能保存到下一关！

original: {PLAYFUL}Now it's time to pick another plant!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}The Endless Zones are harder than usual!/r
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}无尽地带会比一般的关卡更加困难！/r

original: {SAY:winnie}Power Ups and Plant Food can only be purchased once per level.
translation: {SAY:winnie}金手指和植物养料每关只能各购买一次。

original: {SAY}In the Endless Zones, your lawn mowers carry over to the next level!/r
translation: {SAY}在无尽地带，你的割草机会保存到下一关！/r

original: {SAY}Your Plant Food carries over to the next level as well!
{PLAYFUL}Now it's time to pick another plant!
{SAY}Now you get to pick one more.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Warning! I've detected carafes containing chemical compounds of a malevolent makeup!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}警报！我探测到了一些盛着邪恶化合物的玻璃瓶！

original: {TIRED:crazydave}Can you translate that into Crazy Dave Talk for me?
translation: {TIRED:crazydave}你能将这翻译成“疯言戴语”后讲给我听么？

original: {TIRED:winnie}There are evil potions on the lawn!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Evil medieval potions! They're the most dangerous kind...
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}黑暗时代的邪恶魔药！那可是最危险的毒药啊…

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}On account of having twice the evil!
{TIRED:winnie}No one, User Dave. We have simply arrived in the Dark Ages.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}没人关灯，用户戴夫。我们只是抵达了黑暗时代而已。

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Indeed. According to my research, a plague has swept this era.
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}确实如此。根据我的调查，一场瘟疫席卷了这个时代。

original: {SAY:winnie}Also, sun no longer falls from the sky.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}What we need is someone to brighten this place up!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}看来我们需要有人把这个地方点亮。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}These guys not only know how to turn a frown upside down...
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}这些家伙不仅知道如何倒转下垂的嘴角…

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}They make more sun as they grow! Great guys, very talented.
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}还会逐渐长大，生产出更多阳光！太厉害了，真是天赋异禀。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I'm afraid the Dark Ages are giving me a bad case of the vapours.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}黑暗时代这烟雾有毒吧，可给我整吐了。

original: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, the vapours are no longer considered a real ailment.
translation: {SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我并没有检测到烟雾里存在任何有毒物质。

original: {SAY:winnie}But I believe Fume-shroom will be of use here.
translation: {SAY:winnie}不过，我倒是觉得烟雾菇可以在这里大显身手。

original: {EXCITED:winnie}His vapors are quite real and provide a distinct advantage against the right zombie opponents.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}他喷射出的烟雾对我们相当有利。并且，用他来对付某些特殊的僵尸更是有着绝佳的优势。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Fume-tastic! Let's give the zombies a case of the vapours instead!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}“雾”懈可击！用他的烟雾把僵尸整吐吧！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}It is my fervent medical opinion that your humours are out of balance!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}以余之拙见，病在汝脑髓，已入膏肓！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Methinks the siphoning of thine brains is the only way to correct this ailment!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}以虹吸之法亟治，乃为疗养汝脑小恙之上道！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey! I prefer my humors and my brains unbalanced!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}我真是太嗨了！我愈加喜欢我那种病态幽默与脑髓搅成一锅粥的感觉嘞！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Data suggests the Dark Ages were a time of intellectual decline and moral  confusion.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}数据显示，黑暗时代是一个充斥着伦理乱象与低智之风的时期。

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Perhaps now is a good time to call upon the persuasive powers of the Hypno-shroom?
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}也许现在就是使用催眠菇强大说服力的绝佳时机？

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Good idea, Penny! We'll convert the wicked – Dark Ages style!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}好主意！潘妮！我们将会使恶人皈依，扭转黑暗时代的坏风气！

original: {SAY:crazydave}Deploy this shroom and the zombies won't know what bit them...
translation: {SAY:crazydave}只要把这个蘑菇种下去，僵尸就等着被自己的同类撕咬吧…

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Until they see that it was their fellow zombies! Then, mind BLOWN!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}直到它们目睹在面前的是昔日的同伴！然后，脑袋在百思不得其解时被啃得开花！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}According to my data, iron and other metals were routinely put to use during the Dark Ages.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}数据显示，铁和其他金属在黑暗时代常常被使用。

original: {EXCITED:winnie}Thus, Magnet-shroom should make an excellent ally here.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}因此，磁铁菇将在这里大显身手。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}He can pull buckets, helmets and other metal objects off of zombies!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}他可以把铁桶、头盔，以及其他金属物品从僵尸身上弄下来！

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Some people think it's magic. But really, it's just physics.
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}有些人觉得这是一种魔法。实际上，这不过是一种物理现象。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Boy, Pea-shooter and Wall-nut sure are good at what they do.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}嗯，豌豆射手和坚果墙干自己的活都很恪尽职守。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Talk about two great plants that fight great together!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}他们合作起来起来更是无可匹敌！

original: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave! Perhaps you are not as cerebrally unsound as you periodically insist!
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}用户戴夫！虽然你平常故意精神不正常，但这句话说得对！

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}What if there was one plant that behaved like both a Pea-shooter AND a Wall-nut?
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}会不会就有一株植物既能用作豌豆射手，又能当坚果墙？

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Two plant powers in one legume's body?
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}两株植物的力量，集于一株豆类植物的身体？

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Keep talkin' like that and people are going to call you Crazy Penny!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}再这么说下去大家会叫你疯狂潘妮的！

original: {SAY:crazydave}Which would be weird for both of us.
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}A question for you, my Ignoble Foes!
{SAY:zombossicon}Hast thou noted how violent thine plants become upon consuming Plant Food?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}草木因青灰而嗜虐，然汝等未尝意之。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, hast thou wondered what Plant Food is truly made of?
{SAY:zombossicon}Verily, I shall tell thee. It's zombies! Plant food is made out of zombies!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Unpossible! We feed our plants only the highest quality organic uhm...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}不可能！我们给植物的只有高品质的有机……呃…

original: {TIRED:crazydave}Hey Penny, what is Plant Food made of?
translation: {TIRED:crazydave}嘿！潘妮！植物养料是什么做的？

original: {SAY:winnie}I fear the true nature of Plant Food requires further analysis, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}恐怕我需要对植物养料的成分做进一步分析，用户戴夫。

original: {TIRED:winnie}Excuse me while I run some tests.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}我需要对它们做一些检测，在此期间请勿打扰我。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Why would anyone go and stick a nice sword into a dirty ol' rock?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}为何有人将这把圣剑插在这块肮脏的石头上？

original: {TIRED:winnie}I understand it to be a test, User Dave.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}我认为这是一项挑战，用户戴夫。

original: {EXCITED:winnie}Only someone with great physical strength and strength of character may remove it.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}唯独体格强壮，力大无穷的勇士方有可能拔剑出石。

original: {SAY:crazydave}I bet someone with a jackhammer could remove it.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我敢说肯定会有一个携带手提钻的勇士能蛮力钻出此剑！

original: {TIRED:winnie}An inelegant but no doubt effective solution to the test, User Dave.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}这是一个优雅不足但效果显著的手段，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have found no evidence that Plant Food contains zombies or zombie byproducts.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}没有任何证据表明植物养料中含有僵尸或者任何尸制品。

original: {TIRED:crazydave}Phew! Plants shouldn't eat zombies who eat plants.
translation: {TIRED:crazydave}呸！植物才不应该吃那些要吃他们的僵尸呢。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Except Chomper. He has to. Dude needs the fiber.
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}除了食人花，他需要僵尸的纤维。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Why dost thine time-traveling jalopy lie to thee?
{SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, a question best left for another day?
{SAY:zombossicon}Now, I pray, imagine maniacal laughter as I depart.
{NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave, we have encountered a scroll.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}用户戴夫，我们获得了一个卷轴。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}I love side-scrollers! They're my second favorite kind of game.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}横向卷轴小游戏！这可是我第二喜欢的游戏类型！

original: {SAY:winnieicon}This is not a game. It's a piece of parchment bearing a message.
translation: {SAY:winnieicon}这不是游戏，这是一张携带着信息的羊皮纸。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Will ya look at that! It's Dark Ages email. Neat-o!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}请仔细看看这幅画！这是一封黑暗时代的邮件。哇哦！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dartichokes aim first at high-priority targets like Wizards and Octo Zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}飞镖洋蓟可以优先攻击诸如巫师、章鱼僵尸等高优先级的僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}A meteorite. Curious. My records indicate this should be... bigger.
translation: {SAY:winnie}这是一颗陨石。奇怪的是……我的记录表明这应该……更大才对。
{SAY:crazydave}更大？像超级墨西哥卷饼那么大吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}More like super Seattle-sized. I hope history has not gone awry...
translation: {SAY:winnie}非常大，大概有一个超级西雅图体育场那么大，我真希望历史不要出现什么偏差…

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Surrender your brains forthwith, inane time stumblers!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们这群在时间中跌撞前行的疯子，快把脑子交出来！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Else you shall share the fate of these terrible thunder lizards: EXTINCTION!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}否则你们就等着与那些雷霆巨蜥一起遭受噩运吧——走向灭绝！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}But I don't want to get extincted!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}可是我不想和恐龙一样灭绝诶！
{SAY:winnie}有什么事困扰你了吗，用户戴夫？

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I just always wanted a primitive sunflower who gave big suns!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}我只是想要一株产出大阳光的原始版向日葵。
{SAY:winnie}可以准备撰写好评了，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Alert, User Dave. My sensors indicate we have moved 153,954,765 years into the past.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}警告，用户戴夫。我的传感器表明我们已回到 153964765 年前。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yabbers! That's before I was even born!
{SAY:winnie}Correct. We seem to have landed in some form of Jurassic Marsh.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们似乎已着陆于侏罗纪时期的沼泽地上。
{EXCITED:crazydave}我晓得，我感受到了更多的氧气！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Beware the Jurassic Bully zombies, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}请当心侏罗纪暴徒僵尸，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}They are immune to the Primal Peashooter's knockback effect.
translation: {SAY:winnie}他们免疫原始豌豆射手的击退效果。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Zuh? But how? Even Gargantuars get knocked back!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}哈？可是……即便是巨人僵尸也会受击退效果影响啊！

original: {SAY:winnie}True, User Dave. The Bully is simply too stupid to observe typical physics.
translation: {SAY:winnie}这是真的，用户戴夫。然则这些蛮人不过是蠢到不懂遵守基本的物理法则罢了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I detect Primal Potato Mines nearby, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我探测到原始土豆地雷在附近，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}Their prepaleolithic potency will far exceed our more refined modern versions.
translation: {SAY:winnie}旧石器时代的地雷的潜能远超我们那位于现代的改良版。
{EXCITED:crazydave}强力版的土豆？我已经爱上它们了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This epoch is known for its unusual lifeforms, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}这个纪元以它存在的不寻常生物而闻名于世，用户戴夫。
{EXCITED:crazydave}我知道！这里的有众多的裸子植物，对吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}I was thinking more in terms of saurians, User Dave. Dinosaurs.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我想的是这里有更多的蜥蜴亚目的动物，用户戴夫。也就是恐龙。

original: {SAY:winnie}They won't attack us directly and we can't affect them.
{SAY:winnie}However, they will definitely react to zombies. Be wary!
translation: {SAY:winnie}但他们一定会对僵尸有所反应。敬请多加小心！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey! The past is still just when we left it!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}嘿！一切还维持在我们离开那时的模样！

original: {SAY:winnie}True, with differences. More Jurassic zombies have appeared, with amplified abilities.
translation: {SAY:winnie}的确如此，但有所差异的是。更多侏罗纪僵尸出现了，并且它们的能力被强化了。

original: {SAY:winnie}Our plants may need to be upgraded to provide sufficient protection.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们的植物可能需要升级以提供足够的防护。

original: {SAY:winnie}Time fluxes interfere with mowing technology, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}时空的不稳定性干扰了除草科技，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}We must plant with additional care lest we be overrun.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们必须格外小心地种植以防被击溃。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! Your infernal interference enrages me! Bah!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呸！你那可恨的介入惹毛我了！呸！

original: {SAY:zombossicon} The Zombot Dinotronic Mechasaur, 2nd Edition, shall end your travels permanently!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon} 恐惧机龙僵尸机器人，第二代，将永久结束你们的旅程！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}We did it! Thanks, occasionally helpful dinosaurs!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我们做到啦！感谢你们，偶尔有点用处的恐龙！

original: {SAY:winnie}Our upgraded plants proved invaluable as well, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们的升级植物也展现了它们的价值，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Arrg! How could a robot dinosaur fail? MY PLAN WAS FOOLPROOF.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}哇啊啊啊！这机械恐龙怎么可能倾覆！我的计划明明万—无—一—失！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I can feel the ground a-trembling, Penny! More dinos?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我感受到大地在颤抖，潘妮！是更多恐龙要来了吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. A herd of stegosaurs approaches.
translation: {SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫。一大群剑龙正在靠近。

original: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate they will snare zombies with their tail, and then flick them off.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明他们会用尾巴抓住僵尸，然后将它们甩出。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have analyzed a new plant, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我刚分析出这儿有株新植物，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Perfume-shroom charms dinosaurs and turns them against the zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}香水菇可以迷住恐龙，从而使它们转而对抗僵尸。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Dino-sour power? On OUR side? This is taco-level great news!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}龙之波动？为我所用？真是个玉米卷级别的大好消息啊！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny! I just remembered how much I love silent letters!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}潘妮！我回想起了自己是有多么酷爱拼音中“整体认读音节”啊！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Coincidentally, User Dave, a flock of Pterodactyls is approaching.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}真是太巧合了，用户戴夫。一大群翼龙正在接近。
{EXCITED:crazydave}翼龙？这个“翼”字只需整体发音真是太赞了！
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我的暴怒已然开辟了新纪元！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Is there nowhen I may go to avoid your imbecilic interference?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}难道我要一直躲避你们那愚蠢的干涉吗？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Stay right where you are. I have an enormous rock scheduled to make your acquaintance.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}乖乖站好，我的“巨石计划”不久将会呈现在你们面前！
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}“巨石计划”？听起来就让人讨厌。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I see a toenail! Of unusual size!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我看到了一块特大尺寸的脚趾甲！

original: {SAY:winnie}This raptor claw bespeaks an ancient arena of dinosaurian dimensions, User Dave!
translation: {SAY:winnie}此块迅猛龙的爪牙表明附近有一处挤满恐龙的异次元的上古竞技场，用户戴夫！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I detect an incoming meteor, User Dave
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我探测到了一块正在靠近的陨石，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}I advise immediate egress from this timezone.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我建议我们立即离开这个时空！

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Bye-bye, dinos! You'll be birdies in no time!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}再会，恐龙！你们很快就要演变为小鸟儿了！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Bah! You leave me no choice but to enact... Project Paradox!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}呸！你让我别无选择，看来是时候启动“悖论计划”了！
{SAY:zombossicon}我会满心欢喜再见到你们的，傻瓜！

original: {SAY:winnie}New plants will help us face new challenges.
translation: {SAY:winnie}新植物会帮我们应对新的挑战。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I hope this new plant can hit up to three targets in its lane, twice!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}希望这个新植物能一下击中三个目标，还能来回伤害两次！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bloomerangs should prove effective against Camel Zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用回旋花来对付骆驼僵尸应该格外有效。

original: {SAY:winnie}Oh, and no need for sun. Plants are coming special delivery!
translation: {SAY:winnie}对了，这关不需要阳光。传送带会把植物派送过来，请注意查收！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}呜哇，木乃伊！更多的木乃伊僵尸要来了！

original: {SAY:winnie}The time fissure is strengthening zombies from all epochs, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}时空裂痕正在强化来自所有纪元的僵尸，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}We should expect more powerful versions of some zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们可以期待遇见更多某些僵尸的强化版。

original: {SAY:winnie}We may need to retreat to another timeline and return when our plants are stronger.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们也许只能撤退到其他时间线去，等我们的植物变得更加强大了再回来。

original: {SAY:winnie}The timeline is exhibiting instabilities, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}时间线正呈现出不稳定的状态，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}Fixed-loop paradoxes are forbidding the presence of lawnmowers.
translation: {SAY:winnie}固定循环悖论禁止了割草机的存在。
{SAY:crazydave}可我已经把中间那台割草机命名为“小割割”了呀！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Once more we meet in the sands of time!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我们在黄沙漫漫的时空中再度见面了！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Have you enjoyed my new and improved zombies?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}和我的全新强化版僵尸玩得开心吗？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Or should I say ancient and improved?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}或者我应该说，上古的强化版僵尸？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Bah! They are nothing to my Zombot Sphinxinator 2.0!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}呸！它们在我的狮身终结者僵尸机器人 2.0 面前都不值一提！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我已经大汗淋漓！但我们成功了！

original: {SAY:winnie}We may travel to other timelines freely, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们应该可以自由穿梭到其他时空了，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}But I detect further timeline expansions in the future.
translation: {SAY:winnie}但是我探测到了更多未来的时间线在膨胀。
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}到时我一定会征服你的，金字塔！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Indeed they do, User Dave. But they are not.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫。但事实并非如此。

original: {SAY:winnie}The lower Bloomerang is at MAX LEVEL.
translation: {SAY:winnie}下面的回旋花是最高等级的。

original: {SAY:winnie}Oh, and no need for sun. Plants are coming special delivery!
translation: {SAY:winnie}对了，这关不需要阳光。传送带会把植物派送过来，请注意查收！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}No need for sun.  Plants are coming via special delivery.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY} 这关不需要阳光。传送带会把植物派送过来，请注意查收！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}Awesome! I've always wanted to eat one of those.
{SAY:crazydave}Wait... that's not a starfish. It's an actual star.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}等等……那不是海星。那是一颗真正的星星。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}This will be the first last stand. There will be more lasts to come.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}这是我们的第一场“背水一战”。后续有更多的战斗即将打响。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I love sitting, but now is not the time! Let's get crazy.
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}我喜欢！来疯狂地通过这一关吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}I hope that pharaohs had some heirs.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}我倒是希望法老有些继承人。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}I guess that was their last stand too.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}我想这也是他们的最后一战了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}There's a brand new symbol to match. It's a bucket.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}有新的图案可以匹配了。是个桶。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}Match the symbols and win a prize!

translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}我也不清楚。有感受到幸运的气息吗？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}This level is a locked coordinate in time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}这关是一个在时空中锁定的坐标。

original: {EXCITED:winnie}You must take these plants to win.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}你只能使用选定的植物过关。
{EXCITED:winnie}不然的话，现实世界将会面临被你扭曲的风险。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}千万别扭曲现实世界啊！不然就糟了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}Can't we build a modern fence to stop these ancient zombies?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED}我们就不能造一座现代化的栅栏来阻挡这些僵尸吗？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Who needs fences when you have offense?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}当你有能力进攻时，谁还需要栅栏来防守？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}There's a plant call on the banana phone. It's an S.O.S.!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}那里有株植物在用“香蕉手机”向外求助。这是一则“请求植援”信号！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}They'll be sitting plants if we don't help. Let's take that root and save them!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}如果我们坐视不管，它们就只能在那儿坐以待毙了。快快向它们伸出援手吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}My sensors have detected plants in danger.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}我的传感器探测到了正处于危险状态植物。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL9:crazydave}谁会来拯救这些植物呢？谁呢?!??

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}There's too many tombs. Let's clear them out.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}坟墓数量过多，先清除它们吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SHOUT:crazydave}I'm hyperventilating I'm so excited right now.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SHOUT:crazydave}我现在已经呼吸急促了，好激动啊！

original: {SAY:winnie}Please wait 4500 years for your taco to be ready... more or less.
translation: {SAY:winnie}请耐心等待……距你的玉米卷出炉还有大约 4500 年。

original: {PLAYFUL}I'm sure my taco is around here somewhere, but in the meantime...
translation: {PLAYFUL}我敢打赌我的玉米卷就在附近。不过与此同时…

original: {TIRED}If only there was something that you could feed it…
translation: {TIRED}不知道有没有什么东西可以喂他…

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food is packed with vitamins and minerals.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}植物养料富含维生素和矿物质。

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}It's an essential part of a complete breakfast.
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}这是一顿完美早餐必不可少的一部分。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}Special couriers have been dispatched to retrieve your brains.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}邮递特使已经奉我之命前去取得你们的脑子。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Please have your release forms signed before their arrival.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}请在他们来之前在这份授权书上签字。
{SAY:zombossicon}此致 敬礼，埃德加·僵王博士。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Cool, that Mr. Boss guy wants your autograph!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}酷诶，那位博士先生想要你的签名呢！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL7}Whoa... this world goes to eleven! That's crazy!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL7}哇哦！已经在这个世界十一天了！太疯狂了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}My taco tastes so close I can smell it!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我的玉米卷肯定就在附近，我都能闻到它了！

original: {SAY:winnie}Beware, User Dave. Dr. Zomboss still stands in our way.
translation: {SAY:winnie}小心，用户戴夫。僵王博士仍在试图阻止我们。

original: {SAY:crazydave}What does that guy have against tacos and me eating them?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}他为什么非得要阻止我去寻找玉米卷啊？我吃玉米卷惹着他了吗？

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! My reasoning is simple yet beyond your comprehension!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呸！我的理由很简单，但超出了你的理解范围！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Now face my Zombot Sphinx-inator in battle!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}现在，到战场上臣服于我的狮身终结者僵尸机器人吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Though tetrahedrons are pyramids, this one is not a Platonic solid.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}虽然四面都是金字塔般的形状，但这可不是正多面体。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm so hungry, I would love a Platonic solid.
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}饿死了。什么正多面体啊，我想要的是一份正餐。

original: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, this is also not a taco salad.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，它可不是玉米卷沙拉。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Look, Penny! A Pirate Key! It's pirate-y!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}看，潘妮！一把海盗钥匙！真是海盗！

original: {EXCITED:winnie}This will enable us to travel to another time.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}这将允许我们前往另一个时空。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}This is no pleasure trip! Your excursion will be watery... and grave!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这不是一次愉快旅途！你的前程将是水汪汪的墓碑！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL8}看来这场戏杀“清”了!!!! 哈哈哈哈哈！

original: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave has been waiting to use that joke since we got here.
translation: {TIRED:winnie}自从我们来到这里，用户戴夫就一直在等讲那个笑话的机会。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Do you know what's better than a wrap? A Taco. Let's go!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}你知道什么比杀“清”更棒吗？肯定是一份玉米卷！我们走吧！

original: {TIRED:crazydave}There was never any meat in that taco.
{EXCITED:crazydave}I still have Tofunky in my beard to prove it!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}瞧瞧我长胡子里的残渣，它们能做担保！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Well, that just leaves more brains for us... later.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}好吧，这只不过是将更多的脑子……留到以后供我们享用。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}I'll find you again, in another where and another when!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我将再次——在又一个时空，于另一个地点，找到你！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Look! Now there's a star on the time-space map!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}看！现在时空地图上有颗星星！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Stars appear on the map where you earned them.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}当你获取星星时，它们便会出现在地图的对应位置上。

original: {PLAYFUL:winnieicon}Stars could help us get back to the year 2009 and your taco.
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnieicon}星星能帮我们回到 2009 年，并找回你的玉米卷。

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Well let's get going and find some more!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}那么让我们行动起来，去寻找更多星星吧！

original: {TIRED:winnieicon}Empty stars show where you can go to earn stars.
translation: {TIRED:winnieicon}星星槽指引我们何处能获取更多星星。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}Now this looks like the map to my taco!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}现在这张地图应该是用来找我的玉米卷的了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}To be precise this is a world map where we can find plants that can help us and...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}确切地说，这张地图标示着我们能在何处寻找到能助我们一臂之力的植物以及…

original: {TIRED:winnieicon}User Dave, there are more important things at hand than...
translation: {TIRED:winnieicon}用户戴夫，我们手头上还有更要紧的事…

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Good news! Penny found a map to my taco!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}好消息！潘妮发现了能找到玉米卷的地图！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}No, that is a time-space map to the plants that can help us.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}不，这是一张时空地图，指向那些能助我们一臂之力的植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}My Gügle translator indicates the zombies have a plan.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}我的“古鸽翻译”表明僵尸有一项计划。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Somebody passed me a note in homeroom, Penny!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}有人在教室里递给我一张便条，潘妮！

original: {SAY:crazydave}It says to meet behind the bike racks at lunchtime for a funderful surprise!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}上边要我在午餐时间去自行车棚会面，给我一个大惊喜。

original: {SAY:winnie}I believe some skepticism about this note is in order, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我觉得这张纸条有些蹊跷，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Do you feel that you have grooved? Did you bang your head? Have you "dug it"?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们跟上节奏了吗？有跟着节拍摇摆吗？“稀饭”我的音乐吗？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Now the party is over! Melt before the musical might of my majestic Hair Metal Gargantuar!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}不过现在，派对结束了！面对我那雄伟的重金属巨人僵尸，在他的音乐力量面前融化吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I'm scared, Penny! It's two minutes to midnight!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我好害怕啊，潘妮！还差两分钟就到惊魂的午夜了！

original: {SAY:winnie}Be brave, User Dave. We'll jilt this ditty... on rock and roll!
translation: {SAY:winnie}勇敢一点，用户戴夫！别放这首悲情小曲了……切歌到激情摇滚中去！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Mmm! Penny, do you smell something scrum-dicious?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}嗯！潘妮，你有闻到什么美味的东西吗？
{SAY:Winnie}不，用户戴夫。此处只有霹雳舞僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Flashback! I remember this décor from when I chased squirbos as a kid!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}回忆啊！我记得自己还是追疯狂松鼠的小屁孩时就有这些装饰了。

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. We appear to have arrived in the midst of a Neon Mixtape Tour.
translation: {SAY:winnie}的确，用户戴夫。我们似乎来到了炫光魔音游的现场。

original: {SAY:winnie}I suspect the musical tempo may affect the zombies' speeds.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我怀疑音乐的节奏会影响僵尸行进的速度。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm feeding the rhythm, I'M FEEDING THE RHYTHM!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spore-shrooms have a unique ability, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}孢子菇有着独特的能力，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}If they defeat a zombie, a new Spore-shroom will spawn where that zombie fell.
translation: {SAY:winnie}只要其击败一只僵尸，僵尸倒下的地方就会再生成一株孢子菇。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Say, do you think Intensive Carrots can be used to revive defeated plants?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}你说，医护胡萝卜会不会是用来复活倒下的植物的？

original: {SAY:winnie}Sorry. It just confuses me when you pay attention.
translation: {SAY:winnie}抱歉。你专心听我说话让我有点不知所措。

original: {SAY:winnie}I believe special zombies may display unique abilities while their preferred music is playing.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我相信某些特殊僵尸会在自己喜欢的音乐响起后展现其专属技能。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}You mean they'll jam their jam when their jam is jamming?
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}你是说他们在演奏自己的即兴演奏的时候，就会跟着演奏即兴演奏两段？

original: {SAY:winnie}Yes, correct, yes, and yes, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}是的，没错，是的、是的，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Hmmmm... you’re in danger above. You’re a fool; and so knew I!
translation:
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}现在听我唱：/r
♫You're in danger above. You're a fool; and so knew I!♫/r
（你遇上大事了。你是个笨蛋，我早已清楚明白！）

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Hear me now: Ever shall you give up; ever shall you be down; always you’ll run aground, I’ll revert you.
translation:
{SAY:zombossicon}♫Ever shall you give up; ever shall you be down; always you'll run aground, I'll revert you.♫/r
（永远要将你放弃；永远要让你伤心；永远要把你抛弃，要伤害你。）

original: {SAY:zombossicon}I intend to make you cry; I mean for you to say goodbye; I'm not really that nice a guy – I alert you!
translation:
{SAY:zombossicon}♫I intend to make you cry; I mean for you to say goodbye; I'm not really that nice a guy - I alert you!♫/r
（我想让你哭；想和你告别；我不是个好人——我警告你！）

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}Yarbs! That was close... with so many exciting timing and rhythm changes!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}呀！太惊险了……节奏激动人心，韵律变化万千！

original: {SAY:winnie}I fear we have only hit pause on Dr. Zomboss’s heinous deal.
translation: {SAY:winnie}恐怕我们只是暂时阻止了僵王博士那邪恶的大阴谋。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Indeed, next verse, same and yet worse! I go now to when you cannot imagine!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}没错，下节乐章，邪恶依旧，甚至更胜一筹！告辞，我现在要去一个你们永远想不到的时空！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I got a real Cactus feeling about this, Penny!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我终于摸索出仙人掌真正的特性啦，潘妮！

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, Cactus has changed over time, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}没错，仙人掌在这些年的时间里有所改变，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}Now she fires a thorn for ranged damage, but hides for ground damage when zombies approach.
translation: {SAY:winnie}她现在可以发射棘刺来远程攻击，而在僵尸接近时，则可以躲进地下造成伤害。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's so Cactus... always varying her attack and defensive profiles!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}那可真是个“神仙”啊！她总是在攻与守的姿态间切换自如！

original: {SAY:crazydave}Karaoke time! At last my tangerine dreams will come true!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}现在是卡拉 OK 时间！我幼时的歌唱梦终于得以实现啦！

original: {SAY:winnie}Caution, User Dave. This dropped mic promises a banned battle of heavy petal proportions!
translation: {SAY:winnie}小心，用户戴夫。这只丢掉的麦克风预示着一场被禁止的、“重茎薯”般的战斗！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Let's go to the dandy-handy Almanac to upgrade a plant!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}让我们去那本超好用超方便的图鉴中去升级一棵植物吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Defeat levels to unlock and collect new plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}通过更多关卡，解锁、收集新的植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}And then upgrade those plants in the Almanac?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}然后在图鉴中升级那些植物？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Travel Log's got some kinda new thing! Check it out!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}旅行木标里好像有些新东西了！快去看看吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints can be leveled up with mints you earn from Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}你可以通过在竞技场获取的薄荷糖来升级你的超能薄荷。

original: {SAY:winnie}Leveled up Power Mints last longer, have more powerful effects, and can be planted more often.
translation: {SAY:winnie}高等级的超能薄荷持续时间更长、效果更加强大，冷却时间也会更短。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Enchant-mint family is made up of magic plants.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Enforce-mint family includes short-range, high-damage melee plants.
translation: {SAY:winnie}搏荷家族包括近战、高伤害的格斗类植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Enlighten-mint Family is made up of sun-producing plants.
translation: {SAY:winnie}祝荷家族包括可以生产阳光的植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Enlighten-mint can be leveled up with Season Award seed packets.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}祝荷可以用赛季奖励的种子包升级。

original: {SAY:winnie}A leveled up Enlighten-mint lasts longer, produces more sun, and can be planted more often.
translation: {SAY:winnie}一株高等级的祝荷在草坪上的持续时间会更长，给你更多都阳光，并且还可以更频繁地种植。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have detected that you have sustained multiple surface level injuries.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我探测到你的皮肤有多处受到了损伤。

original: {SAY:crazydave}I got into a fight with the Travel Log. He thinks he can tell me what to do!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我和旅行木标吵了一架。他凭什么觉得自己可以吩咐我该干什么！

original: {SAY:winnie}Medical assistance is required. I recommend that we search for an Aloe.
translation: {SAY:winnie}一位随行御医是很有必要的。我推荐我们去找一株芦荟。

original: {SAY:winnie}Aloe is capable of healing damage an adjacent plant takes.
translation: {SAY:winnie}芦荟在治愈毗邻植物这一方面非常得心应手。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Aloe is a steadfast companion to the Kiwi Beast.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}芦荟是野兽猕猴桃的忠实伙伴。
