original: {SAY:winnie}They should continuously generate sun as long as they have plants on them.
translation: {SAY:winnie}若是地砖上边有植物，它们会持续产出阳光。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Lost City? This is it Penny! We've found it!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}失落之城？是这里啦，潘妮！我们找到它了！

original: {SAY:crazydave}Where else would I find my lost taco, except in a Lost City?/r
translation: {SAY:crazydave}除了失落之城外，还有哪里能够找到我丢失的“遗落玉米卷”吗？/r

original: {SAY:winnie}Your continued fixation defies all logic or reason, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}你还是一如既往固执地违抗着一切的因果逻辑，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Beware, User Dave! I detect trap tiles.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}当心，用户戴夫！我探测到了陷阱地砖！

original: {SAY:winnie}They are triggered by zombies, or when you plant on them.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们在你把植物种在上边，亦或有僵尸经过时被触发。
{EXCITED:crazydave}然后它们会赐予你玉米卷，是吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}If you equate tacos with jets of flame and huge boulders, then yes.
translation: {SAY:winnie}若是你将玉米卷等同于一行熊熊烈焰，或者捣毁沿途一切的滚滚的巨石，那么我可以郑重地回答你：是的！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate movement incoming from above.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明我们头顶处传来运动的迹象。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Maybe it's presents. Presents from the sky!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}也许这会是件礼物，来自苍穹的馈赠！

original: {SAY:winnie}The chances of that statement being true are statistically irrelevant./r
translation: {SAY:winnie}从统计学的角度考量，你说的那种情况简直就是无稽之谈。/r

original: {SAY:winnie}I believe it to be a new form of zombie threat. We should be cautious of unexpected guests.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我相信这是僵尸突袭我们的新方式。我们应该当心那些不速之客。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We are facing considerable threats, User Dave. I suggest that we retaliate with tremendous force.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我们目前面临着相当大的威胁，用户戴夫。我建议使用强而有力的打击来回敬他们！

original: {SAY:crazydave}More forceful! That's it! We'll give them all a stern talking to.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}强而有力！就应该这样！我们用强有力的“演讲”回敬他们！

original: {SAY:winnie}I was referring to the Lava Guava. Its explosive blasts leave behind dangerous magma./r
translation: {SAY:winnie}我指的是岩浆番石榴。它轰隆一声爆炸之后会留下危险的熔岩。/r

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}That sounds even better! First a stern talking, then some lava!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}噢，那听起来更棒啦！那就先来一次慷慨激昂的演讲，然后再来一点岩浆！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Caution, User Dave. I detect a zombie with a shovel.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}小心，用户戴夫！我探测到一只携带铲子的僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}It appears to block incoming shots. We need a way to get projectiles over the shovel.
translation: {SAY:winnie}铲子可以抵挡射手的射击，我们得想办法让植物的攻击物越过铲子。
{SAY:crazydave}我知道是什么了！伊克斯派力阿莫斯--除你武器！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon} Do not think to usurp our discovery of the fabled Lost City!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}别妄想篡夺我们于传说中的失落之城里发现的宝物！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}I and my zombies have already submitted our find to the Eminent Journal of the Missing and the Mislaid!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我，还有我的僵尸已经把成果发表在《失落与遗失文明的杰出学刊》上了！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}We will publish and you will PERISH!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我们的论文将日趋完善，你们的棺盖会逐渐关合！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}看啊，潘妮！这有个简直闪瞎我的狗眼不知道是什么鬼的东东！

original: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate this amulet points the way to a long-lost challenge.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明，这个护身符指引着我们进行一项久违的挑战…
{EXCITED:crazydave}麻利点，让我们尽快开始探索吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}All that discovering and still no taco!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}一切谜底都已被揭晓，然而……此地并无玉米卷。

original: {SAY:winnie}The search will no doubt continue, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}有关玉米卷的搜索工作仍在进行，用户戴夫。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}My discovery remains intact. The taco is still unfound. And your brains will certainly one day be mine!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我寻到的宝物安然无恙，毫发无伤！你的玉米卷却仍然下落不明！而你们的脑子，终将成为我囊中的宝物！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Well lookie-here, Penny! It's a treasure map!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}瞧瞧这个，潘妮！这是一张藏宝图！

original: {SAY:winnie}My analysis suggests that the origins of that map are highly suspect.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的分析表明，地图的出处十分值得怀疑。

original: {SAY:crazydave}It has a big red X on it, Penny. When have big red Xs ever been bad?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}这上面有一大红叉，潘妮。大红叉能有什么坏心眼呢？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, shouldn't you be wearing green for the parade?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你不应该换上绿色的服装去参加游行吗？
{SAY:crazydave}我玉米卷里的生菜就是绿色的！
{SAY:crazydave}把你的针离我的玉米卷远点！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha! Ha! Ha! You’ll need more than a bit o’ luck to defeat me!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈！哈！哈！想要打败我，你们得多找一些幸运星！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}啊哦，看来得准备 2 块玉米卷了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}Been waiting all year for this day.
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:sunflower_r}Spider rain go away, come back to fight another day!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:sunflower_r}蛛虫雨快走开，要约战改日再来！
{SAY:sunflower_r}要是我们有这么……幸运就好了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}All in all, you’re just another seed in the pot… of gold.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}总而言之，你不过是花盆中的另一粒种子……金子做的那种。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, Luckily, we have successfully defended the lawn and saved your brainz!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，很幸运，我们成功守护住了草坪，也拯救了你的脑子！
{SAY:winnie}正在为下一次冒险重新校准。

original: {NPC_ENTER:browncoatzombie_r}{SAY:zomboss}One day you won’t be so lucky User Dave then I Zomboss will be there waiting!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:browncoatzombie_r}{SAY:zomboss}总有一天你不会像今天这么幸运，用户戴夫，我僵王会一直等着那天的到来的！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SHOUT:crazydave}Woah, Penny! I found a 4 leaf clover, now I be-leaf in luck.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SHOUT:crazydave}哇，潘妮！我找到了片四叶草，“事业”好运少不了。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha! Ha! Ha! That luck is something you will need. Minions!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈！哈！哈！你们运气最好好一点。小的们！

original: {SAY:peashooter_r}I was thinking the same thing. But what is Wallnut doing?
translation: {SAY:peashooter_r}我也在想一样的事情。话说坚果墙在做什么呢？

original: {SAY:sunflower}Holy leaves! That is a tiny green zombie. Wallnut wait!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}老天“叶”啊！那是只绿小鬼。坚果墙等等！
{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}小矮妖！大金锅！坚果墙发财了！
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}感觉我的好运是不是被我挡住了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}That's it my minions, take it all away.
{SAY:zomboss}Just wait and watch your luck wither away. Muhuhahaha!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}你们就眼睁睁看着自己的好运慢慢凋零吧。木哈哈哈哈！

original: {SAY:peashooter_r}They say, you shouldn't press your luck for a reason you know?
translation: {SAY:peashooter_r}俗话说得好，侥幸心理不可有，你知道吧？

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}Zomboss sure is starting a parade down here.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}僵王肯定是在那儿筹办一场大游行。

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}I guess we have to delay the party now.
{SAY:peashooter}Looks like its shamrocks and shenanigans for all.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}看来生活不只有幸运草，也会有恶作剧。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}The paddy don't start till I walk in.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}等我入场，“葩对”才算真正开始。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, looks like your 4 leaf clover has brought us luck.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，看来你的四叶草为我们带来了好运。

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Lady luck may have been on your side today....
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}也许今天，幸运女神在你们这边…

original: {SAY:zomboss}....but I will be the one dublin' my fortune next time.
translation: {SAY:zomboss}…但下次，我会让她四倍偿还，一片叶子一份账。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, may this new year bring you good health and good fortune.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，祝你新的一年身体安康，福星高照。

original: {SAY:winnie}Yes, User Dave… we really need to get you your taco.
translation: {SAY:winnie}是的，用户戴夫……我们真的应该给你玉米卷。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Chomp! Chomp! Chomp! The Zombies ate your brainz… and now you are done.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}嗷！嗷！嗷！僵尸吃掉了你的脑子……你们已经完蛋了。
{SAY:zomboss}依我看，你们防线的沦陷，就在不远的将来！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}依我看，玉米卷，就在不远的将来！

original: {SAY:peashooter}It’s like Zomboss is lulling us into a false sense of security.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}感觉僵王就是想让我们有安全的错觉，然后放松警惕一样。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we have successfully defended the lawn and saved your brainz!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我们成功守护住了草坪，拯救了你的脑子。

original: {SAY:winnie}This new year is off to a fortuitous start.
{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Happy Lunar Zoo Year my dudes, I have a little....
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}大伙，笼笠新年快乐，我给你们准备了…
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}…一个惊喜，绝对可以轰翻你们的派对！木哈哈哈…

original: {SHOUT:peashooter}Holy Peas! Where did you come from?

translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}“心念快落”，你们这帮没礼貌的杂草！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Is that a bird, is it a plane?
{SAY:winnie}Sensors indicates that it is the new plant...
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明那是一株新植物…

original: {SAY:crazydave}I sense the scales turning to our favor.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我感觉胜利的天平开始倒向我们这边了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Oowee, that loogie's one tough cookie! Those zombies are outta here!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}我去，它吐的痰对僵尸来说肯定是块硬骨头！把僵尸都赶跑了！

original: {SAY:crazydave}Wait, that's what I'm hankering for...a cookie taco!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}等等，我知道我一直想要的是什么了……一份硬骨头玉米卷！

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}The fortune is in our favor, we can do this.
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}但幸运女神在我们这边，我们没问题的。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Hehehe...My symphony of dead has only begun.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}呵呵呵……我的死亡交响曲才刚刚开始。
{NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我知道这场派对还缺些什么了……卡拉 OK！

original: {SAY:sunflower}Bun Chi was a little bit frightening...
{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Oh shoot! How does the next verse go?
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}You may have crashed this party, but next year I will bring the house down.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}你们或许能毁掉这场派对，但明年，就等着我来把你们的房子掀翻吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}Looks like your party of undead had no life in it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}看来你的不死军派对已经毫无生气了。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I get it. Undead, no life. Ha. Ha. Ha.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我听懂这个笑话了。不死军，毫无生气。哈。哈。哈。

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Who unplugged the karaoke machine? It was my turn!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}谁把卡拉 OK 机的电源拔了？该我唱了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}磁铁菇可以把僵尸身上的金属物品吸走。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Fooded Magnet-shroom attracts multiple metallic objects from zombies within his vicinity and throws them.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}磁铁菇受到植物养料效果后，可以从附近的僵尸身上吸走数个金属物品，随后将其扔回去。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Mega Gatling Pea to fire 4 peas at a time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植超级机枪豌豆，获得 4 倍火力。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Pea Vine on Mega Gatling Pea for a damage boost.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在超级机枪豌豆上种植豌豆藤蔓，强化它的伤害！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Mega Gatling Pea has a chance to spontaneously Plant Food.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超级机枪豌豆有概率自动产生植物养料效果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Once Plant Fooded, Mega Gatling Pea fires 5 peas instead of 4.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}获得植物养料效果后，超级机枪豌豆可以一次性发射 5 颗豌豆。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}It’s cold out. Snow is on the ground. And you can smell it in the air…
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}冷死了。遍地都是皑皑白雪。连空气中都满是它的味道…

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:peashooter}There is an inbound infestation of Balloon Zombies!
{SAY:peashooter}I can’t stop them! They are above me.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}我阻止不了它们！它们都在我脑袋上面。

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}Meteor Flower and Mega Gatling Pea are awesome!
translation: {SAY:wallnut_r}流星花和超级机枪豌豆太棒啦！
{SAY:wallnut_r}真是期待我们的下一场冒险啊！

original: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}Facebreaker is a blast from the past, right to your face!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}破“鼻”者，来自往日的打脸之风，每敲每锤，锤锤正中你的鼻子！

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}In that case, it must be right to your vase!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}这样的话，每敲每锤，锤锤正中你的瓶子！

original: {NPC_ENTER:Winnie}{SAY:Winnie}Tap Missile Toe to arm her, then tap the target to fire.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:Winnie}{SAY:Winnie}轻点爆冰槲寄生让她进行武装，然后轻点目标进行开火。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have picked up a Shadow-shroom seed packet, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我们刚捡到了一包暗影菇种子，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie} Shadow-shrooms are shadow plants, so be sure to plant them next to Moonflowers for bonus effects.
translation: {SAY:winnie}暗影菇同样是一种暗影系植物。所以为了获得增强效果，请把他们栽种在月光花身旁。
{EXCITED:crazydave}又是一次邻里关系的大胜利！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave} 看啊，潘妮！这不是我的玉米卷吗！

original: {SAY:winnie}No, User Dave! You must not! I detect high levels of trappiness!
translation: {SAY:winnie}不，用户戴夫！你不能那样！我探测到其中包含着极强的陷阱气息！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Fools! You have fallen into my excruciatingly obvious trap!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}傻瓜！你们已经掉进我明设的残酷陷阱啦！

original: {SAY:zombossicon} My vast and varied array of Gargantuars will pummel you into total oblivion!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我那庞大而形形色色的巨人大军将会以重拳出击，把你打到不省人事！
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}然后我就可以得到我的玉米卷了吗？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Dusk Lobber is yet another shadow plant, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}薄暮掷手又是一种暗影植物，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}On its own, it lobs exploding projectiles.
translation: {SAY:winnie}单独种植的话，它能够投掷具有爆炸属性的炮弹。

original: {SAY:winnie}In its powered state, however, it lobs down three lanes!
translation: {SAY:winnie}不过，一旦受到暗影强化，它的投掷范围将扩充至三行！

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's a lane for each of my thumbs and noses!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}三行！那不正好就俩拇指占两行，鼻子再占一行！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Escape Root is a tricky plant, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}逃脱树根是株很令僵尸棘手的植物，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}When threatened, it swaps in an explosive plant!
translation: {SAY:winnie}一旦受到威胁，它就会变身成爆炸植物！

original: {SAY:winnie}And if you tap it, and then another plant, they will switch places!
translation: {SAY:winnie}如果你轻点它一下，再轻点另一株植物，它们就会交换位置！

original: {SAY:winnie}You can use Escape Roots to rescue endangered plants!
translation: {SAY:winnie}你可以使用逃脱树根来拯救那些处于危险中的植物！

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Whaaaaa-? Plants can be in-dangered? CALL THE POLICE!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}啥？植物受到威胁了？快点打 110 啊啊啊啊！
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}啊哈！时空悖论计划，现在……开始！

original: {SAY:winnie}We have arrived moments before our departure!
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们已经回到了时空之旅出发前的某一时刻！

original: {SAY:winnie}If my guess is correct, Dr. Zomboss will attempt to prevent your initial taco-consumption!
translation: {SAY:winnie}如果我的猜想正确，僵王博士一定在试图阻止你起初的玉米卷吞食行为！
{SAY:winnie}那么我们的时空之旅将会不复存在！

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}...OOOOOOOO! Sorry, I was busy screaming "No." Did you say "taco"?
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}…啊！抱歉，我太专注于张皇失措地喊“不”了。你刚刚是说了“玉米卷”吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}We must beware, User Dave. Dr. Zomboss will surely deploy all his time-varied zombies against us!
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们必须得小心了，用户戴夫。僵王博士肯定会派出他那来自各个时空、形形色色的僵尸来对付我们！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}全明星僵尸越线侵入了，用户戴夫！

original: {SAY:winnie}They tackle and destroy the first plant they encounter!
translation: {SAY:winnie}他们可以立即擒拿、消灭掉他们所遇到的第一株植物！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Oy howdy! I think it's one of those Beghouled-y grids again, Penny!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}啊哈！我觉得这又是一片宝尸迷阵，潘妮！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Grimrose is a shadow plant, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}报丧花是一株暗影植物，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}It drags down a zombie that enters its lane.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它可以把踏入其所在行的一只僵尸拖入地底。

original: {SAY:winnie}When powered, it can dispose of three zombies before it expires.
translation: {SAY:winnie}而受到暗影强化后，它能够在凋亡前带走三只僵尸。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}That just seems like it's trying too hard!

translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}我听到了微弱的脚步声！噼噼啪啪的小跑！

original: {SAY:winnie}Engage caution, User Dave. I detect Super-fan Imps ahead!
translation: {SAY:winnie}务必小心，用户戴夫。我在前方探测到了一大批超球迷小鬼！
{SAY:winnie}他们的团队精神无比狂热炸裂！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Moonflower emits sun, User Dave. But that is not all.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}月光花可以绽放出阳光，用户戴夫。但是这还不是她的所有能力。

original: {SAY:winnie}My scans show that it creates a special glow that augments plants of its type.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的雷达显示，它能制造一片增强同家族植物的特别光晕。

original: {SAY:winnie}Planting Moonflowers next to each other should increase their power.
translation: {SAY:winnie}将月光花种在一起，它们便可以相互强化。

original: {SAY:winnie}I suspect they will have the same effect on any other shadow plants we may find.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我猜想，这样的效果，会同样出现在我们找到的其他暗影植物身上。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}It is presently a moment of your apocalypse!
{SAY:zombossicon}Your reckless pursuit of an already-eaten taco has shattered all of time!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}不计后果，去追寻一块分明已经吃掉的玉米卷，让时空产生了碎片！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}It falls to me to restore future, now, and past!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}令我不得不穿梭于过去、现在以及未来以修补它们！

original: {SAY:winnie}Has our quest ruptured the timestream itself?
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们的追寻真的令时间长河支离破碎了吗？

original: {SAY:crazydave}Allow me to address your concern thusly:
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Fools! Do you not value the validity of time?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}傻瓜！你们是完全不重视时间的有效性吗？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Care you not if one moment follows another?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}你们难道根本不在乎时间流逝的连续性？
{SAY:zombossicon}呆子！蠢货！顶着个铁锅的大傻瓜！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie} {EXCITED:crazydave}It's not a pot, it's a handled basin!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie} {EXCITED:crazydave}这不是一顶普通的锅！这是一个有把柄的盆！

original: {SAY:winnie}I am concerned, User Dave. What if he speaks true?
translation: {SAY:winnie}我有些担心，万一他说的是真的呢？

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm too taco-addled to care, Penny! FORWARD!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}我太"玉米卷心切"，已经来不及管这些了，潘妮！前进！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I beseech you, time-zippers, you must listen to reason!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}算我求你们了，时空穿梭者，你们得听听原因！
{SAY:zombossicon}时空的连贯性将支离破碎，而我们所处的时空正处在崩溃的边缘！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Stuff is all jiggy and super wacked-out, like!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}所有物质都变得不稳定，如你戴夫一般疯疯癫癫！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}I am telling the truth, Insane Dave Person!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}我是在说实话啊，疯疯癫癫的戴某人！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}My words are utterly not an attempt to trick you!
{SAY:zombossicon}You cannot re-eat a taco! It is impossible!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}你不能“再吃”一次玉米卷！这根本不可能！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Imp-possible? I HATE IMPS! WITH A PASSION!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}可能……就见鬼了！我讨厌见到那些激情四射的小鬼！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}If you will not listen, then you will be destroyed!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}如果你不听从我的建议，你们就会被毁灭！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}David, I implore you! You must give up your hopeless dream of a long-ago taco!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}戴夫，我求求你了！你必须放弃吃一块很早以前玉米卷的幻想。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}THIS IS THE GREATEST DAY IN MY OR ANYBODY ELSE'S LIFE!!!!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}这是我和世界上所有人最棒的一天了!!!!

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, perhaps we have misjudged Dr. Zomboss all this time...
translation: {SAY:winnie}的确，也许我们一直都错怪僵王博士了…

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon} {SAY:zombossicon}Ha ha ha! Perhaps you HAVE misjudged me. Or... perhaps not!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon} {SAY:zombossicon}哈哈哈！也许你们确实一直都错怪我了。或者……也许并没有！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}I surely have no devious plans for the future! Or... do I?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}我未来确实没有阴谋诡计了！或者……真的没有了吗？
{SAY:zombossicon}吧哈哈哈哈！我们会再次见面的！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}It is gone, gone forever! But please, in its place, take this!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}它没有了，永远没有了！但求你，收下这个，代替它吧！

original: {SPECIAL2}{EXCITED:crazydave}A TACO WITH A WAFFLE IN IT!!!!!
{SAY:winnie}I detect high levels of deliciousness, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我探测到了极高的美味指数，用户戴夫。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我的华夫饼玉米卷真是美味可口！

original: {SAY:crazydave}But do I smell more zombies ahead?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}可是为何我嗅到前方有更多僵尸的气息呢？

original: {SAY:winnie}Tacos-With-Waffles-In-Them or not, zombies still want brains.
translation: {SAY:winnie}无论玉米卷是否有华夫饼，僵尸始终想要脑子。

original: {SAY:winnie}Stay on the lookout for stronger versions of zombies we've seen.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们要对发现的强化版僵尸时刻保持警惕。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Shrinking Violet is well named, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}缩小“谨”菜这个名字取得好啊，用户戴夫

original: {SAY:winnie}It shrinks zombies and makes them weaker.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它能够缩小僵尸并让它们变得更脆弱。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Tiny zombies! Stay away from my shins!

translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我们的割草机变成了割早机！

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. Perhaps this is a consequence of Dr. Zomboss' Project Paradox.
translation: {SAY:winnie}的确，用户戴夫。或许这是僵王博士悖论计划的成果之一。

original: {SAY:winnie}We likely will not be able to rely on them going forward.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们似乎不能再依赖割草机继续前行了。

original: {SAY:crazydave}But I need them for squirbo hunting!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}可我需要它们来捕猎疯狂松鼠什么的呀！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Did you enjoy your augmented taco, David?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}品尝了自己的强化版玉米卷了吗，戴夫？
{SAY:zombossicon}它的 秘—密—配—方 是什么呢？

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Surely then you shall appreciate my augmented zombies in equal measure!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}可以确定的是你一定会感激那与你实力相当的强化版僵尸的！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I think we survived, Penny! Can you check?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我认为我们活下来了，潘妮！你能检查确认一下吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}Scanning... I calculate 98% chance of survival with 3% margin of error.
translation: {SAY:winnie}扫描中……我算出有 98% 的存活率。本次计算有 3% 的边际误差。
{SAY:crazydave}感谢玉米卷为强化版植物所做的一切！

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Curses! It appears that further zombie game-upping shall be required!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}呸！这表明需要在游戏中加入更高端的僵尸强化了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Nightshade is another shadow plant, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}夜影茄又是一株暗影植物，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}By itself it deals slapping damage to zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}如果使用它单枪匹马出战，它可以在短时间内对僵尸造成伤害。

original: {SAY:winnie}But if it is planted next a Moonflower, both will become more powerful.
translation: {SAY:winnie}若是将它栽种在月光花附近，那么两者都会变得更加强大！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I am picking up a grid of plants, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}我找到了一片成棋盘状分布的植物群，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}My scans suggest that they can be swapped to create matches of three.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的雷达显示，它们可以通过两两交换来制造一组由三株同种植物形成的匹配。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I saw a game like that once on my telephoney!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}就像是我在我手机上见过的那个游戏！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors are picking up increased helium levels, User Dave.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我的传感器检测到氦含量升高。

original: {SAY:winnie}I suspect we may be facing one or more Balloon Zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我猜测我们将要面对至少一只气球僵尸。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}I hate one or more Balloon Zombies!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny! A random length of sewer pipe!
{SAY:winnie}Be careful, User Dave. That pipe is part of a municipal mulch of endless engagement!
translation: {SAY:winnie}小心，用户戴夫。那个下水管道里会爬出无穷无尽的僵尸！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}There's still more levels in open worlds.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}在已开放世界里还有更多关卡。

original: {EXCITED:winnieicon}And there are still plants and rewards to earn too.
translation: {EXCITED:winnieicon}而且还有待获取的植物和奖励。

original: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}We haven't forgotten about you my dear lost taco.
translation: {TIRED:crazydaveicon}我们还没忘了你，我亲爱的失踪玉米卷。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Up Murkadamia Nuts to block and damage zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}强化黑暗夏威夷果，阻挡僵尸，对它们造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Nightcap's poison attacks cut right through armor.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗夜菇的剧毒攻击可以穿透盔甲。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Nightcap goes into stealth when Zombies are close.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}当僵尸接近时，暗夜菇会进入潜行模式。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Nightcap doubles its poison damage and attacks 3 lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到植物养料强化的暗夜菇剧毒伤害翻倍，还能攻击 3 行的敌人。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}Where do you think the future will take us?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}你觉得未来会将我们带向何方？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}Practicing advanced planting techniques in the Endless Zones...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}在无尽地带中练习更为高超的种植技巧…

original: {SAY:winnieicon}Will keep you sharp for future trials.
{SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
translation: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}请记住。明日，永远都是一个玉米卷…

original: {SPECIAL16:crazydaveicon}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
translation: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}而玉米卷，正是我们每个人内心深处所苦苦寻求之物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}It may look like the end of the road...
{PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Could you put it in the fridge?
{SAY:crazydaveicon}But the road goes on when searching for a taco on the space-time continuum.
translation: {SAY:crazydaveicon}但是当在时空连续中寻找玉米卷的时候，这条路还会延伸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}In the meantime, be sure to practice advanced planting techniques in the Endless Zones.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}同时，请确保在无尽地带中练习更为高超的种植技巧…

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Penny is right. It's important to stay sharp.
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}潘妮的说法完全正确。养精蓄锐以备亮剑之时，这事尤为重要。

original: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}You never know when you might find zombies on your lawn.
translation: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}你永远不知哪一天会在草坪上再次发现僵尸。
{TIRED:crazydaveicon}怀疑这一点吗，你只是不清楚而已。

original: {SAY:crazydaveicon}But if you do find my taco on your lawn...
translation: {SAY:crazydaveicon}倘若你在自家草坪上发现我的玉米卷…

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I see more seas! Arrrr there more zombies?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我看到了更广袤的海域！海的那边，是更多的僵尸吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}More pirate zombies have appeared, and with greater strength.
translation: {SAY:winnie}更多的海盗僵尸已经出现，并且有着更强大的力量。

original: {SAY:winnie}We may need to retreat to another timeline and return when our plants are stronger.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们也许只能撤退到其他时间线的世界，等我们的植物变得更加强大时再回来了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Ai-yowza! Our lawnmowers have walked some planks!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}呜哇！我们的割草机走下甲板啦！

original: {SAY:winnie}The temporal energies are too powerful for them, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}时空的能量对于它们来说过于强大了，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:winnie}We cannot allow even a single zombie past our defenses.
translation: {SAY:winnie}现在我们不能让哪怕是一只僵尸跨过我们的防线。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Good thing we popped all those piñatas earlier!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}好消息是，我们早就敲完那些带有种子包的彩陶了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}The timbers be shivered! The seas are ablaze!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}木板瑟瑟发抖，大海怒目圆睁！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Your doom is assured! Your mind is a haze!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}你们的劫数早已板上钉钉！你们的思绪犹如雾里看花！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}The Zombot Plank Walker 2.0 shall soon rule the waves!
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}甲板踏行者僵尸机器人 2.0 必将统领波涛！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}We lived! Take that, planks and zombies and seaweed!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}我们成功存活下来了！接招吧，甲板、僵尸，还有海草！

original: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave, piracy is not a victimless crime.
translation: {SAY:winnie}的确如此，用户戴夫。海盗行为可不是没有受害者的犯罪。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}These upgraded plants are egregious and unfair!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}这些进阶植物太坏，太不公平了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}It's low tide and the waves are coming in.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}退潮了，可是惊涛骇浪般的僵尸要来了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Grab your water wings! We're going to get wet.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}抓好你的救生圈！我们要被淋湿了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}You've got a boat load of sun. Don't go overboard.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}你有一船的阳光。别浪费它们。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}Target score activated. Let's see if you can beat my high score.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}目标分数机制已激活。让我看看你能否够超越我的最高分。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And put in KRZYDV as your initials.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}然后请在最高分排行榜跳出时署名“じ☆ve 瘋狂戴鈇”。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Who cares? We have cannons and a score to beat.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}谁在乎呢？我们手头有大炮以及要挑战的记录。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Congratulations on beating my scores. I'm not bitter.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}恭喜达到我的记录。我一点也不难过。
{TIRED:winnie}我才没有说你开挂的意思……挂仔。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}好耶！真是其乐融融、皆大欢喜呢！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}黄油焖地刺，还有更好的搭配吗。

original: {PLAYFUL}That's what butter and spikes are made of.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}That's hard to argue or agree with.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And don't let those beans walk the plank.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}可千万别让那些豆子“走木板”啊。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}Those Spring Beans are living on the edge.

translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}危险两个字都写它们脸上了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}It is now clear that these beans are being stalked.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}真相大白，这些豆子被跟踪了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}I thought we were trying to get back home and get your taco.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}我曾想我们是否应该尝试回家去找你的玉米卷。

original: {SHOUT:crazydave}But Pirates! Hang on to your parrots and peg legs!
translation: {SHOUT:crazydave}但这可是海盗生活诶！珍藏好你的鹦鹉和假腿！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Be advised that your sailing vessel is of insufficient size.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}提个建议：你们的小帆船似乎不够大。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}I've discovered a mysterious trait in your rattletrap time machine.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}我刚才发现了你那破烂时间机器的秘密。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Its temporal signature is nearly identical to my own creations.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}她的“时间签名”与我其他造物的签名完全相同。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Explain to me, how was this "Penny" created in the first place?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}请你同我解释一下，这个“潘妮”当初是如何被制造出来的呢？

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Could I really be some form of Zombot?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}我真的是某种僵尸机器人吗？

original: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, am I the daughter of Dr. Zomboss?
translation: {TIRED:winnie}用户戴夫，难道我是僵王博士的造物吗？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}That was one fine sandwich! So, what did I miss?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}刚刚那块三明治太好吃了！你们之前在说什么？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Finally, one of these pirates dropped some booty!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}终于啊，有一位海盗掉落了点战利品！

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}I'm detecting something more challenging than treasure inside.
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}我在战利品里面探测到有比金银珠宝更具挑战性的东西。

original: {SAY:winnie}With it we can access another World.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我们可以用这个去拜访另一个世界了。

original: {TIRED:crazydave}Nuts. I was hoping it would make our boat bigger.
translation: {TIRED:crazydave}啊这。我还以为它能让我们的船变得更大一些呢。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}I'm ready to go. Pirates are great, but I think I'm getting homesick.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}我准备好了。海盗虽然很棒，但是我有点想家了。
{TIRED}我在说啥……我不是想家，是晕船，想吐了。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}No time for that. There's a taco to find!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}没时间了。玉米卷正等着我们呢！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}Please, tell me about your creation process.
{EXCITED:crazydave}It was pretty easy! I found some timey wabby wabbo stuff.
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}这超级简单的！我找到了一些充满时间的歪比巴卜的原料。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Then I put it between two slices of bread...
translation: {SAY:crazydave}然后把它们夹在两片面包之间…

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Such proliferous bunk. I should have expected as much.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}诸位的废话正随铺位的数量增加着。我早该预见到这样的！

original: {SAY:zombossicon}I'll have the answers someday, when David's brains are on my plate.
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}答案缭绕我心之日，便是你戴其脑为我盘中之食。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL11}Shiver me timbers. I've always wanted to do some swashbuckling!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL11}吓我一跳。我曾一直想如飞贼僵尸一般，做些持强凌弱的事情！

original: {PLAYFUL}And I've always wanted a poop deck of my own.
translation: {PLAYFUL}我还想拥有属于自己的艉楼甲板！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}Yes, let's go. I'd hate for him to improvise a poop deck here.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}好的，我们走吧。我讨厌他在这里临时拼凑出一块艉楼甲板。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}To treasure! It says no zombies. Maps don't lie!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}有宝藏！这上面说没有僵尸。地图可不会说谎！
{SHOUT:crazydaveicon}那就出发吧！没空做保护措施了！

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}That's it. That's all I had to say.
{SAY:sunflower_r}How's your mind, Wall-nut? Is it blown?
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}怎么样，坚果墙？有没有感觉世界观崩塌了？

original: {SAY:sunflower}I know that, silly. We've been friends for years!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}我知道，小傻瓜。我们已经当了好多年的朋友了！

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}A filthy liar said popanims could switch places./r
translation: {SAY:wallnut_r}一个大骗子说 PopAnim 动画可以换位置。/r

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}A.K.E.E lobs seeds that bounces from zombie to zombie.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}阿开木-木可以投掷能在僵尸间弹跳的子弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Aloe will heal neighboring plants and boost their health.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}芦荟可以治疗周围的植物，还能强化它们的生命值。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Apple Mortar lobs apple cores across multiple lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}苹果迫击炮可以在数行之间投掷苹果核。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Proper plant placement will be the key to victory.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}正确的植物布阵是胜利的关键。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Aqua Vine can support both ground and water plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}绿水藤蔓既能辅助陆生植物，也能辅助水生植物。

original: {SAY:winnie}Depending on the plant its host to, Aqua Vine will change its attack.
translation: {SAY:winnie}绿水藤蔓可以根据其寄生的植物，改变自己的攻击方式。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bamboo Spartan attacks multiple enemies in its lane and endures massive damage.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}斯笆达既可以攻击所在行的多名敌人，还能承受大量伤害。

original: {SAY:winnie}Once the shield is broken, its damage increases significantly.
translation: {SAY:winnie}护盾一旦破损，其伤害会大幅增加。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bean Sprout transforms into a zombie smashing monster when it takes damage.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}豆芽可以在受到伤害时变身成碎尸怪物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blast Spinner lobs webs that may turn zombies into cocoons.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆网织株可以投掷蛛网，有概率令僵尸结茧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cocoons will explode damaging all zombies nearby.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}茧可以爆炸，伤害周围的所有僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bloomerang can damage multiple zombies in its lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}回旋花可以对所在行的数只僵尸造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Boingsetta will destroys grid items and knock back zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}一品轰可以摧毁障碍物，击退僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bombegranate explodes when planted, leaving behind explosive seeds.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}炸弹石榴可以在种植后立即爆炸，随后留下可以爆炸的种子。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bonk Choy can attack zombies in front or behind it. Use this to your advantage.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}无论僵尸是前是后，拳击白菜都能攻击到。记得合理利用这一点。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}BoomBerry lauches explosive berries at the last zombie in its lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆炸莓果可以向所在行最后一只僵尸发射可以爆炸的莓果。

original: {SAY:winnie}Zombies hit, will be stunned for a short duration.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Boom Balloon Flower spawns draggable, exploding balloon mines!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆炸气球花可以通过拖拽施放可以爆炸的气球地雷！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bud'uh Boom explodes and flings butter around the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆浆玉露可以爆炸，随后将黄油抛往附近的草坪。

original: {SAY:winnie}Zombies walking over the butter are slowed down.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When eaten, Bzzz Button electrifies zombies, damaging them overtime.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电鸣金纽扣可以在被吃掉时让僵尸通电，对其造成持续伤害。

original: {SAY:winnie}Electrified zombies shoot Lighting at other nearby zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}通电的僵尸会向周围的其他僵尸发射弧光。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}卷心菜投手可以向敌人发射卷心菜子弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Caulipower can hynotize weak zombies, turning them into allies that fight for you.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能花菜可以催眠脆弱的僵尸，令其变为盟友，为你而战。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cherry Bombs can explode to blow up zombies in an area around them.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}樱桃炸弹可以爆炸，令其周围的僵尸灰飞烟灭。

original: {SAY:winnie}Due to their short fuse, it is adviced to place them near zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}他们的保险丝很短，所以建议将其放在僵尸靠近僵尸的地方。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chili Beans delivers gastrointestinal distress when eaten by a zombie.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}辣豆被吃掉后能让僵尸的肠道翻云覆雨。

original: {SAY:winnie}Zombies, behind the one who ate it, are stunned by the effect.
translation: {SAY:winnie}而食用者后方的僵尸则会受到眩晕效果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chilly Pepper can freeze or chill zombies across 3 lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒冰辣椒可以冻结或冷缓 3 行的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Coconut Cannon delivers explosive coconut blasts to obliterate zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}椰子加农炮可以发射爆炸椰子来消灭僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}Tap on it to fire off the shot, wait for it to recharge and repeat!
translation: {SAY:winnie}轻点它即可开炮，待其冷却，如此反复！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Using Plant Food launches a blast that pushes zombies and explodes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}施用植物养料，发射一枚可以推开僵尸，随后爆炸的炸弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chain grows in power the longer it’s on the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在草坪上的时间越长，雏菊束的能力越强。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Draftodil will eliminate flying and small zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}气流水仙可以消灭飞行僵尸或小体型的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dragon Bruit can launch projectiles across 3 lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吼龙果可以向 3 行发射子弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When Dragon Bruit is destroyed, it will spawn 3 Baby Bruit plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吼龙果被消灭后，可以生成 3 株玲龙果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dragon Bruit gains a damage boost when inside of a shadow aura.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吼龙果可以在暗影光环中获得伤害强化。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When eaten, Electrici-tea releases storm clouds that shocks all nearby zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电能茶可以在被吃掉时释放一朵暴风云，电击周围的所有僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peashooter can damage Zombies on both adjacent lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电力豌豆射手可以伤害两条相邻行上的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel is amphibious, i.e. it can be planted on land and water.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}鳗缠蕉流电是一株两栖植物，也就是说，它既可以种在陆地上，也能种在水里。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel is amphibious, gaining bonuses when planted in water.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}鳗缠蕉流电是一株两栖植物，种在水里可以获得增益。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}On water, Electric Peel's attack deal bonus damage and electrifies the tiles.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在水面上时，鳗缠蕉流电的攻击可以造成额外伤害，并让那块地砖通电。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}On water, Electric Peel's attack deal bonus damage and electrifies the tiles.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在水面上时，鳗缠蕉流电的攻击可以造成额外伤害，并让那块地砖通电。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel releases a giant super eel to deal massive damage to zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}鳗缠蕉流电可以释放一只巨型的超级电鳗，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Peel releases a giant super peel to deal massive damage to zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}鳗缠蕉流电可以释放一只巨型的“超级蕉流电鳗”，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Defeated Explode-O-Nuts will explode to deal damage to all nearby zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆炸坚果被击败后将会爆炸，对周围的所有僵尸造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Fire Peashooter can melt ice blocks. Use this ability to free frozen plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}火焰豌豆射手可以融化冰块。利用这项技能，解救被冰冻的植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Gold Bloom will instantly produce sun when planted.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}能量百合可以在种下时立即生产阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Grave Buster will eat a gravestone, quickly destroying them.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}墓碑吞噬者会吃掉一座墓碑，将其快速摧毁。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Guard-shroom will clone miniature copies of itself for defense.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}守卫菇可以创造出自身的迷你复制体来进行防守。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hot Date will attract zombies from adjacent lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}热辣海枣可以吸引相邻行的僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}When eaten, it will explode and damage all zombies in the lane.
translation: {SAY:winnie}被吃掉后，它便会爆炸，伤害所在行的所有僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hurrikale will both chill and push back zombie in its lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}飓风甘蓝既可以冷缓所在行的僵尸，还能将其往后推。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Ice Bloom can freeze all zombies on the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒冰蓓蕾可以冻结草坪上所有的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Ice-shroom’s frost aura can chill zombies and boost other Winter-mint plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒冰菇的寒霜光环可以冷缓僵尸，同时为其他寒薄家族植物提供强化。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Iceweed can destroy Push Zombies, like Piano,
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰刺草可以消灭如钢琴僵尸等向前推行的僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}and put out the flames of fire zombies, like the Explorer.
translation: {SAY:winnie}还可以熄灭如探险家僵尸等带火焰僵尸的火。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Jalapeno ignites its lane, obliterating all zombies caught within its flames.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}火爆辣椒可以点燃所在行，消灭所有陷入火海中的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and immobilizing butter at zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}玉米投手可以向僵尸投掷玉米粒和让它们定住的黄油。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lightning Reeds shoots lightning at the nearest zombie up to one lane away.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇可以向最近的僵尸发射闪电，上下两行也没问题。

original: {SAY:winnie}The lightning also chains to other nearby zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}发射的闪电还能与周围的其他僵尸产生连锁反应。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lightning Reed creates a storm cloud that attacks random zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}闪电芦苇可以创造一朵风暴云，对随机僵尸造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap Mangofier to switch between Spread and Focus fire modes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点聚光芒，在聚集与发散两种发射模式间进行切换。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}MayBee shoots bee-like projectile that damage and mini-stuns the target.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蜂临兰可以发射蜜蜂状的子弹，对目标造成伤害与轻微的眩晕效果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Melon-pult deals heavy damage to group of zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}西瓜投手可以对尸群造成大量伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Meteor Flower calls upon meteor strikes from above that leaves molten tiles.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}流星花可以从空中召唤流星坠，融化被砸中的格子。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗夜油桃的毒云可以对僵尸造成伤害…

original: {SAY:winnie}And significantly boosts shadow plants like Dusk Lobber.
translation: {SAY:winnie}还可以大幅强化如薄暮掷手等暗影植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Olive Pits sets traps that will gobble up incoming zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} 油橄榄坑可以设下陷阱，吞噬前来的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pea Pod can be placed in the same position upto 5 times.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}豌豆荚最多可以在同一个位置种植 5 次。

original: {SAY:winnie}Strategic distribution in different places will be key to victory.
translation: {SAY:winnie}因地制宜、策略布局是胜利的关键。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Peashooter fires pea projectiles, in it's lane, to damage the zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}豌豆射手可以向其所在行发射豌豆子弹，对僵尸造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Upgraded Peashooter has boosted damage and attack speed. Observe.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}升级后的豌豆射手，伤害和攻速均有强化。来看看效果吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Peashooter fires a barrage of fast peas.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到植物养料强化的豌豆射手可以发射一连串的高速豌豆。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Goo Peashooter shoots peas that both slows and damages zombies overtime.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}黏液豌豆射手发射的豌豆既可以令僵尸减速，也能对其造成持续伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pokra will deliver rapid piercing, zombie slowing attacks to multiple zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}戳刺秋葵可以向多只僵尸发出高速的穿刺攻击，并令其减速。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Potatomine will explode on contact, but require sometime to arm.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}土豆地雷会在接触时爆炸，但需要时间来进行武装。

original: {SAY:winnie}So, place them well in advance and ahead of Zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}所以，将其提早一些种在僵尸前方吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Lily will create a Plant Food when planted.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}能量百合可以在种下时创造一份植物养料。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Repeater shoot 2 pea-like projectiles at a time to damage the zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}双发豌豆可以一次发射 2 枚豌豆状的子弹，对僵尸造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sap-fling will create puddles of sap that will slow the incoming zombies waves.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}树脂投手可以创造一滩树脂，令来袭的尸潮减速。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Seaflora is an amphibious plant that fires piercing bubbles down its lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海英是一株两栖植物，可以向所在行发射具有穿刺效果的泡泡。

original: {SAY:winnie}On water, Seaflora fires bubbles across three lanes.
translation: {SAY:winnie}种植在水面上时，海英可以向三行发射泡泡。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sea-shroom will expire after a short period of time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海洋菇会在一小段时间后凋亡。

original: {SAY:winnie}Use plantfood to extend its lifetime and punish the zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}使用植物养料，延长它的寿命，同时把僵尸打得落花流水。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sea-shroom will expire after a short period of time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海洋菇会在一小段时间后凋亡。

original: {SAY:winnie}Use Plant Food to extend its lifetime and punish the zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}使用植物养料，延长它的寿命，同时把僵尸打得落花流水。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shadow Peashooter hides in it's shadow to trap zombies, when they get too close.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗影豌豆射手可以在僵尸靠得太近时遁入自己的阴影中，捉住僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Caution! Shadow Peashooter cannot trap flying zombies though.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}不过小心！暗影豌豆射手无法捉住飞行僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shadow Peashooter gets boosted when inside a shadow aura.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在暗影光环中，暗影豌豆射手可以获得强化。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到植物养料强化的暗影豌豆射手会向僵尸发射…

original: {SAY:winnie}...a massive enegry bomb towards the zombies. Try it out.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sling Pea will lob peas at multiple zombies across all lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}投掷豌豆可以向所有行的数只僵尸投掷豌豆。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Snapdragon will warm nearby plants, freeing them from frozen ice.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}火龙草会温暖周围的植物，将其从寒冷的冰中解救出来。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spikerock destroy multiple rolling zombies that walk over it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}地刺石可以多次消灭轧过去的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Split Pea shoot peas forward and backwards.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}裂荚豌豆可以向前后发射豌豆。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spring Beans bounce back zombies that get too close.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}弹簧豆可以将靠近的僵尸向后弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sunflower generate extra sun over a small interval of time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}向日葵每隔一小段时间就能生成额外的阳光。

original: {SAY:winnie}Be sure to plant plenty to avoid running out.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Sunflower produces a large amount of sun.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到植物养料强化的向日葵可以生产大量阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tall-nut are heavy duty walls and blocks low flying enemies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}高坚果是一面重型墙壁，可以阻挡低空飞行的敌人。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Teleportato Mine teleports several zombies before exploding.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}传送土豆地雷可以在爆炸前传送若干只僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Threepeater shoots pea projectiles in three lanes to damage the zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}三线豌豆可以向三行发射豌豆子弹攻击僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tomb Tangler engulfs a tomb and releases a fog that slows down zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}坟墓缠绕者可以吞没一座坟墓，随后释放出一阵可以减速僵尸的气体。

original: {SAY:winnie}Occasionally, Tomb Tangler will pull zombies into the ground.
translation: {SAY:winnie}坟墓缠绕者偶尔还能把僵尸拖入地底。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Torchwood will light peas on fire, boosting their damage.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}火炬树桩可以点燃豌豆，强化其伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Twin Sunflower generates twice as many sun as a normal Sunflower.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}双子向日葵生成的阳光是普通向日葵的两倍。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Wallnut's hard shell makes it an effective defense against zombie attacks.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}坚果墙的硬壳是抵御僵尸攻击的利器。

original: {SAY:winnie}Plant them infront of other plants to protect them.
translation: {SAY:winnie}将其种在其他植物的前面，保护它们。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Wallnut heals itself and gains a hard armor shell.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到植物养料强化的坚果墙可以治疗自己，随后获得一副坚硬的盔甲外壳。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bun Chi chains 5 quick strikes to gain up to 5 Chi Stacks.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}兔极每轮可以快速连续攻击 5 次，增加“真气”堆叠数，最多 5 层。

original: {SAY:winnie}Tap on it, when you see a glowing flower, to release a massive Thunder Clap Attack.
translation: {SAY:winnie}看到一朵发光的花朵时，轻点它，即可释放强力的“霹雳擂击”。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zoybean Pod will spawn Zomboids that will attack nearby zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}腐尸豆荚会生成可以攻击周围僵尸的拟尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}User Dave, online banking servers are unresponsive.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}用户戴夫，网银服务器无响应。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}Hear that? We're rich! Let's use unlimited FREE Powerups!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}听到了吗？我们发财了！随心使用免费的金手指吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}Use unlimited FREE Powerups to help those plants!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}无限使用免费的金手指，帮助那些植物吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}You have some Power Ups! I'll show you how to use them.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED}你得到了一些金手指！我来教你怎么用它们吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}Yeah, and now we can break the seal. Let's get crazy!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SPECIAL6:crazydave}耶，现在我们可以启封金手指罐头了。一起疯狂吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}You can try out your Power Ups for free here!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}你可以在这里尽情试用免费的金手指！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Power Vines to fire laser bolts, or more if they're in a network.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植电力藤蔓，发射激光束。种植多个构成电网，更能造成额外伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Primal Potato Mines to create powerful area-of-effect explosions.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植原始土豆地雷，制造强大的范围性爆炸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food on a Power Tile applies Plant Food to all tiles of that color.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}往能量地砖上施放植物养料，同色地砖都能获得植物养料效果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Puffballs to stun and poison zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植马勃，眩晕三排僵尸，并使他们中毒。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Plant Pumpkins on other plants for a tough protective shell!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} 给其他植物套上南瓜来为他们增加一个坚韧的护盾！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Max level Pea Vines have high damage upgrade.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}最高等级的豌豆藤蔓有大幅的伤害升级。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Pea Vine on Appease-mint Family plants to boost their damage.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在喷薄家族植物上种植豌豆藤蔓，强化它们的伤害！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Vines are special plants that can be planted on top of other plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}藤蔓是一类可以种在其他植物上面的特殊植物。

original: {SAY:winnie}Pyre Vines will warm adjacent plants and provide a fiery short range offensive boost!
translation: {SAY:winnie}葬火藤蔓会温暖周围的植物，并喷射火焰，强化近身攻击力！

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What’s that, Travel Log? You provide guidance, progress and rewards?
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}旅行木标，你的作用是啥？你能给予我指导和奖励吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}The Log is not, in fact, speaking, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}其实，木标不会说话，用户戴夫。
{SAY:crazydave}谢了，旅行木标！我会照你说的做的！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Visit the Travel Log to claim your quest reward.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}拜访旅行木标，领取你的任务奖励。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Sorry I'm late, what did I miss? A mint pun?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}啊！抱歉，我来晚了。我错过了什么？你们刚刚是在聊薄荷糖之类的吗？

original: {SAY:crazydave_r}What is that buzzing sound in my ear?
{SAY:winnie_l}My sensors indicate that there are bees in our proximity.
translation: {SAY:winnie_l}我的传感器表明我们附近有蜜蜂。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha! Ha! Ha! Today is the day that Dave will PAY!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈！哈！哈！今天，我一定要让戴夫付出代价！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}I sure hope Dave’s tacos are bean-free.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}我真心希望戴夫的玉米卷里没有豆子。
{SAY:wallnut}被压扁，被吃掉。这一切又有什么意义呢？

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}Come on Wall-nut. Spring is in the air!
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}哎，坚果墙。看看周围，春意盎然啊！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:peashooter}Something tells me the sun isn’t going anywhere for a while.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:peashooter}听消息说，太阳一时半会儿是不会消失了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:iceburg_r}Keep me faaar away from those whips, thanks!
{SAY:peashooter}That was some battle! I think I broke a sweat!
translation: {SAY:peashooter}真是场跌宕起伏的恶战啊！我都感觉冒汗了！

original: {SAY:iceburg_r}Sweating isn’t good for my surface area.
translation: {SAY:iceburg_r}我要是流汗，那我的表面积就要变小了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:winnie_l}Existence of pollen detected in circuitry. Navigation systems malfunctioning.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:winnie_l}探测到电路中存在花粉。导航系统出现故障。

original: {SAY:winnie_l}User Dave, Please replace my filter so I may recalibrate for the next adventure.
translation: {SAY:winnie_l}用户戴夫，请更换我的滤网，这样我才能重新为下次冒险校准。

original: {SAY:crazydave_r}Where did I put the dang ol’ filter doohickey?
translation: {SAY:crazydave_r}我把那滤网啥的玩意儿放哪儿去了来着？

original: {SAY:crazydave_r}I know! I’ll check the doohickey drawer!!
translation: {SAY:crazydave_r}我知道了！我去看看我的“啥的玩意儿”抽屉！

original: {SAY:zomboss}You may have won User Dave but that’s only because of my allergies!!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}算你赢了吧，用户戴夫。但那只是因为我过敏了!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{EXCITED:crazydave_r}Penny, look!  I’m on the right side of the screen!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Rhubarbarian to pummel, stun and punch attacking zombies off the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植野蛮大黄，连续击打、眩晕僵尸，并把攻击他的僵尸击出那行。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave. Penny Tech upgrade complete. I now have new gadgetry, including a Zomboss Positioning System, or ZPS.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}用户戴夫，潘妮升级完成。我现在有了新的设备，包括僵王定位系统，或简称 ZPS。

original: {SAY:winnieicon}Picking up signal... User Dave, I fear... User Dave?
translation: {SAY:winnieicon}正在接收信号……用户戴夫，我有些害怕……用户戴夫？

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydaveicon}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Silence, you nutritional ninny! Remove your shaggy paws from my hyper-radio this insta-...(click)
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydaveicon}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}闭嘴，你这个笨蛋！把你那毛茸茸的爪子从我的超级收音机上拿开……（咔哒）

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnieicon}Oh, dear. Dr. Zomboss has abducted User Dave. I must charge my new fuel cells and pursue with haste into the rift!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnieicon}哦，天啊。僵王博士抓走了用户戴夫。我必须填充我的新燃料快点追到裂缝里去！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}Sensors indicate we have returned to ancient Rome and to The Zombosseum.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}我的传感器表明，我们回到了古罗马和僵王斗兽场。

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We are here to stop you Zomboss.

translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}那得看你们的本事了……小的们！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}You don’t want to make it angry though.

translation: {SAY:sunflower}它应该会喜欢植物养料的吧。
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave} {SAY:crazydave}现在是不是该去参观一下当地的景点呢？
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}否，用户戴夫。僵尸大军正在接近。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}A little more and it’ll be complete!

translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}等会儿你就知道了……木哈哈哈！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You’re too late.. Behold, you fools. My GREATEST invention!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们来晚了……看清楚了，你们这群傻瓜。我最伟大的发明！
{SHOUT:zomboss_r}悍架华轩僵尸机器人!!! <呜嗡嗡嗡嗡>

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}It will CRUSH you this time and there will be no survivors!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}这次，它会把你们统统踩在脚下，不留活口！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}I still have 200 payments left on the loan!
{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}When evil doers arise, we are here to save the day!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}当恶人出现，就让我们来拯救世界！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}This isn’t the end. I’ve got more inventions in store for you.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}还没结束呢。我给你们留了很多发明。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}What! How did you get pass all my minions?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}什么！你们怎么打败我的随从的？

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Your minions are no match for us!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你的虾兵蟹将根本不配与我们一战！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Arrg!! I just need a bit more time for some final adjustments.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}恶额!! 我还需要一点时间来最后调整一下。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}This isn’t the end. Our next encounter will be your last!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}还没结束呢。下次对阵，我将成为你们合眼前最后看到的人！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}When evil doers arise, we are here to save the day!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}当黑恶崛起，就让我们来拯救世界！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Welcome, foolish mortals, to my grand creation...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}欢迎，愚蠢的凡人，欢迎来到我的杰作…

original: {SAY:zomboss}Prepare to descent into the depths of terror.
translation: {SAY:zomboss}准备好溺于这恐惧的深渊吧。
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}你的黑暗遮蔽不了我们的决心。

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}We'll shine through even in the deepest depths!
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}哪怕再深的深渊，我们也能照射出万丈光芒！

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Looks like you redecorated, good for you but you are going down.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}你好像重新装修了一下嘛，真为你感到高兴。不过可惜了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Blast it all! How could this be? My plans foiled by mere plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}真服了！怎么可能？我的计划被区区植物阻止了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}You know Zomboss, you underestimate us a lot.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}其实僵王，你有点太低估我们了。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zombies have been successfully defeated. Well done plants.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}已顺利击败僵尸。好样的，各位植物。

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}Enjoy your temporary victory, but beware the flood that's nigh.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{SAY:zomboss}你们就在眼前的胜利中沉醉吧。不久，我会让你们在洪灾中沉沦。

original: {SAY:zomboss}For when I return, your garden's fate will be high and dry.
translation: {SAY:zomboss}而待我归来之时，你们花园的命运将如旱灾般干枯。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave. It appears we have traveled to Ancient Rome.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫。我们似乎旅行到了古罗马。

original: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss is up to his nefarious schemes again.
translation: {SAY:winnie}僵王又在实施他的邪恶计划了。

original: {SAY:winnie}He’s assembled a horde of new zombie threats.
translation: {SAY:winnie}他集结了一帮前所未有的僵尸大军。

original: {SAY:sunflower}Our new friend to the lawn is quite capable.
translation: {SAY:sunflower}我们的新朋友好像蛮厉害的嘛。
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}把你那令人发指的花花草草扔到一边儿去！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Next time my legions will crush you and your brainz will be ours!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}下次，我的军团必将把你们踩在脚下，而手上，则会握着你们那鲜活的脑子！
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}击败僵尸来提升分数倍增器的数值。

original: {SAY:winnie}The multiplier drops if you go too long without defeating a zombie.
translation: {SAY:winnie}如果你太久没有击败任一僵尸，倍增器的分数加成效果会减弱。

original: {SAY:winnie}The multiplier also drops when zombies destroy plants.
translation: {SAY:winnie}分数倍增器也会在僵尸毁坏植物时降级。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shine Vines amplify the sun production of sun producer plants they're planted on.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}闪耀藤蔓可以增强种植在它上面的阳光生产植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Solar Sage illuminates zombies, who then drop sun as they leave the board.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}圣光鼠尾草能让僵尸开悟，受开悟的僵尸会离开场地，并在过程中掉落阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Solar Tomato stuns zombies in a 3x3 area, with each stunned zombie giving 50 sun.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}阳光番茄能够令 3x3 范围内的僵尸眩晕，同时使他们各产生 50 阳光。

original: {SAY:winnie}Use it to stun large crowds of zombies!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena mode.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以在竞技场模式获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Spear-mint family is made up of piercing plants.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my sensors incidcate that spring has begun.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我的传感器表明春天开始了。

original: {SHOUT:crazydave}Already?! No wonder I was seeing bunnies all around the lawn.
translation: {SHOUT:crazydave}这么快吗?! 难怪草坪上到处都是兔子。

original: {SAY:winnie}Look closely User Dave, they are not normal bunnies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}看清楚了用户戴夫，它们可不是普通兔子。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Wait a minute, why aren't the cute bunnies hopping like normal?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}等等，这些可爱的兔子怎么不像平常一样跳来跳去呢？
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}木哈哈……你们就要完蛋了，彩蛋的蛋！

original: {SAY:peashooter}Yolks on you, we will shell out all your plans.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}“壳”别高兴太早，无论什么计划，我们都会给你搅“黄”。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Only if I hadn't slipped on this butter, my plans would've been sunny side up.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}要不是我不小心踩到黄油滑倒了，我的计划肯定前途大好。

original: {SAY:zomboss}Who told you to take off the costume? We still have much to do.
translation: {SAY:zomboss}谁叫你脱掉兔子装扮的？计划还早着呢。

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}I had a nightmare that I was an egg and flying zombies tried to hatch me.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我做了个噩梦，我梦见自己是颗蛋，会飞的僵尸想孵我。

original: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}You had to open up about your nightmare hadn't you? Look up.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}凭你这嘴，梦里肯定是乌鸦蛋吧？看天上。
{SHOUT:wallnut}不，别啊别……别…别…别…不不不不不不！

original: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}Woah Draftodil's air cannons are as loud as they are powerful.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}哇，气流水仙的空气炮，声音和它的威力一样大。

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SHOUT:wallnut_r}Ohhhh yeeaahh! That's some air conditioning man!
{SAY:iceburg}Why are you shouting I am right in front of you?
translation: {SAY:iceburg}我就在你面前，你吼那么大声干什么？

original: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}Sorry, I can't hear you with all the sound of me enjoying this breeze.
translation: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}对不起，声音太大、微风太爽，我听不到你说话。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we may have a better soultion to our 'Hare' infestation.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我们也许有更好的办法来解决“野兔滥衍”的问题了。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Already working on it, presenting carrot traps.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}已经在处理了，我正在安置胡萝卜陷阱。

original: {SAY:winnie}*Sigh* No User Dave, allow me to show you.
translation: {SAY:winnie}*叹气* 不是，用户戴夫，请允许我向你展示一下吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Dandelion sure helped out in the spring cleaning here.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}蒲公英为春季大扫除帮了不少忙啊。

original: {SAY:winnie_l}After all, bunnies are afraid of lions.
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}Let me clean out these tacos real quick.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave_r}{SAY:crazydave_r}我来扫除那些玉米卷吧，很快的。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Dazey Chain's gas made me choke. Only if I could recover in time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}迷乱雏菊束的气呛死我了。气都喘不过来。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}You may want to recover from this flop first.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}建议你这次失败后喘口气消停一阵子。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Well done plants, navigating to the next adventure.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}各位植物，干得好，正在前往下一场冒险。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}It appears to be some sort of gate... of stars.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}这看上去是某种带着星星的……大门。

original: {SAY:winnieicon}The map shows you where new Stars can be earned!
translation: {SAY:winnieicon}地图显示了何处可获取更多星星！

original: {SAY:winnieicon}By earning enough Stars we can unlock the gate…
translation: {SAY:winnieicon}获取足够多的星星，我们就可以解锁这扇大门…
{EXCITED:winnieicon}然后我们就可以去另外一个时间旅行了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Stickybomb Rice to lob sticky rice bombs.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植黏弹糯米，投掷糯米黏弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}Take these gems and buy some coins!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}收下这些宝石来买些硬币吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}The Ancient Egypt piñata might have what we're looking for. Take these gems and buy one!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}这个上古埃及彩陶应该正好有我们想要找的东西！收下这些宝石去买一个吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}Nice work! Hey Penny, what does this button do?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}干得漂亮！对了，潘妮！这个按钮有什么用呢？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED}Most interesting, there's special items in there!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED}最有意思的是，里面还有许多特殊物品！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}Wowsers! That's node's got a skull on it! What could it mean?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}嚯！那个结点上有个骷髅头！是什么意思呢？

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}I want to make Iceberg Lettuce freeze fire more better-er, Penny!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}我想让冰山生菜更、更、更会熄火，潘妮！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}We can find seed packets in piñatas in the Store.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}我们能在商店中找到含有种子包的彩陶。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap Strawburst to fire an exploding projectile.
{SAY:winnie}Strawburst's berry grows over time, dealing more damage.
translation: {SAY:winnie}爆裂草莓的果实炸弹会随着时间的推移长大，造成更多伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Stunions will breathe a cloud of stunning gas on nearby zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}眩晕洋葱可以呼出晕眩气体来让前面一堆僵尸眩晕。
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:sunflower}夏天到了，坚果墙！以后再也不用上学了！

original: {SAY:sunflower}No more school? That way lies MADNESS!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}不去上学？那就只有“疯”路一条了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}Hey-oh, Sunny! I hear zombie-fightin' school is out for summer.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:crazydave}你好哇，小葵！听说你们打僵尸学校放暑假啦？

original: {SAY:crazydave}Wanna open a new taco truck with me?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}想和我开一辆新的美食车吗？

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Sunflower! Have you not heard? Summer is slack time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}向日葵！你不知道吗？暑假就是该休息嘛。

original: {SAY:zombossicon}Why toil so hard powering an entire infantry? Why not take a break?
translation: {SAY:zombossicon}何苦在这里为战场提供能源呢？休息一下吧？

original: {SAY:sunflower}You've given me a lot to consider, Mr. Zomboss.
translation: {SAY:sunflower}你让我思考了很多，僵王先生。
{SAY:sunflower}主要是在想你说的话有多么可笑！

original: {SAY:winnie}Correct. How are you enjoying Summer Nights, Wall-nut?
translation: {SAY:winnie}是的。仲夏夜过得开心吗，坚果墙？

original: {SAY:sunflower}So much free time! I don't know what to do!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}还有这么多空闲时间！我都不知道玩什么了！

original: {SAY:sunflower}All I know for sure is I don't want to open a taco truck!
translation: {SAY:sunflower}不过我唯一知道的就是我不想开美食车！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}Penny, of all the people and things I know, you're the wisest!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:sunflower}潘妮，你是我认识的所有人和物中最聪明的那个！

original: {SAY:sunflower}How should I fill my free time?
translation: {SAY:sunflower}你能告诉我——我这么多的空余时间该怎么用吗？

original: {SAY:winnie}With what you love, of course. Always.
translation: {SAY:winnie}当然是去做你喜欢的事情了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:sunflower}... and then I realized my favorite way to spend time is DEFEATING ZOMBIES!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:sunflower}...随后我才意识到，我最喜欢做的事情就是击败僵尸！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my GPS indicates we are in the desert.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我的 GPS 表明，我们现在正处于沙漠中。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Uh oh! This desert is so HOT! Did we bring water?!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}啊哦！沙漠好热啊！我们有带水吗?!

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Sensors indicate water tank is dangerously low. Locating water sources.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}我的传感器表明水箱水位过低，十分危险。正在寻找水源。

original: {SAY:crazydave}While you’re at it could you locate my taco?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}反正你都在找了，能顺便帮我看看玉米卷在哪儿吗？

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}The existence of salty water can only mean one thing... A body of sweet water!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}咸水的存在只可能能意味着一件事……有淡水源！

original: {SAY:winnie}My sensors cannot differentiate between salt and sweet water.
translation: {SAY:winnie}我的传感器无法区别咸水和淡水。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}哇，那些海盗看起来很渴呃呃呃啊。
{SAY:winnie}探测到模仿口音的双关。哈。哈。哈

original: {SAY:crazydave} I don’t remember installing the pun detector... or how we ended up at the beach!
translation: {SAY:crazydave} 我怎么不记得有安装双关探测器……也不记得我们是怎么跑到海滩上来的了！

original: {SAY:zomboss} Nooo! The beach zombies were my crowning achievement.
translation: {SAY:zomboss} 不！海滩僵尸是我最大的成就。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I’m receiving a transmission. It’s an invitation to a party!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，我收到一条传输信息。是一则派对邀请！

original: {SAY:crazydave}PARTY?! Why didnt you say so sooner? I wonder what there is to eat...
translation: {SAY:crazydave}派对?! 你怎么不早说？不知道那儿有什么好吃的…

original: {SAY:winnie}Setting a course for the party destination. Standby.
translation: {SAY:winnie}正在设置前往派对目的地的路线。待机中。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Based on my calculations this summer party was a success.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}根据我的计算，这场夏日派对很成功。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Based on my observations, I'd say there was no taco.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}根据我的观察，我想说根本没有炸玉米卷。
{SAY:winnie}正在为下一次冒险重新校准！

original: {SAY:sunflower}At this rate I’m going to wilt.
{NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Muhahaha! You Fools. This weather opens up the perfect opportunity.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈哈！你们这群傻瓜。这样的天气，犹如上帝为我开的一扇窗。
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我诅咒你们这帮植物。你们给我记住了。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}I’ll be back and next time.. My inventions will... Muwahahaha!.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}我一定会回来的…我的发明会…木哇哈哈哈！
{SAY:peashooter}没错坚果墙。僵王博士，也不在话下！

original: {SAY:peashooter}I would call that a good Summer Nights work.
{SAY:wallnut}I don't know about the new event!

translation: {SAY:wallnut}那个叫“生日庆典限时活动“的活动！

original: {SAY:wallnut}The one that just started and goes for 15 days!
translation: {SAY:wallnut}那个刚刚开始，15 天后就结束的活动！

original: {SAY:wallnut}With all the cool prizes and rewards!
translation: {SAY:wallnut}那个可以赢取超酷奖品和奖励的活动！

original: this is a test string bah
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Tiger Grass to spawn aggressive grass tigers.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植虎草，召唤草虎攻击僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:peashooter}Finally we've made it to this newly discovered tomb.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:peashooter}终于赶到这块新发掘到的坟墓了。

original: {SAY:wallnut_r}I wonder what treasures we will find in there?
translation: {SAY:wallnut_r}不知道我们能在里面找到什么宝藏？

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You fools again! This treasure is Mine! You lot can go home!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}又是你们这群傻瓜！宝藏是我的！尔辈回自己家去吧！

original: {SHOUT:peashooter}We can't let zomboss beat us to the treasure. Let's go!!
translation: {SHOUT:peashooter}不能让僵王先于我们找到宝藏！出发吧!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Give it up Zomboss, we won't let you get the treasure.
