translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}放弃吧僵王，我们是不会让你拿到宝藏的。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Mmmm.. Is that a taco that I smell?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}嗯…我是不是闻到玉米卷的味道了？

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Muhahaha! Well! We will see who will have the last laugh next time!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈哈！行啊！下次，看谁笑到最后！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}The sun is shining! Zomboss must be up to his nefarious tricks again.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}真是艳阳高照啊！僵王博士肯定又在琢磨他的小把戏了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Analysis shows that the lawn has been filled with gravestones.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}分析表明，现在草坪上布满了墓碑。

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}I'm Tomb Tangler. Tangles if you're friendly. I hear you have a gravestone problem.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}我是坟墓缠绕者。只要你是好人，我就不会缠着你。听说这些墓碑让你们很头疼。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler_r}{SAY:sunflower}Tomb Tangler! We couldn't have done it without you!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler_r}{SAY:sunflower}坟墓缠绕者！没有你，我们可怎么办呀！
{SAY:tombtangler_r}谢谢你的“缠”美，向日葵。没事儿的。

original: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}Why are there so many gravestones? It's making my tummy rumble!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}怎么这么多墓碑呀？整得我肚子都咕咕叫了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}How are you beating my ghastly gravestone ground gamble?!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们是怎么破解我那精心设计、不寒而栗、尸居余气的墓碑诡计的?!

original: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Time to turn up the terrible tactics!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}是时候拿出那个可怕的战术了！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}We got this team! I’ll tangle the gravestones!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:tombtangler}{SAY:tombtangler}没事儿的，队友们！我去缠住那些墓碑！

original: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{SAY:chilibean}Chili Bean: I don’t feel so good.
{NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:chilibean}Are we done yet? Did we win?
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You plants are always up to something!
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}My villain support group said this would work!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}我的邪恶支持小组说这个办法肯定没问题！
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:sunflower}你们才不是缠绕小分队的对手！
{SAY:chilibean_r}行吧，冰山生菜也帮了一些忙。
{NPC_EXIT:tombtangler}{NPC_EXIT:chilibean_r}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}你们……还有你们的脑子，都将属于我！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Tumbleweeds anywhere to send them rolling down the lane at zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在任意位置种下风滚草，让他们沿着草坪滚向僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Turkey-pults to lob tofu turkeys at zombies. Plant 2 or more per row to overwhelm zombies!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种植火鸡投手，向僵尸投掷豆腐火鸡。种植 2 个以上，更能把它们压倒在鸡潮里！
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}看啊！一株豌豆射手与一株双发豌豆！

original: {SAY:crazydave}I sure hope no Buckethead Zombie attacks that poor lil' Peashooter!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我真希望没有铁桶头僵尸会去攻击那株可怜的豌豆射手！
{SAY:winnie}这株豌豆射手已经到达了最高等级。

original: {SAY:winnie}At its current level, it is even stronger than a regular Repeater.
translation: {SAY:winnie}在这个等级下，它比普通等级的双发豌豆还厉害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Ultomatos on top of themselves to mutate them up from green to yellow to red!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}把终极番茄种在自己身上，让它们从绿到黄，再从黄到红！
{SAY:winnieicon}他会为你带来引导、奖励与更多的可能性！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Penny! The Pirate Key went all flooey! Where are we?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}潘妮！海盗钥匙太疯狂了！我们在哪里？

original: {SAY:winnieicon}We are outside of time. Between Ancient Egypt and the Pirate Seas.
translation: {SAY:winnieicon}我们处于现有时间之外，在上古埃及与海盗港湾之间。
{SAY:crazydaveicon}但是怎么才能找到那个一定有玉米卷的地方？

original: {SAY:winnieicon}We must brave the Pirate Seas, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnieicon}我们必须勇敢面对海盗港湾，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:crazydaveicon}I'll brave ANYTHING for taco treasure! Let's go!
translation: {SAY:crazydaveicon}为了我那宝贵的玉米卷，我愿勇敢面对一切！出发吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}A lawn of vases is like a box of chocolates.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}草地上的一只只花瓶如同一盒盒巧克力。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Some are awesome! Others taste downright ugly!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}有些好吃至极，但有些则让人反胃！

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}But all vases are much harder on your teeth!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}当然啦，你可别真的用牙啃那些花瓶！

original: {SAY:winnie}Be careful with how fast you break vases.
translation: {SAY:winnie}注意自己在敲花瓶时的速度。

original: {EXCITED:winnie}You might end up with more ugly than you can handle.
translation: {EXCITED:winnie}敲得太快，可能让你最后难以收场。

original: {SAY:winnie}It is not necessary to shout, User Dave.
translation: {SAY:winnie}没有必要大喊大叫的，用户戴夫。

original: {SAY:crazydave}Should we mention these post-Zomboss nodes are REALLY difficult?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我们是否应该提一下，后面的僵王关卡会极其困难？

original: {SAY:crazydave}And that it would be CRAAAA-ZY to try them without leveled-up plants?
translation: {SAY:crazydave}并且，没有高等级的植物就去挑战后面的关卡难道不是疯了吗？
{SAY:winnie}当然应该。实际上，你已经那么做了。
{SAY:crazydave}这些关卡困难程度到了令人疯癫的地步！

original: {SAY:crazydave}YOU SHOULD GET SOME PLANTS UP TO AT LEAST LEVEL 5 TO BEAT THEM!!!
translation: {SAY:crazydave}你应该把一些植物至少升到 5 级再来挑战它们!!!
{SAY:crazydave}说真的，请先去探索一下其他世界！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon will chill zombies on impact.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰瓜可以冷缓被砸到的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon attacks will spill over, damaging and chilling adjacent enemies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰瓜的攻击可以向周围溅射，对周遭的所有敌人造成伤害和冷缓效果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon PF Bombards all zombies with frozen melons.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}为冰瓜投手施用植物养料，向所有僵尸轰炸冰冻西瓜。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie} Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire through Arena.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}超能薄荷是一类强大的植物，你可以通过竞技场获得它们。

original: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它们可以对其家族的植物提供巨大增益。

original: {SAY:winnie}The Winter-mint family comprises chilling and freezing plants.
{NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{PLAYFUL}My Penny sense has detected a rare and curious lunch box.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{PLAYFUL}我的潘妮感受器探测到一只新奇稀有的午餐盒。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}I smell a Yeti! Let's go after him!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}我闻到了雪人的味道！走，去追他！
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}看清楚了！更新、更好的 Z 公司。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}I predict an upsurge in Brainz gainz with our synergistic solutions!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}我预测，我们的协同办公解决方案，会让脑子的收益稳步提升！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}I am creating a paradigm shift in the brainz supply chain you fools!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}我在为我们的脑子供应链进行典范转移，你们这群傻瓜！

original: {SAY:peashooter}That still doesn't sound like a good thing for us, Zomboss.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}好像对我们而言依然不是什么好消息，僵王。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}We're satisfied with the current paradigm of not being zombie food.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}我们对目前还没有进僵尸肚子的“典范”很满意。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Resistance is futile. ZCorp is the wave of the future!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}放弃抵抗吧。Z 公司是未来的汹汹之潮！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Oh no, my laptop's busted! This is terrible.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}糟糕，我的笔记本坏了！真倒霉。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}A ZCorp HelpDesk technician will be right over... to remove your brainz...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}正在派发一名 Z 公司技术支持专员……来取走您的脑子…

original: {SAY:peashooter}Uh, no thanks Zomboss, I can live without Wallnut memes for a day.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}啊，不用了僵王，你一天不讲坚果墙笑话我也死不了，谢谢。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Nonsense! We will set you up with one of our brand new Explosive Models!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}胡说！让我们来给您安排一款全新的可以爆炸的机型吧！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}It's the most cutting-edge technology.. it will blow your leaves out!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}那可是用最尖端的技术打造的……您要是亲眼看见，估计得把您的叶子都吓掉！
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}我们已经把它们缩小到看不见了！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}ZCorp is still a force to be reckoned with, even without my legal council!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}即使没有我的法务委员会，Z 公司依然是一股不可忽视的力量！

original: {SAY:sunflower}Oh yeah? What do you have, besides a losing lawsuit and a bad attitude?
translation: {SAY:sunflower}是吗？除了败诉案例和坏脾气，你们还有什么？

original: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}ZCORP DOES NOT HAVE TO ANSWER TO THE LIKES OF YOU!!
translation: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}Z 公司不必回应像你们这样的人!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Ha! So much for this hostile zombie takeover!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}哈！看来僵尸的这次恶意收购就到此为止了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}I can't believe we actually pulled it off. We were so close to being zombie chow.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}我都不敢相信我们真的成功了。我们差一点就变成僵尸的盘中餐了。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Yes, Wallnut! We won! We defeated ZCorp and put Zomboss out of business.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}没错，坚果墙！我们赢了！我们击败了 Z 公司，让僵王的生意泡汤了。

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Just you wait! I'll be back with a leaner, meaner, and more efficient ZCorp!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}等着吧！我会带着一个更精简、更阴险，还更有效率的 Z 公司卷土重来的！

original: {SAY:peashooter}You always were a terrible businessman Zomboss, and now you are all out of Brainz!
translation: {SAY:peashooter}你什么时候把生意做好过啊僵王，而且你现在脑子也用光了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Your Sunflower will grow up too, but it takes awhile.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}你的向日葵同样会长大，但需要一段时间。

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Try some more Gems to speed her up!
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}试试用更多的宝石加速她们的成长吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}Zen Garden isn't just for growing Marigolds.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}禅境花园可不只能种金盏花。

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}You can also grow mega powerful boosted plants!
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}你也可以种更多强大的植物使其获得强化！

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}But boosted plants only last for a single level!
translation: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}但是强化效果仅能维持一关！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}If you wait a while, your Marigold will grow.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}如果你等待一段时间，你的金盏花就会逐渐长大。

original: {PLAYFUL:winnie}But you can speed up the process with Gems!
translation: {PLAYFUL:winnie}但是你能用宝石来加速这个过程！

original: {EXCITED:crazydave}Maybe if you water it, you'll get coins?
translation: {EXCITED:crazydave}如果你耐心给它浇水的话，说不定可以收获一些硬币呢？

original: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}At least, I think that's how it works.
{FEATURE} requires an internet connection! Please connect to the internet and select "Retry" or "Exit" to leave {FEATURE}.
translation: {FEATURE}需要互联网连接！请在重新连接到互联网后选择“重试”或选择“退出”离开{FEATURE}。

original: We could not verify your cloud connection. Please check that you are signed into Google Play Game Services to protect progress and preserve progress across devices.
translation: 我们无法验证你的云端连接。请检查你是否登入了 Google Play 游戏服务，以保护进度并在不同设备上维护进度。

original: We could not verify your cloud connection. Please check that you are signed into iCloud to protect progress and preserve progress across devices.
translation: 我们无法验证你的云端连接。请检查你是否登入了 iCloud，以保护进度并在不同设备上维护进度。

original: We were unable to connect to the server.  Please try again sometime later.
translation: 无法连接服务器。请稍后再来试试。

original: Sorry, it looks like there's a network data issue. Arg! Click to exit Arena.
translation: 抱歉，似乎有一些网络数据问题。呃！点击退出竞技场。

original: An internet connection is required to play Arena. Please connect to the internet and "Retry" to try again, or "Exit" to leave Arena.
translation: 游玩竞技场需要互联网连接。请在连接到互联网后选择“重试”以再次尝试，或选择“退出”离开竞技场。

original: Your internet connection has been lost. Tap "Exit" to continue (your reward streak may be lost).
translation: 已丢失互联网连接。轻点“退出”以继续（你可能会失去连胜奖励）。

original: The current tournament has expired!  Return to collect your winnings!
translation: 当前赛程已经终止了！快返回领取你的奖励吧！

original: Sorry, it looks like there's a network data issue.
translation: 抱歉，似乎有一些网络数据问题。

{FLAVOR}Nightcap's always had a keen sense for justice, back from when she was a tiny spore watching late-night ninja movies instead of concentrating on her mycology homework.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}免疫大多数僵尸的攻击/r
{FLAVOR}暗夜菇对正义总有一种敏锐的洞察力。在她还只是一个小孢子的时候，她就总是喜欢观看深夜档的忍者电影，而不是去专心做她的真菌学作业。

original: Nightcap shoots piercing poisonous stars down the lane and withdraws into a toxic stealth mode when zombies get too close.
translation: 暗夜菇可以向其所在行发射具有穿透效果的毒星星。当僵尸距离暗夜菇过近时，暗夜菇会遁入拥有毒性的潜行模式之中。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Poison Zombies in 3 lanes and push them back!
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}让 3 行的僵尸中毒，随后将它们击退！

original: {FLAVOR}For Nightshade, smacking is a duty and a privilege. He comes from a long line of ardent smackers, and his family counts three kings, four ambassadors and a president as among those proudly slapped around.
translation: {FLAVOR}对夜影茄来说，打脸是一种义务和特权。他来自打脸国度，他的家族有三位国王、四位大使和一位总统，他们都会自豪地互相打脸。

original: Nightshades are shadow plants that smack zombies with slappy leaves. Hurls and regrow its leave when powered by other Shadow plants.
translation: 夜影茄是一株暗影植物，可以用叶子攻击僵尸。受到其他暗影植物的强化后，它会狠狠扔出叶子，然后重新长出来。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Regrows all of its leaves, then throw three large leaves at zombies. Permanently, increases its damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}重新长出所有叶子，随后向僵尸扔出三片大叶子。还能永久提升它的伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}For a plant churning with internal gases, Noctarine's opinions are shockingly conventional. "Jaws is a good movie," he says. Like, NO KIDDING, Noctarine!
translation: {FLAVOR}对于一株带有内部气体的植物来说，暗夜油桃的观念传统到惊人。他说：“《大白鲨》是部好电影”。噗，别开玩笑了，暗夜油桃！

original: Noctarines are shadow plants that explode and create clouds of damaging and slowing gas.
translation: 暗夜油桃是一株可以爆炸的暗影植物，爆炸后可以产生一片能够造成伤害和减速效果的雾气。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。
暗影植物，爆炸并产生能对僵尸造成伤害的雾气

translation: 开启旅行木标任务通知

original: No more sprouts. Play levels to find more!
translation: 没有更多幼芽了。去游玩关卡寻找更多吧！

original: We are unable to play an ad at this time. Please try again later.
translation: 我们目前无法播放广告。请稍后再试。

original: We are unable to show offers at this time. Please try again later.
translation: 我们目前无法展示任务。请稍后再试。

original: Please connect to a network in order to log in to Facebook.
translation: 请连接到网络以登入 Facebook。

original: {FLAVOR}Olive Pit lies buried deep underground, thinking furiously. What about? Hard to say. Maybe airplanes? Do helicopters count as airplanes?
translation: {FLAVOR}油橄榄坑在地底的深处剧烈地思考着。怎么回事啊？很难说。也许是天上有架飞机？直升机应该算飞机吧？

original: Olive Pits drill into the ground and wait to consume zombies foolish enough to walk over them.
translation: 油橄榄坑可以钻入地下，等待僵尸傻傻地过来，然后出其不意地将其拖入地下。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Swallow a bunch of zombies, and spit out oil in the surrounding area.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}吞掉一堆僵尸，在周围吐油。

original: This plant cannot be planted during Last Stand setup.
translation: 这株植物不能在背水一战的布阵环节种植。

original: {FLAVOR}"Snip!" says Parsnip. "Snip snip snip! If it wasn't for my scrapbook, my coupons, and snipping zombies to death, I just don't know what I'd do with myself!"
translation: {FLAVOR}“剪！”欧防锋说。“剪剪剪！如果不是因为我有剪剪贴簿、优惠券，和剪死僵尸之类的事情能做，我真不知道我会拿自己怎么办！”

original: Parsnips snip at zombies, then charge down the lane at the last moment.
translation: 欧防锋可以用锋利的铁钳攻击僵尸，危急关头会义无反顾地向所在行冲锋。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Knocks back every zombie in front and then summons two mini parsnips that will rush down the column.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}击退面前的每只僵尸，随后召唤两株迷你欧防锋，横扫本排。

original: Snips zombies, then charges down lane
translation: 钳击僵尸，随后向所在行冲锋

original: Downloaded content may have been corrupted. Updated content will need to be downloaded again.
translation: 下载的内容好像出了点问题，需要重新下载。

original: {FLAVOR}Pea-nut knows that some folks have an aversion to him. He tries to be sensitive to their concerns and give them the space they need. Still, he can't help but miss the good old days – back when he was the most popular nut around.
translation: {FLAVOR}顽斗花生知道有些人厌恶自己。他试图对这些关注保持敏感，给那些人需要的个人空间。尽管如此，他还是不由自主地怀念过去的美好时光——他是世界上最受欢迎坚果的时光。

original: Pea-nuts can shoot peas and block zombies.
translation: 顽斗花生会可以发射豌豆并阻挡僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals to full health, gains an armor helmet and shoots a barrage of peas.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}治愈自己，获得一个盔甲头盔，发射一连串的豌豆。

original: {FLAVOR}Having studied Quantum Spatial Mechanics in Clown College, Pea Pod has been amusing families of all ages.
translation: {FLAVOR}在小丑学院学习量子力学之后，豌豆荚终于会讲全年龄向的笑话给他各个年龄段的家人了。

original: Pea Pods can be planted in the same space for up to 5 times the destruction.
translation: 豌豆荚可以在同一个地方种植多次，最高可达原先 5 倍的火力。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a giant Peashooter that shoots five giant peas.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}召唤一株巨大的豌豆射手，发射五颗巨型豌豆。

original: Monstrous Peashooter head emerges and shoots 5 giant peas.
translation: 召唤恐怖的巨型豌豆射手脑袋，发射 5 枚巨型豌豆。

original: Plant multiple times on the same spot to multiply damage
translation: 原地多次种植，造成多倍伤害

original: {FLAVOR}"What is it like being famous?" asked the Peashooter while sipping his bottled water, "I can't talk right now, I'm finishing my merchandising deal. Hold my fir coat."
translation: {FLAVOR}“问我成名的滋味如何？”豌豆射手慢慢地饮了一口茶，“我现在没空告诉你这个，我正在整理我的商业合同。还有，帮我保管一下我的外套。”

original: Peashooters are your first line of defense. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.
translation: 豌豆射手是你的第一道防线。他们会发射豌豆攻击僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a barrage of fast peas.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射一连串高速豌豆。

original: Fires off a stream of peas, adding up to a lot of damage.
translation: 发射一大串豌豆，造成巨大伤害。

original: Creates a {HEALTH} health shield every {TIME} seconds!
translation: 每 {TIME} 秒创造一面生命值为 {HEALTH} 的护盾！

original: Creates {NUMBER} shields with {HEALTH} health every {TIME} seconds!
translation: 每 {TIME} 秒创造 {NUMBER} 面生命值为 {HEALTH} 的护盾！

original: {FLAVOR}Pepper-mint likes heat. He's down with flames, he digs on fire, he's a total madman for oxidization and ignition. If he sees you rubbing two sticks together, he'll come over and ask about it. He can't help himself."
translation: {FLAVOR}暖荷喜欢热气。他对火的热爱已经到了疯狂的地步。只要他看见你在摩擦两根棍子，他就会情不自禁地过来看看。

original: Pepper-mints set off lane-wide bursts of flame when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Pepper-mint Family plants on the lawn.
translation: 暖荷在种植后会在整片草坪上燃起火焰，并暂时加强草坪上所有的暖荷家族植物。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: {FLAVOR}Some say Pepper-pult is a hot head. Some find his fiery disposition off-putting. But the truth is, he's just very focused and determined. He loves what he does. He appreciates everything he has. "I came from the weedy side of the lawn," Pepper-pult explains. "I worked hard to pull myself up by my roots. I'm a self-made pepper and I don't take a single thing for granted."
translation: {FLAVOR}有人说甜椒投手总是脑袋一热做傻事；有人觉得他老是莫名其妙火冒三丈。但事实是，他只是太专注和坚定了。他热爱他的工作，并感激着他拥有的一切事物。“我来自那杂草丛生的草坪，”甜椒投手解释道。“我努力工作只是为了提升自我。我是个只依靠自己奋斗的甜椒，我从不认为任何事情理所当然。”

original: Pepper-pults lob flaming peppers at zombies and keep nearby plants warm.
translation: 甜椒投手可以向僵尸投掷燃烧的甜椒，还能温暖周围的植物。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs several giant fire peppers at random zombies that deal moderate splash damage on impact.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机投掷数枚巨型火辣椒，撞击造成中等的溅射伤害。

original: Lobs massive explosive peppers at random targets on the lawn, while melting nearby ice.
translation: 在草坪上的随机位置投掷大甜椒，同时融化周围冰块。

original: Lobs flaming peppers at zombies and warms nearby plants
translation: 向僵尸投掷火焰甜椒，温暖附近的植物

translation: {FLAVOR}香水菇可以迷惑恐龙，让它们与僵尸反目成仇，没有敌方恐龙在场时，可以召唤一只迅猛龙

original: Summons a Raptor in a lane when no enemy dinos are present
translation: 没有敌方恐龙在场时，可以召唤一只迅猛龙

translation: {FLAVOR}节拍甜菜虽然演奏的旋律令人恶心，但是其做出的美味果酱令人垂涎三尺。

translation: 节拍甜菜每秒造成一次伤害。

original:
/r
{FLAVOR}Goo Peashooter is a goopy shooter. See? See how that works? It's a play on words. Words are often playful, folks!/r
translation:
/r
{FLAVOR}他是黏液豌豆射手，而不是“粘”液豌豆射手。看到了吗？看到了吗？语言这东西真的很博大精深！/r

original: Goo Peashooters shoot poison peas at zombies, poisoning them as well as slowing them down.
translation: 黏液豌豆射手可以向僵尸发射毒豌豆，让它们中毒并减速。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a large ball of poison that deals damage, knock back, and poison all zombies on the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}召唤一枚巨大的毒球，对草坪上的所有僵尸造成伤害、击退和中毒效果。

original: {FLAVOR}Pokra’s scrappy, she’s a fighter, she’s not afraid to jab below the belt to get the job done. She won’t, because that would be cheating, but she’s not afraid to. “Just so we’re clear,” she says with a resolute glint in her eye.
translation: {FLAVOR}戳击秋葵魄力十足。她是个能打的斗士，为了赢得胜利，她毫不惧怕使用些肮脏卑鄙的手段来痛击她的对手，但她不会这样做，因为她不想藐视规则。但她用得起，也丝毫不会畏惧。“先把话挑明了才行，”她一边说着，眼角边闪着坚毅的亮光。

original: Pokras deliver piercing, zombie-stalling jabs that add up to a powerful spike launch, then they rest momentarily before starting again.
translation: 戳刺秋葵可以连续穿透僵尸戳出刺拳，使其毒缓。多次刺拳叠加，可以发射强力毒刺。每次发射完都会休息片刻才能再次开始攻击。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches several powerful spikes that both pierces and slows zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射数道强大的尖刺，既能刺穿僵尸，又能减慢僵尸的速度。

original: {FLAVOR}Believe it or not, SPUDOW! did not happen overnight. Having been forced to try out new catchphrases and focus testing as many variations as possible (Tubular? Really?), Potato Mine weeded out the competition to stick with what he knows best.
translation: {FLAVOR}不管你信不信，关于爆炸时该发出什么声音，土豆地雷在地下真的会想很久。他把每个新的流行语试了个遍，想看看哪个最合适（“给力”？你认真的？）。结果最后，好像还是那熟悉的“砰隆”声战胜了它所有的竞争对手。

original: Potato Mines explode on contact, but they take time to arm. Plant them ahead of zombies.
translation: 土豆地雷会在接触时爆炸，但需要时间来进行武装。将其放在僵尸前面一些的位置吧。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Immediately arms and spawns multiple copies of itself.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}立即就绪，生成数份自己的复制体。

original: Immediately arms itself, and launches out 2 armed clones to random tiles on the lawn.
translation: 立即做好准备，并把 2 颗已经准备好的复制体投向草坪上的随机位置。

original: Explodes on contact, but takes time to arm itself
translation: 接触时爆炸，但需要时间来进行武装

original: {FLAVOR}From seedling to sapling, to full grown foliage, Power Lily's experience as a life coach has shown her the best way to empower and support plants everywhere.
translation: {FLAVOR}从种子到小苗，再到枝繁叶茂的大树，凭借自己数年的“植”生导师经验，能量百合可以将最饱满的能量与最合宜的支持洒满大地。

original: Power Lilies create one Plant Food out of thin air.
translation: 能量百合可以凭空创造一份植物养料。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Creates one Plant Food for use
{FLAVOR}DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.
translation: {FLAVOR}DJ 地砖芜菁用他的地下流行曲“萝卜甜菜”让整个舞池 High 到了极点。他的最新杰作是啥？哼，等他录制好，你就能感受到它的力量了。

translation: 地砖芜菁可以在种下时创建一个能量地砖。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Hold your finger down to thaw ice and burn zombies in Frostbite Caves!

original: Swipe a zombie to toss it around. Swipe it twice to send it off the screen!
translation: 在僵尸身上划动一次把它扔起来，再划动一次把它甩飞出屏幕！

original: Pinch a zombie to destroy it!
translation: 在僵尸身上捏合，消灭它！

original: Hold your finger down on a zombie to throw chilling snowballs at it!
translation: 把你的手指按在僵尸身上，朝它扔冰冷的雪球！

original: Tap to butter a single zombie in Vasebreaker!
translation: 在破瓶者中轻点一只僵尸，给它涂上黄油！

original: Complete Egyptian Challenge Pack to unlock.
Tap to select a vase, tap again to relocate to an empty tile in Vasebreaker!
translation: 在破瓶者中轻点一只花瓶，再轻点一块空地，即可移动花瓶！

original: Complete Wave {ENDLESS_WAVE} in Endless to unlock.
translation: 完成无尽第 {ENDLESS_WAVE} 波后解锁。

original: Hold your finger down on a zombie to electrocute it!

original: {FLAVOR}Power Vine's noodly antennae tremble in electric anticipation and he grins, imagining firing laser bolts at zombies in tandem with his brothers.
translation: {FLAVOR}电力藤蔓那对柔软的触角在兴奋的作用下阵阵颤抖。他咧嘴笑着，想像着与他的兄弟密切合作，一起向僵尸发射激光束。

original: Power Vines shoot rapid-fire, high-velocity laser bolts, and can increase their firepower by connecting up in a network.
translation: 电力藤蔓可以高频发射高速激光束，还能互相连接构成网络来提升火力。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Disable nearby mechanical enemies and unleashes a wave of energy bolts. When he's linked with another Power Vine, unleashes 3 waves of energy bolts.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}禁用周围的机械敌人，释放一波能量利箭。当链接到另一株电力藤蔓，可以释放 3 波能量利箭。

original: Zomboss kidnapped Dave! Penny's Pursuit levels use fuel but each level has perks that make it easier to play! Defeat enough levels for a chance to challenge Zomboss and save Dave!/r
translation: 僵王绑架了疯狂戴夫！游玩潘妮的追击关卡需要消耗燃料，但每个关卡都有让游戏更轻松的增益！通过足够多的关卡，就有机会挑战僵王博士，救出戴夫！/r

translation: {FLAVOR}原始土豆地雷并不认为自己很原始。相反，他认为自己很先进。也许事实就是如此呢？

original: Primal Potato Mines cost more than regular Potato Mines, but they arm more quickly and do damage over a larger area.

original: Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.

original: {FLAVOR}"Grunt," explains Primal Wall-nut. "Grunt oog grunt-grunt," he goes on to say. "Ook-urg grunty grunt grunt," he concludes. A nut of many opinions, is Primal Wall-nut.

translation: 原始坚果墙虽然比坚果墙要贵那么一点点，但你可以更频繁地种植他。

original: {FLAVOR}You've gotta see Sap-fling's throwing arm to believe it. He may be young, but everyone agrees ... the kid's got TALENT. Scouts from some of the biggest Pinecone Ball teams have been keeping a close eye on him. He could be headed to the majors. Oh sure, some knock him for his incredibly sticky spitball. But he only uses all-natural sap, so it's entirely legal.
translation: {FLAVOR}你只有看看树脂抛手的投掷臂，才敢相信他到底多强。尽管他现在还小，但所有人都觉得这孩子日后肯定是个大器之才。一些世界顶尖松果球队的球探也在密切关注着他，以后他肯定可以加入一个大型联盟。当然了，虽然某些人可能会因他那黏糊糊的唾沫球打他一顿，但他只用纯天然树脂，所以这完全没问题。

original: Sap-flings create zombie-slowing puddles of sap.
translation: 树脂抛手可以创建出减速僵尸的树脂格子。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lobs pinecones at multiple random tiles on the lawn, creating sticky saps that slows zombie movement.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机将松果抛向草坪上的数块地砖，产生粘稠的树脂，减缓僵尸的移动速度。
制造能使僵尸慢下来的树脂洼

original: {FLAVOR} “How did I get talked into this? I wish I was at home.”
translation: {FLAVOR} “我怎么就被说服来干这事儿了？还是家里好啊。”

original: A timid mushroom that shoots spore projectiles at zombies in its lane, but hides when they get too close.
translation: 一株胆子很小的蘑菇，可以向所在行上的僵尸发射孢子，不过当僵尸靠得太近时，它就会躲起来。

original: Scaredy-shroom has a stronger defense when hiding from zombies.
translation: 胆小菇在躲避僵尸时，防御力更强。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Scaredy-shroom rallies himself and surrounding Scaredy-shrooms to fire a stream of spores that push back advancing zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}胆小菇与周围其他的胆小菇集结，发射一大串孢子，击退前进的僵尸。

original: Shoots spores, but hides when zombies are close.
translation: 发射孢子，但会在僵尸接近时躲起来。

original: {FLAVOR}“Zzz zz… Take over the … the garage… zzzzZzz .. the world… . Zzz…zzz..”
translation: {FLAVOR}“滋滋……统治……世咕……滋滋滋……世界……滋……滋…”

original: Amphibious plant that fires piercing bubbles down its lane. Fire bubbles across three lanes when planted on water.
translation: 两栖植物，可以向所在行发射具有穿刺效果的泡泡。种植在水面上时，可以向三行发射泡泡。

original: Team SeaFlora with slow or other push zombies to take advantage of the large bubble explosion during its plant food.
translation: 将海英与其他可以减速、推动僵尸的植物联动，好好利用它植物养料效果产生的巨大泡泡。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Fires a giant bubble down its lane, pushing back zombies, then exploding for massive damage. Improves to 3 lanes when planted on water.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向所在行发射一颗巨大的泡泡，把僵尸击退，随后发生爆炸，造成巨大伤害。如果种植在水面上，则可以向 3 行发射。

original: Amphibious plant that fires piercing bubbles down the lane.
translation: 两栖植物，向所在行发射具有穿刺效果的泡泡。

original: {FLAVOR} Sea-shroom and Puff-shroom are long distance cousins. No one knows when their family tree diverged, but the family reunions always involve a pool party.
translation: {FLAVOR} 海洋菇与小喷菇是远房表亲。没人知道它们在族谱中是从什么时候岔开的，但族人团聚，怎能没有泳池派对呢。

original: Fire a short range explosive spore that will damage zombies in a radius, but it will wither away after a short time.
translation: 发射短程爆炸孢子，对一定范围内的僵尸造成伤害，不过一小段时间后就会消失。

original: Applying Plant Food to Sea-shroom will reset all Sea-shroom wither timers, as well as trigger every Sea-shroom to fire their spore stream.
translation: 向海洋菇施用植物养料可以重置所有海洋菇的凋零倒计时，同时触发所有海洋菇，一齐发射连串的孢子。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Creates a clone of itself, resets the wither timer on all Sea-shroom on the gameboard, then triggers all Sea-shroom to fire a stream of spores.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}创建一份自己的复制体，重置游戏场地上所有海洋菇的凋零倒计时，随后触发所有海洋菇，一齐发射一大串的孢子。

original: Aquatic short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time.
translation: 水生短程射手，存在时间有限。

original: To enable this setting and receive third-party ads that are relevant to your interests, please enable Tracking in your Apple iOS settings.
translation: 要启用此设置并接收与你兴趣相关的第三方广告，请在 Apple iOS 设置中启用跟踪。

original: EA collects data from your device to develop our products and services. If disabled, EA will only collect your device data we need to provide necessary online services. See EA’s Privacy and Cookie Policy for more information. (Changes will be reflected in your next gameplay session.)
translation: EA 会利用从你的设备收集到数据来开发我们的产品和服务。如果你禁用的话，EA 将只会收集我们需要的设备数据来提供必要的在线服务。如需了解更多信息，请参阅 EA 的《保密和 Cookie 协议》。（更改将在你的下一次游戏会话生效。）

original: EA collects data from your device to develop our products and services. If disabled, EA will only collect your device data we need to provide necessary online services. See EA’s Privacy and Cookie Policy for more information. (Changes will be reflected in your next gameplay session.)

original: If turned OFF, we will not use your data collected from this game to serve you EA marketing on third-party apps and websites, or use your data from other EA services to serve you EA marketing in this game. You will still see EA marketing, but it may be less relevant to you.
translation: 如果你关闭此选项，我们将不会把从此游戏收集到的信息用于在第三方应用和网站上进行 EA 营销服务，或者使用您在其他 EA 服务中的数据为您提供本游戏中的 EA 营销服务。你依然会收到 EA 的营销消息，但它们可能不会与你相关。

original: If disabled, you will still see ads from EA, but we will not personalize them for you.
translation: 关闭此选项后，你仍然会看到由 EA 提供的广告，但是我们将不会再为你定制。

original: We rely on third-party partners to deliver personalized in-game ads. If disabled, you still will see third-party ads, but these ads may not be as relevant to you. You can change your preference by visiting your privacy settings. See EA's Privacy and Cookie Policy for more details./r
translation: 我们依赖第三方合作商的服务来为你在游戏内推送定制化广告。如果禁用此选项，你仍然会看到第三方广告，但这些广告将不会再与你相关。你可以在隐私设置中修改你的偏好。请前往 EA 的《保密和 Cookie 协议》了解更多。/r

original: Restoring your purchases will allow you to claim any previously purchased, non-consumable items from the store, including premium Plants and Upgrades, and purchased Worlds.
translation: 恢复购买功能可以让你领取之前在商店购买过的不可消费品。包括你的高级植物、升级道具，以及购买过的世界。

original: Please complete Egypt 7 to restore purchases.
translation: 请先完成埃及 7 再恢复购买。

original: {FLAVOR}"Phoot," Shadow Peashooter says, emitting a shadowy, ah, hmmm, I guess you could call it a pea, at a distant zombie. "Uph!" gasps the zombie in evident surprise. There's a lot going on under the surface between these two.
translation: {FLAVOR}暗影豌豆射手“呼”地一声，吐出了一枚暗影……豌豆……？好吧……可能对于远处的僵尸来说那玩意儿确实是豌豆吧。“唔！”僵尸惊讶地倒抽了一口气。看来他俩在地下有很多事情可以好好交流一下了。

original: Shadow Peashooters are shadow plants that fire piercing shadowy peas at zombies.
translation: 暗影豌豆射手是一株暗影植物，可以发射具有穿透效果的暗影豌豆攻击僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Summons a bomb that increases its area effect for every adjacent Moonflower plant.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}召唤一枚炸弹，周围的月光花越多，范围效果越强大。
发射可穿透僵尸、有减速效果的光束

original: {FLAVOR}Despite being such a poisonous and profoundly inedible fungus, Shadow-shroom is nonetheless a total cutie-pie.
translation: {FLAVOR}尽管是一种有毒且不能吃的真菌，暗影菇依旧是个十足的可爱派。

original: Shadow-shrooms poison zombies who touch them, inflicting damage over time.
translation: 暗影菇可以让僵尸中毒，随着时间的推移，伤害会越来越高。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Poisons every zombie on the lawn. If a zombie is already poisoned, deal extra damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}让草坪上的每只僵尸中毒。如果僵尸已经中毒了，则造成额外伤害。
让僵尸随着时间的推移慢慢毒死

original: {FLAVOR}"Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"
translation: {FLAVOR}闪耀藤蔓双手放在脸上，突然摊开——“哇啦！”嘴里咯咯地笑着，看着你这个玩家。“好像打破第四面墙了哦！”

original: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants, except Moonflower, create some sun on their own, and use a sun-stun burst as a last-second defense when attacked.
translation: 闪耀藤蔓是一株藤蔓植物，可以增加月光花以外的其他阳光生产植物的阳光产量，同时自己也可以生产阳光，被僵尸啃咬时还可以发出一阵阳光冲击来眩晕僵尸，作为最后一道防线。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Produces sun and stuns all nearby zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}生产阳光，眩晕周围的所有僵尸。

original: Knockback zombies approx. {DISTANCE} tiles every {TIME} seconds!
translation: 每 {TIME} 秒令僵尸后退大约 {DISTANCE} 格地砖的距离！

original: {FLAVOR}Shrinking Violet started out shy, but it's remarkable how discovering a magical talent for zombie-reduction can change your whole outlook.
translation: {FLAVOR}你对缩小堇菜的第一印象可能是它很拘“堇”。不过一旦你发现她有个可以缩小僵尸的魔法天赋，肯定会不禁惊叹：“太强了！”

original: Shrinking Violets shrink zombies in an area, forcing them to take double damage and reducing the bite damage they inflict.
translation: 缩小堇菜可以缩小一定范围内的僵尸，使它们受到的伤害翻倍，并减少啃咬植物的伤害。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shrinks all zombies on the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}缩小草坪上的所有僵尸。

original: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker
translation: 缩小僵尸，使他们更脆弱

original: {FLAVOR}Sling Pea keeps a keen eye on the whole battle space. He's alert and attentive. "If something slips through," he muses quietly, "it would be my fault. And I just couldn't forgive myself if that happened." /r
translation: {FLAVOR}投掷豌豆一直在观察着整个战场。“如果有人偷偷溜走了，我是不会原谅自己的。因为这是我的失职。”他永远都如此机敏，又如此专注。/r

original: Sling Peas fire 5 peas in a burst, targeting the zombies closest to your house each time.
translation: 投掷豌豆可以一次发射 5 颗豌豆，每次都会瞄准离房子最近的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots 3 bursts of stunning peas at zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向僵尸发射 3 发可以眩晕僵尸的豌豆。
向全场发射 5 颗豌豆

original: A new pot is available for sprouts!
translation: 一个供幼芽生长的新花盆已解锁！

original: {FLAVOR}Although the most powerful dragon in the plant kingdom, he still dreams of wings and seeing the world beneath him.
translation: {FLAVOR}尽管他是植物王国中最厉害的龙，但他依然梦想着长出一对翅膀，俯视自己脚下的世界。

original: Snapdragons breathe fire that causes damage in 6 adjacent tiles.
translation: 火龙草可以向 6 块地砖内的僵尸吐出火焰龙息。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Sets the area in front of it on fire, dealing heavy damage to zombies.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}点燃前方的区域，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

original: Creates a 3x3 patch of fire that does massive damage.
translation: 产生一片范围为 3x3 的火，造成巨大的伤害。

original: Breathes fire in an area in front of it
translation: 向前方一片区域呼出火焰

original: {FLAVOR}"I'm a picky eater, I'll admit it," admits Snap Pea casually. "I'll eat a zombie, no problem, but there's just something about heads. I feel like they're looking at me."
translation: {FLAVOR}大嘴豌豆说：“好吧，我承认，我确实有点挑食。我是喜欢吃僵尸，没问题，但它们的脑袋就让我感觉挺不适的。感觉就像是它们在盯着我看一样。”

original: Snap Peas dive underground, burrow towards zombies, then pop up underneath to swallow them in one gulp. Snap Peas then return to their starting spot, chew on the entire matter for a while, and finally spit the zombies' heads out at attackers.
translation: 大嘴豌豆可以先钻入地下，跑到僵尸下面，一口吞下一只僵尸。然后会开始咀嚼僵尸，咀嚼完后会将僵尸的头吐出来攻击另一只僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Eat several zombies and then shoot out their heads.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}吃掉数只僵尸，随后发射出它们的头。

original: Eats zombies and spits out their heads
translation: 吃掉一只僵尸，咀嚼一段时间后吐出他的头

original: {FLAVOR}As a professional table tennis player, in the off-season he also enjoys skiing, playing the bongos, and spelunking.
translation: {FLAVOR}身为一名专业的乒乓球选手，在休赛期他也喜欢滑雪、拍手鼓以及洞穴探险。

original: Snow Peas fire frozen peas making it hard for zombies to advance.
translation: 雪花豌豆可以发射冰冻豌豆，让僵尸难以前行。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Slows all zombies in the column, then shoots a barrage of frozen peas.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}让所在排的所有僵尸减速，随后发射一大堆冷冻豌豆。

original: Fires a stream of frozen peas and creates a sheet of ice that chills everything in its lane.
translation: 发射一大串冰冻豌豆，并创造一条冰道，冷缓这行上的所有东西。

original: Shoots frozen peas that damage and slow zombies
translation: 发射冰冻豌豆，伤害、减速僵尸

original: {FLAVOR}"Ommm," Solar Sage hums softly to herself. But she's not kidding anybody. We all know her mind is filled with race cars and bulldozers.
translation: {FLAVOR}圣光鼠尾草嘴里喃喃着“唵……”。大家都以为她对赛车已经爱到这种丧心病狂地步了，整天在那儿学着发动机的声音。但其实她只是在念经啦。

original: Solar Sages illuminate zombies, causing them to make better choices and depart, leaving behind a trail of sun.
translation: 圣光鼠尾草能让僵尸开悟，让它们心存正念、离开战场，并在经过的道路上留下阳光。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Illuminates zombies in the surrounding area, causing them to fight other zombies. Produces sun if there are no valid zombies in its effect area.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}让周围区域的僵尸开悟，与其他僵尸战斗。如果效果区域内没有可以开悟的僵尸，则会生产阳光。
让僵尸开悟，开悟僵尸会在离开场地过程中提供阳光

original:
{FLAVOR}Solar Tomato wishes folks would just stop and enjoy the sunshine sometimes./r
"Stop," she says. "Enjoy the sunshine. I said stop! Hold it right there! Don't move! I MEAN IT!!!"
translation:
{FLAVOR}阳光番茄希望大家能够时常驻足享受从天空中洒下的缕缕阳光。/r
“停！”她说。“驻足享受那阳光！我说了，停下来！就给我停在那儿不准动！不！准！动!!!”

original: {FLAVOR}Sweet Potato really is as sweet as she looks. Her favorite animal is the unicorn. Her favorite color is (and this is a direct quote) "all the colors of the rainbow." When she writes the letter "i", she draws a little heart where the dot belongs. Frankly, if it were anyone else, this amount of syrup would be sickening. But on her, well, it just seems right.
translation: {FLAVOR}甜薯就像她的名字一样甜。她最喜欢的动物是独角兽，她最喜欢的颜色是（这句是她的原话）“彩虹上的所有颜色”。在写字母“i”的时候，她会把那个小点画成一颗小心心。老实说，要是换做其他人，这么甜估计得让你觉得难受。但如果是她，一切都是那么的理所应当。

translation: 甜薯可以在其他行的僵尸靠近时，将其吸引到自己那行。

original: {FLAVOR}Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"
translation: {FLAVOR}高坚果为高个子开了一家连锁店。“我会把我的好东西都给你们的！”

original: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.
translation: 高坚果是一道坚硬防线，可以阻挡低空飞行的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Heals itself and gains an extra hard armor shell.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}治疗自己，额外获得一副坚硬的盔甲外壳。

original: Becomes encased in metal armor, greatly increasing its health.
translation: 包裹在金属盔甲中，极大地提高生命值。

original: Heavy-duty wall that blocks low flying zombies
translation: 可以阻挡低空飞行僵尸的坚实壁垒

original: {FLAVOR}Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.
translation: {FLAVOR}缠绕海带主修哲学，喜欢与人深入交流。和他一起干一杯根汁汽水，他就会滔滔不绝地向你讨论泥菜的《密生西葫芦如是说》或糠德的《牵牛花理性批判》，他讨论的时候总是很冷静镇定，但你有时候也想让他讨论些轻松点的话题，比如说……水的温度。

original: Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
translation: 缠绕海带是一株水生植物，可以把靠近它的第一只僵尸拖下水。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Drags up to four random zombies underwater.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机将最多四只僵尸拖入水底。

original: Aquatic plant that pulls a zombie underwater
translation: 水生植物，将僵尸拉入水中

original: {FLAVOR}Teleportato Mine's heard the "Help me! Help me!" joke a million times before but she smiles anyway. It's a classic!
translation: {FLAVOR}传送土豆地雷听过上万次“帮帮我！帮帮我！”的笑话了，不过她还是笑得出来。那可太经典了！

original: Teleportato Mine teleports zombies to her location, then explodes.
translation: 传送土豆地雷可以把僵尸传送到她所在的位置，然后爆炸。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Defeat Treasure Yetis before they totally overrun Feastivus!
translation: 击败宝藏雪人，保护我们的盛宴节庆典！

original: Chase down Dr. Zomboss and earn coins while doing it!
translation: 追击僵王博士，同时获取硬币！

original: Play Most Recent Penny's Pursuit Level!
translation: 游玩最新的潘妮的追击关卡！

original: {FLAVOR}Threepeater loves playing multiplayer in video games, but split-screen never works out because the left head always cheats.
translation: {FLAVOR}三线豌豆喜欢玩多人游戏，但是分屏通常没有用，因为最左边的那个头总是会作弊。

original: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.
translation: 三线豌豆能同时向三行发射豌豆。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots a spread of peas in multiple directions, dealing damage.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向多个方向射出一大片豌豆，造成伤害。

original: Fires off a waving wall of peas across the lawn.
translation: 在草坪上发射摆动着的豌豆浪潮。

original: Thyme Warps rewind time, sending zombies back where they started, but healing them in the process.
translation: 逆时百里香可以逆转时间，把僵尸送回他们来的地方，不过过程中也会恢复它们的生命值。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。

original: Sends zombies back where they started
translation: 将僵尸送回开始的位置

original: {FLAVOR}Tiger Grass is waiting. The grass tiger waits within. Soon their time will come. And then... the slashes! THE FURY!!!
translation: {FLAVOR}虎草潜伏着……而草虎，则在它的里面潜伏着。很快，时机就到了，然后……劈砍！暴怒!!!

original: Tiger Grass spawns a grass tiger who leaps out to attack nearby zombies.
translation: 虎草可以召唤草虎，草虎可以跳出去攻击附近的僵尸。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Spawn a fully grown grass tiger that deals a large amount of damage to a zombie.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}生成一只长大的草虎，对僵尸造成大量伤害。

translation: 时间风暴彩陶派对来了！

original: {FLAVOR}Toadstool just can’t stand being idle. “I keep everything that I want to do on lists, and keep the lists where I can see them so that I’m always motivated!” she said. Whenever there’s work to be done, she’s always the first to hop to it.
translation: {FLAVOR}蟾蜍毒菌受不了无所事事，“我会把我想做的钦点在计划单上，并把计划放在没有偏差的地方，这样我就能一直 excited！”每当有工作要做时，她总是第一个跳起来。

original: Toadstools gulp down zombies whole, then produce sun.
translation: 蟾蜍毒菌可以吞下一只僵尸，咀嚼完成后会产出阳光。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Consumes up to 4 random zombies in the surrounding area and produces sun for each zombie it ate.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机吃掉周围最多 4 只僵尸，每吃掉一只，就产生一份阳光。

original: Gulps down zombies whole, then produces sun.
translation: 吞下整只僵尸，咀嚼一段时间后生产阳光

original: {FLAVOR}”I don’t know what these tombstones are made out of, but they sure make me belch out loud. Anyone dares disturb my siesta, I’ll pull them down!”
translation: {FLAVOR}“我不清楚这坟墓是什么做的，但它的饱腹感真的很强。想知道土里的世界长什么样？那就随意过来打扰我睡午觉吧！”

original: Tomb Tangler swallows Tombstones and emits a fog that will slow Zombies and can randomly pull them into the ground.
translation: 坟墓缠绕者可以吞下坟墓，随后释放出一阵可以减速僵尸的气体，还能随机把僵尸拖入地底。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Drags up to 2 random zombies down.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}随机将 2 只僵尸拖入地底。

original: Plant on Tombstones. The fog slows Zombies and may pull them down.
translation: 种在坟墓上。雾中的僵尸会被减速，概率被拖入土中。

original: {FLAVOR}Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.
translation: {FLAVOR}火炬树桩和火龙草是对很要好的朋友。他们喜欢在提基酒廊和文艺复兴博览会那里闲逛。

original: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal close damage as well as lanewide flame damage on defeat.
translation: 火炬树桩可以将通过的豌豆变为火焰豌豆，造成双倍伤害。同时也可以造成近身伤害，被吃掉时则会燃起一行火焰。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Permanently increases the damage bonus of all the peas that pass through it.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}永久提升所有穿过豌豆的额外伤害。

original: Permanently turns into a blue-fire version, with blue-fire peas doing twice the damage of fire peas.
translation: 永久变为蓝火版本，蓝火豌豆将造成火焰豌豆两倍的伤害。

original: Turns peas into fireballs and does lanewide damage on defeat
translation: 将豌豆变成火球，被吃掉后烧伤整行僵尸

translation:

original: Tumbleweeds roar off down the lane, bouncing off zombies and knocking them back with a chance to stun or even flip them off the lawn.
translation: 风滚草可以沿着道路向前翻滚出去，眩晕、击退，甚至可以直接击飞僵尸。
{KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}没有植物养料效果。
从所在行出发后，在不同行之间弹跳！

original: {FLAVOR}Turkey-pult’s turkeys are so delicious, you’d never know they were actually made of tofu! Almost never. You might know. Okay, fine, cards on the table: there is absolutely no way you could ever mistake these turkeys for the real thing.
translation: {FLAVOR}火鸡投手的火鸡非常美味吧？我才不会告诉你它们都是用豆腐做的呢！肯定不会……！也许不会……？行吧，那就这么说吧：你永远也不会把它们当作真火鸡的。

original: Turkey-pults lob tofu turkeys that damage zombies and then charge down the lane to damage even more zombies.
translation: 火鸡投手向僵尸投掷豆腐火鸡，火鸡落地后会攻击僵尸。

translation: 终级番茄可以缓慢蓄能，然后向当前行发射毁灭性的光束伤害僵尸。终极番茄可以通过堆种来变得更强。

original: Special-edition plants are back for a limited time.
translation: 节日专属植物，限时回归。
Progressive 赞助的双倍硬币奖励！

original: Piñata Party is on! Daily mash-ups. Amazing prizes.
translation: 彩陶派对已经开始！每日的混搭关卡，丰厚的回馈奖赏。

original: Get sticky with Sap-fling in today’s Piñata Party!
translation: 在今天的彩陶派对上尽情使用树脂抛手吧！

original: Scoring! In a game! This might just catch on!
translation: 得分！在游戏中得分！可能会流行起来！

original: Try Dandelion in today’s Springening party.
translation: 在今天的暖春节派对试玩蒲公英吧！

original: Celebrate The Springening with Dandelion and friends!
translation: 与蒲公英和他的朋友一起庆祝暖春节吧！

original: Put some BOOM in your blooms!
translation: 爆炸的焰火，绽放的花朵！

original: Take a crack, win a prize! Celebrate The Springening with cheer!
translation: 用丰厚的奖励，迎接暖春节的到来吧！

original: Play Eggbreaker in today’s garden party.
translation: 在今天的花园派对游玩“破壳者”吧。

original: Happy April Fools' Day! Not everything may be as it appears!
translation: 愚人节快乐！眼见不一定为实哦！

original: Put your bunny ears back on.
translation: 重新戴上你的兔子耳朵吧！

original: 50% off replays today in The Springening!
Try charming Sweet Potato in today’s Piñata Party!
translation: 在今天的彩陶派对试试令僵尸着迷的甜薯！
来试试全新的炙鞭山葵吧！

original: Strap in for a furious Time Twister event!
Hunt him down and collect sweet loot!
A Treasure Yeti has spawned in this level. Destroy him and get treasure before he vanishes!
translation: 有一只宝藏雪人出现在了这道关卡！在他消失之前击败他，夺取他的宝藏！

original: A Treasure Yeti has spawned in this world. Destroy him and get treasure before he vanishes!
translation: 有一只宝藏雪人出现在了这个世界！在他消失之前击败他，夺取他的宝藏！
完成侏罗纪沼泽即可解锁
完成海盗港湾即可解锁
完成遥远未来即可解锁

original: Take a trip back to the '60s and hang ten on the ocean waves! Tides are changing and those gnarly zombies make it not-so-safe to go back in the water!
translation: 乘着浪回到 60 年代，感受大海的呼唤！不断变化的海岸线、饥渴的僵尸都让下水游泳危险重重。

original: Head down the dusty trail for a showdown with the outlaw zombies of yesteryear! Gather up your plants for the big Brain Rush of 1850!
translation: 踏上尘土飞扬的小路，让逃亡于此的僵尸尝尝厉害！植物，在此集结！一同参与 1850 年那场淘脑潮！

original: Bring out your undead to the year 948! Harvest mushrooms in the dark of knight and get medieval on zombies from the days of yore!
translation: 与僵尸一起来到如尸般腐臭的 948 年！在这儿，无处不笼罩着黑暗骑士的阴霾；在这儿，你将获得蘑菇，与来自往日岁月的僵尸一同走过中世纪！

original: The ground thunders under the awful feet of terrible lizards! Dinosaurs prowl the past, provoking prehistoric zombies into a frenzy of ancient antipathy!
translation: “轰！轰！”，那是史前巨蜥脚步落在地上的声音。周围是凶猛的恐龙在徘徊，连僵尸也在原始的欲望下变得更为疯狂。

original: Zombies infest one of Earth's earliest civilizations! Tackle mummified monsters and more under the scorching sun of Egypt, circa 2500 BC!
translation: 僵尸侵袭了地球上最早的几个文明之一！在约公元前 2500 年的埃及烈日下对付木乃伊僵尸吧！

original: Stock up on hairspray and rewind to the 1980s! With synthesized music and voraciously radical zombies, this heinous dance party will, like, totally tax you to the MAX!
translation: 抹上发胶，回到 80 年代，跟随着合成音乐与僵尸一起摇摆！来吧，这场舞会保准让你 High 到极点！

original: In the year 2323, the zombies will have brain extraction down to a science! Can the plants of the future save you from the undead of tomorrow?
translation: 2323 年，僵尸的脑子提取技术已然成为一门新兴的科学！未来的植物能否将你从明日的僵尸口中解救出来？

original: Explore the frozen wastes of prehistory and chill out with the coolest zombies ever. Beware the winds or your plants will be frozen veggies.
translation: 探索史前的冰冻废墟，与最“冷酷”的僵尸一起“寒”暄几句。小心吹来的寒风！它能把你的植物冻成冰块！

original: Discover the vanished city of gold, where sun is plentiful and misplaced zombies abound! Use special tiles for extra sun, for these treasure-seekers are no idol threat!
translation: 探索失落的黄金之城，那里阳光充裕，并且到处都是迷路的探险家僵尸！不仅如此，你还可以使用特殊的地砖来获得额外的阳光！

original: The end is the beginning! Return to moments before you left in a contemporary contest stocked with zombies of every egregious era!
translation: 结束，便是一切的开始！回到投身于这场时空之旅前与僵尸酣战的时刻。

original: The year is 1679, the golden age of zombie piracy! Keep your booty close and your plants closer as zombies take to the seas to plunder your brains!
translation: 1679 年，海盗僵尸的黄金时代！僵尸虎视眈眈，盘算着出海掠夺你的脑子。快抱好你的宝藏，抱紧你的植物！

translation: 完成炫光魔音游即可解锁

original: {FLAVOR}Sometimes Rotobaga hears the other plants gossiping about each other. "Did you notice that so-and-so has been putting on weight?" they might say. Or, "I hear that so-and-so is dating so-and-so. Can you believe it?"  But Rotobaga isn’t the kind of plant to engage in idle gossip. She’s not interested in talking about anyone behind their leaves. She does her best to just rise above it.
translation: {FLAVOR}有时候，旋转洋芜菁可以听见其他植物互相八卦。他们有的会说：“你觉不觉得某某长胖了？”或者是“我听说某某和某某正在约会惹！天啦噜！”然而旋转洋芜菁才不是那种背地里说闲话的植物呢，她可不喜欢在植物的“叶后”八卦他们。毕竟她在空中早就看得一清二楚了。

original: Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
translation: 旋转洋芜菁可以在四个角中的任意一角有敌人时发射子弹。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Shoots multiple huge rotobagas in four directions.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向四个方向射击数颗大号的洋芜菁。

original: Fires a rapid stream of shots in all four diagonal directions.
translation: 向四个对角线方向快速发射大量子弹。

original: Shoots along the diagonals, up to four directions at a time
translation: 沿对角线射击，最多同时射击四个方向

original: When a yeti appears on the map, go after him quickly! If you can spot and defeat him in the level, he'll drop fabulous prizes!
translation: 在地图上看到雪人出现，就赶快去追他！只要在关卡里找到并击败他，他就会掉落绝妙的奖励！

original: Gets instant Plant Food effect when planted on the lawn.
translation: 将在种植在草坪上时立即获得植物养料效果。

original: Tap a plant. The bee will speed it up!
translation: 轻点一株植物。蜜蜂会加速它的生长！

original: Opens up another pot to plant sprouts and earn sweet loot and boosts!
translation: 开启另一个花盆，种植幼芽，获取丰厚奖励与植物强化！

original: Are you sure you want to shovel this plant?  It will lose its boost.
translation: 你确定要铲掉这株植物吗？铲掉之后，强化就会消失哦！

original: Here's some coins while you work towards a boost!
translation: 在你获取强化的路上，还会奖励你一些硬币！

original: Return to Zen Garden often to boost your plants!
translation: 常回禅境花园看看，强化你的植物！

original: Sunflower is now boosted! The boost lasts for one level.
translation: 向日葵已强化！本次强化只在这一关内生效。

original: She's ready for water. Keep her growing to get a boost!
translation: 可以给她浇水了。让她成长，获得强化！

original: It's a Sunflower! She's thirsty for water.
translation: 这是一株向日葵！她好像很渴。

original: Marigold's growing up! And she has coins for you.
translation: 金盏花长大了！而且她有硬币要给你。

original: A batch of coins and she's done!
You may plant another sprout now!
translation: 你现在可以多种植一株幼芽了！

original: Return to Zen Garden often to earn coins!
translation: 经常回禅境花园看看，获取更多硬币！

original: It's a Marigold! She needs water.
translation: 这是株金盏花！她需要浇水。

original: The Marigold is ready for water.
translation: 已经可以给金盏花浇水了。

original: You may plant multiple sprouts to add a bonus to your chance to get an uncommon or rare plant.
translation: 你可以种植多株幼芽，以增加得到罕见或稀有植物的概率。

original: Complete Ancient Egypt Day 14 to unlock Zen Garden
translation: 完成上古埃及第 14 天，解锁禅境花园

original: The bee will take your plant, but it hasn't grown enough to be worth any sprouts.  Sell anyway?
translation: 蜜蜂会买下你的植物，但是那植物还没有长到值任何幼芽的程度。还是要卖吗？

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}imps thrown from barrel when destroyed/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Barrel Roller Zombie is part of a super underground secret awesome club. You probably haven't heard of it. Also, his left arm is slightly longer than his right arm.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}可以用桶压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}当桶被摧毁时，会有小鬼跳出来/r
/r
{FLAVOR}滚桶僵尸是超级地下神秘俱乐部的一分子。你估计没听过这俱乐部吧？没办法，它太神秘了。此外，他的左胳膊比右胳膊稍微长一点。

original: His rolling barrel crushes plants and provides excellent protection.
translation: 他的滚桶可以压扁植物，还能为他提供良好的保护。

original: {FLAVOR}Go to the beach, they said. Put a cone on your head, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead did. He's at his best when following simple instructions.
translation: {FLAVOR}蓬巴杜路障头僵尸很喜欢完成别人给他施的简单指令。“到沙滩去”，他照做了；“把路障放到你头上”，他也照做了。

original: His starfish cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal pompadour zombie.
translation: 他的海星锥帽使他的防御力比普通蓬巴杜僵尸高一倍。

original: {FLAVOR}Pompadour Buckethead tried to learn to play the ukulele. He figured it would be easier to learn than the guitar on account of how small it is. But his stiff fingers ... they just weren't made for it. Now he just bangs on his bucket. And he's not half-bad either.
translation: {FLAVOR}蓬巴杜铁桶头僵尸在学习演奏尤克里里琴。他觉得这尺寸可比吉他容易弹多了。但他那又小又僵的手指嘛……很明显不适合这玩意儿。现在就好多了，他敲他那铁桶敲得可开心了！

original: His scallop shelled bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
translation: 他的贝壳铁桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}Pompadour Zombie recently noticed that he was wearing only one flip-flop. He THINKS he lost the other one while doing the limbo at a bonfire party the other night. But to be honest, that entire night is a little hazy ... and that flip-flop could be anywhere.
translation: {FLAVOR}蓬巴杜僵尸最近注意到自己只穿了一只拖鞋。他估计是那天晚上在篝火晚会打杂的时候搞丢了一只。但那天晚上雾蒙蒙的……拖鞋可能在任何地方。
普通的海滩流浪汉僵尸。

original: {FLAVOR}See that starfish on Bikini Conehead's cone? She put that there herself. She gets a lot of compliments on it too. And sure enough, now it seems like everyone is accessorizing with starfish. She's a trendsetter, that one.
translation: {FLAVOR}看到比基尼路障头僵尸脑袋上的海星了吗？是她自己放在那儿的，这让她取得了许多赞美。果然，现在似乎每个人都开始往头上放海星了。但是她才是那个时尚弄潮儿，唯一的那个。

original: Her starfish cone makes her twice as tough as a basic bikini zombie.
translation: 她的海星锥帽使她的防御力比普通比基尼僵尸高一倍。

original: {FLAVOR}Bikini Buckethead had big ambitions. She wanted to do more than just lurch around on a beach all day. Her life's dream: to perform internationally with a synchronized swimming team. Sadly, the nose plug was her undoing. If she only had a nose ...
translation: {FLAVOR}比基尼铁桶头僵尸有着雄心壮志。她想做的可不仅仅是整天在海滩上闲逛。她一生的梦想，便是与一支水上芭蕾队一起参加国际表演。可遗憾的是，她的鼻塞让这个还未萌芽的梦想破灭了……如果她有一个鼻子的话…

original: Her scallop shelled bucket provides great protection from damage.
translation: 她的贝壳铁桶可以帮助她很好地抵御伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}Is it weird that we haven't seen any female zombies before? Some say yes. Some say no. Either way, Bikini Zombie is used to breaking new ground. She's not afraid to go where no woman zombie has gone before. You could call her a pioneer. You could call her a hero.
translation: {FLAVOR}在之前我们从未看到过女性僵尸，是不是很奇怪？有人说是的，有人说不是。不管怎样，比基尼僵尸开辟了新局面，她不惧怕到以前没有女性僵尸涉足的地方。你可以称她为先驱者，也可以称她为英雄。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pulls plants to the right/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants next to him are tossed off the lawn/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Everyone is tired of Fisherman Zombie's fishing stories. He's always bragging about the size of his catch. Time and time again, he claims to have caught "the big one." But the fact of the matter is, no one has seen him actually catch a fish. Not once. It's more than a little suspicious.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}把植物向右拖/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在他旁边的植物会被甩出草坪/r
/r
{FLAVOR}啊……大伙都听腻了渔夫僵尸在那儿讲自己的钓鱼事迹了。他总喜欢吹牛说自己钓到的鱼有多大，但实际上，都没有人看过他钓到鱼，一次都没有。好像是有点可疑。

original: Casts his line to pull far plants to him.
translation: 抛出钓鱼绳，把远处的植物拉到他跟前。

original: {FLAVOR}Talk about a disgruntled zombie. Beach Flag Zombie is fed up. None of the other zombies seem to appreciate just how difficult it is for him to swim while holding a flag. Not once have they thanked him for doing the hard work that needs to be done. So it shouldn't come as a surprise: He's been interviewing for jobs elsewhere.
translation: {FLAVOR}海滩旗帜僵尸实在是受够了。其他的僵尸似乎都不知道他举着旗子游泳有多困难。他们一次也没有感谢过他做的这份苦差事。因此，他其实一直在面试其他地方的工作，你应该不会觉得很意外吧。

original: Marks the arrival of a huge wet "wave" of zombies.
translation: 标示着一“波”僵尸即将随着潮水起落而来袭。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with driftwood/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mermaid when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}This big guy loves the water. When he's deep down in it, he feels light as a feather. He feels like he's flying. Most importantly, during those precious moments, he feels as if the weight of Imp Mermaid Zombie has been lifted from his shoulders.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用漂流木压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼人鱼/r
/r
{FLAVOR}这个大家伙很喜欢水。在水里，他感觉自己如鸿毛般轻盈，如鱼儿般自由。最重要的是，在这段宝贵的时光中，他再也不用承受小鬼人鱼僵尸的重量了。

original: Titanic zombie who isn't shellfish with his might.
translation: 泰坦级的巨型僵尸，力气“壳”大了。

original: {FLAVOR}Imp Mermaid Zombie couldn't decide whether to wear the top made out of coconut shells or the top made out of seashells. She went with the slinky coconut-shell number because, really, the seashells are soooo last wave.
translation: {FLAVOR}小鬼人鱼僵尸不知道自己上半身是该戴椰子壳呢，还是贝壳呢？最后她还是选择了椰子壳，因为她觉得戴贝壳太俗气了。

original: Washes in past your defenses, then flounders forward.
translation: 可以被冲到防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bound plants are passive until their octopus is destroyed/r
/r
{FLAVOR}It started innocently enough. One day, Octo Zombie decided to get a pet octopus. But he loved that octopus so much, he got another and another ... and another. Next thing you know, he was volunteering at an octopus rescue shelter. And now, well, no one wants to tell him, but he's pretty much the undersea equivalent of a cat lady. You should see how many are living at his house. It's quite startling.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}被章鱼抓住的植物将无法动弹，直到章鱼被击落/r
/r
{FLAVOR}现在回想起来，一切都是那么稀松平常。那天，章鱼僵尸决定养一只宠物章鱼。刚开始还好好的，但他后来对章鱼的爱越来越深，于是一只又一只的章鱼都接连成了他的宠物。之后，他又到一间章鱼收容所当志工。现在嘛……你已经可以把他自己的家称作章鱼收容所了。他屋子里的章鱼数量多得有点吓人。

original: Throws octopi at your plants to bind them up.
