translation: 世界未解之谜：他在哪里找到的蓝色皮毛给他做装备的？

original: Crude drawings of buckets provide as much protection as the real thing.
translation: 没想到画工粗糙的铁桶画像能和真正的铁桶提供的防御一样多。

original: Contrary to his name, Jurassic Fossilhead's fossil head isn't actually a fossil. That skull's maybe a week and a half old, tops.
translation: 侏罗纪化石头僵尸的脑袋上戴着的其实并不是什么化石。那块骨头估计才放了一个多星期而已。

original: Fossil skulls not only provide a huge amount of damage absorption, but are also extremely classy.
translation: 化石头骨不仅可以承受大量伤害，而且还很优雅美观。

original: {FLAVOR}If you were to extract DNA from the Amberhead Zombie and combine it with the DNA of a frog, you'd probably be breaking the law at some point.
translation: {FLAVOR}如果你把琥珀头僵尸的 DNA 提取出来和青蛙的结合，那多半会犯法。

original: Amberhead Zombie's head-engulfing ball of amber provides hardened protection.
translation: 琥珀头僵尸的脑袋被一块琥珀包裹住，使其可以承受大量伤害

original: Jurassic Bully is slow, stupid, and smells bad. But hey, at least he's punctual.
translation: 侏罗纪暴徒僵尸又慢、又笨、身上又臭。但是人不可貌相嘛，至少他很……守时。

original: A trudging, damage-resistant zombie who is immune to Primal Peashooter's knockback.
translation: 一只步伐沉重、可以抵挡伤害的僵尸。还能免疫原始豌豆射手的击退效果。

original: {FLAVOR}Somebody tied rocks to Jurassic Rockpuncher's hands. Being unable to remove them (because he had rocks tied to his hands), he was left with no choice but to roll with it.
translation: {FLAVOR}有人把石头绑在了侏罗纪石击僵尸的手上。他其实也不情愿，但是他自己弄不下来啊（因为手上有石头），于是就只好作罢了。

original: Jurassic Rockpuncher pummels plants with rocks tied to his hands.
translation: 侏罗纪石击僵尸可以用手上绑着的石头砸碎植物。

original: Jurassic Zombie is NOT primitive. See, he's wearing a tie and everything!
translation: 侏罗纪僵尸一点也不原始。瞧，他还打着领带什么的呢！

original: Regular beard-having zombie from the unimaginable past.
translation: 普通的大胡子僵尸，来自令人难以想象的过去。

original: He's not only got a flag, but he's also got a can-do attitude and a fierce hunger for success. Success and brains.
translation: 他不单单有一面旗子，还有那旗子代表的一种力所能及的态度和对成功的强烈渴望。成功和代表智慧的脑子。

original: Marks the arrival of a huge epochal "wave" of highly anachronistic zombies.
translation: 标示着一“波”与时代相违的僵尸即将到来。

original: {FLAVOR}Where did Jurassic Rally Zombie get his fancy new flag? Nobody knows. It's a mystery. The police should look into it. Or maybe we could get a fund together and hire a detective. It's a real puzzle.
translation: {FLAVOR}侏罗纪集结僵尸的旗帜是从哪儿拿来的？这是个千古谜题，没有人知道。警察应该来进行深入研究；或者我们应该成立一个特别基金会，然后雇一个侦探来寻找真相。

original: Jurassic Rally Zombie marks the arrival of large group of zombies.
translation: 侏罗纪集结僵尸和他的旗帜象征着超大波僵尸即将来袭。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with bone/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Jurassic Imp when damaged/r
{FLAVOR}Jurassic Gargantuar wonders how there can be zombies millions of years before the advent of humanity. He doesn't let it get in the way of his plant-bashing, though.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用骨头压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出侏罗纪小鬼/r
{FLAVOR}侏罗纪巨人僵尸一直在想，明明还有几百万年人类才诞生，怎么现在就有僵尸了？但这并不妨碍他去砸碎植物。
史前巨尸，带来中生代的荒谬之语。

original: This nasty little nipper can make a serious dent in your defenses if left to his own devious devices.
translation: 如果你任由他使用自己的诡计，这个讨厌的小东西就会严重破坏你的防线。

original: A weaker, smaller, much more vicious version of the typical Jurassic zombie.
translation: 一只更弱，更小，但速度更快的侏罗纪僵尸。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons disco Jetpack Zombies/r
/r
{FLAVOR}After some initial problems with the sideburn suspension system, the Disco-tron 3000 went on to become the shufflin' dance-bot of doom it is today.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}可以召唤迪斯科喷射器僵尸/r
/r
{FLAVOR}在解决了侧燃悬挂系统引发的一些问题之后，迪斯科机 3000 仍是目前为止最为恐怖的毁灭舞步机器人。

original: Drops in disco zombies when dropping the beat.
translation: 播放音乐时会召唤迪斯科僵尸。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Increase movement while on water.

{FLAVOR}It took countless hours for Ducky Tube Conehead to find the perfect starfish to decorate its cone. Look at it! ‘REALLY’ look at it!!! Can you see its magnificence? The Size! The Shape! The Color! No?!?
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在水里时，机动性会提高。/r
/r
{FLAVOR}鸭鸭游泳圈路障头僵尸不知道花了多少时间，才终于找到了一只完美的海星来装饰它的路障。快看！“用力”看!!! 看出来有多华丽了吗？看看这尺寸！看看这形状！再看看这颜色！没看出来啊?!? 那你可能得再看看。

original: The starfish cone on his head grants this zombie higher damage resistance than normal Ducky Tubes.
translation: 他的海星锥帽使他的防御力比普通的鸭鸭游泳圈僵尸更高。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Increase movement while on water.

{FLAVOR}It takes a being of great intellect to innovate, to go against existing conventions and do something different. While others may have put buckets on their heads for protection, few have thought to paint it green. Pure genius!
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在水里时，机动性会提高。/r
/r
{FLAVOR}要想创新、摆脱条条框框、做一些特立独行的事情，过人的智力必不可少。其他僵尸只知道可以往头上放铁桶来保护自己，但只有天才，才能想到可以把它涂成绿色。这可太聪明了！

original: The surprisingly durable seashell bucket makes this the toughest of all the Ducky Tubes.
translation: 它戴着硬得离谱的贝壳铁桶，可以说是所有鸭鸭游泳圈僵尸中生命值最高的。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Increase movement while on water.

{FLAVOR}Many scientists argue over the origins of the Ducky Tube, few can deny its classification. Clearly it is not a duck as some would like to believe.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在水里时，机动性会提高。/r
/r
{FLAVOR}尽管不少科学家都对鸭鸭游泳圈的起源争论不休，但就它的分类，大家都已经默默达成了共识。很明显它不像某些人说的那样是只鸭子。

original: With its inflatable duck-like flotation apparatus, the Ducky Tube can quickly waddle its way through water with ease.
translation: 鸭鸭游泳圈僵尸可以利用它那长得像鸭子的充气漂浮装置，轻松在水中摇摇晃晃地前进。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with sarcophagus/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mummy when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}True fact #1: The pyramids were built in an attempt to make Mummified Gargantuar seem small. It didn't work. True fact #2: The Sphinx isn't missing its nose... that is the face of... Gargantuar.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用石棺压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼木乃伊/r
/r
{FLAVOR}冷知识：木乃伊巨人僵尸其实是用来衬托金字塔有多大的，虽然好像没啥用；冷知识 2：狮身人面像其实并没有失去鼻子，那其实是……巨人僵尸的脸。

original: Massive zombie from a royal line of mummies.
translation: 来自木乃伊皇族血统的巨大僵尸。

original: {FLAVOR}Imp Mummy prefers to laze around the tomb, hop up on the urns, and scratch at the sarcophagi. The sound of him coughing up a hairball is one you will never forget.
translation: {FLAVOR}小鬼木乃伊僵尸喜欢在墓地周围闲逛，跳上骨灰缸，用指甲划石棺。那刺耳的声音会令你永生难忘。

original: Thrown over most of your defenses, then slinks onward.
translation: 可以被甩到你的防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

original: Being made out of light and positional co-ordinates has no effect on this erzatz zombie’s ravenous hunger for tangy brains.
translation: 虽然这只僵尸只是光线与位置坐标相调制的产物，但这丝毫不影响他对脑子的贪婪欲望。

original: Pixelated zombie generated by super cool arcade machine. Comes in regular, cone and bucket flavors.
translation: 像素版僵尸是由电玩城街机创造出来的。可能会出现普通、路障、和铁桶风味。

original: When it’s a choice between quarters for games and quarters for laundry, Arcade Zombie is prepared to make the ultimate stinky sacrifice.
translation: 该花多少硬币在游戏机上，又该花多少去洗衣服？电玩城僵尸已经准备好做出他的终极抉择了。

original: Pushes an arcade cabinet that spits out 8-Bit Zombies.
translation: 推着一台可以产生 8 位僵尸的游戏机

original: Neon Conehead Zombie used to be a big believer in de-evolution, but then he forgot what it meant.
translation: 霓虹路障头僵尸曾经是“退化学说”的忠实拥护者，结果后来他连那是什么东西都忘了。

original: Cones provide protection and focus the sound of righteous tunes.
translation: 路障可以阻挡伤害，还能汇聚正义曲调的声音。

original: Neon Buckethead Zombie had to go all the way to the dump to find a headband he really liked.
translation: 霓虹铁桶头僵尸大老远跑到垃圾场去找那个他真正喜欢的头带。

original: Buckets absorb damage because that’s just what they do.
translation: 他头上的铁桶可以承受伤害，因为……它们本就该这样。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT} boom box has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Boombox Zombie doesn’t want to buy, sell or process anything; he just really wants to consume your brains.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}音响对近地植物和节拍甜菜无效/r
/r
{FLAVOR}音响僵尸并不想买、卖或者处理任何东西；他只是真的很想吃掉你的脑子。

original: Holds aloft a boom box that tranquilizes all plants with its heartfelt tunes.
translation: 他会高举收音机，然后用它播放自己发自内心的曲调感染植物。

original: Delivers only the freshest moves at bargain basement prices.
translation: 最新潮的舞步，最划算的价格！

original: Kicks zombies forward when transported by the power of rap.
translation: 因饶舌乐之力起舞的时候，可以把僵尸向前踢动。

original: He's cutting down on his head-banging so as not to bang his head clean off.
translation: 他最近在尝试减少弹吉他时摇头的次数，以免不小心把头摇掉下来。
普通的音乐爱好者僵尸。

original: Fluorescent colors and little yellow plastic strips are the marks of a truly hip, groundbreaking new style of zombie wave flag.
translation: 荧光颜料和窄塑料带是真正时髦的标志，是震惊四周的大波僵尸旗帜的新款式。

original: Marks the arrival of a huge mixtape-making "wave" of zombies.
translation: 标志着由混音带引起的一大波僵尸的来袭。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with guitar/r
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes sonic blast when metal music plays/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Impunk when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Hair Metal Gargantuar only knows one chord, but you'd better believe he'll play it all night and then some.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用电吉他压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}当重金属音乐炒热场子时会击打出音波/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出小鬼朋克僵尸/r
/r
{FLAVOR}重金属巨人僵尸虽然只知道一个和弦，但他还是会经常弹电吉他弹一整晚。
统治着活力摇滚之狂欢的利维坦巨兽。

original: Glitter Zombie inspires zombies everywhere to boogie their brains out, whether it's just one moment or maybe forever, or at least until the lights come on and they're kicking everybody out.
translation: 闪光僵尸可以鼓舞各地的僵尸，让它们嗨得把脑袋甩掉。甩掉多久？有可能一小会儿；有可能永远都找不到；还有一种可能，就是得等到活动结束，然后它们互相把地上各自的脑袋踹出去。

original: Trails glamorous rainbows that protect zombies behind her when she's feeling the beat.
translation: 在感受到节拍时，拖出一道充满魅力的彩虹，彩虹会保护她身后的僵尸。

original: Impunk’s lyrics have been described as "banal," "incoherent," and "totally expressive of the Zompunk movement at its finest."
translation: 大家说小鬼朋克僵尸的歌词“平淡乏味”、“语无伦次”，并且“完全表达出了僵尸朋克运动的最佳状态”。

original: Tossed past most of your defenses, then rocks out to your detriment.
translation: 可以被抛到防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

original: MC Zom-B doesn’t want you to know it, but his fancy bling is really just gold-plated zinc he got from his grandma.
translation: 饶舌僵尸并不想让你知道，但他的漂亮小挂坠真的只是从他祖母那里得的镀金锌挂饰。

original: Spins microphone to damage nearby plants when he's dropping his sick, sick rhymes.
translation: 在表演爽爆了的饶舌时转动麦克风伤害附近的植物。

original:
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet Shrooms pull off his head/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Punk Zombie’s piercings represent his individuality and his belief in personal freedom, or maybe just that he fell face-first into a sewing machine.
translation:
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}磁铁菇可以吸走他的头/r
/r
{FLAVOR}朋克僵尸的鼻子穿孔代表了他的个性以及他对个人自由的信仰……额，似乎仅仅是因为他有一次掉进了缝纫机里。

original: Moshes plants back a space when his jam is playing.
translation: 当他的主场开始时，他就会将碰到的植物往左推一格。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact/r
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch/r
/r
{FLAVOR}His impressive friendly mutton chops have always kept food in them for weeks, making sure his explorations are filled with snacks.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}火把能烧死接触到的植物/r
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}冰冻的东西可以熄灭火把/r
/r
{FLAVOR}了解他的人都知道，他总是把他的食物存在背包里几个星期，确保他在探险时能有足够的东西吃。

original: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants.
translation: 携带的火把可以瞬间摧毁你的植物。

original: {FLAVOR}Torchlight Zombie has no fear of the dark. That's not because he's always got a torch, however, but rather because as a zombie he has no capacity for fear in the first place.
translation: {FLAVOR}火光僵尸之所以不惧怕黑暗，并不是因为他总是拿着火把，而是因为作为一只僵尸，他从一开始就没有害怕的能力。

original: Carries a torch that instantly destroys plants and scorches the earth.
translation: 携带可以瞬间摧毁植物的火把，并可以把大地烧焦。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Now past his prime, Mecha-Football Zombie is ready to be put back into the game. Until he gets some brains, concussions aren't a concern.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}将植物向左推进而非啃食它们/r
/r
{FLAVOR}尽管他的黄金时代已然过去，机甲橄榄球僵尸时刻准备着回到比赛当中。即便是脑震荡也无法阻碍他赢得一些脑子。
向前推进草地上的植物。

original: {FLAVOR}Has tried to calculate the volume of his mathematically perfect cone, but he always ends up dreaming about brain π.
translation: {FLAVOR}他曾试图计算出自己头上那完美圆锥体的体积，但最终还是沉迷在脑子 π 当中。

original: His poly-polymer cone gives him twice the toughness of regular future zombie.
translation: 他的聚合物路障使他的防御力比普通未来僵尸高一倍。

original: {FLAVOR}Other zombies call him old-fashioned for being nostalgic for the year 2008.  It was a simpler time when brains were brains, zombies were zombies, and those punk plants kept to themselves.
translation: {FLAVOR}因为怀念 2008 年的那些日子，其他僵尸都称他为老古董。啊，那个时候，一切都是如此单纯，脑子就是脑子，僵尸就是僵尸，而那些植物，还是一如既往的废物。

original: His techno-bucket greatly increases his protection from damage.
translation: 他那富有科技感的铁桶让他非常耐打。

original: {FLAVOR}The force field gets its unique color from frequency harmonics and a liberal dose of purple paint.
translation: {FLAVOR}他头上的力场从频率谐波和自由剂量的紫色涂料中得到其独特的紫色。

original: Holo Head Zombie's head-mounted force field provides hyper-protection.
translation: 全息头僵尸脑袋上的力场为他提供了超乎寻常的保护。

original: Future zombies look good in red shirts. Future fact #23: Nothing bad happens to red shirts.
translation: 未来僵尸穿红色衣服还挺好看的嘛。当然啦，根据《未来守则》第 23 条，穿红衣服是“肯定”不会遭遇不测的。
普通的未来风连衣裤僵尸。

original: {FLAVOR}Sometimes Future Flag Zombie regrets having to be at the bleeding edge of zombie wave advancement technology.
translation: {FLAVOR}未来旗帜僵尸经常因被迫处在推动尸群前进的风口浪尖之上而后悔。

original: Marks the arrival of a huge future-proof "wave" of zombies.
translation: 标示着一“波”掌握未来的僵尸即将来袭

original: {FLAVOR}If you look carefully, you'll notice that Robo-Rally Zombie's flag is a sophisticated piece of hovertech combined with a stick.
translation: {FLAVOR}如果你仔细观察，你会发现机器集结僵尸的旗帜是空气悬浮器和一根棍子。

original: Robo-Rally Zombie and his flag marks the arrival of an above-average number of zombies.
translation: 机器集结僵尸与其旗帜标示着一群多于平均数目的僵尸即将来袭

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with arms/r
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}randomly burns tiles with laser eyes/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Bug Bot when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}The imp pilots of the Gargantuar Prime series are handpicked by Dr. Zomboss himself. They are the imp elite.  The small, the mean, and the fearless! But mostly the ones who can drive a stick shift.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用胳膊压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}随机使用激光眼燃烧一格地砖/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}受到一定伤害后扔出机器蛛虫/r
/r
{FLAVOR}擎天巨人僵尸驾驶位上的小鬼是由僵王博士亲自挑选的。他们是小鬼中的精英。既小，又卑鄙，还无所畏惧！但其实只是大多数僵尸都进不去驾驶室。

original: Has it all: heavy armor, laser eyes, smashing arms, and Bug Bot deployment system.
translation: 一应俱全：重型盔甲、激光眼、粉碎一切的手臂，还有机器蛛虫部署系统。

original: {FLAVOR}He always wanted to "see the world," "be his own boss," and "meet and consume interesting brains." He still doesn't understand how he got stuck in this cramped Bug Bot job 24/7.
translation: {FLAVOR}他总是想“看看外面的世界”、“做自己的老板”、“拥有有趣的灵魂”。但他至今仍不明白自己是怎么被困在这个拥挤不堪的机器蛛虫里 7 天 24 小时不停工作的。

original: Lands on the lawn past your defenses, then hops forward.
translation: 可以落到防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants, boosts over most other plants/r
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Tall blocking plants/r
/r
{FLAVOR}The Jetpack Zombie was an early adopter during the brain acquisition tech explosion of 2113. Little did he know he would be stuck with version 1.0 of the simple jetpack.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能飘过低矮植物，飞跃过绝大多数植物/r
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}高大的防御植物/r
/r
{FLAVOR}喷射器僵尸是 2113 年“脑子获取技术大爆炸”期间的早期新技术采用者。他一点也不知道他会被 1.0 版本的简单喷射背包卡住。

original: Boosts to float over all but the tallest plant barriers.
translation: 喷射气体并越过除最高那类植物以外的一切障碍。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants, boosts over most other plants/r
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Tall blocking plants/r
/r
{FLAVOR}A zombie who 'lives' for drama, he's an original cast member of the stage musical "Disco is BACK! For Revenge!" His signature dance move is "The Weed Whacker."
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能飘过低矮植物，飞跃过绝大多数植物/r
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}高大的防御植物/r
/r
{FLAVOR}一个为戏剧“活着”的僵尸，他是原创舞台剧《迪斯科回归！复仇！》的其中一位演员，他的招牌舞步是“一剪没”。

original: Boosts to float over all but the tallest plant barriers, in style.
translation: 喷射气体并以独特的姿态越过除最高那类植物以外的一切障碍。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants, boosts over most other plants/r
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}tall blocking plants/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Blastronaut's rocket-pack is strictly ornamental; his hovering ability comes from a deep meditative state and from being full of helium.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}飘过低矮植物，飞越绝大多数其他植物/r
{KEYWORD}弱点：{STAT}高大的防御植物/r
/r
{FLAVOR}航天员僵尸的火箭背包纯属装饰；他之所以可以悬浮，全靠深度的冥想与满肚子的氦气。

original: Blastronaut Zombie boosts to float over all but the tallest plants.
translation: 航天员僵尸喷射气体并越过除最高那类植物以外的一切障碍。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a shield to protect from incoming attacks/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Shield Zombie developed his system using funds from a BiteStarter campaign. The push goal for pushing plants was not met.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}创造一面护盾，抵挡袭来的攻击/r
/r
{FLAVOR}屏障僵尸利用来自“咬咬创客”的众筹资金开发了他的系统。但推动“推动植物”的目标没有实现。

original: Protect himself and nearby zombies with a force field.
translation: 用一幕强力的屏障保护自身及其周围的僵尸。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}shield regenerates over time/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Deflector Zombie saw what Shield Zombie was doing and said to himself, "BRAAAAAAINS," because that's really the only word zombies know.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}随着时间的推移重新生成护盾/r
/r
{FLAVOR}偏向器僵尸看到了护盾僵尸的行为后，自言自语了一声：“脑——子！”，因为这是僵尸唯一会说的词。

original: Deflector Zombie protects himself with a powerful force field that stretches across 5 rows.
translation: 偏向器僵尸可以用一个延伸到 5 行的能量立场保护自己与其他僵尸。

original: History records that Roman Caesar Zombie was a leader of impressive size and grandeur, looked up to by all his subjects.
translation: 据史料记载，罗马凯撒僵尸是位身材高大、威风凛凛的领袖，深受所有臣民的敬仰。

original: Roman Caesar Zombie tosses imperial salad dressing onto plants, making them irresistibly delicious to zombies. He also promotes Roman Zombies, giving them stronger helmets.
translation: 罗马凯撒僵尸可以向植物投掷帝国沙拉，让僵尸无法抗拒它们的美味。他还能提拔罗马僵尸，赐予他们更强大的头盔。

original: Cardio Zombie is all about health, healthiness and healthy lifestyles. He refuses to consume carbs, downing nothing but high-protein brains for every meal. In his opinion, other zombies really need to up their game. NO EXCUSES!
translation: 有氧运动僵尸只在乎健康、锻炼，还有绿色的生活方式。他拒绝摄入任何碳水，每顿饭只吃高蛋白的脑子。他觉得其他僵尸真的需要多注意一下这种东西。没有借口！

original: Advances to a set spot on the board, then tosses buffing brains at other zombies until he's chased away or retreats on his own.
translation: 可以前进到场地上的一个固定位置，然后向其他僵尸抛出富含胆固醇的脑子，直到他被打败或自己撤退为止。

original: Z-Mech is taking time out from his PvZ Heroes and PvZ Garden Warfare duties to bring his unique brand of destruction to Plants vs. Zombies 2. Don't worry, though; he's cleared it with his manager.
translation: Z 机甲专程从《植物大战僵尸：英雄》和《植物大战僵尸：花园战争》的工作里抽出时间，来向《植物大战僵尸 2》的世界展示自己独特的破坏风格。不必担心，他已经和自己的经理沟通过了。

original: Deploys a set of summoning and teleportation technologies to harass, damage and otherwise imperil plants on the board.
translation: 部署一整套可以召唤与传送僵尸的科技道具，袭扰、攻击场上的植物，对其造成威胁。

original: {FLAVOR}Cave Conehead Zombie was the first zombie to invent the cone. He lashed the horn of a mammoth to a slab of petrified wood ... and boom! A cone! The invention of the cone changed everything for the zombies. EVERYTHING.
translation: {FLAVOR}洞穴路障头僵尸是世界上第一只发明路障的僵尸。他把猛犸象的角和一块石化的木板绑了起来，然后“砰”！一个路障就此诞生了。路障的诞生标志着僵尸的崭新时代已然来临。

original: His mammoth horn cone makes him twice as tough as normal cave-dwellers.
translation: 他的猛犸象角路障使他的防御力比普通的洞穴僵尸高一倍。

original: {FLAVOR}Cave Buckethead Zombie likes rocks. He likes rocks A LOT. He strapped a rock to his head and called it a bucket. None of the other Cave Zombies know what a "bucket" is, but they like his style.
translation: {FLAVOR}洞穴铁桶头僵尸喜欢石头。超—级—喜欢。他把一块石头绑在头上，把它叫作“铁桶”。其他洞穴僵尸都不知道什么是“铁桶”，但他们喜欢他的命名风格。

original: His stone "bucket" hat provides great protection from damage.
translation: 他的石质“铁”桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}One day, a Cave Zombie fell head-first into a glacial stream. It had been a bad day already, so he lay there in the frigid water for a long time contemplating the insignificance of his life. When he finally stood up, he discovered that his head was encased in ice. At last, his life had meaning! He was unique! He was Blockhead Zombie! At least, that's his story and he's sticking to it.
translation: {FLAVOR}有一天，一只洞穴僵尸掉进了一条冰河里。这对于他来说是糟糕的一天，他躺在冰冷的水中很长一段时间，思考着他那毫无意义的生命。而当他站起来时，他发现自己的头被冰块包裹着。终于——他的生命终于有意义了！他成为了独一无二的冰块头僵尸！至少他自己是这么说的。

original: The ice block on his head provides amazing protection from damage.
translation: 他的头上的冰块可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}Cave Zombie was busy painting handprints on cave walls when he was told to start fighting plants. He's not sure why he's fighting plants, but he hopes he can get back to painting soon. He was feeling inspired. He had plans for some big pieces. Art school was finally paying off.
translation: {FLAVOR}植物战争爆发时，洞穴僵尸正在他的洞穴墙壁上画手印。他虽然不知道为什么要和植物打仗，但他希望能尽快回来完成他的作品。那时的他，思如泉涌。那时的他，胸有宏图。那时，在艺术学院的潜心苦学没有白费。

original: {FLAVOR}Dodo Rider believes dodos are the future of transportation. He believes a public dodo-riding system is not only a wise expenditure of tax dollars but would help the vast majority of zombies get where they need to go more efficiently. Everyone keeps telling him there's no future in dodos, but he refuses to listen.
translation: {FLAVOR}渡渡鸟骑手坚信渡渡鸟是未来的交通工具。他相信，搭建一个公共渡渡鸟骑乘系统是一种对纳税开支的明智手法，有助于绝大多数僵尸快速到达他们想到的地方。所有人一直在告诉他渡渡鸟没有未来，但他就是不听。

original: Dodo bird with an imp rider. The dodo can flap and jump over barricades as well as troublesome plants.
translation: 渡渡鸟僵尸有着一只小鬼作为骑手。渡渡鸟可以飞越障碍物与棘手的植物。

original: {FLAVOR}Cave Flag Zombie has been in the flag-carrying business for a long time. It's been his life's work. He's good at it. But sometimes, just sometimes, he longs for a change. He wonders if he could be good at something else. He wonders if he could leave it all behind and start fresh. He's pretty sure he's having a mid-life crisis.
translation: {FLAVOR}洞穴旗帜僵尸做扛旗工作很久了，已经成为了他一生的事业。他擅长这工作，但有时候（真的是有时）期望改变。他希望可以擅长其他的，希望可以把所有都抛开，开始休息。他十分确定他正在经历中年危机。

original: Marks the arrival of a huge frosty "wave" of zombies.
translation: 标示着一“波”冷若冰霜的僵尸即将随风而至。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with icicle/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Yeti Imps when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Somewhere along the line, Sloth Gargantuar contracted a bad case of Yeti Imps. He used soap, medicinal powders, and a salve made from sloth slobber in an attempt to get rid of them ... to no avail. But the truth is, he's grown used to their presence. The darn things are itchy. They're always squabbling. They nag him endlessly. But at this point, he'd probably miss them if they ever cleared up.
translation:
{KEYWORD}伤害：{STAT}用冰柱压扁植物
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出雪人小鬼/r
/r
{FLAVOR}某时某地，地懒巨人僵尸被一群雪人小鬼缠住了。他试过用肥皂、药粉，甚至是树懒口水制成的药膏，但结果都无济于事——他没有办法摆脱他们。不过现在他已经习惯了。虽然那些小鬼经常弄得他痒痒的，而且还从早到黑都在不停地吵架，有时候甚至还在他的背后说三道四，但如果有一天他们真的不见了，他估计会很想他们吧。

original: Massive sloth skinned zombie with a case of the imps. Carries and throws three imps instead of just one.
translation: 身着树懒皮的大型僵尸，肩负数只小鬼。相比其他巨人僵尸只有一只小鬼，他有三个。

original: {FLAVOR}Shhhhh ... Hunter Zombie didn't actually kill that sabertooth tiger. He found the skin at a thrift store. Also, he's a vegetarian. Tell no one.
translation: {FLAVOR}嘘……其实猎人僵尸根本没有杀死那只剑齿虎。那张皮只是他在一个旧货店里找到的罢了。不仅如此，他还是位素食主义者。好啦，别给其他人说。

original: Zombie that can throw snow balls at range to cool down plants until they freeze into blocks.
translation: 朝临近植物投掷雪球的僵尸，该行为持续至植物冻结为止。

original: {FLAVOR}Yeti Imp recently took up knitting. He started with a scarf, moved on to mittens and eventually knitted an entire bodysuit out of hair he shaved off of Yeti Zombie. He just loves knitting. When those needles are in his hands, he feels a sense of calm he's never felt before.
translation: {FLAVOR}雪人小鬼最近开始学习编织。他从一条围巾开始，然后是手套，最后甚至用雪人僵尸的毛发做了一整件的紧身衣。他喜欢编织，当针在他手中时，他能感到一种从未有过的平静感。

original: Thrown over most of your defenses, then ambles onward.
translation: 可以被甩到你的防线后排，然后缓缓前进。

original: {FLAVOR}Troglobite has been pushing ice blocks across the tundra day in and day out for as long as he can remember. It's cold and exhausting work, and frankly, he's ready for a vacation. He'd like to go somewhere sunny and warm for a change. He'd like to relax in the sand. He hears Big Wave Beach is nice this time of year.
translation: {FLAVOR}穴居僵尸从他能记事起，就在日复一日地把冰块推过冻土。这是份又冷又累的活。说真的，他想度个假。他想在一个晴朗又温暖的地方换换口味。他喜欢在沙子中放松。他还听说每年这个时候的巨浪海滩就是个不错的选择。

original: Strong zombie that can push blocks of ice across the lawn.
translation: 体魄强健的僵尸，能推动场上的冰块并向前行进。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases zombie ice weasels when damaged/r
{FLAVOR}Weasel Hoarder claims she's the one who wrote the song "Pop! Goes the Weasel." And for eons now, she's been demanding royalties for it. But everyone just ignores her. They know that Weasel Hoarder can't even carry a tune, much less write a catchy ditty about the sound vermin make when hugged a bit too tightly.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后放出冰鼬/r
{FLAVOR}囤鼬僵尸一直在声明《砰！冰鼬出来了。》这首歌是她写的。千百年来，她一直在申请自己的版权费，但是没有僵尸理她。他们知道囤鼬僵尸不可能会写歌，更不可能写出一首朗朗上口的歌，一首关于抱得太紧而发出的声音的歌。

original: Zombie hiding in a log with a pack of snow weasels. Weasels are released when her log is shattered.
translation: 这只僵尸和一群冰鼬一起挤在原木里。只要她的原木碎掉，冰鼬就会跑出来。

original: Once released, weasels run full speed even over ice floes to nibble your brains.
translation: 一旦释放，冰鼬就会全速前进，越过浮冰去吃掉你的脑子。

original: They carry no memory of the zombie they’d been before.
translation: 它们没有一点变成小鬼之前的记忆。

original: Zombies converted into Imps by Imp Pear become Imp Pear Imps./r
translation: 由小鬼梨转化而成的小鬼被称作“小鬼梨小鬼”。/r
在关卡内替换 {ZOMBIE} 只僵尸！

original: No one ever presumes that he’s Dr. Unlivingstone. Just once, though, he wishes that someone would.
translation: 从来没有人设想过他是死利文斯通博士。他多希望有人会这样想啊，哪怕只有一次。

original: His expedition cone makes him twice as tough as normal adventurers.
translation: 他用来考察的路障使他的防御力比普通冒险家僵尸高一倍。

original: Buckethead Adventurer’s greatest discovery was that one morning, without warning or reason, there was a bucket on his head.
translation: 铁桶头冒险家僵尸最大的发现是，一顶铁桶于某日清晨毫无征兆地出现在了他的头顶。

original: His rugged bucket provides considerable protection from damage.
translation: 他那结实的铁桶提供了使他免于受伤的可靠保护。

original: Bug Zombie and Bug make a great team, partly because Bug gives Bug Zombie great mobility, but mostly because they share an intense disinterest in horses.
translation: 昆虫僵尸和他们的昆虫是一组很棒的团队。一方面昆虫能给予昆虫僵尸很快的速度，但更多的原因是昆虫僵尸答应以后带它们去看它们感兴趣的马。

original: Bug carries zombie in over ground defenses and lifts him over barriers.
translation: 昆虫可以带僵尸越过你的防线和较矮的屏障。

original: Unlike the more famous crystal skulls, turquoise skulls are totally non-mysterious and common as dirt.
translation: 与更著名的水晶头骨不同，绿松石头骨完全不神秘，而且就和泥土一样常见。

original: Uses skull to steal sun, then unleashes energy in a destructive beam.
translation: 使用手中的头骨窃取阳光，然后释放带有破坏性的能量光束。

original: Adventurer Zombie just went looking for a jolly good show, and somehow ended up in the Lost City. “Hmm. Yes. Quite.” is all that he would say on the matter.
translation: 冒险家僵尸试图寻找一个令僵愉快的好节目，并以某种方式离开失落之城。“嗯，没错。差不多。“他的节目表演完了。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}blocks incoming projectiles, but is vulnerable to lobbed shots/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Excavator Zombie once heard a song about having a hammer. He liked the idea, but decided it was too mainstream for him – so he got a shovel. Now he’s confident that he’s clearly the coolest zombie, the others are just too jealous to admit it.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}阻挡袭来的子弹，但对投掷攻击脆弱/r
/r
{FLAVOR}发掘者僵尸听过一首关于拿着锤子的歌。他很喜欢这个主意，但是觉得对他来说太主流了，所以他拿了把铲子。现在他很确信自己就是最炫的僵尸，他人只是嫉妒得不想承认。

original: Digs up plants and throws them behind him.
translation: 挖起植物并朝自己身后抛掷。

original: Flag Adventurer Zombie is always shouting "Tally ho!" as he leads the charge. At least, he's shouting it in his head.
translation: 旗帜冒险家僵尸在带队的时候总喜欢大喊大叫：“呜呼！”呃，至少他是在脑子里面喊的。

original: Marks the arrival of an intrepid “wave” of zombies.
translation: 标示着一“波”勇敢无畏的僵尸即将来袭。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lost City Imp when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Porter Gargantuar dreams of the discovery that will make him powerful and influential. Maybe then the Imps will be the one carrying him around. It's always nice to have dreams.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后投掷失落之城小鬼/r
/r
{FLAVOR}脚夫巨人僵尸做梦都想找到一个能使自己强大、为世人瞩目的发现。到时候，就会是小鬼背着他走来走去了。有梦总是好的。
恐怖的庞然大物，胸中激荡着对探索的怒求。

original: Imp Porter is stronger than he looks. He’s also more charming, smarter and has a better education.
translation: 小鬼脚夫可比他看起来聪明得多。他更有魅力，更聪明，还受过更好的教育。

original: Drops pack on Gold Tile; pack becomes tent from which zombies emerge.
translation: 可以把自己的包袱放到黄金地砖上；然后变成帐篷，僵尸会从帐篷里出来。

original: {FLAVOR}Nepotism got Lost City Imp where he is. He’s Bug Zombie’s second cousin thrice removed, but he parlayed that connection into a sweet gig getting carried around in a little box.
translation: {FLAVOR}失落之城小鬼是靠裙带关系才到达现在的位置的。他是昆虫僵尸太爷爷的另一个曾孙，相隔三代。他利用这份关系，获得了一份清闲的工作——被装在小箱子里到处背着走。

original: Gets tossed past most defenses, then explores on foot.
translation: 越过你的大部分防御，然后徒步探索。

original: Wealthy beyond reason, the Parasol Zombie lived a life of luxury – when what she craved was a life of adventure. She funded the expedition to the Lost City and set out to see its wonders for herself, never forgetting to bring her trusty parasol. “In case it rains,” she explained – but it only came out sounding like “Brains.”
translation: 阳伞僵尸过着奢华的生活——而她渴望的却是冒险生活。她资助了对失落之城的考察，开始亲眼看到失落之城的奇观，而且从来没忘记过带上她值得信赖的阳伞。“万一下雨了呢，”她解释道——然而她说话听起来只会像是“脑子”。

original: Parasol provides protection from lobbed projectiles.
translation: 阳伞提供了免受投掷物伤害的保护。

original: He faked his pilot's license and figured nobody would notice. But they did.
translation: 他伪造了飞行员执照，以为没人会注意到。但僵尸个个都看得清清楚楚。
在你的后部防御中落下。

original: Relic Hunter has hunted some pretty impressive relics in his day. Idols, antiques, curios... he’s hunted 'em all.
translation: 在他那个时代，古物搜寻僵尸就已经找到一些很棒的遗迹了。里面有一些古董、古玩……他全给拿走了。
会将自己甩到你的后部防御。

original: {FLAVOR}Given the rarity of traffic in the jungle, it’s a mystery how Conehead Adventurer managed to acquire his headgear. Maybe he ordered it online?
translation: {FLAVOR}考虑到丛林中交通困难，路障头冒险家僵尸怎么获得他的帽子还是个谜。也许是网上订的？

original: His makeshift cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal explorer zombie.
translation: 他的临时路障使他的防御力比普通探险家僵尸高一倍。

original: {FLAVOR}Armed with his sturdy kettle and even sturdier moustache, Kettlehead Adventurer is ready to ruin your day and possibly make a stew.
translation: {FLAVOR}他脑袋上有两个奇葩——他那结实的水壶，和他那结实胡子。它俩合在一起，绝对可以让你美好的一天当场碎成渣，然后被放进水壶里炖碗汤。

original: His kettle-bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
translation: 他的水壶铁桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

original: Bug Zombie and Bug make a great team, partly because Bug gives Bug Zombie great mobility, but mostly because they share an intense disinterest in horses.
translation: 昆虫僵尸和他们的昆虫是一组很棒的团队。一方面昆虫能给予昆虫僵尸很快的速度，但更多的原因是昆虫僵尸答应以后带它们去看它们感兴趣的马。

original: Bug carries zombie in over ground defenses and lifts him over barriers.
translation: 昆虫可以带僵尸越过你的防线和较矮的屏障。

original: {FLAVOR}Adventurer Zombie was certain he was the first to rediscover the Lost City. He was less certain after he ran into another 50 Adventurer Zombies at the gift shop.
translation: {FLAVOR}冒险家僵尸一直坚信他是第一只发现失落之城的僵尸。直到他在礼品店又遇到了 50 只冒险家僵尸。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lost City Imp when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Porter Gargantuar actually provided the bulk of the funding for the expedition. And most of the bulk all around, come to think of it.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出失落之城小鬼/r
/r
{FLAVOR}实际上，脚夫巨人僵尸为这次探险提供的大部分资金。想想看，周围大部分都是这样。
恐怖的庞然大物，胸中激荡着对探索的怒求。

original: {FLAVOR}Nepotism got Lost City Imp where he is. He’s Bug Zombie’s second cousin thrice removed, but he parlayed that connection into a sweet gig getting carried around in a little box.
translation: {FLAVOR}失落之城小鬼是靠裙带关系才到达现在的位置的。他是昆虫僵尸太爷爷的另一个曾孙，相隔三代。他利用这份关系，获得了一份清闲的工作——被装在小箱子里到处背着走。

original: Gets tossed past most defenses, then explores on foot.
translation: 越过你的大部分防御，然后徒步探索。

original: Parasol Zombie desperately wants to get to the opera before the curtain rises. She’s not going to make it, though, because it’s thousands of miles away on another continent.
translation: 阳伞僵尸拼命想赶在大幕升起之前赶到歌剧院，但她不可能做到的，因为歌剧院在千里之外、另一块大陆上。

original: Parasol provides protection from lobbed projectiles.
translation: 阳伞提供了免受投掷物伤害的保护。

original: {FLAVOR}Zombie engineers considered the orange cone the height of zombie protective technology. It wasn't until they perfected the design for the Robo-Cone that someone remembered the bucket.
translation: {FLAVOR}僵尸工程师认为橙色的路障是僵尸防护技术的最高点。直到他们完成了机器路障的设计，他们才想起来还有铁桶这个东西。

original: The armor-plated cone offers phenomenal protection for its pilot.
translation: 盔甲锥为它的驾驶员提供了不错的保护。

original: All-Star Zombie is a third-round draft pick and shows a lot of promise, but come on, his salary demands are beyond ridiculous. Ten million brains per year? For FIFTY YEARS?
translation: 全明星僵尸是第三轮僵尸选秀中的热门人选，并有很大的潜力胜出。但是他的期望薪资实在是太离谱了。每年一百万个脑子？还要持续 50 年？

original: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line.
translation: 一只可以冲破你防线的健硕僵尸。

original: Balloon zombie has no idea where the balloon came from, but he's going with it and he's open to seeing where it takes him.
translation: 气球僵尸不知道气球是哪里来的，不过他会跟着那气球。他很乐意看看气球会把他带到哪里。

original: Balloon carries zombies over barriers and ground defenses.
translation: 气球可以带僵尸飞过你的防线。

original: You can't really blame him for getting so upset; he was THIS close to finishing the crossword (23 down was "Brains.")
translation: 因为报纸坏掉而生气真不是他小题大做。他就差那么一点点就可以顺利完成那报纸上的填字游戏了（第 23 行从上往下应该填 “BRAINS”）

original: Newspaper protects zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
translation: 报纸可以保护他，而如果报纸被打坏，他就会生气

original: Super-Fan Imp has season tickets, subscribes to the team newsletter, and is super pumped about exploding on contact with fans of the opposing team.
translation: 超球迷小鬼每次季票都不会放过，还会订阅球队资讯。而在与敌方球队球员接触时反应会很强烈。

original: An all-too-enthusiastic imp who explodes with rah-rah-rah fervor.
translation: 一只对球队无穷、无尽、无比热情，热情到爆——爆炸的小鬼。

original: {FLAVOR}Conehead Mummy Zombie prefers the circular cone shape over the typical pyramid shape. It's a fashion thing, and Conehead Mummy Zombie always stays ahead of fashion.
translation: {FLAVOR}路障头木乃伊僵尸更喜欢圆锥形而非金字塔形。这在当时可时尚了，他总是喜欢走在时尚最前线。

original: His cobra cone headdress makes him twice as tough as normal mummies.
translation: 他的眼镜蛇路障使他的防御力比普通木乃伊僵尸高一倍。

original: {FLAVOR}Buckethead Mummy Zombie graduated Magna Zom Louder from Zombie Academy where he learned to utilize his diaphragm during groaning lessons.
translation: {FLAVOR}铁桶头木乃伊僵尸毕业于僵尸学院。在那儿他学会了用横膈膜呻吟。

original: His sandy bucket greatly protects him from damage.
translation: 他的沙漠铁桶保护他免受外界伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}Pyramid-Head Zombie isn't aware that his pyramid is pyramid-shaped. He's a little slow in that respect.
translation: {FLAVOR}金字塔头僵尸的反应有些迟钝，就比如他不知道他的金字塔是金字塔形状的。

original: His pyramid-shaped headgear provides triangular noggin protection.
translation: 他的金字塔形状头饰提供了如三角形般稳定性的防御。

original: {FLAVOR}Is he a mummy? Is he a zombie? It turns out he's a zombie who's rolled himself in toilet paper to protect his fair skin. True fact!
translation: {FLAVOR}他是木乃伊还是僵尸？答案是：他是只裹着厕纸的僵尸。之所以要这样，是因为他想要保护自己那白皙的皮肤。真相果然只有一个！

original: {FLAVOR}Egyptian Flag Zombie is so far behind he thinks he's in first place. He's clearly living in de-Nile.
translation: {FLAVOR}埃及旗帜僵尸虽然落后，但是他永远认为自己是第一名。很明显，他住在尼罗河畔。

original: Marks the arrival of a huge sandy "wave" of zombies.
translation: 标示着一“波”僵尸即将随黄沙而来。

original: {FLAVOR}Sometimes, a regular Flag Mummy Zombie simply isn't enough to inspire the desired amount of terror and disgust. In these instances, upgrading to the Egypt Rally Zombie isn't the sensible choice, it's the only choice.
translation: {FLAVOR}有时候，普通的旗帜木乃伊僵尸并不足以激起足够的恐惧和厌恶。在这般情况下，把事情推到埃及集结僵尸身上并不算是一个明智的选择，但这也是唯一的选择。

original: He celebrates with increased vigor and truculence the arrival of a new wave of bandaged baddies.
translation: 他标志着非常非常多的木乃伊僵尸即将来袭。

original: {FLAVOR}Sunday Edition Zombie REALLY loves the comics section, which is why his rage is so all-consuming when it is torn to tatters before he's finished reading it.
translation: {FLAVOR}周日版报纸僵尸真的很喜欢里面的漫画部分。怪不得在他还没读完的时候给他打破他会那么生气。

original: The newspaper protects zombie, who becomes enraged when it is destroyed.
translation: 报纸可以保护他，而如果报纸被打坏，他就会生气

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}Crushes most nut plants with Nut Chopping action!/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Will have to recharge after each Nut Chop./r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Nut Chop can be disabled if the Wind up key is removed or destroyed/r
/r
{FLAVOR}He was created by Dr. Zomboss to be the nemesis of Wallnut and his kin, but all Nutcracker wanted was to “crack” jokes... too bad he's "nut" so good at it
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}可以快速夹碎大多数的坚果类植物！/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}每夹一次都需要时间来恢复。/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}只要拿掉、摧毁掉发条，他就不能再夹坚果了。/r
/r
{FLAVOR}胡桃夹子僵尸本是僵王博士造出来当作坚果家族的克星的，结果他满脑子想着的却怎么说一口好听的夹子音……然鹅他讲得吼像有一点点“坚难”捏。

original: Nutcracker Zombie can make short work of Nut plants as well as some Wall-like plants.
translation: 胡桃夹子僵尸可以快速解决掉坚果类，以及一些其他的防御类植物。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants/r
/r
{FLAVOR}The Pelican Zombie upgraded from the Seagull Zombie and has no regrets. No egrets, either. Just a pelican.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}掠过低矮植物/r
/r
{FLAVOR}鹈鹕僵尸是海鸥僵尸的升级版，毕竟乌鹊南飞，虽然没有乌鹊，因为他就是个鹈鹕。

original: Pelican Zombie crosses water without a plank and flies over low plants.
translation: 鹈鹕僵尸飞越没有甲板的水路，同时掠过低矮植物。

original:
{KEYWORD}Speed Details: {STAT}moves like a hungry zombie once free/r
/r
{FLAVOR}The second cousin once removed of King Rot, he rose to power with his disappearing sarcophagus act, but met his untimely end in an unfortunate goat accident. His tale is told in great detail on the back of his sarcophagus, which no one will ever see.
translation:
{KEYWORD}速度细节：{STAT}解除封印后会如饿尸般行动/r
/r
{FLAVOR}在罗特国王的第二个堂兄被撤职后，他凭借《消失的石棺法案》取得了权力。但在一次出行中，他不幸被山羊撞下悬崖，早早地结束了自己年轻的生命。他的所有故事都记录在他的石棺后面，但似乎没有任何人能看到。

original: His sarcophagus greatly protects him but slows down a rather fast zombie.
translation: 他的石棺给予了他超高的防御，却大幅限制了他的速度。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with piano/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}causes cowboy zombies to switch lanes/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Pianist Zombie only knows two songs, and they're both groaners.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用钢琴压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}使牛仔僵尸换行/r
/r
{FLAVOR}钢琴僵尸只会两首歌，而且这两首都只是哼哼地呻吟。

original: His rolling piano crushes plants while his music causes dancing zombies to switch lanes.
translation: 他那架前进的钢琴会压扁植物，还能奏起使僵尸起舞换行的音乐。

original: {FLAVOR}Conehead Pirate is a simple zombie. When asked what his favorite dish is, he'd think for a moment, straighten his ascot, and say, "Rrurrarrbrains." Perhaps he could borrow a cup, neighbor?
translation: {FLAVOR}路障头海盗只是一只平凡的僵尸。当你问他最喜欢的菜是什么时，他会想很长一段时间，然后整理一下他的领带，然后说：“液体脑子。”邻居，他能从你这里借一杯吗？

original: His Jolly Roger cone makes him twice as tough as normal pirates.
translation: 他的骨头路障使他的防御力比普通海盗僵尸高一倍。

original: {FLAVOR}Buckethead Pirate Zombie is looking for his bucket. Have you seen it? It's where? Up where? Speak up, he can't hear you.
translation: {FLAVOR}铁桶头海盗僵尸正在找他的桶。你有看到他的桶吗？在哪儿？大声点儿，他听不到！

original: His sturdy wooden bucket provides excellent protection from damage.
translation: 他结实的木桶可以帮助他很好地抵御伤害。

original: {FLAVOR}Dredged from the deepest of seas, Barrelhead Zombie's barrel is a high-quality cask that fits just a bit too snugly.
translation: {FLAVOR}酒桶头僵尸的酒桶是从深海中挖出来的，质量很高，就是有点太贴身了。

original: Barrelhead Zombie's keg-like hat provides augmented protection.
translation: 酒桶头僵尸的桶状头饰提供了额外的头部防御。

original: {FLAVOR}What could it be? Could it be gold? Or some sort of other kind of treasure?  Who knows!
translation: {FLAVOR}里面有什么呢？金子？宝藏？谁知道呢！

original: Contains Imp Zombies that launch out when destroyed.
translation: 被摧毁时会发射里面装着的小鬼僵尸。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}parrot pet steals plants/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Pirate Captain Zombie isn't actually a captain.  His dry cleaning got mixed up with someone else's, but he thought he looked cool with an eye patch.  Plus, the parrot already knew his name, so he just went with it.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}鹦鹉能偷走植物/r
/r
{FLAVOR}海盗船长僵尸并不是个真正的船长。他干洗的衣帽和别人的弄混了，但他觉得自己戴着眼罩很酷，就没还回去。此外，这个鹦鹉也认识他，所以就跟着他走了。

original: His parrot can fly away with your plant and then return to him.
translation: 他的鹦鹉能在带走你的植物以后再次飞回他身上。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can fly to plants in other lanes to carry them away/r
/r
{FLAVOR}He's a third generation aviation revolutionary. He wants to serve his pirate brethren like his father and his grandmother, Salty Anne, before him.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}能带走位于其他列的植物/r
/r
{FLAVOR}他是第三代飞行革命家。他想要服侍他的海盗同胞，就像他的父亲和祖母“咸安妮女王”一样。

original: Quickly flies from the Captain to carry away a plant.
translation: 迅速从船长身边飞走，带走一株植物。

original: {FLAVOR}Keeping up with the latest pirate trends is always tricky, but remember, he was planking before it was cool.
translation: {FLAVOR}跟进最新的海盗潮流总是很棘手，不过记住，他早在“木板趴”变得潮起来之前，就已经开始趴着了。

original: Marks the arrival of a huge salty "wave" of zombies.
translation: 标示着一“波”僵尸即将随着咸潮上溯而来袭。

original: {FLAVOR}Jolly Roger Zombie and his flag are fused together into a single brain-munching unit. Their teamwork is an inspiration to ghouls everywhere.
translation: {FLAVOR}海盗旗僵尸和他的旗帜可以完全融合成食脑军团。那旗子可以鼓舞各地的僵尸。

original: Jolly Roger Zombie marks the arrival of lots and lots of zombies.
translation: 海盗旗僵尸标示着非常非常多的僵尸即将来袭。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with shark/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Pirate Imp when damaged/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Gargantuar Pirate likes short walks off the plank, moonlit raiding parties, and the smell of cannon fire. A true romantic.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用鲨鱼压扁植物/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}在受到一定伤害后扔出海盗小鬼/r
/r
{FLAVOR}巨人海盗僵尸喜欢在叫甲板上散一小会儿步，喜欢看月光之下的突击队，喜欢闻闻炮火的气味。真是一个浪漫主义者。

original: Enormous zombie who redefines the shark attack.
translation: 巨大的僵尸，重新定义了鲨鱼袭击。

original: {FLAVOR}He was a bootblack, with a side trade as a pickpocket on the streets of London, but all he stole were oversized footwear. "Time to steal some booty!" was his catchphrase.
translation: {FLAVOR}他是一个擦皮鞋的，兼职伦敦街扒手，但是他偷的都是大号的鞋子。他的口头禅是“是时候偷些战利鞋了！”。

original: Prefers the compact space of barrels, both cannon and rolling.
translation: 喜欢呆在紧凑的空间内，比如炮管和滚桶。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}randomly wears a protective metal grate/r
/r
{FLAVOR}The grate is his most prized possession. The poncho is there just to protect it from getting rusty. Also, he's looking for his mechanical horse.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}随机携带金属壁炉/r
/r
{FLAVOR}他身上的壁炉是他最珍贵的财产。斗篷只是为了让那东西不生锈。同时，他还在寻找自己丢失的机械马。

original: Sometimes has a hidden armored plate.
translation: 有时候会携带一只铁板盔甲。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}appears on the left side of the lawn after dynamite explodes/r
/r
{FLAVOR}"There once was a zombie who got old, spending all his days looking for gold.  'Til one day in the rain, he finally ate brains... and, wait, where's his other shoe?"
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}雷管爆炸时可以出现在草坪的另一端/r
/r
{FLAVOR}“从前有个僵尸，整天都在找金子，一直找到老。终于，他在一个雨天吃到了脑子……等等，他的另一只鞋呢？”

original: Launches over your defenses when his fuse burns down.
translation: 雷管的引线烧尽时会越过你的防线。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}Insta-kills most ground plants with its Kick attack.
{KEYWORD}Armor: {STAT}Negates damage from Filamint family which is insulated by it’s raincoat.
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Filamint family damage is effective once the raincoat is shredded.

{FLAVOR}When not raiding the lawns, Raincoat Zombie can always be found raiding the clothing stores around the town. Doesn’t matter if it fits, if it's yellow and brand new, it is good enough. Dr. Zomboss has saved loads of money on laundry since Raincoat Zombie never repeats a raincoat it has worn. The only issue is that not all of them fit Raincoat Zombie. “If it's yellow and new, then it doesn't matter and it will do.” said Raincoat Zombie, admiring itself in the mirror.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}用脚猛踢，瞬间消灭绝大多数陆生植物。
{KEYWORD}盔甲：{STAT}雨衣绝缘，可以抵抗电荷家族的伤害。
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}雨衣破损后，电荷家族即可造成伤害。

{FLAVOR}在入侵草坪以外的休息时间，雨衣僵尸喜欢去入侵小镇里的服装店。无论合不合身，只要颜色是黄色的，成色是全新的，它都能接受。正因如此，雨衣僵尸每次都只穿新衣服，穿过的坚决不碰，给僵王博士省了一大笔洗衣费。而唯一的问题，可能就只有不合身了。看着镜中帅气的自己，雨衣僵尸说：“是大是小，只要颜色对、没穿过就好。”

original: Raincoat Zombie kicks off ground plants and resist damage from Filamint family plants.
translation: 雨衣僵尸可以踢走陆生植物，并且抵抗来自电荷家族植物的攻击。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tries to steal sun/r
/r
{FLAVOR}Ra Zombie isn't actually named after the Sun God Ra, though that's a common mistake. He just likes to say “Ra” a lot.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}试图偷走阳光/r
/r
{FLAVOR}太阳神僵尸虽然叫“太阳神”，但他和“太阳神·拉”并没有任何关系。他只是经常“拉拉拉”地叫，并且喜欢太阳罢了。

original: Tries to steal sun, just for safe keeping.
Was there enough traffic in Ancient Rome to justify cones? Historians differ. It's a real debate.
translation: 古罗马时期的交通真的有必要用到路障吗？历史学家莫衷一是。真是场无休止的争论…

original: A traffic cone made of marble provides some protection.
translation: 一个由大理石制成的路障为它提供了一些保护。

original: They had buckets just like this back in Ancient Rome. Believe it.
translation: 他们古罗马时期就已经有这种桶了。可别不信。

original: A fancy bucket with a bit of flair distinguishes this zombie.
translation: 一个花哨的桶外加一点艺术天赋，让这只僵尸与众不同。

original: Did you know that in Ancient Rome, a centurion commanded a century? Isn't that wild?
translation: 你知道吗？在古罗马，一位百夫长能指挥百夫。是不是很野？

original: A higher grade of Roman Zombie.
translation: 一种更高级别的罗马僵尸。

original: Bust Head Zombie belongs in museum with a big sign that says something like, "WARNING: THIS IS A ZOMBIE!"
translation: 胸像头僵尸应当被放置在博物馆内，并且有一个大标语，上面写着“警告：这是一只僵尸！”

original: A bust head means this Roman zombie can take a serious beating.
translation: 头上的胸像意味着这只罗马僵尸很抗打。

original: Surprise! That exploding vase has a zombie in it! Isn’t that surprising?
translation: 那会个爆炸的花瓶里，居然有只僵尸！惊不惊喜，意不意外？

original: A ballista from Ancient Rome, the Zcorpion Zombie launches an exploding vase at the nearest plant in its lane.
translation: 来自古罗马的投石机，投石机僵尸会向所在行内最近植物发射会爆炸的花瓶。
他并不明白“十一抽杀”是什么意思。
你的普通罗马军团僵尸。

original: In Ancient Rome, flags were often used on the battlefield to direct troop movements. Though come on: how much direction do you really need to shuffle leftward?
translation: 在古罗马，旗帜常用来在战场中指挥军队行动的方向。虽然但是……僵尸反正都是向左走，真的还需要指挥吗？

original: The flag indicates more zombies are on their way!

{FLAVOR}农场主和农民拖着自己煞白的脸，纷纷弃田而去。只见小径尘土飞扬，牛车隆隆作响。它的诞生，就是为了将恐惧送到每个种植者的心中。不到万不得已，僵王博士不会冒险使用这台机器，但这一次，他破例了。

original: The stagecoach of destruction from the western wilds.
translation: 来自荒原西部的毁灭战车。

original:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fire breathing attacks destroy plants/r
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbed fireballs can hatch Imp Dragon Zombies/r
/r
{FLAVOR}With a rumble of destruction, Dr. Zomboss forged his Dark Dragon in the heart of a volcano. Then he tempered the beast in the chilled waters of Doom Lake. Finally  he fed its furnace with coal from the Mines of Morbidity. And the paint job - that was done by Carl.
translation:
{KEYWORD}攻击：{STAT}可以喷出火焰摧毁植物/r
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}投出的火球可以生成小鬼龙僵尸/r
/r
{FLAVOR}轰隆一声巨响，僵王博士在火山中心创造了这条黑龙；之后，他在毁灭之湖的刺骨冷水中驯服了这头野兽；最后，再用多疾矿洞的煤炭喂满它的熔炉。至于绘图工作嘛——那是卡尔完成的。

original: The desolator of all, from dark times.
translation: 化世间的一切为荒芜虚空，来自那黑暗的时代。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons dinosaurs/r
/r
{FLAVOR}With flagrant disregard for temporal tidiness and simple good taste, Dr. Zomboss figured it would be a good idea to build a big metal dinosaur.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}召唤恐龙/r
/r
{FLAVOR}带着对时间整齐度的公然漠视以及自己的好品味，僵王博士觉得建造一只大型金属恐龙是个好主意。

original: A mechanical means of dinosaurian destruction.
translation: 恐龙的威力，机械的身躯。
狮身终结者僵尸机器人

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attack can create tombstones/r
/r
{FLAVOR}To add that extra bit of wickedness to the Sphinx-inator Dr. Zomboss chiseled his creation from the stonework of cursed tombs. You should not take this instance of reuse and recycle to mean he's going green. The only thing green about him is his tongue.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}大炮攻击后，会创造出坟墓/r
/r
{FLAVOR}为了给狮身终结者增添几分邪恶的感觉，僵王博士用被诅咒的墓碑雕刻出了他的作品。但是，别看他现在回收再利用，他其实一点都不环保。别听信他的鬼话。

original: The destroyer of plants from the ancient sands.
translation: 来自古老沙场的植物毁灭者。
狂舞碎灭者僵尸机器人

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speakers do passive damage (except to ground plants and Phat Beet) and send out shockwave attacks/r
/r
{FLAVOR}In another world, in another time, Dr. Zomboss would receive the bounty of enthusiastic applause that is his due. Not here and now, though. Nope.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}扬声器可以造成被动伤害（除了地底植物和节拍甜菜），还会发出冲击波攻击/r
/r
{FLAVOR}在另一个世界、另一个时间，僵王博士也许能够得到他应得的热烈掌声。不过不是现在，绝对不是。

original: An intimate evening with some of Dr. Zomboss’ most recent and painful explorations.
translation: 僵王博士会在这个激动僵心的夜晚让你感受痛苦。
明日破译者僵尸机器人

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can destroy Power Tiles/r
/r
{FLAVOR}When Dr. Zomboss is nestled into the comfy folds of his futuristic cerebral control pod he almost finds it hard to be evil. Of course once he sees a lawn full of happy plants that puts him right back where he needs to be, hungry and evil.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}导弹攻击可以摧毁能量地砖/r
/r
{FLAVOR}当僵王博士依偎在控制仓中那舒适、如脑子般的褶皱中时，他甚至都不想再邪恶下去了。当然，他一看到草坪上种满了快乐的植物，顿时兴致全无，回到了弥漫着饥饿与邪恶的归属之中。

original: The Power Tile crushing creation from the Far Future.
translation: 能量地砖毁灭器，遥远未来荣誉出品
獠牙驯服者 10000 BC 僵尸机器人

original: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss was real impressed with himself when he came up with the idea to build a weaponized woolly mammoth with the power to blast snow and ice out of its mechanical trunk. But what Dr. Zomboss didn’t realize until it was too late: He’s allergic to mammoth fur. Now he has to load up on allergy medication every time he wants to take the darn thing out for a spin.
translation: {FLAVOR}僵王博士还清晰地记得他是怎么想到要创造一个可以喷雪的机械猛犸象的。但当他想起自己对猛犸象的毛过敏时，一切都太晚了。现在，他每想出去溜溜这家伙，都得吃很多的抗过敏药。

original: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past.
translation: 来自冰河时代的机械猛犸象。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT} drops zombies and bags o’ sand/r
/r
{FLAVOR}After repeated failures with variously robotic engines of destruction, Dr. Zomboss decided to go with a kinder, more eco-friendly lighter-than-air option to sow disaster and discord.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT} 扔下僵尸以及沙袋/r
/r
{FLAVOR}在经历了无数次因机器人被破坏而失败的不堪后，僵王博士决定采用一种更友好、更环保，比空气更轻的手段来制造各种灾难和混乱。

original: The floating fortress from the skies above.

translation: 甲板踏行者僵尸机器人

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses/r
/r
{FLAVOR}"Hoist the mizzenmast, batten down the hatches! 15 zombies on a dead man's boat, yo ho ho and a bucket of brains!" Dr. Zomboss had to admit he was really getting into this whole pirate thing. Though he never thought he'd be on a boat on a boat.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}小鬼炮能发射出穿越防线的小鬼雨/r
/r
{FLAVOR} “吊起桅，甲板放北！十五只僵尸朝你飞！做得好，赏有一桶脑！” 僵王博士必须承认他已经沉迷于海盗生活了。不过他做梦都没想自己会在一艘船上再开一辆船。

original: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas.
translation: 在公海掠劫植物的私掠船。

original:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Spawns waves of Roman Zombies that serve both as shields and swords.
 
{FLAVOR}They said some things just don't go together. Oil and Water. Ice and Fire. Zombies and Brainz. But Dr. Zomboss always manages to make the impossible possible. Just look at all the latest cutting edge widgets and gadgets he manages to cram into one mech. A twin turbo V-Imp motor. A 6 cornu sound system. An independent plant crushing 4 wheel suspension.
He definitely blew through his entire year's food budget on this one. 
This would explain why his minions are always out looking for Brainz.
translation:
{KEYWORD}特殊：{STAT}生成一波又一波的罗马僵尸，它们进可如利剑般进攻，退可如盾牌般防守。

{FLAVOR}人们觉得：“冰火相克，水油不溶。僵尸食脑，千载难逢”。而僵王博士，总是能化不可能为可能。瞧，他能把这一系列尖端组件、最新工具塞进一台机甲中，就是最好的证明。里面有一对双涡轮“微鬼”电机，一组 6 角复古音响系统，还有 4 个悬挂式轮胎来碾压植物。
只能说，他肯定把整年的伙食费都搭在这上面了。
怪不得他的手下天天都得出门找脑子吃。

original: {EVENTNAME} is about to end! Come play!
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Mwahaha! Welcome foolish mortals to your doom.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哇哈哈！愚蠢的凡人，欢迎来到你们的末日。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Tonight my minions and I will feast on your brainz.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}今天我和我的随从们，会尽情享用你们的脑子。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Are you here for trick or treat? All I have is tacos but thats my feast...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}你们是来“不给脑子就捣蛋”的吗？我只有玉米卷，不过得我先享用…

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Silence and prepare youselves for a spine-chilling encounter.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}肃静，准备面对自己那令人背脊发凉的遭遇吧。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Looks like Zomboss is up to no good again.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}看起来僵王又在想坏点子了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Does it have to be tonight? I wasn't planning on facing these undead creepers.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}就非得今晚吗？我不想面对这些古灵精怪的不死军团。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper}{SAY:ghostpepper}Boo! I am here to ghost-bust those zombies with some spectral spice.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper}{SAY:ghostpepper}唬！我来用自己的幽魂香料，“鬼捉敢死队”。

original: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}Holy creepers! Stop sneaking up on me man, I am on your team.
translation: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}我天！别这样突然出现吓我啊，我们是一队的。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curses! My haunted plans turned into pumpkin patch!.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}呸！我的鬼点子变成南瓜籽了。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}But mark my words puny mortals, next time my tricks will get the treatz!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}不过记住，卑微的凡人，下次我的点子绝不只是捣捣蛋。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}That was such a scream and hair-raising.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}真是让人尖叫又让人发寒啊。

original: {SAY:winnie}You can relax User Dave, my sensors indicate no undead activity on the lawn.
translation: {SAY:winnie}可以放心用户戴夫，我的传感器表明草坪上没有不死军团的活动。

original: {SAY:winnie}Great job plants! Dr. Zomboss' spooky schemes have been scared off.
translation: {SAY:winnie}做得好各位植物！你们把僵王博士的诡计吓破产了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Bowling Bulb's shots can bounce on multiple zombies, dealing damage
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}保鳞茎的子弹可以在数只僵尸间弹跳，造成伤害

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Celery Stalker waits for the zombies to pass and then strike from behind.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}潜伏芹菜静候僵尸经过，随后从其背后突袭。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chard Guard knocks back zombies but loses one of its leaves.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜菜护卫可以击退僵尸，但会失去自己的一片叶子。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}After losing all the leaves, it acts as a normal defensive plant.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}失去所有叶子后，它便和一株普通防御植物类似。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dandelion releases bombs that will explode upon contact.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蒲公英可以释放炸弹，炸弹在接触时爆炸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Iceberg Lettuce freezes the first zombie that steps on it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰山生菜可以冻结第一只踏上它的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Imp Pear transforms zombies into Imp Pear imps when eaten.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}小鬼梨可以把僵尸变形成小鬼梨小鬼。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lava Guava errupts dealing damage to all nearby zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}岩浆番石榴可以喷射攻击，对周围的所有僵尸造成伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sundewtangler traps zombies, leeching them to produce sun.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}茅膏菜缠绕者可以困住僵尸，榨取它的养分，生产阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Vamporcini will drain the health of nearby zombies, to increase its own.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}吸血牛肝菌可以榨干周围的僵尸，用来增加自己的生命值。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter-mint will chill all zombies on the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}寒薄会冷缓草坪上的所有僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}And provide a boost to the effectiveness of other plants in its family.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}随后强化其他自己家族植物的能力。

original: {FLAVOR}”Things are crazy now. Back in my day, there were Browncoats, Browncoats with cones, and Browncoats with buckets. That’s it! What are all these? Jetpacks? Magicians? Dark creatures?.. Hrmph! They better not think I am old and harmless. I may be retired but I still know a thing or two about blowing up zombies''.
translation: {FLAVOR}“这年头可真是群魔乱舞啊。想我们那个年代，棕色外套僵尸、戴路障的棕色外套僵尸，戴铁桶的棕色外套僵尸，没了！现在的这都是啥？喷气背包？魔术师？暗黑生物？哼！他们可别以为我老了就不中用了。就算退休，炸僵尸这方面我还是宝刀未老的。”

translation: 在这惊悚的末日草坪上战胜僵尸！！！

original: Life the Adventurer's life with Mega Gatling Pea.
translation: 像冒险家一样，在超级机枪豌豆大冒险中冒险。

original: Is that a ship on the horizon? Arrgh it's pirates!
translation: 地平线那边是艘船吗？恶，是海盗！

original: Surfs up! Zombies are rolling in with the tide!
translation: 准备冲浪！尸潮即将汹涌而来！

original: Happy Birthday to us! Join the revelry!
translation: 祝我们生日快乐！一同加入狂欢吧！

original: Come one, come all. To the BigTop circus event.
translation: 快来，都来。来后院游乐园。

original: Zombie tidings we bring to you Feastivus chaos!
Brainz is on the menu during the Food Fight event.
translation: 食物大战活动中，脑子也是菜单的一部分。

original: It's a Gourd-geous Harvest! Coming Soon.
translation: 五谷丰登大丰收！敬请期待。

original: Play ball! Go head to head with Dr. Zomboss.
translation: 夺球、玩球！与僵王博士正面交锋。

original: Having a ghouling and Zpooktacular day!!!
Defend your lawn from those green zombie hordes.
translation: 别让绿色尸潮破坏你的草坪。

original: Celebrate the new Lunar Zoo Year!
Defeat Dr. Zomboss’s creations in The Zombosseum!
translation: 在僵王斗兽场击败僵王博士的造物！

original: Are those zombies dressed as bunnies?
Beat the heat and push back the zombie hordes.
Explore the tomb of the lost zombie!
Resumes ready? Zcorp is looking for fresh Brainz!
translation: 简历准备好了吗？Z 公司大收购正在招贤纳尸！

original: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}Gosh! My tummy is rumbling looking at this feast!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean}{SAY:chilibean}天哪！这种盛宴，看得我肚子都咕咕叫了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}This is nothing, I can handle this all by myself.
{NPC_EXIT:chilibean}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Did someone say feast? I am famished. Some brainz will be delightful.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:chilibean}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}有人说盛宴？饿死我了。要是可以吃点脑子就好了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Were you even invited here Zomboss? This is a private event.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}邀请你来了吗，僵王？这是可是私人活动。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Okay no more Dr. Nice Pie Zomboss, time to raid the buffet. Minions!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}好吧，僵乖王小博士下线，该入侵吃自助餐了。小的们！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss' attempt to turn our feast into a food fright has been neutralised.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}僵王博士把盛宴变成食物大战的企图已经化解了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}What threat? Are the tacos running out? I was just getting in the zone.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}什么威胁？玉米卷要吃完了？我才刚进入状态呢。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Astounding how you could consume eateries during all of this.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}这边打仗你却还能这么吃，我挺吃惊的。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You may have turned my gourmet disaster into a fancy meal...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们可以把我的美味灾难变成可口佳肴…

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}...But next time, my minions will be the ones sealing the deal.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}...但下次，我的随从会是那个决定报价的人。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap on Banana Launcher and then anywhere on the board to fire explosives.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点香蕉火箭炮，随后轻点场地任意位置即可发射爆炸物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blover blows away all flying zombies from the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}三叶草可以将所有飞行僵尸吹出草坪。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cran Jelly crushes zombies in its lane and leaves behind pool of acidic goo.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蔓越莓果冻可以撞向所在行的僵尸，留下一池酸性黏液。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Acidic goo both slows and damages zombies that passes through.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}酸性黏液既可以令经过的僵尸减速，也能对其造成伤害。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}毁灭菇可以在被消灭时爆炸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The larger it grows, the bigger the explosion.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}E.M.Peach releases an E.M.P wave that disables all machine zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电磁脉冲桃可以释放令所有机械僵尸失灵的电磁脉冲波。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tap Magnifying Grass to fire a sun charged bolt at zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}轻点透镜草，发射充能阳光束。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The shot does consume sun, so use it with caution.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}发射会消耗阳光，请谨慎使用。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Scardey-shroom's low sun cost allows you to plant many at once.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}胆小菇价格实惠，你可以一次种植很多株。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It's plant food effect increases when there are other Scaredy-shroom nearby.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}如果周围有其他胆小菇，那么植物养料效果会更强。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Winter Melon deals heavy damage to group of zombies and slows them.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰瓜投手可以对尸群造成大量伤害，并令其减速。

translation: 无法连接至服务器。请寻找更稳定的互联网连接或稍后再试。

translation: 啊哦！没有可以租用的植物了！请稍后再试。

translation: 植物槽数量已满。请稍后再试！

original: Turret-Head Zombie’s solid headgear forms the foundation to its sturdy defense and provides it with unparalleled toughness.
translation: 角楼头僵尸用牢固的头饰为自己的防御力打下坚实基础，以此获得无与伦比的生命值。

translation: 独一无二、与众不同——一起加入丰收节，收获无穷的乐趣与欢笑！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The holiday season is upon us User Dave, shall we begin the party?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}圣诞季近在咫尺，用户戴夫，要开始派对吗？
{SAY:crazydave}圣诞派对让我感觉有点幽闭恐惧。

original: {SAY:winnie}It will be in the lawn User Dave, in the open.
translation: {SAY:winnie}开在草坪上，用户戴夫，在户外。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}I brought marshmallows for roasting everyone. Time for some s'mores.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我带了些棉花糖，大家一起来烤吧。来吃点烤棉花糖。

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Ho ho ho! A party without my chilling presence?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}嚯嚯嚯！派对，怎能没有我来冷冷场？

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Learn to enjoy the holidays and stop being a grinch.
{SAY:zomboss_r}Oh enjoy I will, watching my zombies ruin your holiday spirits. Minions!!!!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}哦，看我的僵尸毁掉你吗的圣诞精神一定很享受。小的们!!!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}Looks like your evil plans were cooled off pretty quickly, eh Zomboss?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg}{SAY:iceburg}看来你的邪恶计划一下就凉透了，是吧僵王？

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}I think you said it too soon my friend, Zomboss seems to be unfazed.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}你说的好像太早了，朋友——僵王好像不为所动。

original: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Didn't mean to give you the cold shoulder...
{SAY:zomboss_r}...mind you wretched plants, I will have the final sleigh.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}..…记住你们这些卑劣的植物，最后的雪橇在我手上。

original: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Zomboss is up to no good this time as well. We need to be on alert.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}僵王又在想坏点子了。我们要小心。

original: {SAY:iceburg_r}I am here to put those zombies on ice and keep things cool and frosty.
translation: {SAY:iceburg_r}我来让这些僵尸如履薄冰，让局面冰霜般镇定。

original: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Alright, I am ready for seconds. Has anyone seen my roasting stick?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:iceburg_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}好，我马上准备好。谁看到我的烤棉花糖棍了？

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Back for more, are you? Prepare for the ultimate frozen fiasco!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们又回来自讨苦吃了，是吧？准备面对透心凉的惨败吧！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:iceburg_r}Here we go again, this time we will melt your plans away. Bring it on!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:iceburg_r}{SAY:iceburg_r}我们又来了，这次我们会让你的计划融化为流水。放马过来吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curse you! I keep slipping up on this icy path.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}诅咒你们！这条冰道老是让我滑倒。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Hehehe, being naughty the whole year has its consequences eh, Zomboss.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}呵呵呵，淘气一整年是有后果的，是吧僵王。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{SAY:zomboss_r}Enjoy your fleeting victory, but I will be back with even colder plans.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{SAY:zomboss_r}享受你们那短暂的胜利吧，我会带着更冷酷的计划回来的。

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Umm Guys?! I think these are burnt. S'mores emergency here!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}额，兄弟们?! 这些好像烤糊了。烤出问题了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Chomper will eat zombies whole, but is vulnerable while chewing.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大嘴花可以一口吃掉整只僵尸，不过在咀嚼的时候很脆弱。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dusklobber is a shadow plants that lob explosive bud down their lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}薄暮掷手是一株可以向本行目标投掷爆炸花蕾的暗影植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When powered by shadow aura, they lob buds in 3 lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到暗影光环强化时，其可以向 3 行投掷花蕾。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Infi-Nut is a defensive plant who can regenerate its health over time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}无穷坚果是一株可以随着时间的推移重新生成的防御植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Laser Bean fires a beam of laser down its lane, hitting all Zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}激光豆可以向所在行发射激光束，攻击所有僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pea-nut has both defensive and offensive capabilities.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This additional flexibility allow it to be planted either in the front or the rear.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}得益于此，你可以将其灵活放置在前线或是后排。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Snow Pea's frozen pea will slow the zombie's movement and attack speed.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}雪花豌豆的冻豌豆可以减缓僵尸的移动与攻击速度。

original: {FLAVOR}Blaze Leaf actually meditates in the Zen Garden to control his temper. Anyone to disturb that can expect all hell to break loose on the lawn as Blaze Leaf can be seen chasing the poor soul, launching its flame waves at them. This can go on for the whole morning, often destroying the lawn. Dave hasn’t even dared to suggest an anger management course knowing what may follow. He has just accepted the fact and actually treats it as a morning call to wake up.
translation: {FLAVOR}其实炽叶常在禅境花园冥想，想要压制自己的脾气。任何胆敢打扰他的人，都将在草坪上被他喷着烈火追得到处跑。大战经常一个上午都不消停，把草坪弄得黄沙漫天。戴夫想推荐一门情绪管理课给他，但他也知道后果会怎样，所以一直不敢。只得接受这个事实，把它当作自己每天早上的起床铃。

original: Blaze Leaf attacks Zombies in a large radius. Every third strike, it releases the Blaze Wave attack which damages zombies in multiple lanes as it travels along a straight path.
translation: 炽叶可以攻击大范围的僵尸。每攻击三次，它都会释放“炽浪”攻击，“炽浪”向前推进，伤害数行的僵尸。

original: Blaze Leaf can target zombies in the front and back as well so position it wisely.
translation: 炽叶可以锁定前后两个方向的僵尸，要记得合理选择位置。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches a swirling fiery wave of energy damaging all the zombies on the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射旋转的炽热能量波，伤害草坪上的所有僵尸。

original: Deals damage in an area and releases flame wave attack.
translation: 造成范围伤害，释放热浪攻击。

original: Start the New Zoo Year with a Bang! Defend your lawn and check out the Zodiac plants.
translation: 点燃鞭炮，新年来到！守护草坪，结识植物生肖。

original: Learn more about your new seedlings in the New Plant nursery and help it grow into a powerful ally.
translation: 在新芽苗圃里了解你的新幼苗，助其生长为强力队友。

original: Love is in the air! Defend your lawn and check out the Valentines' plants.
translation: 空气里充满了爱的味道！守护草坪，结识春意“情种”。

original: Lunar Zoo Year will be here soon! Check back later!
translation: 笼笠新年活动即将到来！过段时间再来看看吧！

original: Help your seedlings grow in the New Plant Nursery.
translation: 在新芽苗圃协助你的幼苗成长。

original: Valenbrainz is almost here! Check back later!
translation: 情尸节活动即将到来！过段时间再来看看吧！

original: {FLAVOR}Dave has set a few rules to maintain order at the house. Keep the lawn clean. Turn off the faucet after watering. No munching on zombies after midnight. The rules are there to keep all plants comfortable and happy. There is a special rule that applies only to Frost Bonnet. No touching the thermostat! Hot or Cold? It just needs to pick one.
translation: {FLAVOR}为了让整个家井然有序，戴夫设立了几条规矩。草坪要清洁；用完水记得关水龙头；半夜不准大声嚼僵尸。有了这些规矩，才能保证所有植物都舒服、开心。不过对小霜帽，有一条特别的——就是不准碰空调的温度！到底是冷还是热？赶紧拿定主意吧。

original: Frost Bonnet can switch between Fire and Ice bloom. Each mode deals a different damage type, allowing Frost Bonnet to both either set zombies on fire or freeze them solid.
translation: 小霜帽可以在火花与雪花之间进行切换。每种模式可以造成不同种类的伤害，让小霜帽既可以点燃僵尸，又能让它们“冻”弹不得。

original: Frost Bonnet deals bonus damage to zombies affected by chill. Tap to toggle between the firing modes to maximize its damage.
translation: 小霜帽可以对受到冷缓效果的僵尸造成额外伤害。轻点即可切换开火模式，最大化伤害量。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches a combo fire and ice attack at nearby zombies. Zombies destroyed may turn into an ice wall.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向周围的僵尸发射一连串火、冰攻击。被消灭的僵尸可能变为冰墙。

original: Toggle between Fire and Ice attack modes.
translation: 在火、冰攻击模式间切换。

original: Get ready for the ultimate boot camp and learn about your plants in the New Plant Nursery.

original: Celebrate Valentine’s Day and defend your lawn with your favorite Valentine's plant in this Limited Thymed Event.
