original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Is everything ready for Dave's surprise birthday party?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}戴夫的惊喜生日派对都准备好了吗？

original: {SAY:peashooter}All that's left are the decorations. I told Wallnut to clean the lawn.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}只差装饰品了。我刚叫坚果墙去打扫草坪。

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}Then why is Wallnut playing with the garden hose? Wait Walln...
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}那坚果墙怎么在玩水龙头？等等坚…
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}*电流声* 错误！探-探测到-到-到-水。系-系统故-故-故障。

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Look what you did. Penny's circuit boards are damaged now.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}看你干的好事。现在潘妮的电路板坏掉了。

original: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}And the lawn! It's all flooded. We need to clean this before the party.
translation: {SHOUT:peashooter_r}草坪也是！水漫金山。我们得在派对开始前清理好。
{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:peashooter}发生了什么?! 我们在哪儿，潘妮？
{SAY:winnie}*电流声* 系-系统故-故-故障。开-开始旅-旅-旅行。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Uh oh! Penny's taking us to random places due to her malfunction.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}啊哦！潘妮故障了，在带我们到处乱跑。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:peashooter}Thank you, Mother Nature! We are back home.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:peashooter}感谢你，自然母亲！我们回家了。

original: {SAY:winnie}All systems are operational. Apologies for the inconvenience caused.
translation: {SAY:winnie}所有系统工作正常。抱歉对你们造成的不便。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}All threats are neutralized. Begin protocol surprise party.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}所有威胁已解除。开始惊喜派对协议。

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Shh! Dave will hear us. Do you want to ruin the surprise?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}嘘！戴夫会听到的。你想毁了惊喜吗？

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}You're the one to talk, but we will discuss this later. Dave's coming
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}大哥别说二哥，待会儿在吵吧。戴夫来了。

original: {SHOUT:crazydave}Holy moly! You guys scared the tacos out of me.
translation: {SHOUT:crazydave}天呐！你们把我的玉米卷都吓出来了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SHOUT:crazydave}Penny! Everything is all set up for the party! Green everything!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SHOUT:crazydave}潘妮！派对准备得真好！到处都是绿的！

original: {SAY:winnie}*analyzing* I don't like the look of that green drink...
translation: {SAY:winnie}*分析* 我不喜欢那杯绿色饮料的样子…

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Ha! Ha! Ha! There will be no party today! Minions! Attack!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}哈！哈！哈！今天不准开派对！小的们！进攻！

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}Now all day long you'll have good luck!
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}现在你整天运气都不会差啦！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:sunflower_r}For once can you let us enjoy the holiday!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:sunflower_r}就不能让我们过节消停一次吗！

original: {SAY:sunflower_r}At least we have our lucky charms!
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}All the lucky charms in the world won't save you now!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}现在全世界的幸运符都救不了你们了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}At least most of these zombies have the holiday spirit.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}至少这些僵尸都挺有节日精神的。
{SAY:sunflower_r}可它们让我们的派对延期了…

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, it looks like our party is saved.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，看起来我们的派对得救了。

original: {SAY:zomboss}Enjoy your party while you can! I'll be back! Sooner than you think!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}趁现在赶紧享受你的派对吧！我会回来的！让你措手不及！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Is it new year? Or am I just seeing shiny stuff?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}又是新年了？还是什么东西太闪闪发光了？

original: {SAY:winnie}It is User Dave, shall I log your customary resolution for this year?
translation: {SAY:winnie}是的用户戴夫，需要我记录下您一年一度的新年决心吗？

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}I have a resolution, to take over your lawn!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}我有一个决心，就是统治你们的草坪！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Every time Zomboss, haven't you learned anything?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}这么多次失败，僵王，你真的不涨教训吗？

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Nonsense! This year, I've upgraded! You will be at my mercy.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}胡说！一年来，我已经进化了！你们将任我摆布。

original: {SAY:peashooter}Well, we have a new friend to transform your resolution into a stalemate.
translation: {SAY:peashooter}这样的话，我们刚认识一位新朋友，可以把你的决心变成绝望。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Wait?! What?! Who is that?! Where did you slither in from?
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}等等?! 什么?! 谁?! 你从哪儿来的?
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}看来有些东西亘古不变呢，是吧？

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Can I still change my new year's resolution?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我能改一改我的新年决心吗？

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Forget that! Next year, I'll be the one celebrating...in your lawn!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}算了吧！明年，我会尽情狂欢……在我掌控的草坪里！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Ah...the holidays are over! You know what that means?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}啊…节日结束了！你们知道这代表什么吗？

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}MWHAHA! I'll make the crowds busier than ever, then all the sales will be MINE!!!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}木哈哈！我要让人潮比以往更繁杂，这样，所有的折扣商品都是我的了!!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}This is the final battle! Those sales are as good as mine!!!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}决战时刻！折扣商品都是我的!!!

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}You're right about one thing Zomboss, but you can't keep us from those savings!!!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}确实是决战，僵王，但能省下钱的是我们!!!

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Back of the line with you Zomboss!
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}These zombies will not keep us from our discounts!!!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}这些僵尸阻止不了我们享受特价!!!

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}We don't want to miss the fire sales...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我们可不能错过这些清仓甩卖啊…

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}We don't want to miss the fire sales...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我们可不能错过这些清仓甩卖啊…

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blaze Leaf attacks in a large area, both in front and back.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}炽叶攻击范围很大，前后兼顾。

original: {SAY:winnie}Every third strike releases a Blaze Wave, damaging zombies in multiple lanes.
translation: {SAY:winnie}每攻击三次，都会释放“炽浪”，伤害数行的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Blooming Hearts' damage increase whenever a zombie is mesmerized by its attack.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}攻击被自己迷惑的僵尸时，铃儿草的伤害会增加。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cactus shoots piercing thorns that can hit multiple zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}仙人掌可以发射具有穿刺效果的尖刺，命中数只僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When a zombie gets too close, it'll bury itself underground for safety.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}僵尸太靠近时，安全起见，它便会把自己埋到地下。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Citron shoots powerful balls of plasma after charging for a short duration.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}等离子香橼可以在短时间的充能后，发射强力的等离子球。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Cold Snapdragon's breath attack will chill zombies across multiple lanes.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}冰龙草的龙息攻击可以冷缓数行的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electric Blueberry summons a thundercloud that periodically zap zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}电击蓝莓可以召唤雷云，间歇性地电击僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}Place Electric Currants in the same row or column to zap Zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}把电流醋栗放在相同行或排，电击僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Endurian's spiky shell deals damage back at zombies that try to bite it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}榴镰尖锐的外壳可以对想要咬它僵尸进行反击。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winni}Tap on Frost Bonnet to switch it between Fire and Ice damage attack.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winni}单击小霜帽，在火、冰攻击间进行切换。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Fume-shroom shoots fumes that damages zombies in an area.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}烟雾菇可以发射烟雾，对范围内的僵尸造成伤害。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大蒜可以让僵尸避开到相邻行。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Ghost Pepper can haunt zombies in front or behind it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}断魂椒可以缠扰前后的僵尸。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到缠扰的僵尸会随着时间的推移受到伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Gold Leaf creates a gold tile when placed.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}黄金叶可以在安放时创造一块黄金地砖。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Grapeshot launches multiple grapes that bounces around the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}葡萄爆弹可以发射数枚葡萄，在草坪间弹跳。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Grimroses are shadow plants that drag zombies into the dirt.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}报丧花是可以把僵尸拖入地底的暗影植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Once it drags a zombie into the ground, it will disappear.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}一旦把僵尸拖入地下，它就会消失。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}报丧花可以接受月光花的强化。

original: When they are, they can defeat up to three enemies before disappearing.
translation: 强化后，便可以在消失前消灭最多三名敌人。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Guacodiles can be planted on land and in water.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}鳄梨既可以种在陆地上，也可以种在水里。

original: {SAY:winnie}Their attacks differ based on where they are planted.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks they're planted on.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}热土豆可以融化种的地方的冰块。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Imitater copies the previous Seed Slot plant, doubling your planting rate.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}变身洋芋可以拷贝前一个种子槽的植物，让你种植的频率加倍。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Intensive Carrot can revive fallen plants, bringing them back into the fight.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}医护胡萝卜可以复活倒下的植物，令其重新投入战斗。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Jack O' Lantern shoots out a jet of flame towards zombies in its lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}南瓜灯可以向所在行的僵尸吐出一团火焰。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lilypad is an aquatic plant that can host non-aquatic plants on it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}睡莲叶是一株水生植物，可以承载其上方的非水生植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Moonflower emits sun but also powers up adjacent Shadow plants.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}月光花可以绽放出阳光，但也能强化临近的暗影植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Nightshade is a shadow plant that strikes zombie with its leaves.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}夜影茄是一株暗影植物，可以用自己的叶片攻击僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}Shadow aura boosted Nightshade gains damage, hurls and regrows it leaves.
translation: {SAY:winnie}受到暗影光环强化的夜影茄伤害会变高，叶片投掷后还能重新长出来。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Parsnip deals heavy damage to zombies in close range.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}欧防锋可以对近距离的僵尸造成大量伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When it's able to be eaten, it'll charge at zombies down its lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在快被吃掉时，他可以朝所在行的僵尸冲锋。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pepper-pult lobs fiery peppers at zombies in its lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜椒投手可以向所在行的僵尸投掷炽热的甜椒。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Perfume-shroom charms dinosaurs to make them fight against zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}香水菇可以吸引恐龙，使它们转而对抗僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Phat Beet damages zombies every second around it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}节拍甜菜可以每秒攻击一次周围的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tile Turnip creates a Power Tile when planted.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}地砖芜菁可以在安放时创造一块能量地砖

original: {SAY:winnie}Place them wisely and make sure to use Plant Food to defeat zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}合理选择种植的位置，记得用植物养料来击败僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Primal Peashooter fires peas with a brief stun and can knock back zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}原始豌豆射手可以发射能击退、眩晕僵尸的豌豆。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}原始向日葵冒出的不是普通的阳光，而是大号阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Primal Wallnut is a defensive plant that can be planted quickly.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}原始坚果墙是一株可以快速种植的防御植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Puff-shroom will expire after a short period of time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}小喷菇会在一小段时间后凋亡。

original: {SAY:winnie}Use Plant Food to extend its lifetime and punish the zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}使用植物养料，延长它的寿命，同时把僵尸打得落花流水。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Red Stingers fire shots at full force when planted close to home.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}把红针花种在靠近家的地方时它会全力攻击。

original: {SAY:winnie}When planted further from home, they become more defensive.
translation: {SAY:winnie}种得离家越远，它们就会越具防御性。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shadow Shroom poisons zombies that attacks it, dealing damage over time.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}暗影菇可以让攻击它的僵尸中毒，随着时间的推移对其造成伤害。
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}缩小堇菜可以缩小周围的僵尸。
{SAY:winnie}缩小的僵尸会承受额外的伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spikeweed will deals damage to zombies as they walk over it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}地刺草会对踏过它的僵尸造成伤害。

original: {SAY:winnie}Its low on the ground, so most zombies will not attack it.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它在地面，低到大多数僵尸都无法攻击它。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Spore-shroom fires spores that create new Spore-shrooms out of defeated zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}孢子菇可以发射孢子，在击败的僵尸身上再创造出一株孢子菇。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food Spring Bean to bounce all zombies back.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}为弹簧豆施用植物养料，击退所有僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}倭瓜可以压扁第一只接近的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Stallia slows down zombies with a puff of perfume.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}大丽花可以喷出香水，令僵尸减速。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sun Bean infects zombies with sun. As zombies take damage, it will generate sun.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}阳光豆可以让僵尸染上阳光效果。僵尸受到伤害，便会生成阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sun-shroom generates more sun as it grows in size.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}阳光菇可以随着自己越长越大，生成更多阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sweetheart Snare slows and damages zombies as they step through her.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜心陷阱从可以在僵尸踩过她时对其造成伤害和减速效果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When planted in the same column, she gets damage and slow bonuses.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}种在同一排时，她可以获得伤害与减速效果加成。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}When fed plant food, she launches multiple thorns both forwards and backward.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}施用植物养料后，她可以向前后发射数根尖刺。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This will also activate other Sweetheart Snares on the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}同时激活草坪上其他的甜心陷阱从。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Sweet Potato attracts zombies from other lanes when they are close by.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}甜薯可以在其他行的僵尸靠近时，将其吸引到自己那行。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}缠绕海带是可以把第一只靠近的僵尸拖入水底的水生植物。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Thyme warp can teleport zombies back to the start of the lawn.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}逆时百里香可以把僵尸传送回草坪的起点。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This buys you time to advance your strategy.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Toadstool can eat most zombies, generating sun after it digests them.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}蟾蜍毒菌可以吃掉大多数僵尸，并在消化完后生成阳光。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Tumbleweed anywhere to send them rolling down the lane at zombies.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}在任意位置种下风滚草，让他们沿着草坪滚向僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Wasabi Whip's attack can reach zombies both in front or behind it.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}无论僵尸是前是后，炙鞭山葵都能攻击到。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Witch Hazel will transform zombies into shrooms that fights for you.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}巫术金缕梅会把僵尸变形成蘑菇，为你而战。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}旋转洋芜菁可以在四个角中的任意一角有敌人时发射子弹。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Znake Lily releases tornados that transforms zombies into Zomboids.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}尸讹百合可以释放把僵尸变形成拟尸的龙卷风。

original: {SAY:winnie}Zomboids fight to protect the lawn against incoming zombies.
translation: {SAY:winnie}拟尸可以与来袭的僵尸作战，保护草坪。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}User Dave, it appears that we have arrived in Rome yet again.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie_l}{SAY:winnie_l}用户戴夫，我们好像又抵达罗马了。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}HAHAHA!!! Prepare to face your doom in the Zombosseum!!!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}哈哈哈!!! 准备在僵王斗兽场直面自己的末日吧!!!

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We'll stop whatever you throw at us, Zomboss.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie_l}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}无论给我们什么困难，我们都会阻止你的。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Well, you're in my domain now! Minions, attack!!!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}嗯，可现在你们正踏在我的领土上！小的们，进攻!!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Looks like you and your zombies are equally brain-dead!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}看来你和你的僵尸大军都有点“脑死亡”了！

original: {SAY:zomboss}This isn't over!!! Next time, you'll be the ones saying, 'Foiled again!'
translation: {SAY:zomboss}还没完呢!!! 下回，说“又一次败北”的是你们！

original: {SAY:zomboss}Just wait till I return. Revenge will be MINE!!!
{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:peashooter}Ah, the spring time is here! I feel amazing.
{SAY:sunflower_r}I couldn't agree more my friend. Feels like nothing can go wrong today.
translation: {SAY:sunflower_r}太同意了，我的朋友。感觉今天诸事顺心。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}The spring won't stop me and my egg-cellent plans. Muhuhaha!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}春天阻止不了我，也阻止不了我彩蛋般精彩的计划。木呼哈哈！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}This isn't over! My allergies might be acting up...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}还没完呢！虽然我的过敏发作了…

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}...but, I'll sneeze the victory next time! Achooo!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}…但，我下次定会喷出我的胜利！阿嚏！

original: {SAY:sunflower}It's the only souvenir you'll get from our lawn. Hehe.
translation: {SAY:sunflower}这是你在草坪上唯一能带走的纪念品了。呵呵。

original: First you freeze, then you’ll burn!
10 Blazeleaf seed packets + 10 Pepper-Mint family seeds
translation: 10 包炽叶种子 + 10 包暖荷家族种子

original: 10 Doom Shroom seed packets + 10 Bombard-Mint family seeds
translation: 10 包毁灭菇种子 + 10 包爆薄家族种子

original: 10 Frost Bonnet seeds and 10 Winter-mint seeds
translation: 10 包小霜帽种子加 10 包寒薄种子

original: Personal space is my love language.
All problems can be transformed into solutions!
translation: 所有的问题都可以变为答案！

original: {FLAVOR}Sweetheart Snare enjoys her alone time. When not defending the lawn, she enjoys reading romance novels and drinking her favorite tea, Rose Tea.
translation: {FLAVOR}甜心陷阱从喜欢独处的时光。守护草坪以外的时间，她喜欢泡一杯最爱的玫瑰花茶，在暖香中翻翻言情小说。

original: Sweetheart Snare slows and damages zombies as they step through her.
translation: 甜心陷阱从可以在僵尸踩过她时对其造成伤害和减速效果。

original: Plant Sweetheart Snare and connect her with others, within the same column, to gain damage and slow bonuses.
translation: 把甜心陷阱从种在与相同排其他个体相连接的地方，获得伤害与减速增益。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple thorns both forwards and backward, while also activating other Sweetheart Snares on the lawn.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}向前后发射数根尖刺，同时激活草坪上其他的甜心陷阱从。

original: Sweetheart Snare slows and damages zombies stepping through her.
translation: 甜心陷阱从可以减速并伤害踩过她的僵尸。

original: {FLAVOR}Znake Lily believes everyone is capable of change and they can turn around. “Except for zombies, those dudes need to be literally transformed and I mean literally.” Znake Lily stated when asked “What about zombies?”.
translation: {FLAVOR}尸讹百合相信所有人都能改变，都能改过自新。“那僵尸呢？”，有人问。尸讹百合答道：“僵尸除外，除非让它们彻底变形——彻彻底底。”

original: Znake Lily swirls up enchanted tornados that transform zombies into plant “zomboids” to attack them.
translation: 尸讹百合可以卷起数阵魔龙卷，把僵尸变形成植物“拟尸”攻击它们。

original: Znake Lily can transform zombies into strong plant “zomboids” as it levels up.
translation: 随着等级提升，尸讹百合可以把僵尸变形成强力的植物“拟尸”。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Launches multiple tornados to transform zombies into various types of plant “zomboids”.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}发射数阵龙卷风，把僵尸变形成各种植物“拟尸”。

original: Targets zombies in a large radius across multiple lanes.
translation: 锁定数行内大范围的僵尸。

original: Sweetheart Snare cannot be placed with vine plants.
translation: 甜心陷阱从不能和藤蔓植物种在一起。

original: Znake Lily Early Access Level Up
translation: 尸讹百合抢先体验升级
尸讹百合抢先体验解锁

original: {FLAVOR}Even though Hammeruit claims that, “Patience is a virtue”, there have been multiple cases where ‘things’ around the house and lawn have been found smashed beyond repair. The more Hammeruit has to wait, the amount of smashing increases around it. Whenever confronted, Hammeruit always responds with, “Show me the evidence, and then we will talk”.
translation: {FLAVOR}虽然巨锤果嘴上说“忍耐是一种美德”，可房子、草坪周围却常常会有东西被砸得面目全非。巨锤果等得越久，周围被砸坏的东西就越多。每次找其对证，巨锤果总会答道：“先拿出证据再说吧”。

original: Hammeruit smashes zombies with its charging hammer attacks.
translation: 巨锤果可以使用充能巨锤击打僵尸。

original: Hammeruit’s attack deals more damage, the more it has to wait to attack.
translation: 巨锤果攻击造成的伤害越高，下一次攻击等待的时间就越久。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Slams its hammer 3 times in a row, dealing increasing damage with each hit. Releases shockwaves at the last hit that travels in 3 directions.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}连续猛击 3 次巨锤，每次攻击造成更高伤害。最后一次攻击释放冲击波，向 3 个方向推进。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Alright! The beach day is finally here!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}好诶！终于等到去海滩的时候了！

original: {SAY:sunflower}I couldn't agree more. Nothing can ruin this beautiful day.
translation: {SAY:sunflower}是这样的。没有什么可以毁掉如此美好的一天。

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Attention you leafy lifeguards, this beach is Zomboss Territory.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}听好了你们这些绿油油的救生员，这片海滩是我僵王的领土。

original: {SAY:zomboss}My zombies will turn your paradise into a sand trap.
translation: {SAY:zomboss}我的僵尸大军会把你们的乐园变为桎梏沙土。

original: {SAY:peashooter_r}Zomboss, the only thing trapped here will be your plans.
translation: {SAY:peashooter_r}僵王，被桎梏的，只有你的计划。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:sunflower}You might need a whole storm shelter after that, eh, Zomboss?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:sunflower}你待会儿估计得找一间防风窖，对吧，僵王？

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Curses! I will be back with a new plan...and a life jacket.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}呸！我会带着新的计划……还有一间新的救生衣回来的。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Hammeruit charges its hammer, the longer it waits to attack.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}进攻前等得越久，巨锤果的锤子充能越高。

original: {SAY:winnie}The hammer attack can charge up to 2 times to deal increased damage.
translation: {SAY:winnie}巨锤攻击可以充能 2 次，造成更高伤害。

original: {SAY:winnie}Excessive temperature detected. Shutting down non-critical systems.
translation: {SAY:winnie}探测到过高温度。正在关闭不必要的系统。

original: {SAY:peashooter}We should stand guard during this malfunction!
translation: {SAY:peashooter}自检的时候我们可不能掉以轻心！

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}System errors detected and corrected. All systems restored.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}已检测到系统错误并修正。所有系统已恢复。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Curse you! Just wait until I debut my brand new invention!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}诅咒你们！等着看我的全新发明吧！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We’ll be ready for you Zomboss and whatever invention you can come up with.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}无论你发明什么，我们都会从容应对的，僵王。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}These gravestones are not just decor, but also zombie factories!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}这些墓碑不只是诱饵，还是僵尸工厂！

original: {SAY:peashooter}Do you have a recycling plan for all these stones?
translation: {SAY:peashooter}你真不打算回收一下这些石头吗?

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Enough prattle! My gravestones will flood your lawn with zombies...
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}别废话了！不等你们说出“脑子”两个字…
{SAY:zomboss_r}…我的墓碑，就将让尸海淹没你们的草坪。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}I hope you are ready, because the real fun begins NOW!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们最好准备周到了，好戏才刚刚开始！

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}If you say so. We're just getting warmed up!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}随你怎么说吧。我们才刚热身呢！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Silence! My Zombies will zoom over your zephyrous zeal!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}闭嘴！我的僵尸大军会呼啸而过，瞬间吹散你那如微风般的热忱！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}You'll rue the day, plants! Next time, I shall make you pay.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}今天算你们走运，植物！下次，我要让你们付出代价。

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}It's Valentine's Day! A perfect time to celebrate with the ones who matter most!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}情人节到了！最适合与最重要的人一同庆祝！

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Yeah! We even got the dance floor all set up.
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}There will be no dancing or celebrating!
{SHOUT:zomboss_r}Prepare for the greatest heartbreak of all...your demise!!!
translation: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}准备好接受最心碎的时刻吧——自己的灭亡!!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Blast it all! Love cannot shield you forever!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}真该死！爱是不可能永远保护你们的。

original: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}I will return...and next time, it will be MY party!
translation: {SHOUT:zomboss_r}我会回来的……而下次，这片土地上将是我的派对！

original: {SAY:peashooter}And we'll be happy to crash that party!
{NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}I'm just happy we got some fireworks on Valentine's Day!
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You lot! What are you doing here??
{SAY:zomboss_r}We're close today. Come back another time.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}我们今天打烊了。以后再来吧。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Justice closes for no one. We're here to shut you down!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}正义绝不打烊。我们是来让你关门大吉的！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Fools, you think you can take on all of ZCorp!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}傻瓜，你们以为自己可以对付整个 Z 公司吗！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}This will be the end of you! Muhahaha!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}今天就是你们的末日！木哈哈哈！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}You think you have bested me today. But this isn't the end.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}你们自以为今天打败了我。可这还没完。
{SAY:zomboss_r}反正我也一直想换个工作地点，

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}He got away.  But we'll get another chance.
{SAY:peashooter}There's no place to hide from Justice!
10 Znake Lily seeds and 10 Enchant-mint seeds
translation: 10 包尸讹百合种子和 10 包魔荷种子
情尸节彩陶情尸节彩陶
情尸节彩陶情尸节彩陶

生日庆典高级彩陶捆绑包

original: {FLAVOR}Everyday is a party with Corn-fetti Popper, and every zombie crash is just another reason to celebrate! Corn-fetti Popper learned early that life is short not to be explosive. Its favorite pastime? Sending zombies flying with colourful confetti blasts and proving that even the apocalypse could use a bit of fun.
translation: {FLAVOR}有了爆礼花，每天都是一场派对；每只僵尸的倒下，都是一个狂欢的理由。爆礼花很早就明白了人生苦短，何不活得轰轰烈烈。它最爱的消遣是什么？那一定是把僵尸随着五彩礼花炸上天空，向人们证明——即便是末世，也总有办法为生活添一抹乐趣。

original: Corn-fetti Popper fires zombie piercing cobs that can push back zombies close enough to it.
translation: 爆礼花可以发射能穿透僵尸的玉米棒，击退靠得足够近的僵尸。

original: Corn-fetti Popper’s attacks can go through zombies, so choose your placement wisely.
translation: 爆礼花的攻击可以穿过僵尸，所以要合理选择你的布阵。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Corn-fetti Popper releases a huge blast of corn in 3 lanes damaging and pushing back all zombies that get hit.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}爆礼花向 3 行爆发出大量玉米，对命中的僵尸造成伤害和击退效果。

original: Pushes back zombies if they get too close.

translation: 海洋射手抢先体验升级
海洋射手抢先体验解锁

translation: 甜心陷阱从抢先体验升级
甜心陷阱从抢先体验解锁

僵尸幸运星彩陶捆绑包
僵尸幸运星高级彩陶捆绑包
僵尸幸运星高级彩陶包
僵尸幸运星超级捆绑包
僵尸幸运星终极捆绑包
僵尸幸运星植物解锁捆绑包

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Corn-fetti Popper's attacks pierces through zombies in its path.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}爆礼花的攻击可以穿透路径上的僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}It also has a chance to knock back zombies within a 2 tile area.
translation: {SAY:winnie}它还有机会击退 2 块地砖范围内的僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Seashooter fires 3 water pea projectiles in different directions.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}海洋射手可以向不同的方向发射 3 枚水豌豆作为子弹。

original: {SAY:winnie}When planted near water tiles, deals increased damage.
translation: {SAY:winnie}种在水地砖附近时，可以造成更高伤害。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Seashooter launches a barrage of water pea in 3 directions.

Four years later, Dave returned to his niece’s graduation and found it had mutated into a totally different plant. “No beach pass? No entry!” says Seashooter while personally throwing the zombies out of the water. “H2-OH-NO you don’t!” exclaims Seashooter to the zombies entering the lawn or the pool on its watch.

original: {FLAVOR}In the deep jungle, where the air is thick and the zombies are clueless, Devour Bloom learned the ultimate survival trick—sit still, look pretty, and let dinner walk right in. At first, it tried being a normal flower, soaking up the sun and minding its own business. But after a few zombies tripped into its petals (and mysteriously vanished), it realized something: being a passive plant was overrated. Now, it patiently waits, looking all innocent, until—SNAP! One less zombie, one satisfied plant. What happens inside Devour Bloom after it closes? Nobody knows. And if they do, they aren’t talking.
translation: {FLAVOR}在那浓雾滚滚、空气闷热、僵尸呆笨的丛林深处，吞噬蓓蕾学到了终极生存技巧——坐得稳健点，长得好看点，让晚餐径直走向自己。起初，它试着做一朵普通的花，只需要吸收阳光、管好自己。但是在几只僵尸被自己的花瓣绊倒（并神秘地消失了）以后，它意识到：如此被动并不是最好的生活。现在，它耐心地等着，装出无辜样，直到——唰！少了一只可怜的僵尸，多出一株满意的植物。吞噬蓓蕾闭合后，里面到底发生了什么？没人知道。就算知道，他们也说不出来了。

original: Devour Bloom gobbles up zombies that walk or fly over it. It can devour multiple zombies at the same time, instantly eliminating them. However, larger zombies are a bit too much for Devour Bloom to eat up, so they only take damage instead.
translation: 吞噬蓓蕾可以一口吞下走过或飞过它的僵尸。它能同时吞噬多只僵尸，再瞬间消灭他们。然而，吞噬大型僵尸对吞噬蓓蕾来说有点太难了，所以它们一般只会受到伤害。

original: Devour Bloom is generally ignored by zombies as it tries to trap and gobble them up.
translation: 吞噬蓓蕾会尝试困住并一口吞下僵尸，因为僵尸往往会忽略它。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Devour Bloom sends a swarm of its clones towards the first zombie in its lane, who lunges out from the ground and devours zombies in a large area.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}吞噬蓓蕾会向最靠前的僵尸所在行派出一群它的复制体，复制体会从地面冲出，吞噬大范围内的僵尸。

original: Devour Bloom can instantly eliminate most zombies.
translation: 吞噬蓓蕾能够瞬间清除大部分僵尸。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ah, the Harvest Festival… A bountiful occasion, ripe for the taking!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}啊，丰收节……丰收的季节，时机也成熟了！

original: {SAY:zomboss}I’ll strip it bare, one plant at a time, until no hope is left to grow!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}我要剥光这些植物，一次一株，直到它们没机会继续长！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Not so fast, Zomboss! We’ll make sure your defeat blooms loud and clear!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}别急嘛，僵王！我们保证你的败绩会像烟花一样响亮地绽放的！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}The sun’s on our side, Zomboss! You’ll be left in the dark while we shine!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}阳光在我们这边，僵王！我们闪闪发亮的同时，你只会被笼罩在黑暗里！

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Dark? We’ll see how long your garden stays bright...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}黑暗？我们拭目以待你们的花园……
{SAY:zomboss}在被我的不死大军占领前还能亮多久！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Blast it! This harvest has turned sour! You may have thwarted me today...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}可恶！这场收割彻底完蛋了！也许这次你们成功阻止了我…

original: {SAY:zomboss}...but next time, my twisted schemes will sprout something far worse!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}...但下次，我扭曲的阴谋将孕育出更恐怖的东西！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Keep dreaming, Zomboss. Your plans will always wilt under the sun's light.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}接着做梦吧，僵王。你的计划在阳光下只会枯萎。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}While your schemes crumble, our garden will keep growing, no brains on the menu!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}你的计划只会不断失败，而我们的花园将不断生长，绝不让脑子出现在菜单上！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Fools! My latest game plan ensures total victory! You don't stand a chance!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}傻瓜！我最新的比赛计划无懈可击！你们不可能赢！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Ooooh! I love games....wait, what are we playing?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}哦！我喜欢比赛…等等，我们在玩什么？

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}The "keep zombies off the lawn" game as usual.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}就平常的“不让僵尸踏进草坪”比赛。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}And I play the "find the tacos and eat them" game!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}而我在玩“找到玉米卷再吃掉”比赛！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}No! My perfect strategy has crumbled like stale chips!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}不！我完美的战略像烂薯条一样坏掉了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Wanna know my strategy? Its called standing still!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}知道我的战略是什么吗？坚守阵地！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}And somehow that always works for you.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}不知道为什么，你这招总是管用。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}This was a delicious game. Now, time for my victory snacks.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}这场比赛真是过瘾啊。现在，再来点胜利小零食吧。

translation: {SAY:winnie}大型僵尸吞不下，只会对其造成伤害。

original: {SAY:winnie}These seeds have a chance of knocking zombies back.

translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}杨桃可以向 5 个方向发射星星。
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}不可能！我的胜利计划明明天衣无缝。

original: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Your flawless triumph crumbled like your gravestones.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}你那天衣无缝的计划和你的墓碑一样散落一地了。

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Looks like your plans are dead and buried, Zomboss.
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}看起来你的计划已经命丧黄泉，葬入地底了，僵王。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}You'll rue the day, plants! Next time, I shall make you pay.
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}你们会为今天后悔的，植物！下次，我一定要让你们付出代价！

original: After all the hard-fought battles, it's time to redeem your {EVENTNAME} tokens for exciting rewards! At the end of the event, any currency not redeemed will be converted into coins.

original: Join Thymed Events for exclusive rewards! Replay levels to earn more {EVENTNAME} tokens and redeem special rewards from event exclusive store. Hard levels unlock in week two, so level up your plants for tougher challenges. Finish before time runs out!
translation: 加入限时活动，赢取专属奖励！重玩关卡，获取更多{EVENTNAME}代币，在活动专属商店内兑换特殊奖励。活动第二周将解锁困难关卡，升级植物，迎接更艰巨的挑战。在结束活动前抓紧完成吧。

original: {FLAVOR}Sour Shot is the silent soldier of the garden, patiently waiting to hold the line. It may seem unassuming, but once a zombie crosses its path—PEW PEW PEW! The seeds fly, repelling another intruder. Hidden beneath its calm exterior is a fierce defender, ready to spring into action and keep the garden safe.
translation: {FLAVOR}酢浆草是花园中默默无闻的战士，沉稳地坚守阵地。听着毫不起眼，但只要有僵尸进犯它的地盘——piu piu piu！种子飞扬，入侵者败退战场。其平静的外表下，是一位热血沸腾的护卫，时刻准备投入战斗，保卫花园。

original: Sour Shot launches seeds at zombies upon contact, providing a constant stream of damage and crowd control. It can knock back zombies, but larger zombies might only take partial damage.
translation: 酢浆草在接触时向僵尸发射种子，提供源源不断的伤害与群体控制效果。它可以击退僵尸，但大型僵尸可能只会受到部分伤害。

original: Sour Shot is generally unnoticed by zombies as it continuously pelts them with seeds.
translation: 酢浆草会不断向僵尸投掷种子，僵尸通常不会注意到它。

original: {KEYWORD} Plant Food: {STAT} Sour Shot rapidly fires a barrage of seeds, bouncing off zombies and creating chaos in a large area.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}酢浆草快速发射一连串种子，眩晕僵尸，在很大区域内制造混乱。

original: Sour Shot can knock back and damage most zombies.
translation: 酢浆草可以对大部分僵尸造成伤害与击退效果。

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Jiggle, juggle, juke! This is skill and not mere fluke!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}摇摆、杂耍、闪避！这是技巧，不是运气好！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Wait, what now? And who invited you to the stage?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}等等，什么？而且谁请你来舞台的？

original: {SAY:zomboss}Silence! Thou needs to concentrate! Act I - NO SUN FOR YOU!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}安静！专心看节目！第一幕——不给你阳光！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}He's always so dramatic... But... Is he better than me?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}他就是这么神神叨叨的…不过…他有比我好吗？

original: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Of course not, Wallnut! Let's show him what we've got!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}肯定没有，坚果墙！咱们给他点颜色瞧瞧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Ha ha! I can see it! Big Top Tent will be MINE!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}哈哈！胜利近在咫尺！后院大帐篷就要归我了！

original: {SAY:zomboss}And for the final act - my zombies shall have your brainz!
translation: {SAY:zomboss}最后一幕——我的僵尸吃你的脑子！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Final act? More like, final goodbye! We're ready to take you on!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}最后一幕？不如说——最后一面！我们准备好送你出去了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}Yup! We still have an ace down our roots!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower_r}{SAY:sunflower_r}没错！我们根子里还藏着王牌呢！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}No! My rehearsals were flawless! How could I lose?!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}不！我的排练明明完美无瑕！我怎么会输?!

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}You were no match for us, Zomboss! We beat you fair and square on stage!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}你根本不是我们的对手，僵王！我们在舞台上堂堂正正地赢了你！

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}You may have won this time, but I shall return with another performance!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}这次你们可能赢了，但下次我会带另一场表演回来的！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Prepare all you want - we'll beat you any time and any place!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}尽情准备吧——无论何时，无论何地，我们都将击败你！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Bwahaha! Prepare for a night of fright and delight!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}吧哇哈哈！准备好迎接整晚的恐惧与快乐吧！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}My zombies are hungry for a brain buffet!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}我的僵尸大军正想要一场脑子自助餐来填肚子呢！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Trick or taco? Sorry, I'm fresh out of brains!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}不给玉米卷就捣蛋？对不起，脑子刚好没有了！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Enough! Time to turn your garden into our spooky playground!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}够了！该把你们的草坪变成恐怖游乐场了！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Oh no, Zomboss is at it again!
{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Can't we reschedule? My shell wasn't ready for this!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}不能改约一个时间吗？我的壳都还没准备好呢！

original: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper}{SAY:ghostpepper}Boo! I'm here to spice things up with my ghostly heat!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:ghostpepper}{SAY:ghostpepper}哇嗷！我来用我炽热的鬼魂来炒热气氛了！

original: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}Yikes! Warn me next time, I'm on your side!
translation: {SHOUT:wallnut_r}呀！下次先警告我一下，我就在你旁边呢！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Blast it! My ghoulish plans went up in smoke!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}真该死！我吓人的计划全都化为青烟了！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}But beware, my tricks will return with extra treats!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}不过小心了，下次我来捣蛋，会从你这里要走更多的糖！

original: {SAY:winnie}Relax, User Dave. My sensors show the lawn is zombie-free!
translation: {SAY:winnie}放松，用户戴夫。我的传感器表明草坪已经没有僵尸了！

original: {SAY:winnie}Fantastic work, plants! Zomboss' spooky schemes are toast!
translation: {SAY:winnie}干得漂亮，植物！僵王吓人的诡计彻底玩完了！

original: Play Time Ended: Collect rewards in {DAYS} days
translation: 游玩时间已结束：请于 {DAYS} 天之内收集奖励。

translation: 游玩时间已结束：请于 {DURATION}之内收集奖励。

translation: 你的{EVENTNAME}代币不够。完成关卡，获取更多{EVENTNAME}代币。

original: You need {EVENTNAME} Tokens to purchase rewards from the event store.
translation: 你需要{EVENTNAME}代币才能在活动商店购买奖励。

original: {FLAVOR} Brain Stem: your garden’s ultimate zombie magnet! With its irresistible allure, it lures zombies from its lane and neighboring ones, making them forget all about the tasty plants they were eyeing. Once they're hooked, the Brain Stem becomes their new obsession. But that’s not all, its shrink ability can zap those pesky zombies into nothingness! Watch as it turns chaos into calm with a touch of brainy magic. Perfect for adding a little mind-control mischief to your zombie-busting fun!
translation: {FLAVOR}脑杆：你花园里的终极僵尸磁铁。它的诱惑力难以抵挡，可以轻松让僵尸放下之前看中的植物，将其吸引到周围行。一旦上钩，脑杆就会成它们更喜欢的东西。但不仅如此，它还能利用自己的缩小能力，让讨厌的僵尸变得微不足道。看它用自己的脑力，把混乱变得平静吧。非常适合为你破坏僵尸的乐趣中添加一丝心灵控制的恶作剧！

original: Brain Stem excels at crowd control and eliminating high-value targets. It draws zombies into its lane, shrinks them, and provides a unique rescue mechanism when zombies approach the house.
translation: 无论是群体控制还是消灭高价值目标，脑杆都得心应手。它可以吸引僵尸来到自己所在行，将其缩小，同时还能在僵尸靠近房子时提供独特的救场机制。

original: Brain Stem attracts zombies into its lane and shrinks them, providing essential crowd control.
translation: 脑杆可以吸引僵尸到自己所在行，将其缩小，提供基本的群体控制效果。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Brain Stem activates its full potential, shrinking and eliminating multiple zombies across the gameboard with its mind-bending prowess.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}脑杆释放全部潜力，用其脑洞大开的本领缩小、消灭全场多只僵尸。

original: Brain Stem shrinks and eliminates high-value zombie threats.
translation: 脑杆可以缩小、消灭高价值的僵尸。

original: The {EVENTNAME} has wrapped up! Thanks for joining the fun. Stay tuned for more awesome events!
translation: {EVENTNAME}已圆满结束！感谢你的加入。敬请期待更多精彩活动！
草坪碗高级彩陶捆绑包

original: {FLAVOR} When the tides turn and hope begins to fade, Lemonaid steps in as the citrus-sweet savior your garden needs. Far more than just a support unit, Lemonaid brings a refreshing twist to the battlefield—healing injured allies, reviving fallen plants, and packing a surprising punch when push comes to shove. At first glance, it might seem like a background player, but in the heat of a zombie ambush, it shines as a lifeline. Its plant food ability? A full-force rescue operation, restoring strength and turning the tables when all seems lost. Lemonaid embodies the zest of resilience, delivering a burst of strategy just when you need it most!
translation: {FLAVOR}在局势逆转、希望开始黯淡的时候，柠檬汁援会以酸甜清爽的救世主之姿现身，守护你的花园。它远不止是一个辅助单位，更能为战场带来耳目一新的反转——治疗受伤的盟友、复活倒下的植物，还能在必要的时候迸发出惊人的一击。乍看之下，它似乎只是幕后配角，但在僵尸伏击的高压时刻，它就是救命的关键。它的植物养料能力？一次全力救援行动，恢复战力、扭转乾坤于绝境之中。柠檬汁援象征着坚韧的活力，总能在你最需要的时候送上大量的计策！

original: Zombies got you cornered? Worry not! Whether you need heals, a bit of extra firepower, or straight up need to revive a downed plant, Lemonaid has got you covered!
translation: 僵尸把你逼到角落了吗？别担心！无论你是需要治疗、额外的火力支援，还是要直接复活倒下的植物——柠檬汁援都能帮你搞定！

original: Lemonaid heals other plants in its row and has a chance to activate PF on them.
translation: 柠檬汁援可以治疗自己所在行的其他植物，并且有概率为其激活植物养料效果。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Lemonaid heals all plants in it’s row, reviving downed plants and providing PF to some plants.
translation: {KEYWORD}植物养料：{STAT}柠檬汁援可以治疗自己所在行的植物，在其倒下时将其复活，同时为其中一部分提供植物养料效果。

original: Generates sun, heals right plants, and boosts with Plant Food.
translation: 生成阳光，治疗右侧植物，并用植物养料强化它。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Brain stem lures zombies from nearby lanes and from behind.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}脑杆可以引诱周围行以及自己身后的僵尸。

original: {SAY:winnie}Brain stem shrinks nearby zombies, possibly down to nothing.
translation: {SAY:winnie}脑杆可以缩小周围的僵尸，甚至可能小到直接消失。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Brain stems shrink multiple zombies, possibly to nothing.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到植物养料强化的脑杆可以缩小多只僵尸，甚至可能令其直接消失。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lemonaid generates sun and heals any damaged plants to its right in the same lane.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}柠檬汁援可以生成阳光，还可以治疗所在行右侧的任何受伤植物。

original: Lawn of Doom Premium Pinata Pack
{SAY:winnie}Not yet, User Dave. But we are setting up the Feastivus lawn celebration.
translation: {SAY:winnie}暂时没有，用户戴夫。不过我们正在布置盛宴节草坪庆典。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}I’ve brought a giant mug of hot cocoa! But I may have already drunk half of it...
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}我买了一个巨大的被子来装热可可！不过我可能已经喝了一半了…

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Pathetic! Your cocoa is nothing compared to my Brrr-Bot 9000!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}令人悲哀！你的可可与“好冷机器人 9000”相比根本不值一提！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}It serves FROST instead of warmth! Get ready to get frozen!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}它不会带来温暖，而是霜冻！准备冻成冰块吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Guess we’ll just have to heat things up. Get ready, Zomboss!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}看来我们得升升温了。准备好吧，僵王！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}No! My snowstorm of doom… melted into slush!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}不！我的末日雪暴…融成一地残雪了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}That’s what happens when you bring cold hearts to a warm holiday, Zomboss.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}你用冷酷的心过这样温暖的节下场就是这样，僵王。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Bah! It's not over yet! There's s'more where that came from!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}呸！还没完呢！好戏才刚刚开始！

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, did you eat all the s'mores?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}用户戴夫，你把棉花糖饼干吃完了吗？

original: {SAY:crazydave}I can't say for sure. I remember starting to eat, but not ending.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}我不确定。我只记得我开始吃的时候，不记得停下来了。

original: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Did anyone find my gingerbread? I can’t defend the party bare-handed!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}有谁看到我的姜饼了吗？两手空空我该怎么保护派对呢？

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Fools! While you hunt for cookies, my machines are warmed up to thaw your lawn!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}傻瓜！你们还在找饼干的时候，我的机器已经热好身准备融化你们的草坪了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Machines or not, we’ll keep the holiday spirit blazing bright! Time for round 2!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}管你有没有机器，我们会让节日精神发光发热的！来打第 2 回合吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curse you meddling plants! My Frost-o-Matic Sleigh has crashed again!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}我诅咒你们这帮爱管闲事的植物！我的“霜冻力”雪橇又毁了！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Maybe try spreading cheer instead of fear, Zomboss. It works wonders.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}要不你试试不去害怕，而是散播欢悦呢，僵王？这样的效果非常奇妙。

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Cheer makes me itch! Come next Feastivus, I’ll be unstoppable!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}欢悦让我浑身痒痒！下次盛宴节再来，我将无人能敌！

original: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Until then… anyone up for s’mores round 2?
translation: {NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}嗯，到时候再说吧…有人想吃第 2 轮棉花糖饼干吗？
{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}嗝——！棉花糖饼干大餐人人有份!!!

original: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Whoa! Who brought the spice? This feast is gonna be lit!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}哇哦！谁带的香料？这次的盛宴绝对非同凡响！

original: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}Careful now. That looks like it could trigger an actual food fight.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:chilibean_r}{SAY:chilibean_r}小心。这看着像是真的会引起一场食物大战。

original: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:chilibean_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}So many flavors, so little time! Let's spice this up with chaos so prime!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_EXIT:chilibean_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}口味这么多，时间这么少！让我们用混乱来加些料吧！

original: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Zomboss! Not again! Can’t we have one peaceful potluck without brain-banter?
translation: {NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}僵王！又来了！我们就不能避开一次你的脑子急转弯吗，平平静静地吃一顿百乐餐吗？

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}Potlucks aren't just for plants! I bring Chaos Cuisine to the scene!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}可不只有植物可以吃百乐餐！我可是带了混乱料理来的！

original: {NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}What? No! Not unless theres brainz in it.
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Alright, I think it's time we taught you some table manners!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}好了，是时候来教你一些餐桌礼仪了！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}I'll take that with a side of brainz!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It looks like Zomboss chewed on more than he can bite. Literally.
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}看来僵王想一口吃个胖子。字面意义上的。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Wait, what? I didn't even take a bite! I wanted that taco!
translation: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}等等，什么？我一口都没吃呢！我要吃那个玉米卷！

original: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Grrr! Foiled again! A fight without food is like a brain that isn't chewed!
translation: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}恶！又一次的败北！没有食物的大战就像没有嚼过的脑子！

original: {SAY:zomboss_r}I will be back again, with minions marching down your lane!
translation: {SAY:zomboss_r}我会回来的，带着我的小弟们在你的草坪上行军！

original: {SAY:crazydave}It's ok, Penny. I think he left hangry.
translation: {SAY:crazydave}没事的，潘妮。他应该已经满肚子怒气地走了。

original: {SAY:winnie}The healed plant may also receive a Plant Food buff.
translation: {SAY:winnie}收到治疗的植物也可能受到植物养料增强。

original: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Food powered Lemonaid heals all plants in the lane...
translation: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}受到植物养料强化的柠檬汁援可以治疗所在行所有植物…

original: {SAY:winnie}...revives fallen ones, and generates a burst of sun.
translation: {SAY:winnie}…还能复活倒下的植物，同时生成大量阳光。

original: 10 Brain Stem seeds and 10 Enchant-mint seeds
translation: 10 包脑杆种子和 10 包魔荷种子

translation: 剩下的日子不能再完成任务了，不过你依然可以再活动商店里兑换你的{EVENTNAME}代币。

original: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SHOUT:crazydave}Penny! Everything’s greener than guacamole out here!
{SAY:winnie}Scanning… that “lucky punch” drink looks dangerously radioactive.
{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Luck? HA! Your luck runs out the moment I arrive! Zombies—forward!
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}You’ll need more than leaves! Try escaping MY unlucky streak!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, it appears our luck has held—the party is safe.
{SHOUT:crazydave}BLARGL! Time to celebrate with extra green goodies!
{SAY:zomboss_r}Enjoy your luck while it lasts! I’ll be back… with even unluckier luck!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Wowee! All these lights! Is it New Year again?
{SAY:winnie}Correct, User Dave. Shall I note your resolution for the year?
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}I've got a resolution too: to finally defeat you and your plants!
{SAY:zomboss_r}This time, I'm serious! My new machines are unbeatable!
{SAY:sunflower}We'll see about that. We've got a fresh recruit to foil your plans.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Looks like we did it again! Zomboss is on the run!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Another victory for the plants, User Dave. How satisfying!
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curse you, meddling plants! This isn’t over!
{NPC_ENTER:snapdragon}{SAY:snapdragon}Better luck next time, Zomboss. We’ll be ready!
{SAY:zomboss_r}You may have won this round, but I'll be back with even more tricks!
{NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:crazydave}Let’s celebrate with some tacos! What a great start to the year!
{SAY:winnie}Happy New Year, everyone! Until next time!
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Brrr! Winter may be ending, but the cool deals are just heating up!
{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:peashooter_r}Perfect time to stock up on some extra plant-food!
{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Don’t forget to bundle up your bargains!
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}MWAHAHA! I’ll freeze the sales solid! No refunds, no returns, no resistance!
{NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{SAY:wallnut}Not so soon, Zomboss! Mega Gatling Pea, Help us!
{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Target locked and loaded! Time to blast those bargain busters!
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Let’s roll out before the discounts expire!
{NPC_EXIT:wallnut}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Get ready for the best combo of the year --
{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}Oh no! Zomboss marked his minions “Buy One, Get One Free”!
{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}At least I’m built for bulk shopping!
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss}{SAY:zomboss}Bah! Defeated despite my deal breaker destruction!
{NPC_EXIT:zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}We’ve redeemed victory before he could say 'sale'!
{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Price check on aisle... doom! Victory - added to cart and checked out!
{NPC_EXIT:wallnut_r}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{SAY:peashooter}Nothing beats Mega Gatling savings—and mega firepower!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Rose will transform the zombies into sheep, creating a barrier to block them.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Rose plant is immune to the wizard's spell.
{SAY:winnie}If the spell hits it or nearby plants, it reflects, turning the wizard into a sheep.
{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:peashooter_r}{SAY:sunflower}Happy Valentine's Day! A time for warm hearts, bright petals, and lots of love!
{SAY:peashooter_r}We even decorated the lawn with heart-shaped lights. It looks amazing!
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter_r}{NPC_EXIT:sunflower}{NPC_ENTER:wallnut}{SAY:wallnut}I wrote valentines notes for everyone! Most of them are… drawings of nuts.
{SHOUT:zomboss_r}I shall turn your sweet celebration into a bitter BREAK-UP…
{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}I hope you are all warmed up and cuddled, dear plants...
{NPC_ENTER:peashooter}{NPC_ENTER:zomboss_r}{SAY:zomboss_r}Curses! Foiled by your ridiculous affection-fueled teamwork - again!
{NPC_EXIT:peashooter}{SHOUT:zomboss_r}This isn’t over! Next time, I’ll crush your cuddly little celebrations into dust!
{NPC_EXIT:zomboss_r}{NPC_ENTER:sunflower}{SAY:sunflower}Well, that could’ve gone worse! At least the glowsticks survived!
{NPC_ENTER:wallnut_r}{SAY:wallnut_r}Glowsticks are fun! I cracked one open... it tasted weird.
{SAY:sunflower}Wallnut… you’re not supposed to eat those.

original: {FLAVOR} Meet Rose, the magical maestro! She bounces spells back, turning wizards into woolly wonders. With her Goatify spell, she sheepifies zombies, stalling them with style. Her Plant Food ability transforms entire hordes, making her the garden’s magical defender!
translation: {FLAVOR} 见见魔法指挥家——玫瑰！她能反弹法术，将巫师变成满身羊毛的奇物。她施出“山羊化形”法术，化僵尸为绵羊，优雅地拖住它们的脚步。她的植物养料能力还能把整群敌人统统变形，让她成为花园里最强的魔法卫士！

original: Reflects spells back, turning zombies into sheep and wizards into sheepish wonders!
translation: 反弹法术，把僵尸变成绵羊，把巫师变成绵羊般的奇物！

original: Rose transforms zombies into sheep and reflects spells back at wizards.
translation: 玫瑰可以把僵尸变为绵羊，同时反弹巫师的法术。

original: {KEYWORD}Plant Food: {STAT}Rose unleashes a woolly whirlwind, turning zombie hordes into fluffy sheep with flair!
Turns zombies into sheep and bounces spells back at enemies.
